    54→    }

1→/**
     2→ * useGenerationInvalidation.ts
     3→ * 
     4→ * Centralized hook for invalidating generation-related React Query caches.
     5→ * 
     6→ * Why this exists:
     7→ * - 19 different places were calling invalidateQueries with different combinations
     8→ * - Inconsistent patterns led to stale data or excessive invalidation
     9→ * - No visibility into what triggered invalidations
    10→ * 
    11→ * Usage:
    12→ *   const invalidateGenerations = useInvalidateGenerations();
    13→ *   invalidateGenerations(shotId, { reason: 'delete-image' });
    14→ * 
    15→ * For variant changes (no shotId needed):
    16→ *   invalidateVariantChange(queryClient, { generationId, reason: 'set-primary' });
    17→ * 
    18→ * Scopes:
    19→ * - 'all': All generation-related queries (default)
    20→ * - 'images': Just image data (all-shot-generations, segment-live-timeline)
    21→ * - 'metadata': Just metadata (shot-generations-meta)
    22→ * - 'counts': Just counts (unpositioned-count)
    23→ *
    24→ * Note: Uses queryKeys registry from @/shared/lib/queryKeys for all key references.
    25→ */
    26→
    27→import { useQueryClient, QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    28→import { useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
    29→import { queryKeys } from '../../lib/queryKeys';
    30→
    31→export type InvalidationScope =
    32→  | 'all'           // All generation-related queries for a shot
    33→  | 'images'        // Just image data (all-shot-generations)
    34→  | 'metadata'      // Just metadata (shot-generations-meta)
    35→  | 'counts';       // Just counts (unpositioned-count)
    36→
    37→export interface InvalidationOptions {
    38→  /** Which queries to invalidate. Default: 'all' */
    39→  scope?: InvalidationScope;
    40→  /** Debug reason for logging. Required for traceability. */
    41→  reason: string;
    42→  /** Delay invalidation by this many ms (for batching rapid changes) */
    43→  delayMs?: number;
    44→  /** Also invalidate the 'shots' query for the project (e.g., for thumbnail updates) */
    45→  includeShots?: boolean;
    46→  /** Project ID - required if includeShots is true */
    47→  projectId?: string;
    48→  /** Also invalidate unified-generations at project level */
    49→  includeProjectUnified?: boolean;
    50→}
    51→
    52→/**
    53→ * Options for variant-specific invalidation.
    54→ * Use when a variant is created/updated/set-as-primary.
    55→ */
    56→export interface VariantInvalidationOptions {
    57→  /** Debug reason for logging. Required for traceability. */
    58→  reason: string;
    59→  /** Generation ID that the variant belongs to */
    60→  generationId: string;
    61→  /** Optional: specific shot ID to prioritize (will refetch immediately before global invalidation) */
    62→  shotId?: string;
    63→  /** Optional: project ID for project-scoped unified-generations invalidation */
    64→  projectId?: string;
    65→  /** Delay before invalidation (e.g., 100ms for DB trigger to complete) */
    66→  delayMs?: number;

    86→function performInvalidation(

    88→  shotId: string,
    89→  options: InvalidationOptions
    90→): void {
    91→  const { 
    92→    scope = 'all',

    94→    projectId,
    95→    includeProjectUnified = false
    96→  } = options;
    97→  
    98→  // Debug logging via centralized config
    99→  
   100→  // Invalidate based on scope
   101→  if (scope === 'all' || scope === 'images') {
   102→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](shotId) });
   103→    // NOTE: ['shot-generations'] removed in Phase 3.5 - it was never queried, only invalidated
   104→    // Also invalidate segment-live-timeline so segment video positions update
   105→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](shotId) });
   106→  }
   107→
   108→  if (scope === 'all' || scope === 'metadata') {
   109→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](shotId) });
   110→  }
   111→
   112→  if (scope === 'all' || scope === 'counts') {
   113→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](shotId) });
   114→  }
   115→
   116→  // Optional: include shots query
   117→  if (includeShots && projectId) {

   119→  }
   120→
   121→  // Optional: include project-level unified generations
   122→  if (includeProjectUnified && projectId) {

   124→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](projectId) });

   128→/**
   129→ * Hook that returns a stable invalidation function.
   130→ * Use this in React components/hooks.
   131→ */
   132→export function useInvalidateGenerations() {
   133→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   134→  const timeoutRefs = useRef<Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>>(new Map());
   135→  
   136→  return useCallback((shotId: string, options: InvalidationOptions) => {
   137→    const { delayMs } = options;
   138→    
   139→    // If there's already a pending invalidation for this shotId, clear it
   140→    const existingTimeout = timeoutRefs.current.get(shotId);
   141→    if (existingTimeout) {
   142→      clearTimeout(existingTimeout);
   143→      timeoutRefs.current.delete(shotId);
   144→    }
   145→    
   146→    if (delayMs && delayMs > 0) {
   147→      // Delayed invalidation (useful for batching rapid changes)
   148→      const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
   149→        performInvalidation(queryClient, shotId, options);
   150→        timeoutRefs.current.delete(shotId);
   151→      }, delayMs);
   152→      timeoutRefs.current.set(shotId, timeout);
   153→    } else {
   154→      // Immediate invalidation
   155→      performInvalidation(queryClient, shotId, options);
   156→    }
   157→  }, [queryClient]);
   158→}
   159→
   160→/**
   161→ * Non-hook version for use outside React components (e.g., in event handlers).
   162→ * Requires passing in the queryClient.

   165→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   166→  shotId: string,
   167→  options: InvalidationOptions
   168→): void {
   169→  if (options.delayMs && options.delayMs > 0) {
   170→    setTimeout(() => {
   171→      performInvalidation(queryClient, shotId, options);
   172→    }, options.delayMs);
   173→  } else {
   174→    performInvalidation(queryClient, shotId, options);
   175→  }
   176→}
   177→

   188→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({

1→# Data Fetching System
     2→
     3→**Purpose**: Document which hooks own which data, how mutations invalidate caches, optimistic update patterns, and cache synchronization.
     4→
     5→**Source of Truth**: `src/shared/lib/queryKeys.ts` (all cache keys), `src/shared/hooks/invalidation/useGenerationInvalidation.ts` (invalidation patterns), `src/shared/lib/queryDefaults.ts` (query presets).
     6→
     7→---
     8→
     9→## Query Scopes
    10→
    11→Three intentionally separate scopes for generation data. These are NOT duplication.
    12→
    13→| Scope | Hook | Query Key | Table | Use Case |
    14→|-------|------|-----------|-------|----------|
    15→| Project | `useProjectGenerations` | `['unified-generations', 'project', projectId, ...]` | `generations` | Paginated gallery (GenerationsPane, MediaGallery) |
    16→| Shot | `useShotImages` | `['all-shot-generations', shotId]` | `shot_generations` JOIN `generations` | Timeline, ShotEditor, shot image grids |
    17→| Variant | `useVariants` | `['generation-variants', generationId]` | `generation_variants` | Lightbox variant switching |
    18→
    19→### Derived/selector hooks (no separate queries)
    20→
    21→| Hook | Derives From | Filters |
    22→|------|-------------|---------|
    23→| `useTimelineImages(shotId)` | `useShotImages` | Positioned, non-video, valid location |
    24→| `useUnpositionedImages(shotId)` | `useShotImages` | Null timeline_frame, non-video |
    25→| `useVideoOutputs(shotId)` | `useShotImages` | Video type only |
    26→| `useDerivedItems(generationId)` | Own query `['derived-items', id]` | Edits/children of a generation |
    27→
    28→---
    29→
    30→## Cache Priming & Loading
    31→
    32→`useShotImages` uses a single query to `shot_generations` JOIN `generations` (no multi-phase loading). For instant display on shot navigation, `usePrimeShotGenerationsCache` seeds the cache from `ShotsContext` data before the network query completes.
    33→
    34→| Step | What happens | Source |
    35→|------|-------------|--------|
    36→| 1. Shot selected | Cache primed from `ShotsContext` (no metadata) | `usePrimeShotImagesCache` in `useShotImages.ts` |
    37→| 2. Selectors fire | `useTimelineImages` etc. immediately have data | Derived from primed cache |
    38→| 3. Network query | Full data with metadata replaces primed data | `useShotImages` queryFn |
    39→
    40→### Query Presets (`src/shared/lib/queryDefaults.ts`)
    41→
    42→| Preset | staleTime | Use Case |
    43→|--------|-----------|----------|
    44→| `realtimeBacked` | 30s | Data updated by realtime/mutations (generations, tasks, shots) |
    45→| `static` | 5min | Resources, presets, tool settings |
    46→| `immutable` | Infinity | Completed task results, historical data |
    47→| `userConfig` | 2min | User preferences, account settings |
    48→
    49→---
    50→
    51→## Mutation Ownership
    52→
    53→Mutations live in `useGenerationMutations.ts` (re-exported from `useProjectGenerations.ts` for compatibility).
    54→
    55→| Mutation Hook | Table | Invalidation |
    56→|---------------|-------|-------------|
    57→| `useDeleteGeneration` | `generations` | None (caller invalidates) |
    58→| `useDeleteVariant` | `generation_variants` | None (caller invalidates) |
    59→| `useUpdateGenerationLocation` | `generations` | None (caller invalidates) |
    60→| `useCreateGeneration` | `generations` + `generation_variants` | None (caller invalidates) |
    61→| `useToggleGenerationStar` | `generations` | Optimistic update on `unified-generations`, `shots`, `all-shot-generations` |
    62→
    63→Shot-generation mutations in `useShotGenerationMutations.ts`:
    64→
    65→| Mutation | Table | Optimistic? | Invalidation |
    66→|----------|-------|-------------|-------------|
    67→| `useAddImageToShot` | `shot_generations` | Yes (temp ID, cache update) | shots list, meta, unified |
    68→| `useRemoveImageFromShot` | `shot_generations` | Yes (set frame null) | segment queries |
    69→| `useUpdateShotImageOrder` | `shot_generations` | Yes (reorder frames) | meta, source-slot |
    70→| `useDuplicateAsNewGeneration` | `generations` + `shot_generations` | No | shots, generations, segments |
    71→
    72→Variant mutations in `useVariants.ts`:
    73→
    74→| Mutation | Table | Invalidation |
    75→|----------|-------|-------------|
    76→| `setPrimaryVariant` | `generation_variants` | `invalidateVariantChange()` |
    77→| `deleteVariant` | `generation_variants` | `invalidateVariantChange()` |
    78→
    79→---
    80→
    81→## Optimistic Update Pattern
    82→
    83→Used by shot-generation mutations (`useShotGenerationMutations.ts`). All follow the same structure:
    84→
    85→```
    86→onMutate:  cancel queries -> snapshot previous -> update cache (mark _optimistic)
    87→onError:   rollback from snapshot
    88→onSuccess: replace temp IDs with real IDs -> scoped invalidation
    89→```
    90→
    91→Cache utilities (`src/shared/hooks/shots/cacheUtils.ts`) provide helpers: `cancelShotsQueries`, `updateAllShotsCaches`, `rollbackShotsCaches`, `updateShotGenerationsCache`, `rollbackShotGenerationsCache`.
    92→
    93→Stable callbacks: use refs to prevent recreation storms (avoid `addMutation` in deps).
    94→
    95→---
    96→
    97→## Invalidation Patterns
    98→
    99→### Centralized: `useGenerationInvalidation.ts`
   100→
   101→| Function | When to Use | What It Invalidates |
   102→|----------|------------|-------------------|
   103→| `useInvalidateGenerations()(shotId, opts)` | After shot-scoped changes | `all-shot-generations`, `segment-live-timeline`, `shot-generations-meta`, `unpositioned-count` (scoped by `opts.scope`) |
   104→| `invalidateVariantChange(qc, opts)` | After variant create/update/set-primary | Variants, detail, badges, all shot-generations (broad), unified, derived, segment children/sources |
   105→| `invalidateGenerationUpdate(qc, opts)` | After generation data change (not variant) | Detail, unified, derived, segment children/parents |
   106→| `invalidateAllShotGenerations(qc, reason)` | Global fallback (avoid if possible) | All `all-shot-generations` queries via predicate |
   107→
   108→Scopes for `useInvalidateGenerations`: `'all'` | `'images'` | `'metadata'` | `'counts'`.
   109→
   110→### Realtime invalidation
   111→
   112→Realtime event -> invalidation mapping: see [realtime_system.md](realtime_system.md).
   113→
   114→### Smart Polling (fallback)
   115→
   116→`DataFreshnessManager` + `useSmartPollingConfig` provides intelligent polling when realtime is unhealthy. Hooks opt in via `useSmartPollingConfig(['namespace', id])`.
   117→
   118→---
   119→
   120→## When to Use Which Hook
   121→
   122→| I want to... | Use |
   123→|-------------|-----|
   124→| Show a paginated gallery of all project generations | `useProjectGenerations(projectId, page, limit, enabled, filters)` |
   125→| Show images in a shot's timeline or grid | `useShotImages(shotId)` |
   126→| Get only positioned timeline images | `useTimelineImages(shotId)` |
   127→| Get unpositioned images for a shot | `useUnpositionedImages(shotId)` |
   128→| Get video outputs for a shot | `useVideoOutputs(shotId)` |
   129→| Show/switch variants in lightbox | `useVariants({ generationId })` |
   130→| Show edits/children of a generation | `useDerivedItems(generationId)` |
   131→| Delete/star/create generations | Import from `useGenerationMutations` |
   132→| Add/remove/reorder images in a shot | Import from `useShotGenerationMutations` |
   133→| Invalidate after shot-scoped changes | `useInvalidateGenerations()` |
   134→| Invalidate after variant changes | `invalidateVariantChange()` |
   135→
   136→---
   137→
   138→## Key Invariants
   139→
   140→1. **Three scopes, three hooks** -- project, shot, variant. Don't merge them.
   141→2. **Mutations in dedicated files** -- `useGenerationMutations.ts` and `useShotGenerationMutations.ts`, not in query hooks.
   142→3. **Prefer `queryKeys.*` registry for all query keys** -- ~25 isolated hooks still use inline keys (see `code_quality_audit.md` S2).
   143→4. **Optimistic updates use snapshot + rollback** -- cancel queries first, snapshot for rollback, replace temp IDs on success.
   144→5. **Realtime -> invalidation, not direct cache updates** -- keeps cache consistent with DB.
   145→6. **Smart polling is fallback** -- primary freshness from realtime events.
   146→7. **Cache priming for instant navigation** -- `usePrimeShotGenerationsCache` seeds from context; full data arrives via network query.
   147→
```

     6→/**
     7→ * Filters project-level settings for inheritance into a new project.
     8→ * Content fields (prompts, references) are excluded; configuration settings are kept.
     9→ *
    10→ * INHERITANCE POLICY: Content data doesn't inherit, but configuration settings do.
    11→ */
    12→function filterSettingsForInheritance(
    13→  settings: Record<string, unknown>
    14→): Record<string, unknown> {
    15→  const settingsToInherit: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    16→
    17→  Object.entries(settings).forEach(([toolId, toolSettings]) => {
    18→    if (typeof toolSettings === 'object' && toolSettings !== null) {
    19→      const filteredToolSettings = { ...toolSettings } as Record<string, unknown>;
    20→
    21→      // Remove prompt-related keys
    22→      delete filteredToolSettings.promptsByShot;
    23→      delete filteredToolSettings.prompt;
    24→      delete filteredToolSettings.prompts;
    25→      delete filteredToolSettings.beforeEachPromptText;
    26→      delete filteredToolSettings.afterEachPromptText;
    27→      delete filteredToolSettings.pairConfigs;
    28→
    29→      // Remove reference-related keys
    30→      delete filteredToolSettings.references;
    31→      delete filteredToolSettings.selectedReferenceId;
    32→      delete filteredToolSettings.selectedReferenceIdByShot;
    33→      delete filteredToolSettings.styleReferenceImage;
    34→      delete filteredToolSettings.styleReferenceImageOriginal;
    35→      delete filteredToolSettings.styleReferenceStrength;
    36→      delete filteredToolSettings.subjectStrength;
    37→      delete filteredToolSettings.subjectDescription;
    38→      delete filteredToolSettings.inThisScene;
    39→
    40→      // Remove prompt-editor specific AI settings
    41→      delete filteredToolSettings.generationSettings;
    42→      delete filteredToolSettings.bulkEditSettings;
    43→      delete filteredToolSettings.activeTab;
    44→
    45→      // Filter out any keys containing "prompt" or "reference" (case-insensitive)
    46→      Object.keys(filteredToolSettings).forEach(key => {
    47→        const lowerKey = key.toLowerCase();
    48→        if (lowerKey.includes('prompt') || lowerKey.includes('reference')) {
    49→          delete filteredToolSettings[key];
    50→        }
    51→      });
    52→
    53→      if (Object.keys(filteredToolSettings).length > 0) {
    54→        settingsToInherit[toolId] = filteredToolSettings;
    55→      }
    56→    }
    57→  });
    58→
    59→  return settingsToInherit;
    60→}

1→import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
     2→import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     3→import { GenerationRow } from '@/types/shots';
     4→import type { Task } from '@/types/tasks';
     5→import { preloadGenerationTaskMappings, enhanceGenerationsWithTaskData } from '@/shared/lib/generationTaskBridge';
     6→
     7→// ================================================================
     8→// GENERATION-TASK INTEGRATION CONTEXT
     9→// ================================================================
    10→// This context provides a centralized way for components to work with
    11→// both generation and task data seamlessly. It handles background
    12→// preloading and cache management automatically.
    13→
    14→interface GenerationTaskContextValue {
    15→  // Methods for working with generation-task relationships
    16→  preloadTaskMappings: (generationIds: string[]) => Promise<void>;
    17→  enhanceWithTaskData: (generations: GenerationRow[]) => (GenerationRow & { taskId?: string | null; taskData?: Task | null })[];
    18→  
    19→  // Configuration
    20→  isPreloadingEnabled: boolean;
    21→  setPreloadingEnabled: (enabled: boolean) => void;
    22→}
    23→
    24→const GenerationTaskContext = createContext<GenerationTaskContextValue | null>(null);
    25→
    26→interface GenerationTaskProviderProps {
    27→  children: React.ReactNode;
    28→  
    29→  // Configuration options
    30→  enableBackgroundPreloading?: boolean;
    31→  preloadBatchSize?: number;
    32→  preloadDelay?: number;
    33→}
    34→
    35→export function GenerationTaskProvider({ 
    36→  children, 
    37→  enableBackgroundPreloading = true,
    38→  preloadBatchSize = 5,
    39→  preloadDelay = 200 
    40→}: GenerationTaskProviderProps) {
    41→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    42→  const [isPreloadingEnabled, setPreloadingEnabled] = React.useState(enableBackgroundPreloading);
    43→
    44→  const preloadTaskMappings = React.useCallback(async (generationIds: string[]) => {
    45→    if (!isPreloadingEnabled || generationIds.length === 0) return;
    46→
    47→    try {
    48→      await preloadGenerationTaskMappings(generationIds, queryClient, {
    49→        batchSize: preloadBatchSize,
    50→        delayBetweenBatches: preloadDelay,
    51→        preloadFullTaskData: true, // Preload full task data for better UX
    52→      });
    53→    } catch (error) {
    54→    }
    55→  }, [queryClient, isPreloadingEnabled, preloadBatchSize, preloadDelay]);
    56→
    57→  const enhanceWithTaskData = React.useCallback((generations: GenerationRow[]) => {
    58→    return enhanceGenerationsWithTaskData(generations, queryClient);
    59→  }, [queryClient]);
    60→
    61→  // Memoize context value to prevent unnecessary re-renders of consumers
    62→  const contextValue = useMemo<GenerationTaskContextValue>(() => ({
    63→    preloadTaskMappings,
    64→    enhanceWithTaskData,
    65→    isPreloadingEnabled,
    66→    setPreloadingEnabled,
    67→  }), [preloadTaskMappings, enhanceWithTaskData, isPreloadingEnabled, setPreloadingEnabled]);
    68→
    69→  return (
    70→    <GenerationTaskContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
    71→      {children}
    72→    </GenerationTaskContext.Provider>
    73→  );
    74→}
    75→
    76→// ================================================================
    77→// HOOKS FOR USING THE CONTEXT
    78→// ================================================================
    79→
    80→function useGenerationTaskContext() {
    81→  const context = useContext(GenerationTaskContext);
    82→  if (!context) {
    83→    throw new Error('useGenerationTaskContext must be used within a GenerationTaskProvider');
    84→  }
    85→  return context;
    86→}
    87→
    88→
    89→

1→import { useRef, useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
     2→import { useToolSettings, SettingsScope } from './useToolSettings';
     3→import { deepEqual, sanitizeSettings } from '../lib/deepEqual';
     4→import { toolsManifest } from '@/tools';
     5→import { handleError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandler';
     6→
     7→/**
     8→ * Infer an appropriate "empty" value for a given value based on its type.
     9→ * 
    10→ * IMPORTANT: This is a SAFETY NET for fields that are persisted but don't have
    11→ * explicit defaults defined in their tool's settings.ts file. This prevents stale
    12→ * state from previous projects from persisting when switching projects.
    13→ * 
    14→ * BEST PRACTICE: All persisted fields should have explicit defaults in settings.ts,
    15→ * even if those defaults are empty (e.g., promptsByShot: {}, batchVideoPrompt: '').

   479→export const OnboardingModal: React.FC<OnboardingModalProps> = ({
   480→  isOpen,
   481→  onClose,
   482→}) => {
   483→  const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState(1);
   484→  const [isShaking, setIsShaking] = useState(false);
   485→  const shakeTimeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
   486→  const modal = useMediumModal();
   487→  const { showFade, scrollRef } = useScrollFade({
   488→    isOpen,
   489→    preloadFade: modal.isMobile
   490→  });
   491→
   492→  // Reset to step 1 when modal opens
   493→  useEffect(() => {
   494→    if (isOpen) {
   495→      setCurrentStep(1);
   496→    }
   497→  }, [isOpen]);
   498→
   499→  // Cleanup shake timeout on unmount
   500→  useEffect(() => {
   501→    return () => {
   502→      if (shakeTimeoutRef.current) {
   503→        clearTimeout(shakeTimeoutRef.current);
   504→      }
   505→    };
   506→  }, []);
   507→
   508→  const handleNext = () => {
   509→    setCurrentStep(prev => Math.min(prev + 1, 6));
   510→  };
   511→
   512→  const handleBack = () => {
   513→    setCurrentStep(prev => Math.max(prev - 1, 1));
   514→  };
   515→
   516→  const handleShake = () => {
   517→    setIsShaking(true);
   518→    if (shakeTimeoutRef.current) {
   519→      clearTimeout(shakeTimeoutRef.current);
   520→    }
   521→    shakeTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => setIsShaking(false), 500);
   522→  };
   523→
   524→  // Render current step component conditionally to avoid calling hooks for unused steps
   525→  const renderCurrentStep = () => {
   526→    switch (currentStep) {
   527→      case 1:
   528→        return <IntroductionStep onNext={handleNext} />;
   529→      case 2:
   530→        return <CommunityStep onNext={handleNext} />;
   531→      case 3:
   532→        return <GenerationMethodStep onNext={handleNext} />;
   533→      case 4:
   534→        return <ThemeStep onNext={handleNext} />;
   535→      case 5:
   536→        return <PrivacyDefaultsStep onNext={handleNext} />;
   537→      case 6:
   538→        return <SetupCompleteStep onClose={onClose} />;
   539→      default:
   540→        return <IntroductionStep onNext={handleNext} />;
   541→    }
   542→  };
   543→
   544→  const stepTitles = ["Welcome", "Community", "Generation", "Theme", "Privacy", "Complete"];
   545→  
   546→  return (
   547→    <Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={handleShake}>
   548→      <DialogContent 
   549→        className={modal.className}
   550→        style={modal.style}
   551→      >
   552→        <style>
   553→          {`
   554→            @keyframes shake {
   555→              0%, 100% { transform: translateX(0); }
   556→              10%, 30%, 50%, 70%, 90% { transform: translateX(-8px); }
   557→              20%, 40%, 60%, 80% { transform: translateX(8px); }
   558→            }
   559→            .shake-wrapper {
   560→              animation: shake 0.5s ease-in-out;
   561→            }
   562→          `}
   563→        </style>
   564→        <style>{`
   565→          /* Hide the built-in close button from Dialog component */
   566→          button[data-dialog-close] {
   567→            display: none !important;
   568→          }
   569→        `}</style>
   570→        <div className={`flex flex-col flex-1 min-h-0 ${isShaking ? 'shake-wrapper' : ''}`}>
   571→          <div className={modal.headerClass}></div>
   572→
   573→        <div ref={scrollRef} className={modal.scrollClass}>
   574→          {renderCurrentStep()}
   575→          <div className="h-6"></div>
   576→        </div>
   577→        
   578→        <div className={`${modal.footerClass} relative`}>
   579→          {/* Fade overlay */}
   580→          {showFade && (
   581→            <div 
   582→              className="absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 h-16 pointer-events-none z-10"
   583→              style={{ transform: 'translateY(-64px)' }}
   584→            >
   585→              <div className="h-full bg-gradient-to-t from-white via-white/95 to-transparent dark:from-gray-950 dark:via-gray-950/95 dark:to-transparent" />
   586→            </div>
   587→          )}
   588→
   589→          {/* Step indicator and back button container */}
   590→          <div className="relative flex justify-center gap-x-2 pt-6 pb-2 border-t relative z-20">
   591→            {/* Back button - only show after step 1 */}
   592→            {currentStep > 1 && (
   593→              <button
   594→                onClick={handleBack}
   595→                className="absolute left-0 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/4 rounded-sm opacity-70 ring-offset-background transition-opacity hover:opacity-100 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-2 flex items-center gap-x-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
   596→              >
   597→                <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
   598→                <span>Back</span>

   601→            
   602→            {/* Step indicators */}
   603→            <div className="flex gap-x-2">
   604→              {stepTitles.map((_, index) => (

   607→                  className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full transition-colors ${
   608→                    currentStep === index + 1 ? 'bg-primary' : 'bg-muted'
   609→                  }`}
   610→                />
   611→              ))}
   612→            </div>
   613→            </div>
   614→          </div>

    93→            <span className="text-xs text-white/90">
    94→              {durationInfo}
    95→            </span>

    97→          
    98→          {/* Right: Owner visibility toggle */}

   105→                    onClick={(e) => {

   108→                      onToggleVisibility(resource.id, isPublic);

   110→                    className={`rounded-full p-1 transition-colors focus:outline-none ${

   112→                        ? "bg-green-500 text-white hover:bg-green-600"

   138→
   139→// Image item component matching VideoResourceItem's structure
   140→interface ImageResourceItemProps {
   141→  resource: Resource;
   142→  isOwner: boolean;
   143→  isProcessing: boolean;
   144→  isLoaded: boolean;
   145→  onLoaded: () => void;
   146→  onClick: () => void;
   147→  onToggleVisibility?: (resourceId: string, currentIsPublic: boolean) => void;
   148→}
   149→
   150→const ImageResourceItem: React.FC<ImageResourceItemProps> = ({
   151→  resource,
   152→  isOwner,
   153→  isProcessing,
   154→  isLoaded,
   155→  onLoaded,
   156→  onClick,
   157→  onToggleVisibility,

   169→      onClick={onClick}
   170→    >

   176→            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/20 dark:via-gray-600/20 to-transparent animate-shimmer transform -skew-x-12" />
   177→          </div>
   178→        )}
   179→
   180→        <img
   181→          src={thumbnailUrl}
   182→          alt={resourceName}
   183→          className="w-full h-full object-cover"

   186→          onError={onLoaded}
   187→        />
   188→
   189→        {isProcessing && (
   190→          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/50 flex items-center justify-center">
   191→            <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin text-white" />
   192→          </div>
   193→        )}
   194→        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/0 group-hover:bg-black/20 transition-all pointer-events-none" />
   195→
   196→        {/* Overlay info bar at bottom of image */}
   197→        {isOwner && (
   198→          <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 flex items-center justify-between px-2 py-1.5 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm z-10">
   199→            <span className="text-xs text-white/90">Mine</span>
   200→
   201→            {/* Visibility toggle */}
   202→            {onToggleVisibility ? (
   203→              <TooltipProvider delayDuration={300}>
   204→                <Tooltip>
   205→                  <TooltipTrigger asChild>
   206→                    <button
   207→                      type="button"
   208→                      onClick={(e) => {
   209→                        e.stopPropagation();
   210→                        e.preventDefault();
   211→                        onToggleVisibility(resource.id, isPublic);
   212→                      }}
   213→                      className={`rounded-full p-1 transition-colors focus:outline-none ${
   214→                        isPublic
   215→                          ? "bg-green-500 text-white hover:bg-green-600"
   216→                          : "bg-gray-400 text-white hover:bg-gray-500"
   217→                      }`}
   218→                    >
   219→                      {isPublic ? (
   220→                        <Globe className="h-3 w-3" />
   221→                      ) : (
   222→                        <Lock className="h-3 w-3" />
   223→                      )}
   224→                    </button>
   225→                  </TooltipTrigger>
   226→                  <TooltipContent side="top" className="text-xs">
   227→                    {isPublic
   228→                      ? "Public - visible to others. Click to make private."
   229→                      : "Private - only you can see this. Click to make public."}
   230→                  </TooltipContent>
   231→                </Tooltip>
   232→              </TooltipProvider>

   242→
   243→// =============================================================================
   244→// useResourceBrowsing - Data layer for resource browsing modal
   245→// =============================================================================
   246→
   247→interface UseResourceBrowsingProps {
   248→  isOpen: boolean;
   249→  resourceType: 'style-reference' | 'structure-video';
   250→  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
   251→  onImageSelect?: (files: File[]) => void;
   252→  onResourceSelect?: (resource: Resource) => void;
   253→}
   254→
   255→function useResourceBrowsing({
   256→  isOpen,
   257→  resourceType,
   258→  onOpenChange,
   259→  onImageSelect,
   260→  onResourceSelect,
   261→}: UseResourceBrowsingProps) {
   262→  const isVideoMode = resourceType === 'structure-video';
   263→
   264→  // State
   265→  const [userId, setUserId] = useState<string | null>(null);
   266→  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
   267→  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
   268→  const [processingResource, setProcessingResource] = useState<string | null>(null);
   269→  const [loadedThumbnails, setLoadedThumbnails] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
   270→  const [showMyResourcesOnly, setShowMyResourcesOnly] = useState(false);
   271→
   272→  // Get current user session
   273→  useEffect(() => {
   274→    const getUser = async () => {
   275→      const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
   276→      setUserId(session?.user?.id || null);
   277→    };
   278→    if (isOpen) {
   279→      getUser();
   280→    }
   281→  }, [isOpen, onResourceSelect, onImageSelect, resourceType]);
   282→
   283→  // Fetch resources based on type
   284→  const publicResources = useListPublicResources(resourceType);
   285→  const myResources = useListResources(resourceType);
   286→  const updateResource = useUpdateResource();
   287→
   288→  // Combine and filter resources
   289→  const allResources = useMemo(() => {
   290→    const publicRefs = (publicResources.data || []) as Resource[];
   291→    const myRefs = (myResources.data || []) as Resource[];
   292→    const combined = [...publicRefs];
   293→    const publicIds = new Set(publicRefs.map(r => r.id));
   294→    myRefs.forEach(ref => {
   295→      if (!publicIds.has(ref.id)) {
   296→        combined.push(ref);
   297→      }
   298→    });
   299→    return combined;
   300→  }, [publicResources.data, myResources.data]);
   301→
   302→  // Helper to get searchable text from resource metadata
   303→  const getSearchableText = useCallback((resource: Resource): string => {
   304→    if (isVideoMode) {
   305→      const metadata = resource.metadata as StructureVideoMetadata;
   306→      return metadata.name?.toLowerCase() || '';
   307→    } else {
   308→      const metadata = resource.metadata as StyleReferenceMetadata;
   309→      return [metadata.name, metadata.subjectDescription, metadata.styleBoostTerms]
   310→        .filter(Boolean).join(' ').toLowerCase();
   311→    }
   312→  }, [isVideoMode]);
   313→
   314→  // Filter resources
   315→  const filteredResources = useMemo(() => {
   316→    const base = showMyResourcesOnly ? ((myResources.data || []) as Resource[]) : allResources;
   317→    if (!searchTerm.trim()) return base;
   318→    const lowerSearch = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
   319→    return base.filter(r => getSearchableText(r).includes(lowerSearch));
   320→  }, [allResources, searchTerm, showMyResourcesOnly, myResources.data, getSearchableText]);
   321→
   322→  // Pagination
   323→  const ITEMS_PER_PAGE = 16;
   324→  const totalPages = Math.ceil(filteredResources.length / ITEMS_PER_PAGE);
   325→  const paginatedResources = useMemo(() => {
   326→    const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * ITEMS_PER_PAGE;
   327→    return filteredResources.slice(startIndex, startIndex + ITEMS_PER_PAGE);
   328→  }, [filteredResources, currentPage]);
   329→
   330→  const loading = publicResources.isLoading || myResources.isLoading;
   331→
   332→  const handleSearch = useCallback((newSearchTerm: string) => {
   333→    setSearchTerm(newSearchTerm);
   334→    setCurrentPage(1);
   335→  }, []);
   336→
   337→  const handlePageChange = useCallback((newPage: number) => {
   338→    setCurrentPage(newPage);
   339→  }, []);
   340→
   341→  // Reset to page 1 when filters change
   342→  useEffect(() => {
   343→    setCurrentPage(1);
   344→  }, [searchTerm, showMyResourcesOnly]);
   345→
   346→  const handleToggleVisibility = useCallback(async (resourceId: string, currentIsPublic: boolean) => {
   347→    const resource = allResources.find(r => r.id === resourceId);
   348→    if (!resource) {
   349→      console.error('[ResourceBrowser] Could not find resource:', resourceId);
   350→      return;
   351→    }
   352→    try {
   353→      const updatedMetadata = { ...resource.metadata, is_public: !currentIsPublic };
   354→      await updateResource.mutateAsync({
   355→        id: resourceId,
   356→        type: resourceType,
   357→        metadata: updatedMetadata as ResourceMetadata,
   358→      });
   359→    } catch (error) {
   360→      handleError(error, { context: 'DatasetBrowserModal', toastTitle: 'Failed to update visibility' });
   361→    }
   362→  }, [allResources, updateResource, resourceType]);
   363→
   364→  const handleResourceClick = useCallback(async (resource: Resource) => {
   365→    if (processingResource) return;
   366→    setProcessingResource(resource.id);
   367→    try {
   368→      if (onResourceSelect) {
   369→        onResourceSelect(resource);
   370→        onOpenChange(false);
   371→      } else if (onImageSelect && !isVideoMode) {
   372→        const metadata = resource.metadata as StyleReferenceMetadata;
   373→        const imageUrl = metadata.styleReferenceImageOriginal;
   374→        const filename = `${metadata.name.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, '_')}.png`;
   375→        const file = await processImageUrl(imageUrl, filename);
   376→        onImageSelect([file]);
   377→        onOpenChange(false);
   378→      }
   379→    } catch (error) {
   380→      handleError(error, { context: 'DatasetBrowserModal', toastTitle: 'Failed to process selected resource' });
   381→    } finally {
   382→      setProcessingResource(null);
   383→    }
   384→  }, [processingResource, onImageSelect, onResourceSelect, onOpenChange, isVideoMode]);
   385→
   386→  const clearSearch = useCallback(() => {
   387→    setSearchTerm('');
   388→    setCurrentPage(1);
   389→  }, []);
   390→
   391→  // Reset processing state and loaded thumbnails when modal closes
   392→  useEffect(() => {
   393→    if (!isOpen) {
   394→      setProcessingResource(null);
   395→      setLoadedThumbnails(new Set());
   396→    }
   397→  }, [isOpen]);
   398→
   399→  return {
   400→    isVideoMode,
   401→    userId,
   402→    searchTerm,
   403→    currentPage,
   404→    processingResource,
   405→    loadedThumbnails,
   406→    setLoadedThumbnails,
   407→    showMyResourcesOnly,
   408→    setShowMyResourcesOnly,
   409→    filteredResources,
   410→    paginatedResources,
   411→    totalPages,
   412→    loading,
   413→    handleSearch,
   414→    handlePageChange,
   415→    handleToggleVisibility,
   416→    handleResourceClick,
   417→    clearSearch,
   418→  };
   419→}
   420→
   421→// =============================================================================
   422→// DatasetBrowserModal Component
   423→// =============================================================================
   424→
   425→interface DatasetBrowserModalProps {
   426→  isOpen: boolean;
   427→  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
   428→  resourceType?: 'style-reference' | 'structure-video'; // Type of resources to browse
   429→  title?: string; // Optional custom title
   430→  onImageSelect?: (files: File[]) => void; // Legacy: for file upload flow (style-reference only)
   431→  onResourceSelect?: (resource: Resource) => void; // New: for direct resource reference
   432→}
   433→
   434→export const DatasetBrowserModal: React.FC<DatasetBrowserModalProps> = ({
   435→  isOpen,
   436→  onOpenChange,
   437→  resourceType = 'style-reference',
   438→  title,
   439→  onImageSelect,
   440→  onResourceSelect,
   441→}) => {
   442→  const modal = useLargeModal();
   443→  const { showFade, scrollRef } = useScrollFade({ isOpen });
   444→
   445→  const browsing = useResourceBrowsing({ isOpen, resourceType, onOpenChange, onImageSelect, onResourceSelect });
   446→
   447→  // Dynamic title based on resource type
   448→  const modalTitle = title || (browsing.isVideoMode ? 'Browse Guidance Videos' : 'Browse Style References');
   449→  const resourceLabel = browsing.isVideoMode ? 'video' : 'reference';
   450→  const resourceLabelPlural = browsing.isVideoMode ? 'videos' : 'references';
   451→  const myResourcesLabel = browsing.isVideoMode ? 'My Videos' : 'My References';
   452→
   453→  return (
   454→    <Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
   455→      <DialogContent
   456→        className={modal.className}
   457→        style={modal.style}
   458→      >
   459→        <div className={modal.headerClass}>
   460→          <DialogHeader>
   461→            <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
   462→              {browsing.isVideoMode ? <Video className="h-5 w-5" /> : <ImageIcon className="h-5 w-5" />}
   463→              {modalTitle}
   464→              {browsing.filteredResources.length > 0 && (
   465→                <Badge variant="secondary" className="ml-2">
   466→                  {browsing.filteredResources.length} {browsing.filteredResources.length !== 1 ? resourceLabelPlural : resourceLabel}
   467→                </Badge>
   468→              )}
   469→            </DialogTitle>
   470→          </DialogHeader>
   471→        </div>
   472→
   473→        <div ref={scrollRef} className={modal.scrollClass}>
   474→          {/* Search and Filters */}
   475→          <div className="space-y-4 mb-6">
   476→            {/* Filter Buttons */}
   477→            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
   478→              <Button
   479→                variant={browsing.showMyResourcesOnly ? "default" : "outline"}
   480→                size="sm"
   481→                onClick={() => browsing.setShowMyResourcesOnly(!browsing.showMyResourcesOnly)}
   482→              >
   483→                {myResourcesLabel}
   484→              </Button>
   485→              {browsing.showMyResourcesOnly && (
   486→                <Badge variant="outline">
   487→                  Showing your {resourceLabelPlural} only
   488→                  <X className="h-3 w-3 ml-1 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => browsing.setShowMyResourcesOnly(false)} />
   489→                </Badge>
   490→              )}
   491→            </div>
   492→
   493→            {/* Search */}
   494→            <div className="relative">
   495→              <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 transform -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
   496→              <Input
   497→                placeholder={`Search ${resourceLabelPlural}...`}
   498→                value={browsing.searchTerm}
   499→                onChange={(e) => browsing.handleSearch(e.target.value)}
   500→                className="pl-10"
   501→              />
   502→            </div>
   503→
   504→            {/* Active search indicator */}
   505→            {browsing.searchTerm && (
   506→              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
   507→                <Badge variant="outline">
   508→                  Search: "{browsing.searchTerm}"
   509→                  <X className="h-3 w-3 ml-1 cursor-pointer" onClick={browsing.clearSearch} />
   510→                </Badge>
   511→                <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={browsing.clearSearch}>
   512→                  Clear search
   513→                </Button>
   514→              </div>
   515→            )}
   516→          </div>
   517→
   518→          {/* Loading State - Skeleton Grid */}
   519→          {browsing.loading && (
   520→            <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-3">
   521→              {Array.from({ length: 16 }).map((_, index) => (
   522→                <div
   523→                  key={`skeleton-${index}`}
   524→                  className="relative rounded-lg overflow-hidden border-2 border-transparent"
   525→                >
   526→                  <div className="aspect-square bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-200 via-gray-100 to-gray-200 dark:from-gray-800 dark:via-gray-900 dark:to-gray-800 animate-pulse relative">
   527→                    <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/20 dark:via-gray-600/20 to-transparent animate-shimmer transform -skew-x-12" />
   528→                  </div>
   529→                </div>
   530→              ))}
   531→            </div>
   532→          )}
   533→
   534→          {/* Resources Grid - 4x4 layout */}
   535→          {!browsing.loading && browsing.paginatedResources.length > 0 && (
   536→            <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-3">
   537→              {browsing.paginatedResources.map((resource) => {
   538→                const resourceOwnerId = resource.userId || (resource as Record<string, unknown>).user_id as string | undefined;
   539→                const isOwner = browsing.userId && resourceOwnerId === browsing.userId;
   540→
   541→                if (browsing.isVideoMode) {
   542→                  return (
   543→                    <VideoResourceItem
   544→                      key={resource.id}
   545→                      resource={resource}
   546→                      isOwner={!!isOwner}
   547→                      isProcessing={browsing.processingResource === resource.id}
   548→                      isLoaded={browsing.loadedThumbnails.has(resource.id)}
   549→                      onLoaded={() => browsing.setLoadedThumbnails(prev => new Set(prev).add(resource.id))}
   550→                      onClick={() => browsing.handleResourceClick(resource)}
   551→                      onToggleVisibility={isOwner ? browsing.handleToggleVisibility : undefined}
   552→                    />
   553→                  );
   554→                }
   555→
   556→                return (
   557→                  <ImageResourceItem
   558→                    key={resource.id}
   559→                    resource={resource}
   560→                    isOwner={!!isOwner}
   561→                    isProcessing={browsing.processingResource === resource.id}
   562→                    isLoaded={browsing.loadedThumbnails.has(resource.id)}
   563→                    onLoaded={() => browsing.setLoadedThumbnails(prev => new Set(prev).add(resource.id))}
   564→                    onClick={() => browsing.handleResourceClick(resource)}
   565→                    onToggleVisibility={isOwner ? browsing.handleToggleVisibility : undefined}
   566→                  />
   567→                );
   568→              })}
   569→            </div>
   570→          )}
   571→
   572→          {/* No Results */}
   573→          {!browsing.loading && browsing.paginatedResources.length === 0 && (
   574→            <div className="text-center py-12">
   575→              {browsing.isVideoMode ? (
   576→                <Video className="h-12 w-12 text-muted-foreground mx-auto mb-4" />
   577→              ) : (
   578→                <ImageIcon className="h-12 w-12 text-muted-foreground mx-auto mb-4" />
   579→              )}
   580→              <p className="text-muted-foreground">
   581→                {browsing.filteredResources.length === 0
   582→                  ? (browsing.showMyResourcesOnly
   583→                      ? `You don't have any ${resourceLabelPlural} yet`
   584→                      : `No ${resourceLabelPlural} found`)
   585→                  : "No results on this page"
   586→                }
   587→              </p>
   588→              {browsing.searchTerm && (
   589→                <Button variant="ghost" onClick={browsing.clearSearch} className="mt-2">
   590→                  Clear search to see all {resourceLabelPlural}
   591→                </Button>
   592→              )}
   593→              {browsing.showMyResourcesOnly && (
   594→                <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => browsing.setShowMyResourcesOnly(false)} className="mt-2">
   595→                  Show all {resourceLabelPlural}
   596→                </Button>
   597→              )}
   598→            </div>
   599→          )}
   600→        </div>
   601→
   602→        <div className={`${modal.footerClass} relative`}>
   603→          {/* Fade overlay */}
   604→          {showFade && (
   605→            <div
   606→              className="absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 h-16 pointer-events-none z-10"
   607→              style={{ transform: 'translateY(-64px)' }}
   608→            >
   609→              <div className="h-full bg-gradient-to-t from-white via-white/95 to-transparent dark:from-gray-950 dark:via-gray-950/95 dark:to-transparent" />
   610→            </div>
   611→          )}
   612→
   613→          <DialogFooter className="border-t relative z-20 pt-4">
   614→            {/* Pagination */}
   615→            {browsing.totalPages > 1 && (
   616→              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full md:w-auto md:mr-auto">
   617→                <Button
   618→                  variant="outline"
   619→                  size="sm"
   620→                  onClick={() => browsing.handlePageChange(browsing.currentPage - 1)}
   621→                  disabled={browsing.currentPage === 1}
   622→                  className="flex-1 md:flex-initial"
   623→                >
   624→                  <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
   625→                  Previous
   626→                </Button>
   627→                <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground whitespace-nowrap">
   628→                  Page {browsing.currentPage} of {browsing.totalPages}
   629→                </span>
   630→                <Button
   631→                  variant="outline"
   632→                  size="sm"
   633→                  onClick={() => browsing.handlePageChange(browsing.currentPage + 1)}
   634→                  disabled={browsing.currentPage === browsing.totalPages}
   635→                  className="flex-1 md:flex-initial"
   636→                >
   637→                  Next
   638→                  <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
   639→                </Button>
   640→              </div>
   641→            )}
   642→
   643→            <Button variant="retro" size="retro-sm" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)} className="hidden md:inline-flex">
   644→              Close
   645→            </Button>
   646→          </DialogFooter>
   647→        </div>
   648→      </DialogContent>
   649→    </Dialog>
   650→  );
   651→};

You are refactoring the Reigh codebase. Your task is to fix the imagesPerPrompt silent change bug.

## Problem
In `src/shared/components/ImageGenerationForm/ImageGenerationForm.tsx` (lines ~70-76), switching prompt mode silently resets `imagesPerPrompt`:
```tsx
form.setEffectivePromptMode(mode);
if (mode === 'automated') {
  form.setImagesPerPrompt(8);
} else if (mode === 'managed') {
  form.setImagesPerPrompt(1);
}
```
If a user manually set imagesPerPrompt to 4, switching to managed drops it to 1 silently.

## Fix: Store per-mode values
The fix is to remember the user's imagesPerPrompt setting for each mode separately, so switching modes restores their previous value.

### Steps:
1. Read `ImageGenerationForm.tsx` to understand the current code
2. Read the form hook/context to understand how `imagesPerPrompt` and `effectivePromptMode` are managed (look at the form's hook — likely `useImageGenForm` or similar)
3. Read the settings type definitions to understand what's persisted

Implementation approach:
- Add `automatedImagesPerPrompt` and `managedImagesPerPrompt` as stored values (either in the form state or as refs)
- When switching modes: save current imagesPerPrompt to the outgoing mode's slot, restore from incoming mode's slot
- Default values: automated=8, managed=1 (matching current behavior for first use)
- Use refs (not state) to avoid extra renders — these are just "memory" values

The key change is in the mode-switching handler in ImageGenerationForm.tsx. Find where the prompt mode is toggled and modify that handler.

## Verification
1. Read the modified code and verify: switching automated→managed saves the automated value and restores managed value
2. Verify: switching managed→automated saves the managed value and restores automated value
3. Verify: first-time switching still defaults to 8 (automated) and 1 (managed)

## Rules
- Keep changes minimal — just fix this specific behavior
- Read files before editing
- Don't change the UI or add toasts — just preserve per-mode values

    34→  useContextValue,

    54→
    55→interface UseImageGenFormProps {
    56→  onGenerate: (params: BatchImageGenerationTaskParams) => Promise<string[]> | string[] | void;
    57→  openaiApiKey?: string;
    58→  onShotChange?: (shotId: string | null) => void;

    61→
    62→export function useImageGenForm({
    63→  onGenerate,
    64→  openaiApiKey,
    65→  onShotChange,
    66→  initialShotId,
    67→}: UseImageGenFormProps) {
    68→  // ============================================================================
    69→  // UI State (reducer for modal states, session tracking)
    70→  // ============================================================================
    71→  const { uiState, uiActions } = useFormUIState();
    72→
    73→  const [imagesPerPrompt, setImagesPerPrompt] = useState(8); // Default to 8 for automated mode
    74→  const [promptMultiplier, setPromptMultiplier] = useState(1); // How many images per prompt in automated mode
    75→  const [hiresFixConfigRaw, setHiresFixConfig] = useState<Partial<HiresFixConfig>>({});
    76→  // Always merge with defaults to handle incomplete persisted data
    77→  // Also migrate legacy camelCase field names to snake_case
    78→  const hiresFixConfig = useMemo<HiresFixConfig>(() => {
    79→    const raw = hiresFixConfigRaw as Record<string, unknown>;
    80→    // Migrate legacy camelCase fields if present
    81→    const migrated: Partial<HiresFixConfig> = {
    82→      ...hiresFixConfigRaw,
    83→      // Map old camelCase to new snake_case (prefer new names if both exist)
    84→      base_steps: (raw.base_steps as number) ?? (raw.baseSteps as number),
    85→      hires_scale: (raw.hires_scale as number) ?? (raw.hiresScale as number),
    86→      hires_steps: (raw.hires_steps as number) ?? (raw.hiresSteps as number),
    87→      hires_denoise: (raw.hires_denoise as number) ?? (raw.hiresDenoise as number),
    88→      // Migrate from old single lightning_lora_strength to phase_1 (phase_2 defaults to 0)
    89→      lightning_lora_strength_phase_1: (raw.lightning_lora_strength_phase_1 as number)
    90→        ?? (raw.lightning_lora_strength as number)
    91→        ?? (raw.lightningLoraStrength as number),
    92→      lightning_lora_strength_phase_2: (raw.lightning_lora_strength_phase_2 as number),
    93→    };
    94→    return {
    95→      ...DEFAULT_HIRES_FIX_CONFIG,
    96→      ...migrated,
    97→    };
    98→  }, [hiresFixConfigRaw]);
    99→  // Associated shot for image generation
   100→  const [associatedShotId, setAssociatedShotId] = useState<string | null>(null);
   101→
   102→  // ============================================================================
   103→  // Project Settings & References (extracted hook)
   104→  // ============================================================================
   105→  const {
   106→    selectedProjectId,
   107→    projectAspectRatio,
   108→    projectResolution,
   109→    privacyDefaults,
   110→    isLocalGenerationEnabled,
   111→    projectImageSettings,
   112→    updateProjectImageSettings,
   113→    isLoadingProjectSettings,
   114→    effectiveShotId,
   115→    referencePointers,
   116→    referenceCount,
   117→    selectedReferenceIdByShot,
   118→    selectedReferenceId,
   119→    hydratedReferences,
   120→    displayedReferenceId,
   121→    selectedReference,
   122→    isReferenceDataLoading,
   123→  } = useProjectImageSettings(associatedShotId);
   124→
   125→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   126→
   127→  // Mark that we've visited this page in the session
   128→  useEffect(() => {
   129→    try {
   130→      if (!uiState.hasVisitedImageGeneration && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
   131→        window.sessionStorage.setItem('hasVisitedImageGeneration', 'true');
   132→        uiActions.setHasVisited(true);
   133→      }
   134→    } catch { /* Ignore sessionStorage errors */ }
   135→  }, [uiState.hasVisitedImageGeneration, uiActions]);
   136→
   137→  // Text to prepend/append to every prompt
   138→  const [beforeEachPromptText, setBeforeEachPromptText] = useState("");
   139→  const [afterEachPromptText, setAfterEachPromptText] = useState("");
   140→  // Prompt mode: automated vs managed (default to automated)
   141→  const [promptMode, setPromptMode] = useState<PromptMode>('automated');
   142→  // Local state for prompts when no shot is selected
   143→  const [noShotPrompts, setNoShotPrompts] = useState<PromptEntry[]>([]);
   144→  const [noShotMasterPrompt, setNoShotMasterPrompt] = useState('');
   145→
   146→  // Optimistic button state for immediate feedback: idle → submitting → success → idle
   147→  const automatedSubmitButton = useSubmitButtonState();
   148→
   149→  const { data: shots } = useListShots(selectedProjectId);
   150→  const { createShot, isCreating: isCreatingShot } = useShotCreation();
   151→  const { navigateToShot } = useShotNavigation();
   152→
   153→  // Define generatePromptId before using it in hooks
   154→  const promptIdCounter = useRef(1);
   155→  const generatePromptId = useCallback(() => `prompt-${promptIdCounter.current++}`, []);
   156→
   157→  // AI interaction service for automated prompt generation
   158→  const { generatePrompts: aiGeneratePrompts } = useAIInteractionService({
   159→    apiKey: openaiApiKey,
   160→    generatePromptId,
   161→  });
   162→
   163→  // Fetch public LoRAs from all users
   164→  const { data: availableLoras } = usePublicLoras();
   165→
   166→  // LoRA management using the modularized hook with new generalized approach
   167→  const loraManager = useLoraManager(availableLoras, {
   168→    projectId: selectedProjectId,
   169→    persistenceScope: 'project', // Use new persistence scope
   170→    enableProjectPersistence: true,
   171→    persistenceKey: 'project-loras', // Standardized key shared across all tools
   172→    enableTriggerWords: true,
   173→    onPromptUpdate: setAfterEachPromptText,
   174→    currentPrompt: afterEachPromptText,
   175→    disableAutoLoad: true, // Disable auto-load since we handle our own default logic
   176→  });
   177→
   178→  // Default settings for shot prompts - recomputed when shot changes to pick up fresh localStorage
   179→  // Inheritance chain: localStorage (last edited shot) → project-level settings → hardcoded defaults
   180→  // Reference selection defaults to most-recent reference (handled in auto-select effect)
   181→  // Note: beforeEachPromptText/afterEachPromptText are persisted per-shot but NOT inherited (default empty)
   182→  const shotPromptDefaults = useMemo<ImageGenShotSettings>(() => {
   183→    // Try to load last active shot settings for inheritance
   184→    try {
   185→      const stored = localStorage.getItem('image-gen-last-active-shot-settings');
   186→      if (stored) {
   187→        const parsed = JSON.parse(stored);
   188→        return {
   189→          prompts: [],
   190→          masterPrompt: parsed.masterPrompt || '',
   191→          promptMode: parsed.promptMode || 'automated',
   192→          // IMPORTANT: Do NOT default this to null.
   193→          // null is treated as an explicit override and would suppress the project-level
   194→          // per-shot selection mapping (selectedReferenceIdByShot), leading to "no selection"
   195→          // and jitter/jumps when the user clicks.
   196→          // Leave undefined so we can fall back to project-level mapping until the user picks one.
   197→        };
   198→      }
   199→    } catch {
   200→      // Ignore localStorage errors
   201→    }
   202→    // Fall back to project-level settings if localStorage is empty
   203→    return {
   204→      prompts: [],
   205→      masterPrompt: noShotMasterPrompt || '',
   206→      promptMode: promptMode || 'automated',
   207→    };
   208→  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps -- associatedShotId triggers recompute to pick up fresh localStorage
   209→  }, [associatedShotId, noShotMasterPrompt, promptMode]);
   210→
   211→  // Shot-specific prompts using per-shot storage
   212→  const shotPromptSettings = useAutoSaveSettings<ImageGenShotSettings>({
   213→    toolId: 'image-gen-prompts',
   214→    shotId: associatedShotId,
   215→    projectId: selectedProjectId,
   216→    scope: 'shot',
   217→    defaults: shotPromptDefaults,
   218→    enabled: !!associatedShotId,
   219→  });
   220→
   221→  // Project-level settings (NOT shot-specific)
   222→  // Note: promptMode here is the fallback when no shot is selected
   223→  // beforeEachPromptText/afterEachPromptText persist but default to empty (not inherited from other shots)
   224→  const { ready, markAsInteracted } = usePersistentToolState<PersistedFormSettings>(
   225→    TOOL_IDS.IMAGE_GENERATION,
   226→    { projectId: selectedProjectId },
   227→    {
   228→      imagesPerPrompt: [imagesPerPrompt, setImagesPerPrompt],
   229→      selectedLoras: [loraManager.selectedLoras, loraManager.setSelectedLoras],
   230→      beforeEachPromptText: [beforeEachPromptText, setBeforeEachPromptText],
   231→      afterEachPromptText: [afterEachPromptText, setAfterEachPromptText],
   232→      associatedShotId: [associatedShotId, setAssociatedShotId],
   233→      promptMode: [promptMode, setPromptMode],
   234→      prompts: [noShotPrompts, setNoShotPrompts], // Persist no-shot prompts
   235→      masterPrompt: [noShotMasterPrompt, setNoShotMasterPrompt], // Persist no-shot master prompt
   236→      hiresFixConfig: [hiresFixConfig, setHiresFixConfig],
   237→    }
   238→  );
   239→
   240→  // ============================================================================
   241→  // Generation Source & Model Selection (extracted hook)
   242→  // ============================================================================
   243→  const {
   244→    generationSource,
   245→    selectedTextModel,
   246→    generationSourceRef,
   247→    selectedTextModelRef,
   248→    handleGenerationSourceChange,
   249→    handleTextModelChange,
   250→  } = useGenerationSource({
   251→    projectImageSettings,
   252→    isLoadingProjectSettings,
   253→    updateProjectImageSettings,
   254→    markAsInteracted,
   255→    loraManager: {
   256→      selectedLoras: loraManager.selectedLoras,
   257→      setSelectedLoras: loraManager.setSelectedLoras,
   258→    },
   259→    setHiresFixConfig,
   260→  });
   261→
   262→  // ============================================================================
   263→  // Prompt Management (extracted hook)
   264→  // ============================================================================
   265→  const {
   266→    prompts,
   267→    masterPromptText,
   268→    effectivePromptMode,
   269→    currentBeforePromptText,
   270→    currentAfterPromptText,
   271→    actionablePromptsCount,
   272→    lastKnownPromptCount,
   273→    setPrompts,
   274→    setMasterPromptText,
   275→    setEffectivePromptMode,
   276→    setCurrentBeforePromptText,
   277→    setCurrentAfterPromptText,
   278→    handleAddPrompt,
   279→    handleUpdatePrompt,
   280→    handleRemovePrompt,
   281→    handleDeleteAllPrompts,
   282→    handleSavePromptsFromModal,
   283→  } = usePromptManagement({
   284→    associatedShotId,
   285→    effectiveShotId,
   286→    shotPromptSettings: {
   287→      entityId: shotPromptSettings.entityId,
   288→      status: shotPromptSettings.status,
   289→      settings: shotPromptSettings.settings,
   290→      updateField: shotPromptSettings.updateField,
   291→    },
   292→    noShotPrompts,
   293→    setNoShotPrompts,
   294→    noShotMasterPrompt,
   295→    setNoShotMasterPrompt,
   296→    promptMode,
   297→    setPromptMode,
   298→    beforeEachPromptText,
   299→    setBeforeEachPromptText,
   300→    afterEachPromptText,
   301→    setAfterEachPromptText,
   302→    ready,
   303→    markAsInteracted,
   304→    generatePromptId,
   305→  });
   306→
   307→  // ============================================================================
   308→  // Reference Management (extracted hook)
   309→  // ============================================================================
   310→  const {
   311→    styleReferenceStrength,
   312→    subjectStrength,
   313→    subjectDescription,
   314→    inThisScene,
   315→    inThisSceneStrength,
   316→    referenceMode,
   317→    styleBoostTerms,
   318→    isUploadingStyleReference,
   319→    styleReferenceImageDisplay,
   320→    styleReferenceImageGeneration,
   321→    handleStyleReferenceUpload,
   322→    handleResourceSelect,
   323→    handleSelectReference,
   324→    handleDeleteReference,
   325→    handleUpdateReferenceName,
   326→    handleToggleVisibility,
   327→    handleRemoveStyleReference,
   328→    handleStyleStrengthChange,
   329→    handleSubjectStrengthChange,
   330→    handleSubjectDescriptionChange,
   331→    handleSubjectDescriptionFocus,
   332→    handleSubjectDescriptionBlur,
   333→    handleInThisSceneChange,
   334→    handleInThisSceneStrengthChange,
   335→    handleStyleBoostTermsChange,
   336→    handleReferenceModeChange,
   337→  } = useReferenceManagement({
   338→    selectedProjectId,
   339→    effectiveShotId,
   340→    selectedReferenceId,
   341→    selectedReferenceIdByShot,
   342→    referencePointers,
   343→    hydratedReferences,
   344→    selectedReference,
   345→    isLoadingProjectSettings,
   346→    isLocalGenerationEnabled,
   347→    updateProjectImageSettings,
   348→    markAsInteracted,
   349→    privacyDefaults,
   350→    associatedShotId,
   351→    shotPromptSettings: {
   352→      updateField: shotPromptSettings.updateField,
   353→    },
   354→    setHiresFixConfig,
   355→  });
   356→
   357→  const effectiveSubjectDescription = subjectDescription.trim() || 'this character';
   358→
   359→  // ============================================================================
   360→  // Form Submission (extracted hook)
   361→  // ============================================================================
   362→  const {
   363→    handleSubmit,
   364→    handleGenerateAndQueue,
   365→    handleUseExistingPrompts,
   366→    handleNewPromptsLikeExisting,
   367→  } = useFormSubmission({
   368→    selectedProjectId,
   369→    prompts,
   370→    imagesPerPrompt,
   371→    promptMultiplier,
   372→    associatedShotId,
   373→    currentBeforePromptText,
   374→    currentAfterPromptText,
   375→    styleBoostTerms,
   376→    isLocalGenerationEnabled,
   377→    hiresFixConfig,
   378→    effectivePromptMode,
   379→    masterPromptText,
   380→    actionablePromptsCount,
   381→    generationSourceRef,
   382→    selectedTextModelRef,
   383→    styleReferenceImageGeneration,
   384→    styleReferenceStrength,
   385→    subjectStrength,
   386→    effectiveSubjectDescription,
   387→    inThisScene,
   388→    inThisSceneStrength,
   389→    referenceMode,
   390→    aiGeneratePrompts,
   391→    onGenerate,
   392→    setPrompts,
   393→    automatedSubmitButton,
   394→  });
   395→
   396→  // Apply initialShotId once after hydration (takes precedence over persisted value)
   397→  // If initialShotId is explicitly null, reset to None (opened from outside shot context)
   398→  // IMPORTANT: Do NOT call markAsInteracted() here - initialShotId is a temporary context
   399→  // override (e.g., from modal opened in shot context), not a user preference to persist.
   400→  // The tool page's persisted shot selection should only change when explicitly changed by user.
   401→  const hasAppliedInitialShotId = useRef(false);
   402→  useEffect(() => {
   403→    // Only apply once, after hydration is complete
   404→    // Only override when initialShotId is a specific shot ID (truthy string)
   405→    // null or undefined = keep the persisted value from project settings
   406→    if (ready && !hasAppliedInitialShotId.current && shots) {
   407→      if (initialShotId) {
   408→        // initialShotId was provided as a specific shot - set to that shot if it exists
   409→        const shotExists = shots.some(shot => shot.id === initialShotId);
   410→        if (shotExists && associatedShotId !== initialShotId) {
   411→          setAssociatedShotId(initialShotId);
   412→          // Don't persist - this is a temporary context override
   413→        }
   414→      }
   415→      // If initialShotId is null/undefined, keep the persisted value from project settings
   416→      hasAppliedInitialShotId.current = true;
   417→    }
   418→  }, [ready, initialShotId, shots, associatedShotId]);
   419→
   420→  // Reset associatedShotId if the selected shot no longer exists (e.g., was deleted)
   421→  useEffect(() => {
   422→    if (associatedShotId && shots) {
   423→      const shotExists = shots.some(shot => shot.id === associatedShotId);
   424→      if (!shotExists) {
   425→        setAssociatedShotId(null);
   426→        markAsInteracted();
   427→      }
   428→    }
   429→  }, [associatedShotId, shots, markAsInteracted]);
   430→
   431→  // ============================================================================
   432→  // LORA Handlers (extracted hook)
   433→  // ============================================================================
   434→  const {
   435→    handleAddLora,
   436→    handleRemoveLora,
   437→    handleLoraStrengthChange,
   438→  } = useLoraHandlers({
   439→    loraManager: {
   440→      selectedLoras: loraManager.selectedLoras,
   441→      handleAddLora: loraManager.handleAddLora,
   442→      handleRemoveLora: loraManager.handleRemoveLora,
   443→      handleLoraStrengthChange: loraManager.handleLoraStrengthChange,
   444→      handleLoadProjectLoras: loraManager.handleLoadProjectLoras,
   445→    },
   446→    markAsInteracted,
   447→    generationSource,
   448→    selectedTextModel,
   449→    projectImageSettings,
   450→    updateProjectImageSettings,
   451→  });
   452→
   453→  // Handle creating a new shot
   454→  const handleCreateShot = useCallback(async (shotName: string, files: File[]) => {
   455→    // Use unified shot creation - handles inheritance, events, lastAffected automatically
   456→    const result = await createShot({
   457→      name: shotName,
   458→      files: files.length > 0 ? files : undefined,
   459→      dispatchSkeletonEvents: false, // No skeleton needed in form context
   460→      onSuccess: () => {
   461→        // Invalidate and refetch shots to update the list
   462→        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](selectedProjectId!) });
   463→        queryClient.refetchQueries({ [REDACTED](selectedProjectId!) });
   464→      },
   465→    });
   466→
   467→    if (!result) {
   468→      // Error already shown by useShotCreation
   469→      return;
   470→    }
   471→
   472→    // Note: Settings inheritance is handled automatically by useShotCreation
   473→
   474→    // Switch to the newly created shot
   475→    markAsInteracted();
   476→    setAssociatedShotId(result.shotId);
   477→    uiActions.setCreateShotModalOpen(false);
   478→  }, [createShot, markAsInteracted, queryClient, selectedProjectId, uiActions]);
   479→
   480→  // Optimize event handlers with useCallback to prevent recreating on each render
   481→  const handleSliderChange = useCallback((setter: Dispatch<SetStateAction<number>>) => (value: number) => {
   482→    markAsInteracted();
   483→    setter(value);
   484→  }, [markAsInteracted]);
   485→
   486→  // Ensure the `promptIdCounter` is always ahead of any existing numeric IDs.
   487→  // This prevents duplicate IDs which caused multiple prompts to update together.
   488→  useEffect(() => {
   489→    let nextId = prompts.reduce((max, p) => {
   490→      const match = /^prompt-(\d+)$/.exec(p.id || "");
   491→      if (match) {
   492→        const num = parseInt(match[1], 10) + 1;
   493→        return num > max ? num : max;
   494→      }
   495→      return max;
   496→    }, 1);
   497→
   498→    // Resolve any duplicate IDs on the fly by assigning new ones.
   499→    const seen = new Set<string>();
   500→    let hadDuplicates = false;
   501→    const dedupedPrompts = prompts.map(prompt => {
   502→      if (!seen.has(prompt.id)) {
   503→        seen.add(prompt.id);
   504→        return prompt;
   505→      }
   506→      hadDuplicates = true;
   507→      // Duplicate found – give it a fresh ID.
   508→      const newId = `prompt-${nextId++}`;
   509→      seen.add(newId);
   510→      return { ...prompt, id: newId };
   511→    });
   512→
   513→    if (hadDuplicates) {
   514→      setPrompts(dedupedPrompts);
   515→    }
   516→
   517→    if (nextId > promptIdCounter.current) {
   518→      promptIdCounter.current = nextId;
   519→    }
   520→  }, [prompts, setPrompts]);
   521→
   522→  // Handle shot change with proper prompt initialization
   523→  const handleShotChange = (value: string) => {
   524→    markAsInteracted();
   525→    const newShotId = value === "none" ? null : value;
   526→
   527→    // usePersistentToolState auto-syncs associatedShotId to DB
   528→    setAssociatedShotId(newShotId);
   529→
   530→    // Call the parent callback if provided
   531→    if (onShotChange) {
   532→      onShotChange(newShotId);
   533→    }
   534→
   535→    // Note: Prompts for the new shot will be loaded automatically via useAutoSaveSettings
   536→    // and initialized if empty via the initialization effect
   537→  };
   538→
   539→  // ============================================================================
   540→  // Context Value (for sections to pull from)
   541→  // ============================================================================
   542→
   543→  const coreState = useMemo<FormCoreState>(() => ({
   544→    selectedProjectId,
   545→    associatedShotId,
   546→    effectiveShotId,
   547→    isGenerating: automatedSubmitButton.isSubmitting,
   548→    ready,
   549→  }), [selectedProjectId, associatedShotId, effectiveShotId, automatedSubmitButton.isSubmitting, ready]);
   550→
   551→  const promptState = useMemo<FormPromptState>(() => ({
   552→    prompts,
   553→    masterPromptText,
   554→    effectivePromptMode,
   555→    actionablePromptsCount,
   556→    currentBeforePromptText,
   557→    currentAfterPromptText,
   558→    lastKnownPromptCount,
   559→  }), [prompts, masterPromptText, effectivePromptMode, actionablePromptsCount, currentBeforePromptText, currentAfterPromptText, lastKnownPromptCount]);
   560→
   561→  const promptHandlersValue = useMemo<FormPromptHandlers>(() => ({
   562→    setPrompts,
   563→    setMasterPromptText,
   564→    setEffectivePromptMode,
   565→    setCurrentBeforePromptText,
   566→    setCurrentAfterPromptText,
   567→    handleAddPrompt,
   568→    handleUpdatePrompt,
   569→    handleRemovePrompt,
   570→    handleDeleteAllPrompts,
   571→    markAsInteracted,
   572→  }), [setPrompts, setMasterPromptText, setEffectivePromptMode, setCurrentBeforePromptText, setCurrentAfterPromptText, handleAddPrompt, handleUpdatePrompt, handleRemovePrompt, handleDeleteAllPrompts, markAsInteracted]);
   573→
   574→  const referenceState = useMemo<FormReferenceState>(() => ({
   575→    references: hydratedReferences,
   576→    selectedReferenceId: displayedReferenceId,
   577→    referenceMode,
   578→    styleReferenceStrength,
   579→    subjectStrength,
   580→    subjectDescription,
   581→    inThisScene,
   582→    inThisSceneStrength,
   583→    styleBoostTerms,

     4→import type { Task } from '@/types/tasks';

     6→
     7→// ================================================================
     8→// GENERATION-TASK INTEGRATION CONTEXT
     9→// ================================================================
    10→// This context provides a centralized way for components to work with
    11→// both generation and task data seamlessly. It handles background
    12→// preloading and cache management automatically.
    13→
    14→interface GenerationTaskContextValue {
    15→  // Methods for working with generation-task relationships
    16→  preloadTaskMappings: (generationIds: string[]) => Promise<void>;
    17→  enhanceWithTaskData: (generations: GenerationRow[]) => (GenerationRow & { taskId?: string | null; taskData?: Task | null })[];
    18→  
    19→  // Configuration
    20→  isPreloadingEnabled: boolean;
    21→  setPreloadingEnabled: (enabled: boolean) => void;
    22→}
    23→
    24→const GenerationTaskContext = createContext<GenerationTaskContextValue | null>(null);
    25→
    26→interface GenerationTaskProviderProps {
    27→  children: React.ReactNode;
    28→  
    29→  // Configuration options
    30→  enableBackgroundPreloading?: boolean;
    31→  preloadBatchSize?: number;
    32→  preloadDelay?: number;
    33→}
    34→
    35→export function GenerationTaskProvider({ 
    36→  children, 
    37→  enableBackgroundPreloading = true,
    38→  preloadBatchSize = 5,
    39→  preloadDelay = 200 
    40→}: GenerationTaskProviderProps) {
    41→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    42→  const [isPreloadingEnabled, setPreloadingEnabled] = React.useState(enableBackgroundPreloading);
    43→
    44→  const preloadTaskMappings = React.useCallback(async (generationIds: string[]) => {
    45→    if (!isPreloadingEnabled || generationIds.length === 0) return;
    46→
    47→    try {
    48→      await preloadGenerationTaskMappings(generationIds, queryClient, {
    49→        batchSize: preloadBatchSize,
    50→        delayBetweenBatches: preloadDelay,
    51→        preloadFullTaskData: true, // Preload full task data for better UX
    52→      });
    53→    } catch (error) {
    54→    }
    55→  }, [queryClient, isPreloadingEnabled, preloadBatchSize, preloadDelay]);
    56→
    57→  const enhanceWithTaskData = React.useCallback((generations: GenerationRow[]) => {
    58→    return enhanceGenerationsWithTaskData(generations, queryClient);
    59→  }, [queryClient]);
    60→
    61→  // Memoize context value to prevent unnecessary re-renders of consumers
    62→  const contextValue = useMemo<GenerationTaskContextValue>(() => ({
    63→    preloadTaskMappings,
    64→    enhanceWithTaskData,
    65→    isPreloadingEnabled,
    66→    setPreloadingEnabled,
    67→  }), [preloadTaskMappings, enhanceWithTaskData, isPreloadingEnabled, setPreloadingEnabled]);
    68→

    74→}

     4→ * Centralized hook for invalidating generation-related React Query caches.
     5→ * 
     6→ * Why this exists:
     7→ * - 19 different places were calling invalidateQueries with different combinations
     8→ * - Inconsistent patterns led to stale data or excessive invalidation
     9→ * - No visibility into what triggered invalidations
