```
    12→ *   const invalidateGenerations = useInvalidateGenerations();
    13→ *   invalidateGenerations(shotId, { reason: 'delete-image' });
    14→ * 
    15→ * For variant changes (no shotId needed):
    16→ *   invalidateVariantChange(queryClient, { generationId, reason: 'set-primary' });
    17→ * 
    18→ * Scopes:
    19→ * - 'all': All generation-related queries (default)
    20→ * - 'images': Just image data (all-shot-generations, segment-live-timeline)
    21→ * - 'metadata': Just metadata (shot-generations-meta)
    22→ * - 'counts': Just counts (unpositioned-count)

    37→export interface InvalidationOptions {

    40→  /** Debug reason for logging. Required for traceability. */
    41→  reason: string;

    96→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](shotId) });
    97→  }

   115→/**

   119→export function useInvalidateGenerations() {
   120→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   121→  const timeoutRefs = useRef<Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>>(new Map());
   122→  
   123→  return useCallback((shotId: string, options: InvalidationOptions) => {
   124→    const { delayMs } = options;
   125→

   127→    const existingTimeout = timeoutRefs.current.get(shotId);
   128→    if (existingTimeout) {
   129→      clearTimeout(existingTimeout);
   130→      timeoutRefs.current.delete(shotId);
   131→    }
   132→    
   133→    if (delayMs && delayMs > 0) {
   134→      // Delayed invalidation (useful for batching rapid changes)
   135→      const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
   136→        performInvalidation(queryClient, shotId, options);
   137→        timeoutRefs.current.delete(shotId);
   138→      }, delayMs);
   139→      timeoutRefs.current.set(shotId, timeout);
   140→    } else {
   141→      // Immediate invalidation
   142→      performInvalidation(queryClient, shotId, options);
   143→    }
   144→  }, [queryClient]);

   157→    setTimeout(() => {
   158→      performInvalidation(queryClient, shotId, options);
   159→    }, options.delayMs);
   160→  } else {
   161→    performInvalidation(queryClient, shotId, options);
   162→  }

   190→ * @param queryClient - React Query client
   191→ * @param options - Invalidation options including generationId and reason
   192→ */
   193→export async function invalidateVariantChange(
   194→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   195→  options: VariantInvalidationOptions
   196→): Promise<void> {
   197→  const { generationId, shotId, projectId, delayMs } = options;
   198→  
   199→  // Apply delay if specified (e.g., for DB trigger to complete)
   200→  if (delayMs && delayMs > 0) {
   201→    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, delayMs));
   202→  }
   203→  
   204→  // 1. Invalidate variant-specific queries
   205→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](generationId) });
   206→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](generationId) });
   207→  // Also invalidate variant-badges so the "X new" badges update
   208→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   209→
   210→  // 2. If we know the shot, refetch it immediately for faster UI update
   211→  if (shotId) {
   212→    await queryClient.refetchQueries({ [REDACTED](shotId) });
   213→  }
   214→
   215→  // 3. Invalidate all shot-generations (generation might be in multiple shots)
   216→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   217→    predicate: (query) => query.queryKey[0] === queryKeys.generations.byShotAll[0]
   218→  });
   219→  // NOTE: ['shot-generations'] removed - it was never queried, only invalidated
   220→
   221→  // 4. Invalidate generation galleries - cover ALL key patterns for compatibility
   222→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   223→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   224→  // Derived items (variants/generations "based on this")
   225→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   226→
   227→  // 5. If projectId provided, also invalidate project-scoped queries
   228→  if (projectId) {
   229→    // Partial key match for project-scoped unified generations
   230→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](projectId) });
   231→  }
   232→
   233→  // 6. Invalidate segment output queries (for timeline segment strip)
   234→  // This ensures variant changes are reflected in the segment strip
   235→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   236→    predicate: (query) => query.queryKey[0] === queryKeys.segments.childrenAll[0]
   237→  });
   238→
   239→  // 7. Invalidate source image change detection (for video warning indicators)
   240→  // This ensures warnings appear immediately when source images change
   241→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   242→    predicate: (query) => query.queryKey[0] === queryKeys.segments.sourceSlotAll[0]
   243→  });
```

You are refactoring the Reigh codebase. Your task is to merge the double query in complete_task into a single query.

## Problem

In `supabase/functions/complete_task/index.ts` (lines ~42-81), there are two sequential queries:

```ts
// Query 1: Fetch task
const { data: task } = await supabase
  .from("tasks")
  .select(`id, task_type, project_id, params`)
  .eq("id", taskId)
  .single();

// Query 2: Fetch task_types metadata  
const { data: typeData } = await supabase
  .from("task_types")
  .select("tool_type, category, content_type, variant_type")
  .eq("name", task.task_type)
  .single();
```

A comment says "no FK relationship exists" but you CAN join on string columns with Supabase.

## Fix

### Step 1: Check if an FK constraint exists
Look in `supabase/migrations/` for any migration that creates a foreign key from `tasks.task_type` to `task_types.name`. Search for `tasks_task_type_fkey` or similar.

### Step 2: If FK exists, merge into single query:
```ts
const { data: task } = await supabase
  .from("tasks")
  .select(`id, task_type, project_id, params, task_types!tasks_task_type_fkey(tool_type, category, content_type, variant_type)`)
  .eq("id", taskId)
  .single();
```

Then update downstream code to access type data as `task.task_types` instead of a separate `typeData` variable.

### Step 3: If NO FK exists, create a migration:
Create a new migration file in `supabase/migrations/` with the FK constraint:
```sql
ALTER TABLE tasks ADD CONSTRAINT tasks_task_type_fkey 
  FOREIGN KEY (task_type) REFERENCES task_types(name);
```
Then do the query merge as in Step 2.

### Step 4: Update all downstream code
After merging, everywhere that references `typeData` or the separate type query result needs to reference the joined data instead. Read the entire file to find all usages.

## Important
- Read the full `complete_task/index.ts` file first to understand all downstream usage of both `task` and `typeData`
- Also read `generation.ts`, `generation-handlers.ts`, `generation-child.ts` in the same directory — they may receive the task data
- Make sure the merged result shape works for all consumers
- The task_types data is used to determine `tool_type`, `category`, `content_type`, `variant_type`

## Verification
1. Check that all references to the old `typeData` variable are updated
2. Verify the join syntax is correct for Supabase PostgREST
3. No orphaned variables or unused imports

## Rules
- Read the complete file before editing
- Don't change any logic — only merge the queries
- Keep error handling intact

```
   101→ * MODE 4 (REFERENCE EXISTING PATH):
   102→ *   Body: { task_id, storage_path: "user_id/filename", ... }
   103→ */
   104→export interface CompleteTaskDeps {
   105→  /**
   106→   * Override Supabase client factory for tests.
   107→   */
   108→  createClient?: (supabaseUrl: string, serviceKey: string) => any;
   109→  /**
   110→   * Provide a pre-constructed Supabase client (bypasses createClient).
   111→   */
   112→  supabaseAdmin?: any;
   113→  /**
   114→   * Override auth + ownership utilities for tests.
   115→   */
   116→  authenticateRequest?: typeof authenticateRequest;
   117→  verifyTaskOwnership?: typeof verifyTaskOwnership;
   118→  getTaskUserId?: typeof getTaskUserId;
   119→  /**
   120→   * Override logger implementation for tests.
   121→   */
   122→  LoggerClass?: typeof SystemLogger;
   123→  /**
   124→   * Override env var access for tests.
   125→   */
   126→  env?: { get: (key: string) => string | undefined };
   127→}
   128→
   129→export async function completeTaskHandler(req: Request, deps: CompleteTaskDeps = {}): Promise<Response> {
   130→  if (req.method !== "POST") {
   131→    return new Response("Method not allowed", { status: 405 });
   132→  }
   133→
   134→  // 1) Parse and validate request
   135→  const parseResult = await parseCompleteTaskRequest(req);
   136→  if (!parseResult.success) {
   137→    return parseResult.response;
   138→  }
   139→  const parsedRequest = parseResult.data;
   140→  const taskIdString = parsedRequest.taskId;
   141→
   142→  console.log(`[COMPLETE-TASK] Processing task ${taskIdString} (mode: ${parsedRequest.mode})`);
   143→
   144→  // 2) Get environment variables and create Supabase client
   145→  const env = deps.env ?? Deno.env;
   146→  const serviceKey = env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY");
   147→  const supabaseUrl = env.get("SUPABASE_URL");
   148→  if (!serviceKey || !supabaseUrl) {
   149→    console.error("Missing required environment variables");
   150→    return new Response("Server configuration error", { status: 500 });
   151→  }
   152→  const createClientFn = deps.createClient ?? createClient;
   153→  const supabaseAdmin = deps.supabaseAdmin ?? createClientFn(supabaseUrl, serviceKey);
   154→  
   155→  // Create logger
   156→  const LoggerClass = deps.LoggerClass ?? SystemLogger;
   157→  const logger = new LoggerClass(supabaseAdmin, 'complete-task', taskIdString);
   158→  logger.info("Processing task", { 
   159→    task_id: taskIdString, 
   160→    mode: parsedRequest.mode,
   161→    filename: parsedRequest.filename
   162→  });
   163→
   164→  // 3) Security check: Validate storage path for orchestrator references
   165→  if (parsedRequest.requiresOrchestratorCheck && parsedRequest.storagePath) {
   166→    const securityResult = await validateStoragePathSecurity(
   167→      supabaseAdmin,
   168→      taskIdString,
   169→      parsedRequest.storagePath,
   170→      parsedRequest.storagePathTaskId
   171→    );
   172→    if (!securityResult.allowed) {
   173→      logger.error("Storage path security check failed", { error: securityResult.error });
   174→      await logger.flush();
   175→      return new Response(securityResult.error || "Access denied", { status: 403 });
   176→    }
   177→  }
   178→
   179→  // 4) Authenticate request
   180→  const authenticateFn = deps.authenticateRequest ?? authenticateRequest;
   181→  const auth = await authenticateFn(req, supabaseAdmin, "[COMPLETE-TASK]");
   182→  if (!auth.success) {
   183→    logger.error("Authentication failed", { error: auth.error });
   184→    await logger.flush();
   185→    return new Response(auth.error || "Authentication failed", { status: auth.statusCode || 403 });
   186→  }
   187→
   188→  const isServiceRole = auth.isServiceRole;
   189→  const callerId = auth.userId;
   190→
   191→  try {
   192→    // 5) Verify task ownership if user token
   193→    if (!isServiceRole && callerId) {
   194→      const verifyOwnershipFn = deps.verifyTaskOwnership ?? verifyTaskOwnership;
   195→      const ownershipResult = await verifyOwnershipFn(supabaseAdmin, taskIdString, callerId, "[COMPLETE-TASK]");
   196→      if (!ownershipResult.success) {
   197→        return new Response(ownershipResult.error || "Forbidden", { status: ownershipResult.statusCode || 403 });
   198→      }
   199→    }
   200→
   201→    // 6) MODE 4: Verify referenced file exists
   202→    if (parsedRequest.storagePath) {
   203→      const pathParts = parsedRequest.storagePath.split('/');
   204→      const isMode3Format = pathParts.length >= 4 && pathParts[1] === 'tasks';
   205→
   206→      if (!isMode3Format) {
   207→        const fileCheck = await verifyFileExists(supabaseAdmin, parsedRequest.storagePath);
   208→        if (!fileCheck.exists) {
   209→          return new Response("Referenced file does not exist or is not accessible in storage", { status: 404 });
   210→        }
   211→      }
   212→    }
   213→
   214→    // 7) Determine user ID for storage path
   215→    let userId: string;
   216→    if (isServiceRole) {
   217→      const getTaskUserIdFn = deps.getTaskUserId ?? getTaskUserId;
   218→      const taskUserResult = await getTaskUserIdFn(supabaseAdmin, taskIdString, "[COMPLETE-TASK]");
   219→      if (taskUserResult.error) {
   220→        return new Response(taskUserResult.error, { status: taskUserResult.statusCode || 404 });
   221→      }
   222→      userId = taskUserResult.userId!;
   223→    } else {
   224→      userId = callerId!;
   225→    }
   226→
   227→    // 8) Fetch task context once (used by validation, generation creation, orchestrator check)
   228→    const taskContext = await fetchTaskContext(supabaseAdmin, taskIdString);
   229→    if (!taskContext) {
   230→      logger.error("Failed to fetch task context", { task_id: taskIdString });
   231→      await logger.flush();
   232→      return new Response("Task not found", { status: 404 });
   233→    }
   234→    console.log(`[COMPLETE-TASK] Task type: ${taskContext.task_type}, tool_type: ${taskContext.tool_type}`);
   235→
   236→    // 9) Handle storage operations
   237→    const storageResult = await handleStorageOperations(supabaseAdmin, parsedRequest, userId, isServiceRole);
   238→    const { publicUrl, objectPath, thumbnailUrl } = storageResult;
   239→
   240→    // 10) Validate shot references and update params if needed
   241→    console.log(`[COMPLETE-TASK] Validating shot references for task ${taskIdString}`);
   242→    try {
   243→      let updatedParams = { ...taskContext.params };
   244→      let needsParamsUpdate = false;
   245→
   246→      // Validate and cleanup invalid shot_id references
   247→      const shotValidation = await validateAndCleanupShotId(supabaseAdmin, updatedParams, taskContext.tool_type);
   248→      if (shotValidation.needsUpdate) {
   249→        needsParamsUpdate = true;
   250→        updatedParams = shotValidation.updatedParams;
   251→      }
   252→
   253→      // Add thumbnail URL if available
   254→      if (thumbnailUrl) {
   255→        needsParamsUpdate = true;
   256→        updatedParams = setThumbnailInParams(updatedParams, taskContext.task_type, thumbnailUrl);
   257→      }
   258→
   259→      if (needsParamsUpdate) {
   260→        console.log(`[COMPLETE-TASK] Updating task parameters${thumbnailUrl ? ' with thumbnail_url' : ''}${shotValidation.needsUpdate ? ' with cleaned shot references' : ''}`);
   261→        await supabaseAdmin.from("tasks").update({ params: updatedParams }).eq("id", taskIdString);
   262→        
   263→        // Keep in-memory context in sync so downstream steps (generation creation) use updated params
   264→        taskContext.params = updatedParams;
   265→      }
   266→    } catch (validationError) {
   267→      console.error(`[COMPLETE-TASK] Error during validation:`, validationError);
   268→      // Continue anyway - don't fail task completion due to validation errors
   269→    }
   270→
   271→    // 11) Create generation (if applicable)
   272→    const CREATE_GENERATION_IN_EDGE = Deno.env.get("CREATE_GENERATION_IN_EDGE") !== "false";
   273→    if (CREATE_GENERATION_IN_EDGE) {
   274→      try {
   275→        await createGenerationFromTask(
   276→          supabaseAdmin,
   277→          taskContext.id,
   278→          {
   279→            id: taskContext.id,
   280→            task_type: taskContext.task_type,
   281→            project_id: taskContext.project_id,
   282→            params: taskContext.params,
   283→            tool_type: taskContext.tool_type,
   284→            content_type: taskContext.content_type,
   285→            variant_type: taskContext.variant_type,
   286→            category: taskContext.category,
   287→          },
   288→          publicUrl,
   289→          thumbnailUrl,
   290→          logger
   291→        );
   292→      } catch (genErr: any) {
   293→        const msg = genErr?.message || String(genErr);
   294→        logger.error("Generation creation failed", { error: msg });
   295→        await logger.flush();
   296→        // Preserve atomic semantics: do NOT mark the task Complete if generation creation failed.
   297→        return new Response(`Generation creation failed: ${msg}`, { status: 500 });
   298→      }
   299→    }
   300→
   301→    // 12) Update task to Complete
   302→    console.log(`[COMPLETE-TASK] Updating task ${taskIdString} to Complete status`);
   303→    const { error: dbError } = await supabaseAdmin.from("tasks").update({
   304→      status: "Complete",
   305→      output_location: publicUrl,
   306→      generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()
   307→    }).eq("id", taskIdString).eq("status", "In Progress");
   308→
   309→    if (dbError) {
   310→      console.error("[COMPLETE-TASK] Database update error:", dbError);
   311→      await cleanupFile(supabaseAdmin, objectPath);
   312→      return new Response(`Database update failed: ${dbError.message}`, { status: 500 });
   313→    }
   314→
   315→    // 13) Check orchestrator completion (for segment tasks) - uses task context
   316→    try {
   317→      await checkOrchestratorCompletion(
   318→        supabaseAdmin,
   319→        taskIdString,
   320→        taskContext, // Pass context instead of fetching again
   321→        publicUrl,
   322→        supabaseUrl,
   323→        serviceKey
   324→      );
   325→    } catch (orchErr) {
   326→      console.error("[COMPLETE-TASK] Error checking orchestrator completion:", orchErr);
   327→    }
   328→
   329→    // 14) Calculate cost (service role only)
   330→    if (isServiceRole) {
   331→      await triggerCostCalculationIfNotSubTask(supabaseAdmin, supabaseUrl, serviceKey, taskIdString);
   332→    }
   333→
   334→    // 15) Return success
   335→    console.log(`[COMPLETE-TASK] Successfully completed task ${taskIdString}`);
   336→    const responseData = {
   337→      success: true,
   338→      public_url: publicUrl,
   339→      thumbnail_url: thumbnailUrl,
   340→      message: "Task completed and file uploaded successfully"
   341→    };
   342→
   343→    logger.info("Task completed successfully", { 
   344→      task_id: taskIdString,
   345→      output_location: publicUrl,
   346→      has_thumbnail: !!thumbnailUrl
   347→    });
   348→    await logger.flush();
   349→
   350→    return new Response(JSON.stringify(responseData), {
   351→      status: 200,
   352→      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }
   353→    });
   354→
   355→  } catch (error: any) {
   356→    logger.critical("Unexpected error", { 
   357→      task_id: taskIdString, 
   358→      error: error?.message,
   359→      stack: error?.stack?.substring(0, 500)
   360→    });
   361→    console.error("[COMPLETE-TASK] Edge function error:", error);
   362→    await logger.flush();
   363→    return new Response(`Internal error: ${error?.message}`, { status: 500 });
   364→  }
   365→}
   366→
```

```
    39→export async function createGenerationFromTask(
```

```
    57→// ===== HANDLER: VARIANT ON SOURCE =====
    58→
    59→/**
    60→ * Create variant on source generation (for edit/upscale tasks with based_on)
    61→ * Reads is_primary and variant_type from task data
    62→ */
    63→export async function handleVariantCreation(
    64→  supabase: any,
    65→  taskId: string,
    66→  taskData: any,
    67→  basedOnGenerationId: string,
    68→  publicUrl: string,
    69→  thumbnailUrl: string | null
    70→): Promise<boolean> {
    71→  const isPrimary = taskData.params?.is_primary === true;
    72→  const variantType = taskData.variant_type || 'edit';
    73→
    74→  console.log(`[Variant] Task ${taskId} creating ${variantType} variant on ${basedOnGenerationId} (is_primary=${isPrimary})`);
    75→
    76→  try {
    77→    const { data: sourceGen, error: fetchError } = await supabase
    78→      .from('generations')
    79→      .select('id, params, thumbnail_url, project_id')
    80→      .eq('id', basedOnGenerationId)
    81→      .single();
    82→
    83→    if (fetchError || !sourceGen) {
    84→      console.error(`[Variant] Source generation ${basedOnGenerationId} not found:`, fetchError);
    85→      return false;
    86→    }
    87→
    88→    const variantParams = {
    89→      ...taskData.params,
    90→      source_task_id: taskId,
    91→      source_variant_id: taskData.params?.source_variant_id || null,
    92→      created_from: taskData.task_type,
    93→      tool_type: taskData.tool_type,
    94→      content_type: taskData.content_type,
    95→    };
    96→
    97→    await createVariant(
    98→      supabase,
    99→      basedOnGenerationId,
   100→      publicUrl,
   101→      thumbnailUrl,
   102→      variantParams,
   103→      isPrimary,
   104→      variantType,
   105→      null
   106→    );
   107→
   108→    console.log(`[Variant] Successfully created ${variantType} variant on ${basedOnGenerationId} (is_primary=${isPrimary})`);
   109→
   110→    await supabase.from('tasks').update({ generation_created: true }).eq('id', taskId);
   111→    return true;
   112→
   113→  } catch (variantErr) {
   114→    console.error(`[Variant] Error creating variant for task ${taskId}:`, variantErr);
   115→    return false;
   116→  }
   117→}
   118→
   119→// ===== HANDLER: VARIANT ON PARENT =====
   120→
   121→/**
   122→ * Creates a variant on the parent generation (for stitch tasks)
   123→ * Used by: travel_stitch, join_final_stitch
   124→ */
   125→export async function handleVariantOnParent(ctx: HandlerContext): Promise<any | null> {
   126→  const { supabase, taskId, taskData, publicUrl, thumbnailUrl, logger } = ctx;
   127→
   128→  const orchTaskId = taskData.params?.orchestrator_task_id_ref ||
   129→                     taskData.params?.orchestrator_task_id ||
   130→                     taskData.params?.full_orchestrator_payload?.orchestrator_task_id;
   131→
   132→  if (!orchTaskId) {
   133→    console.log(`[GenHandler] ${taskData.task_type} task ${taskId} - no orchestrator_task_id found`);
   134→    return null;
   135→  }
   136→
   137→  console.log(`[GenHandler] ${taskData.task_type} - getting parent generation for orchestrator ${orchTaskId}`);
   138→  const parentGen = await getOrCreateParentGeneration(supabase, orchTaskId, taskData.project_id, taskData.params);
   139→
   140→  if (!parentGen?.id) {
   141→    console.log(`[GenHandler] ${taskData.task_type} task ${taskId} - could not find/create parent generation`);
   142→    return null;
   143→  }
   144→
   145→  console.log(`[GenHandler] ${taskData.task_type} task ${taskId} - creating variant on parent generation ${parentGen.id}`);
   146→  logger?.info(`${taskData.task_type}: creating variant on parent`, {
   147→    task_id: taskId,
   148→    parent_generation_id: parentGen.id,
   149→    orchestrator_task_id: orchTaskId,
   150→    action: "create_variant_on_parent"
   151→  });
   152→
   153→  const variantType = taskData.variant_type || 'edit';
   154→
   155→  const result = await createVariantOnParent(
   156→    supabase,
   157→    parentGen.id,
   158→    publicUrl,
   159→    thumbnailUrl,
   160→    taskData,
   161→    taskId,
   162→    variantType,
   163→    {
   164→      tool_type: taskData.tool_type,
   165→      created_from: `${taskData.task_type}_completion`,
   166→    }
   167→  );
   168→
   169→  // For loop tasks with based_on (e.g., "Add to Join" loop), also create variant on source generation
   170→  const orchDetails = taskData.params?.orchestrator_details || taskData.params?.full_orchestrator_payload || {};
   171→  const isLoop = orchDetails.loop_first_clip === true;
   172→  const basedOnId = orchDetails.based_on || taskData.params?.based_on;
   173→
   174→  if (isLoop && basedOnId) {
   175→    console.log(`[GenHandler] Loop with based_on detected - also creating variant on source generation ${basedOnId}`);
   176→    logger?.info(`${taskData.task_type}: creating loop variant on source`, {
   177→      task_id: taskId,
   178→      based_on: basedOnId,
   179→      action: "create_loop_variant_on_source"
   180→    });
   181→
   182→    // Verify the source generation exists before creating variant
   183→    const { data: sourceGen, error: sourceError } = await supabase
   184→      .from('generations')
   185→      .select('id')
   186→      .eq('id', basedOnId)
   187→      .maybeSingle();
   188→
   189→    if (sourceGen && !sourceError) {
   190→      await createVariant(
   191→        supabase,
   192→        basedOnId,
   193→        publicUrl,
   194→        thumbnailUrl,
   195→        {
   196→          ...taskData.params,
   197→          source_task_id: taskId,
   198→          tool_type: taskData.tool_type,
   199→          created_from: 'loop_variant',
   200→        },
   201→        true, // is_primary - make this the new primary variant
   202→        'clip_join', // variant_type
   203→        null
   204→      );
   205→      console.log(`[GenHandler] Successfully created loop variant on source generation ${basedOnId}`);
   206→    } else {
   207→      console.warn(`[GenHandler] Source generation ${basedOnId} not found, skipping loop variant`);
   208→    }
   209→  }
   210→
   211→  return result;
   212→}
   213→
   214→// ===== HANDLER: VARIANT ON CHILD =====
   215→
   216→/**
   217→ * Creates a variant on an existing child generation (for individual segment regeneration)
   218→ * Used by: individual_travel_segment (when child_generation_id is present)
   219→ */
   220→export async function handleVariantOnChild(ctx: HandlerContext): Promise<any | null> {
   221→  const { supabase, taskId, taskData, publicUrl, thumbnailUrl, logger, childGenerationId } = ctx;
   222→
   223→  if (!childGenerationId) {
   224→    console.log(`[GenHandler] No child_generation_id, falling back to child_generation behavior`);
   225→    return null; // Fall back to child_generation behavior
   226→  }
   227→
   228→  const childGenId = childGenerationId;
   229→
   230→  console.log(`[GenHandler] individual_travel_segment - creating variant for child generation ${childGenId}`);
   231→  logger?.info("individual_travel_segment with child_generation_id", {
   232→    task_id: taskId,
   233→    child_generation_id: childGenId,
   234→    action: "create_variant_on_existing_child"
   235→  });
   236→
   237→  const { data: childGen, error: fetchError } = await supabase
   238→    .from('generations')
   239→    .select('*')
   240→    .eq('id', childGenId)
   241→    .single();
   242→
   243→  if (fetchError || !childGen) {
   244→    console.error(`[GenHandler] Error fetching child generation ${childGenId}:`, fetchError);
   245→    return null;
   246→  }
   247→
   248→  // Extract pair_shot_generation_id from nested locations if not at top level
   249→  const segmentIndex = taskData.params?.segment_index ?? 0;
   250→  const orchPairIds = taskData.params?.orchestrator_details?.pair_shot_generation_ids;
   251→  const pairShotGenerationId = taskData.params?.pair_shot_generation_id ||
   252→                                taskData.params?.individual_segment_params?.pair_shot_generation_id ||
   253→                                (Array.isArray(orchPairIds) && orchPairIds[segmentIndex]);
   254→
   255→  const variantParams = {
   256→    ...taskData.params,
   257→    tool_type: taskData.tool_type,
   258→    source_task_id: taskId,
   259→    created_from: 'individual_segment_regeneration',
   260→    ...(pairShotGenerationId && { pair_shot_generation_id: pairShotGenerationId }),
   261→  };
   262→
   263→  // Respect make_primary_variant flag from UI (defaults to true for backward compatibility)
   264→  const makePrimary = taskData.params?.make_primary_variant ?? true;
   265→  console.log(`[GenHandler] Creating variant with isPrimary=${makePrimary}`);
   266→
   267→  // Always check for single-segment case (independent of makePrimary flag)
   268→  // This determines if we should propagate to the parent generation
   269→  const singleSegmentViewedAt = await getChildVariantViewedAt(supabase, {
   270→    taskParams: taskData.params,
   271→    childGeneration: childGen,
   272→  });
   273→  const isSingleSegmentChild = singleSegmentViewedAt !== null;
   274→
   275→  // For the child variant, only auto-view if makePrimary is true
   276→  const childViewedAt = makePrimary ? singleSegmentViewedAt : null;
   277→
   278→  const variantType = taskData.variant_type || 'edit';
   279→
   280→  await createVariant(
   281→    supabase,
   282→    childGen.id,
   283→    publicUrl,
   284→    thumbnailUrl,
   285→    variantParams,
   286→    makePrimary,
   287→    variantType,
   288→    null,
   289→    childViewedAt
   290→  );
   291→
   292→  console.log(`[GenHandler] Successfully created variant for child generation ${childGenId}${childViewedAt ? ' (auto-viewed)' : ''}${isSingleSegmentChild ? ' (single-segment)' : ''}`);
   293→
   294→  // SINGLE-SEGMENT PROPAGATION: If this child is the only child of its parent,
   295→  // also create a variant on the parent so the main generation updates automatically
   296→  if (isSingleSegmentChild && childGen.parent_generation_id) {
   297→    // Check if parent already has variants - only make primary if it's the first
   298→    const { count: existingParentVariants } = await supabase
   299→      .from('generation_variants')
   300→      .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
   301→      .eq('generation_id', childGen.parent_generation_id);
   302→
   303→    const isFirstParentVariant = (existingParentVariants || 0) === 0;
   304→    const makeParentPrimary = isFirstParentVariant || makePrimary;
   305→
   306→    console.log(`[GenHandler] Single-segment child - also creating variant on parent ${childGen.parent_generation_id} (isFirst=${isFirstParentVariant}, makePrimary=${makeParentPrimary})`);
   307→    logger?.info("Single-segment propagation to parent", {
   308→      task_id: taskId,
   309→      child_generation_id: childGenId,
   310→      parent_generation_id: childGen.parent_generation_id,
   311→      action: "propagate_to_parent",
   312→      is_first_parent_variant: isFirstParentVariant,
   313→      make_primary: makeParentPrimary
   314→    });
   315→
   316→    await createVariant(
   317→      supabase,
   318→      childGen.parent_generation_id,
   319→      publicUrl,
   320→      thumbnailUrl,
   321→      {
   322→        ...variantParams,
   323→        propagated_from_child: childGenId,
   324→        created_from: 'single_segment_propagation',
   325→      },
   326→      makeParentPrimary,
   327→      variantType, // Use same variant_type as child
   328→      null
   329→    );
   330→    console.log(`[GenHandler] Successfully propagated to parent generation`);
   331→  }
   332→
   333→  await supabase.from('tasks').update({ generation_created: true }).eq('id', taskId);
   334→  return childGen;
   335→}
   336→
   337→// ===== HANDLER: STANDALONE GENERATION =====
   338→
   339→/**
   340→ * Creates an independent generation (for regular tasks)
   341→ * Used by: single_image, wan_2_2_i2v, image_inpaint, etc.
   342→ */
   343→export async function handleStandaloneGeneration(ctx: HandlerContext): Promise<any> {
   344→  const { supabase, taskId, taskData, publicUrl, thumbnailUrl, logger } = ctx;
   345→
   346→  const { shotId, addInPosition } = extractShotAndPosition(taskData.params);
   347→
   348→  // Validate shot exists
   349→  if (shotId) {
   350→    const uuidRegex = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
   351→    if (uuidRegex.test(shotId)) {
   352→      const { data: shotData, error: shotError } = await supabase.from('shots').select('id').eq('id', shotId).single();
   353→      if (shotError || !shotData) {
   354→        console.log(`[GenHandler] Shot ${shotId} does not exist, proceeding without shot link`);
   355→      }
   356→    }
   357→  }
   358→
   359→  const generationType = taskData.content_type || 'image';
   360→  const generationParams = buildGenerationParams(
   361→    taskData.params, taskData.tool_type, generationType, shotId, thumbnailUrl || undefined, taskId
   362→  );
   363→  const newGenerationId = crypto.randomUUID();
   364→
   365→  const generationName = taskData.params?.generation_name ||
   366→    taskData.params?.orchestrator_details?.generation_name ||
   367→    taskData.params?.full_orchestrator_payload?.generation_name;
   368→
   369→  // Find based_on
   370→  let basedOnGenerationId: string | null = extractBasedOn(taskData.params);
   371→  if (basedOnGenerationId) {
   372→    const { data: basedOnGen, error: basedOnError } = await supabase
   373→      .from('generations')
   374→      .select('id')
   375→      .eq('id', basedOnGenerationId)
   376→      .maybeSingle();
   377→
   378→    if (basedOnError || !basedOnGen) {
   379→      console.warn(`[GenHandler] based_on generation ${basedOnGenerationId} not found, clearing reference`);
   380→      basedOnGenerationId = null;
   381→    }
   382→  }
   383→  if (!basedOnGenerationId) {
   384→    const sourceImageUrl = taskData.params?.image;
   385→    if (sourceImageUrl) {
   386→      basedOnGenerationId = await findSourceGenerationByImageUrl(supabase, sourceImageUrl);
   387→    }
   388→  }
   389→
   390→  logger?.info("Creating standalone generation", {
   391→    task_id: taskId,
   392→    generation_id: newGenerationId,
   393→    based_on: basedOnGenerationId,
   394→    shot_id: shotId,
   395→    generation_type: generationType,
   396→  });
   397→
   398→  const generationRecord: Record<string, any> = {
   399→    id: newGenerationId,
   400→    tasks: [taskId],
   401→    params: generationParams,
   402→    type: generationType,
   403→    project_id: taskData.project_id,
   404→    name: generationName,
   405→    based_on: basedOnGenerationId,
   406→    parent_generation_id: null,
   407→    is_child: false,
   408→    child_order: null,
   409→    created_at: new Date().toISOString()
   410→  };
   411→
   412→  const newGeneration = await insertGeneration(supabase, generationRecord);
   413→  console.log(`[GenHandler] Created standalone generation ${newGeneration.id}`);
   414→
   415→  // Create "original" variant
   416→  console.log(`[GenHandler] Creating original variant`);
   417→  await createVariant(
   418→    supabase, newGeneration.id, publicUrl, thumbnailUrl,
   419→    { ...generationParams, source_task_id: taskId, created_from: 'generation_original' },
   420→    true, 'original', null, null
   421→  );
   422→
   423→  // Link to shot if applicable
   424→  if (shotId) {
   425→    await linkGenerationToShot(supabase, shotId, newGeneration.id, addInPosition);
   426→  }
   427→
   428→  await supabase.from('tasks').update({ generation_created: true }).eq('id', taskId);
   429→
   430→  console.log(`[GenHandler] Standalone generation creation complete`);
   431→  return newGeneration;
   432→}
   433→
```

```
   168→ */
   169→export async function findExistingGenerationAtPosition(
   170→  supabase: any,
   171→  parentGenerationId: string,
   172→  childOrder: number,
   173→  pairShotGenId?: string
   174→): Promise<string | null> {
   175→  console.log(`[GenHandler] Checking for existing generation at segment_index=${childOrder}, pair_shot_gen_id=${pairShotGenId || 'none'}`);
   176→
   177→  // Strategy 1: Try to find by pair_shot_generation_id column
   178→  if (pairShotGenId) {
   179→    // Match by the FK column (source of truth with referential integrity)
   180→    const { data: matchByColumn, error: matchByColumnError } = await supabase
   181→      .from('generations')
   182→      .select('id')
   183→      .eq('parent_generation_id', parentGenerationId)
   184→      .eq('is_child', true)
   185→      .eq('pair_shot_generation_id', pairShotGenId)
   186→      .maybeSingle();
   187→
   188→    if (!matchByColumnError && matchByColumn?.id) {
   189→      console.log(`[GenHandler] Found match by pair_shot_generation_id column: ${matchByColumn.id}`);
   190→      return matchByColumn.id;
   191→    }
   192→
   193→    // NOTE: We intentionally DON'T fall back to params JSONB here.
   194→    // Pre-migration generations have already been migrated to the column.
   195→    // Any generation with NULL column but non-NULL params is orphaned
   196→    // (FK cascade set column to NULL when shot_generation was deleted).
   197→    console.log(`[GenHandler] No match by pair_shot_generation_id column`);
   198→  }
   199→
   200→  // Strategy 2: Fallback to child_order match
   201→  // IMPORTANT: Only use this fallback when NO pair_shot_generation_id was provided
   202→  // If pairShotGenId was provided but no match found, DON'T fall back to child_order
   203→  // because the existing child at that index may be for a different timeline layout
   204→  if (!pairShotGenId) {
   205→    const { data: matchByChildOrder, error: matchByChildOrderError } = await supabase
   206→      .from('generations')
   207→      .select('id')
   208→      .eq('parent_generation_id', parentGenerationId)
   209→      .eq('is_child', true)
   210→      .eq('child_order', childOrder)
   211→      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
   212→      .limit(1)
   213→      .maybeSingle();
   214→
   215→    if (!matchByChildOrderError && matchByChildOrder?.id) {
   216→      console.log(`[GenHandler] Found match by child_order=${childOrder}: ${matchByChildOrder.id}`);
   217→      return matchByChildOrder.id;
   218→    }
   219→  } else {
   220→    console.log(`[GenHandler] No match by pair_shot_generation_id, skipping child_order fallback (would match wrong slot after timeline rearrangement)`);
   221→  }
   222→
   223→  console.log(`[GenHandler] No existing generation found at position`);
   224→  return null;
   225→}

   227→/**
   228→ * Create the child generation record and its initial variant
   229→ */
   230→export async function createChildGenerationRecord(
   231→  ctx: HandlerContext,
   232→  parentGenerationId: string,
   233→  childOrder: number | null,
   234→  isSingleItemCase: boolean,
   235→  pairShotGenerationId?: string | null | false
   236→): Promise<any> {
   237→  const { supabase, taskId, taskData, publicUrl, thumbnailUrl, logger } = ctx;
   238→
   239→  const { shotId } = extractShotAndPosition(taskData.params);
   240→  const generationType = taskData.content_type || 'video';
   241→  const toolType = taskData.tool_type;
   242→  let generationParams = buildGenerationParams(
   243→    taskData.params, toolType, generationType, shotId, thumbnailUrl || undefined, taskId
   244→  );
   245→
   246→  // Ensure pair_shot_generation_id is at top level of params (for slot matching)
   247→  if (pairShotGenerationId && !generationParams.pair_shot_generation_id) {
   248→    generationParams = { ...generationParams, pair_shot_generation_id: pairShotGenerationId };
   249→    console.log(`[GenHandler] Added pair_shot_generation_id to child generation params: ${pairShotGenerationId}`);
   250→  }
   251→
   252→  const newGenerationId = crypto.randomUUID();
   253→
   254→  const generationName = taskData.params?.generation_name ||
   255→    taskData.params?.orchestrator_details?.generation_name ||
   256→    taskData.params?.full_orchestrator_payload?.generation_name;
   257→
   258→  // Find based_on
   259→  let basedOnGenerationId: string | null = extractBasedOn(taskData.params);
   260→  if (basedOnGenerationId) {
   261→    const { data: basedOnGen, error: basedOnError } = await supabase
   262→      .from('generations')
   263→      .select('id')
   264→      .eq('id', basedOnGenerationId)
   265→      .maybeSingle();
   266→
   267→    if (basedOnError || !basedOnGen) {
   268→      console.warn(`[GenHandler] based_on generation ${basedOnGenerationId} not found, clearing reference`);
   269→      basedOnGenerationId = null;
   270→    }
   271→  }
   272→  if (!basedOnGenerationId) {
   273→    const sourceImageUrl = taskData.params?.image;
   274→    if (sourceImageUrl) {
   275→      basedOnGenerationId = await findSourceGenerationByImageUrl(supabase, sourceImageUrl);
   276→    }
   277→  }
   278→
   279→  logger?.info("Creating child generation record", {
   280→    task_id: taskId,
   281→    generation_id: newGenerationId,
   282→    parent_generation_id: parentGenerationId,
   283→    child_order: childOrder,
   284→    is_single_item: isSingleItemCase,
   285→    based_on: basedOnGenerationId,
   286→    pair_shot_generation_id: pairShotGenerationId || null,
   287→  });
   288→
   289→  // Verify pair_shot_generation_id still exists before inserting (FK constraint check)
   290→  // If the shot_generation was deleted between task creation and completion, set to NULL
   291→  let validatedPairShotGenId = pairShotGenerationId || null;
   292→  if (validatedPairShotGenId) {
   293→    const { data: shotGenExists } = await supabase
   294→      .from('shot_generations')
   295→      .select('id')
   296→      .eq('id', validatedPairShotGenId)
   297→      .maybeSingle();
   298→
   299→    if (!shotGenExists) {
   300→      console.log(`[GenHandler] pair_shot_generation_id ${validatedPairShotGenId} no longer exists, setting to NULL`);
   301→      validatedPairShotGenId = null;
   302→    }
   303→  }
   304→
   305→  const generationRecord: Record<string, any> = {
   306→    id: newGenerationId,
   307→    tasks: [taskId],
   308→    params: generationParams,
   309→    type: generationType,
   310→    project_id: taskData.project_id,
   311→    name: generationName,
   312→    based_on: basedOnGenerationId,
   313→    parent_generation_id: parentGenerationId,
   314→    is_child: true,
   315→    child_order: childOrder,
   316→    // Store pair_shot_generation_id as proper column (not just in params)
   317→    // This enables FK constraint and ON DELETE SET NULL behavior
   318→    // Validated above to prevent FK violation if shot_generation was deleted
   319→    pair_shot_generation_id: validatedPairShotGenId,
   320→    created_at: new Date().toISOString()
   321→  };
   322→
   323→  const newGeneration = await insertGeneration(supabase, generationRecord);
   324→  console.log(`[GenHandler] Created child generation ${newGeneration.id}`);
   325→
   326→  // Log segment state for debugging (travel segments only)
   327→  const isTravelSegmentTask = taskData.task_type === TASK_TYPES.TRAVEL_SEGMENT ||
   328→                               taskData.task_type === TASK_TYPES.INDIVIDUAL_TRAVEL_SEGMENT;
   329→  const orchDetails = taskData.params?.orchestrator_details ||
   330→                      taskData.params?.full_orchestrator_payload || {};
   331→
   332→  if (isTravelSegmentTask && childOrder !== null) {
   333→    try {
   334→      logSegmentMasterState({
   335→        taskId,
   336→        generationId: newGeneration.id,
   337→        segmentIndex: childOrder,
   338→        parentGenerationId,
   339→        orchDetails,
   340→        segmentParams: taskData.params,
   341→        shotId,
   342→      });
   343→    } catch (logError) {
   344→      console.warn('[GenHandler] Error logging segment state:', logError);
   345→    }
   346→  }
   347→
   348→  // Create "original" variant
   349→  let autoViewedAt: string | null = null;
   350→  let createdFrom = 'child_generation_original';
   351→
   352→  if (isSingleItemCase) {
   353→    autoViewedAt = new Date().toISOString();
   354→    createdFrom = 'single_segment_child_original';
   355→  } else {
   356→    autoViewedAt = await getChildVariantViewedAt(supabase, {
   357→      taskParams: taskData.params,
   358→    });
   359→    if (autoViewedAt) {
   360→      createdFrom = 'single_segment_child_original';
   361→    }
   362→  }
   363→
   364→  console.log(`[GenHandler] Creating original variant${autoViewedAt ? ' (auto-viewed)' : ''}`);
   365→  await createVariant(
   366→    supabase, newGeneration.id, publicUrl, thumbnailUrl,
   367→    { ...generationParams, source_task_id: taskId, created_from: createdFrom },
   368→    true, 'original', null, autoViewedAt
   369→  );
   370→
   371→  await supabase.from('tasks').update({ generation_created: true }).eq('id', taskId);
   372→
   373→  console.log(`[GenHandler] Child generation creation complete`);
   374→  return newGeneration;
   375→}

   380→/**
   381→ * Logs a comprehensive summary of a segment after creation.
   382→ * For debugging FE vs BE discrepancies in travel segment generation.
   383→ */
   384→export function logSegmentMasterState(params: {
   385→  taskId: string;
   386→  generationId: string;
   387→  segmentIndex: number;
   388→  parentGenerationId: string | null;
   389→  orchDetails: any;
   390→  segmentParams: any;
   391→  shotId?: string;
   392→}) {
   393→  const TAG = '[SEGMENT_MASTER_STATE]';
   394→  const divider = '═'.repeat(80);
   395→  const sectionDivider = '─'.repeat(60);
   396→
   397→  const { taskId, generationId, segmentIndex, parentGenerationId, orchDetails, segmentParams, shotId } = params;
   398→
   399→  console.log(`\n${divider}`);
   400→  console.log(`${TAG} SEGMENT CREATION SUMMARY`);
   401→  console.log(`${TAG} Task ID: ${taskId}`);
   402→  console.log(`${TAG} Generation ID: ${generationId}`);
   403→  console.log(`${TAG} Segment Index: ${segmentIndex}`);
   404→  console.log(`${TAG} Parent Gen ID: ${parentGenerationId || '(none)'}`);
   405→  console.log(`${TAG} Shot ID: ${shotId || '(none)'}`);
   406→  console.log(`${TAG} Timestamp: ${new Date().toISOString()}`);
   407→  console.log(divider);
   408→
   409→  // SECTION 1: SEGMENT-SPECIFIC DATA
   410→  console.log(`\n${TAG} SEGMENT DATA (Index ${segmentIndex})`);
   411→  console.log(sectionDivider);
   412→
   413→  const numFrames = segmentParams?.num_frames || extractFromArray(orchDetails?.segment_frames_expanded, segmentIndex);
   414→  const frameOverlap = segmentParams?.frame_overlap || extractFromArray(orchDetails?.frame_overlap_expanded, segmentIndex);
   415→  console.log(`${TAG}   Frames: ${numFrames || '(unknown)'} | Overlap: ${frameOverlap || '(unknown)'}`);
   416→
   417→  const basePrompt = segmentParams?.prompt || extractFromArray(orchDetails?.base_prompts_expanded, segmentIndex) || orchDetails?.base_prompt || '';
   418→  const negativePrompt = segmentParams?.negative_prompt || extractFromArray(orchDetails?.negative_prompts_expanded, segmentIndex) || '';
   419→  const enhancedPrompt = extractFromArray(orchDetails?.enhanced_prompts_expanded, segmentIndex) || '';
   420→
   421→  const promptPreview = basePrompt ? (basePrompt.length > 60 ? basePrompt.substring(0, 57) + '...' : basePrompt) : '(empty)';
   422→  const hasCustomPrompt = basePrompt && basePrompt.trim().length > 0;
   423→  const negPreview = negativePrompt ? (negativePrompt.length > 40 ? negativePrompt.substring(0, 37) + '...' : negativePrompt) : '(default)';
   424→  const enhancedPreview = enhancedPrompt ? (enhancedPrompt.length > 50 ? enhancedPrompt.substring(0, 47) + '...' : enhancedPrompt) : '';
   425→
   426→  console.log(`${TAG}   Prompt: ${hasCustomPrompt ? 'CUSTOM:' : 'DEFAULT:'} ${promptPreview}`);
   427→  if (enhancedPrompt) {
   428→    console.log(`${TAG}   Enhanced: ${enhancedPreview}`);
   429→  }
   430→  console.log(`${TAG}   Negative: ${negPreview}`);
   431→
   432→  // SECTION 2: INPUT IMAGES
   433→  console.log(`\n${TAG} INPUT IMAGES`);
   434→  console.log(sectionDivider);
   435→
   436→  const inputImages = orchDetails?.input_image_paths_resolved || [];
   437→  const inputGenIds = orchDetails?.input_image_generation_ids || [];
   438→  const pairShotGenIds = orchDetails?.pair_shot_generation_ids || [];
   439→
   440→  const startIdx = segmentIndex;
   441→  const endIdx = segmentIndex + 1;
   442→
   443→  const startImageUrl = inputImages[startIdx] || '(unknown)';
   444→  const endImageUrl = inputImages[endIdx] || '(unknown)';
   445→  const startGenId = inputGenIds[startIdx] || '(unknown)';
   446→  const endGenId = inputGenIds[endIdx] || '(unknown)';
   447→  const pairShotGenId = pairShotGenIds[segmentIndex] || '(none)';
   448→
   449→  const startUrlShort = startImageUrl.length > 50 ? '...' + startImageUrl.slice(-47) : startImageUrl;
   450→  const endUrlShort = endImageUrl.length > 50 ? '...' + endImageUrl.slice(-47) : endImageUrl;
   451→
   452→  console.log(`${TAG}   Start Image [${startIdx}]: ${startUrlShort}`);
   453→  console.log(`${TAG}     Gen ID: ${typeof startGenId === 'string' ? startGenId.substring(0, 8) : startGenId}`);
   454→  console.log(`${TAG}   End Image [${endIdx}]: ${endUrlShort}`);
   455→  console.log(`${TAG}     Gen ID: ${typeof endGenId === 'string' ? endGenId.substring(0, 8) : endGenId}`);
   456→  console.log(`${TAG}   Pair Shot Gen ID: ${typeof pairShotGenId === 'string' ? pairShotGenId.substring(0, 8) : pairShotGenId}`);
   457→
   458→  // SECTION 3: STRUCTURE VIDEOS
   459→  console.log(`\n${TAG} STRUCTURE VIDEOS`);
   460→  console.log(sectionDivider);
   461→
   462→  const structureVideos = orchDetails?.structure_videos || [];
   463→  const legacyStructurePath = orchDetails?.structure_video_path;
   464→  const segmentFramesExpanded = orchDetails?.segment_frames_expanded || [];
   465→
   466→  let segStartFrame = 0;

   468→    segStartFrame += segmentFramesExpanded[i];

   471→
   472→  console.log(`${TAG}   Segment Frame Range: ${segStartFrame} -> ${segEndFrame}`);
   473→
   474→  if (structureVideos.length > 0) {
   475→    let foundAffecting = false;

   486→      }

   492→    const pathShort = legacyStructurePath.length > 40 ? '...' + legacyStructurePath.slice(-37) : legacyStructurePath;
   493→    console.log(`${TAG}   Legacy Video: ${pathShort}`);
   494→    console.log(`${TAG}   Type: ${orchDetails?.structure_video_type || 'flow'} | Treatment: ${orchDetails?.structure_video_treatment || 'adjust'}`);
   495→  } else {
   496→    console.log(`${TAG}   (No structure videos - I2V mode)`);
   497→  }
   498→
   499→  // SECTION 4: MODEL & SETTINGS
   500→  console.log(`\n${TAG} MODEL & SETTINGS`);
   501→  console.log(sectionDivider);
   502→  console.log(`${TAG}   Model: ${orchDetails?.model_name || segmentParams?.model_name || '(unknown)'}`);
   503→  console.log(`${TAG}   Model Type: ${orchDetails?.model_type || segmentParams?.model_type || 'i2v'}`);
   504→  console.log(`${TAG}   Seed: ${orchDetails?.seed_base || segmentParams?.seed || '(random)'}`);
   505→  console.log(`${TAG}   Amount of Motion: ${orchDetails?.amount_of_motion !== undefined ? Math.round(orchDetails.amount_of_motion * 100) + '%' : '(default)'}`);
   506→  console.log(`${TAG}   Advanced Mode: ${orchDetails?.advanced_mode || false}`);
   507→  console.log(`${TAG}   Turbo Mode: ${orchDetails?.turbo_mode || false}`);
   508→  console.log(`${TAG}   Enhance Prompt: ${orchDetails?.enhance_prompt || false}`);
   509→
   510→  const additionalLoras = orchDetails?.additional_loras;
   511→  const phaseConfig = orchDetails?.phase_config;
   512→  if (additionalLoras && Object.keys(additionalLoras).length > 0) {
   513→    console.log(`${TAG}   LoRAs: ${Object.keys(additionalLoras).length} configured`);
   514→    Object.entries(additionalLoras).forEach(([path, strength]) => {
   515→      const pathShort = path.split('/').pop() || path;

   517→    });
   518→  } else if (phaseConfig?.phases) {
   519→    const uniqueLoras = new Set<string>();
   520→    phaseConfig.phases.forEach((phase: any) => {
   521→      phase.loras?.forEach((lora: any) => uniqueLoras.add(lora.url?.split('/').pop() || 'unknown'));
   522→    });
   523→    if (uniqueLoras.size > 0) {
   524→      console.log(`${TAG}   LoRAs (in phase_config): ${uniqueLoras.size} unique`);
   525→    }
   526→  } else {
   527→    console.log(`${TAG}   LoRAs: (none)`);
   528→  }
   529→
   530→  // SECTION 5: ORCHESTRATOR CONTEXT
   531→  console.log(`\n${TAG} ORCHESTRATOR CONTEXT`);
   532→  console.log(sectionDivider);
   533→  console.log(`${TAG}   Total Segments: ${orchDetails?.num_new_segments_to_generate || '(unknown)'}`);
   534→  console.log(`${TAG}   Total Images: ${inputImages.length}`);
   535→  console.log(`${TAG}   Generation Mode: ${orchDetails?.generation_mode || 'batch'}`);
   536→  console.log(`${TAG}   Generation Name: ${orchDetails?.generation_name || '(unnamed)'}`);
   537→  console.log(`${TAG}   Resolution: ${orchDetails?.parsed_resolution_wh || '(auto)'}`);
   538→
   539→  if (segmentFramesExpanded.length > 0) {
   540→    console.log(`${TAG}   All Segment Frames: [${segmentFramesExpanded.join(', ')}]`);
   541→    const totalFrames = segmentFramesExpanded.reduce((a: number, b: number) => a + b, 0);
   542→    console.log(`${TAG}   Total Duration: ${totalFrames} frames (~${(totalFrames / 24).toFixed(1)}s)`);
   543→  }
   544→
   545→  console.log(`\n${divider}\n`);
   546→}

   548→/**
   549→ * Extract segment-specific params from expanded arrays in orchestrator_details.
   550→ * For travel segments, each segment can have different prompts, frame counts, etc.
   551→ */
   552→export function extractSegmentSpecificParams(
   553→  params: any,
   554→  orchDetails: any,
   555→  segmentIndex: number
   556→): any {
   557→  const specificParams = { ...params };
   558→
   559→  const specificPrompt = extractFromArray(orchDetails.base_prompts_expanded, segmentIndex);
   560→  if (specificPrompt !== undefined) {
   561→    specificParams.prompt = specificPrompt;
   562→    console.log(`[GenMigration] Set child prompt: "${String(specificPrompt).substring(0, 20)}..."`);
   563→  }
   564→
   565→  const specificNegativePrompt = extractFromArray(orchDetails.negative_prompts_expanded, segmentIndex);
   566→  if (specificNegativePrompt !== undefined) {
   567→    specificParams.negative_prompt = specificNegativePrompt;
   568→  }
   569→
   570→  const specificFrames = extractFromArray(orchDetails.segment_frames_expanded, segmentIndex);
   571→  if (specificFrames !== undefined) {
   572→    specificParams.num_frames = specificFrames;
   573→  }
   574→
   575→  const specificOverlap = extractFromArray(orchDetails.frame_overlap_expanded, segmentIndex);
   576→  if (specificOverlap !== undefined) {
   577→    specificParams.frame_overlap = specificOverlap;
   578→  }
   579→
   580→  const pairShotGenId = extractFromArray(orchDetails.pair_shot_generation_ids, segmentIndex);
   581→  if (pairShotGenId !== undefined) {
   582→    specificParams.pair_shot_generation_id = pairShotGenId;
   583→    console.log(`[GenMigration] Set pair_shot_generation_id: ${pairShotGenId}`);
   584→  }
   585→
   586→  const startImageGenId = extractFromArray(orchDetails.input_image_generation_ids, segmentIndex);
   587→  if (startImageGenId !== undefined) {
   588→    specificParams.start_image_generation_id = startImageGenId;
   589→  }
   590→  const endImageGenId = extractFromArray(orchDetails.input_image_generation_ids, segmentIndex + 1);
   591→  if (endImageGenId !== undefined) {
   592→    specificParams.end_image_generation_id = endImageGenId;
   593→  }
   594→
   595→  return specificParams;
   596→}
```

```
   118→  }
   119→
   120→  const taskIds = successful.map(r => r.value);
```

```
    54→function filterReferenceSettingsByMode(

    56→  settings: {

   258→
   259→async function calculateTaskResolution(
   260→  projectIdOrOptions: string | CalculateTaskResolutionOptions,
   261→  customResolution?: string,
   262→  modelName?: string
   263→): Promise<string> {
   264→  // Handle both old and new API
   265→  const options: CalculateTaskResolutionOptions = typeof projectIdOrOptions === 'string'
   266→    ? { projectId: projectIdOrOptions, customResolution, modelName }
   267→    : projectIdOrOptions;
   268→
   269→  const { projectId, resolution_scale, resolution_mode, custom_aspect_ratio } = options;
   270→
   271→  // 1. If explicit custom resolution is provided, use it as-is (assumes it's already final)
   272→  if (options.customResolution?.trim()) {
   273→    return options.customResolution.trim();
   274→  }
   275→
   276→  // 2. Determine base resolution
   277→  let baseResolution: string;
   278→
   279→  if (resolution_mode === 'custom' && custom_aspect_ratio) {
   280→    // Use custom aspect ratio
   281→    baseResolution = ASPECT_RATIO_TO_RESOLUTION[custom_aspect_ratio] ?? '902x508';
   282→  } else {
   283→    // Use project resolution
   284→    const { resolution } = await resolveProjectResolution(projectId);
   285→    baseResolution = resolution;
   286→  }
   287→
   288→  // 3. Apply scaling for image generation models
   289→  const isImageGenerationModel = options.modelName === 'qwen-image' || options.modelName === 'qwen-image-2512' || options.modelName === 'z-image';
   290→  if (isImageGenerationModel) {
   291→    const scale = resolution_scale ?? 1.5; // Default to 1.5 if not specified
   292→    const [width, height] = baseResolution.split('x').map(Number);
   293→    const scaledWidth = Math.round(width * scale);
   294→    const scaledHeight = Math.round(height * scale);
   295→    const scaledResolution = `${scaledWidth}x${scaledHeight}`;
   296→    return scaledResolution;
   297→  }
   298→
   299→  return baseResolution;
   300→}

   302→/**

   304→ * This replaces the direct call to the single-image-generate edge function

   307→ * @param params - Image generation task parameters
   308→ * @returns Promise resolving to the created task
   309→ */
   310→async function createImageGenerationTask(params: ImageGenerationTaskParams): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
   311→
   312→  try {
   313→    // 1. Validate parameters
   314→    validateImageGenerationParams(params);
   315→
   316→    // 2. Calculate final resolution (handles Qwen scaling automatically)
   317→    const finalResolution = await calculateTaskResolution(

   319→      params.resolution,

   322→
   323→    // 3. Determine task type based on model and whether there's a style reference
   324→    const taskType = (() => {
   325→      const modelName = params.model_name;

   331→          return hasStyleRef ? 'qwen_image_style' : 'qwen_image';
   332→        case 'qwen-image-2512':
   333→          return 'qwen_image_2512';
   334→        case 'z-image':
   335→          return 'z_image_turbo';
   336→        default:
   337→          // Fallback to wan_2_2_t2i for unknown models
   338→          return 'wan_2_2_t2i';
```

```
    14→ * Parameters for creating a Z Image Turbo I2I task
    15→ * Maps to fal-ai/z-image/turbo/image-to-image endpoint
    16→ */
    17→interface ZImageTurboI2ITaskParams {
    18→  project_id: string;
    19→  image_url: string;           // Source image URL (required)
    20→  prompt?: string;             // Text prompt (default "")
    21→  strength?: number;           // Transform strength 0-1 (default 0.6)
    22→  enable_prompt_expansion?: boolean; // Enable AI prompt expansion (default false)
    23→  seed?: number;               // Random seed (optional)
    24→  num_images?: number;         // Number of outputs (default 1, max 4)
    25→  loras?: ZImageLoraConfig[];  // LoRAs (triggers /lora endpoint if provided)
    26→  shot_id?: string;            // Associate with shot
    27→  based_on?: string;           // Source generation ID for lineage
    28→  source_variant_id?: string;  // Source variant ID
    29→  create_as_generation?: boolean; // Create as new generation vs variant
    30→  tool_type?: string;          // Override tool type
    31→}
    32→
    33→/**
    34→ * Parameters for batch Z Image Turbo I2I task creation
    35→ */
    36→interface BatchZImageTurboI2ITaskParams {
    37→  project_id: string;
    38→  image_url: string;
    39→  prompt?: string;
    40→  strength?: number;
    41→  enable_prompt_expansion?: boolean;
    42→  numImages: number;           // How many variations to generate (creates multiple tasks)
    43→  loras?: ZImageLoraConfig[];
    44→  shot_id?: string;
    45→  based_on?: string;
    46→  source_variant_id?: string;
    47→  create_as_generation?: boolean;
    48→  tool_type?: string;
    49→}
    50→
    51→/**
    52→ * Validates Z Image Turbo I2I task parameters
    53→ */
    54→function validateZImageTurboI2IParams(params: ZImageTurboI2ITaskParams): void {
    55→  validateRequiredFields(params, ['project_id', 'image_url']);
    56→
    57→  if (!params.image_url || params.image_url.trim() === '') {
    58→    throw new TaskValidationError('Image URL cannot be empty', 'image_url');
    59→  }
    60→
    61→  // Validate URL format
    62→  try {
    63→    new URL(params.image_url);
    64→  } catch {
    65→    throw new TaskValidationError('Image URL must be a valid URL', 'image_url');
    66→  }
    67→
    68→  if (params.strength !== undefined && (params.strength < 0 || params.strength > 1)) {
    69→    throw new TaskValidationError('Strength must be between 0 and 1', 'strength');
    70→  }
    71→
    72→  if (params.num_images !== undefined && (params.num_images < 1 || params.num_images > 4)) {
    73→    throw new TaskValidationError('Number of images must be between 1 and 4', 'num_images');
    74→  }
    75→
    76→  if (params.seed !== undefined && (params.seed < 0 || params.seed > 0x7fffffff)) {
    77→    throw new TaskValidationError('Seed must be a 32-bit positive integer', 'seed');
    78→  }
    79→
    80→  if (params.loras && params.loras.length > 0) {
    81→    params.loras.forEach((lora, index) => {
    82→      if (!lora.path || lora.path.trim() === '') {
    83→        throw new TaskValidationError(`LoRA ${index + 1}: path is required`, `loras[${index}].path`);
    84→      }
    85→      if (lora.scale !== undefined && (lora.scale < 0 || lora.scale > 2)) {
    86→        throw new TaskValidationError(`LoRA ${index + 1}: scale must be between 0 and 2`, `loras[${index}].scale`);
    87→      }
    88→    });
    89→  }
    90→}
    91→
    92→/**
    93→ * Validates batch parameters
    94→ */
    95→function validateBatchParams(params: BatchZImageTurboI2ITaskParams): void {
    96→  validateRequiredFields(params, ['project_id', 'image_url', 'numImages']);
    97→
    98→  if (params.numImages < 1 || params.numImages > 16) {
    99→    throw new TaskValidationError('Number of images must be between 1 and 16', 'numImages');
   100→  }
   101→
   102→  // Validate the rest using single task validation
   103→  validateZImageTurboI2IParams({
   104→    project_id: params.project_id,
   105→    image_url: params.image_url,
   106→    prompt: params.prompt,
   107→    strength: params.strength,
   108→    loras: params.loras,
   109→  });
   110→}
   111→
   112→/**
   113→ * Builds task params in the format expected by the worker
   114→ */
   115→function buildTaskParams(params: ZImageTurboI2ITaskParams): Record<string, unknown> {
   116→  const taskParams: Record<string, unknown> = {
   117→    image_url: params.image_url,
   118→    prompt: params.prompt ?? '',
   119→    strength: params.strength ?? 0.6,
   120→    enable_prompt_expansion: params.enable_prompt_expansion ?? false,
   121→    num_images: params.num_images ?? 1,
   122→    // API-specific params
   123→    image_size: 'auto',
   124→    num_inference_steps: 8,
   125→    output_format: 'png',
   126→    enable_safety_checker: true,
   127→  };
   128→
   129→  // Add seed if provided
   130→  if (params.seed !== undefined) {
   131→    taskParams.seed = params.seed;
   132→  }
   133→
   134→  // Add LoRAs if provided (transforms to API format)
   135→  if (params.loras && params.loras.length > 0) {
   136→    taskParams.loras = params.loras.map(lora => ({
   137→      path: lora.path,
   138→      scale: lora.scale ?? 1.0,
   139→    }));
   140→    // When using LoRAs, acceleration must be "none"
   141→    taskParams.acceleration = 'none';
   142→  } else {
   143→    // Without LoRAs, use "high" acceleration
   144→    taskParams.acceleration = 'high';
   145→  }
   146→
   147→  // Add lineage tracking
   148→  if (params.based_on) {
   149→    taskParams.based_on = params.based_on;
   150→  }
   151→
   152→  if (params.source_variant_id) {
   153→    taskParams.source_variant_id = params.source_variant_id;
   154→  }
   155→
   156→  if (params.create_as_generation) {
   157→    taskParams.create_as_generation = true;
   158→  }
   159→
   160→  // Add shot association
   161→  if (params.shot_id) {
   162→    taskParams.shot_id = params.shot_id;
   163→  }
   164→
   165→  // Add tool type override
   166→  if (params.tool_type) {
   167→    taskParams.tool_type = params.tool_type;
   168→  }
   169→
   170→  // Make edits unpositioned by default
   171→  taskParams.add_in_position = false;
   172→
   173→  return taskParams;
   174→}
   175→
   176→/**
   177→ * Creates a single Z Image Turbo I2I task
   178→ * (internal use only - used by createBatchZImageTurboI2ITasks)
   179→ */
   180→async function createZImageTurboI2ITask(params: ZImageTurboI2ITaskParams): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
   181→
   182→  try {
   183→    // 1. Validate parameters
   184→    validateZImageTurboI2IParams(params);
   185→
   186→    // 2. Build task params
   187→    const taskParams = buildTaskParams(params);
   188→
   189→    // 3. Create task using unified create-task function
   190→    const result = await createTask({
   191→      project_id: params.project_id,
   192→      task_type: 'z_image_turbo_i2i',
   193→      params: taskParams,
   194→    });
   195→
   196→    return result;
   197→
   198→  } catch (error) {
   199→    handleError(error, { context: 'ZImageTurboI2I', showToast: false });
   200→    throw error;
   201→  }
   202→}
   203→
   204→/**
   205→ * Creates multiple Z Image Turbo I2I tasks in parallel (batch generation)
   206→ */
   207→export async function createBatchZImageTurboI2ITasks(params: BatchZImageTurboI2ITaskParams): Promise<TaskCreationResult[]> {
   208→
   209→  try {
   210→    // 1. Validate parameters
   211→    validateBatchParams(params);
   212→
   213→    // 2. Generate individual task parameters for each image
   214→    const taskParams = Array.from({ length: params.numImages }, (_, index) => {
   215→      // Generate a different seed for each task
   216→      const seed = params.seed ?? Math.floor(Math.random() * 0x7fffffff);
   217→
   218→      return {
   219→        project_id: params.project_id,
   220→        image_url: params.image_url,
   221→        prompt: params.prompt,
   222→        strength: params.strength,
   223→        enable_prompt_expansion: params.enable_prompt_expansion,
   224→        seed: seed + index, // Increment seed for variation
   225→        num_images: 1, // Each task creates one image
   226→        loras: params.loras,
   227→        shot_id: params.shot_id,
   228→        based_on: params.based_on,
   229→        source_variant_id: params.source_variant_id,
   230→        create_as_generation: params.create_as_generation,
   231→        tool_type: params.tool_type,
   232→      } as ZImageTurboI2ITaskParams;
   233→    });
   234→
   235→    // 3. Create all tasks in parallel
   236→    const results = await Promise.allSettled(
   237→      taskParams.map(taskParam => createZImageTurboI2ITask(taskParam))
   238→    );
   239→
   240→    return processBatchResults(results, 'createBatchZImageTurboI2ITasks');
   241→
   242→  } catch (error) {
   243→    handleError(error, { context: 'BatchZImageTurboI2I', showToast: false });
   244→    throw error;
   245→  }
   246→}
   247→
```

```
   212→ * @param arr - Array to potentially expand
   213→ * @param targetCount - Target count for the array

   216→export function expandArrayToCount<T>(arr: T[] | undefined, targetCount: number): T[] {
   217→  if (!arr || arr.length === 0) {
   218→    return [];
   219→  }
   220→
   221→  if (arr.length === 1 && targetCount > 1) {
   222→    return Array(targetCount).fill(arr[0]);
   223→  }
   224→
   225→  // Truncate arrays that are longer than the target count
   226→  // This handles the case where images were deleted and arrays are stale
   227→  if (arr.length > targetCount) {
   228→    return arr.slice(0, targetCount);
   229→  }
   230→
   231→  return arr;
   232→}

   272→    return JSON.parse(jsonStr) as T;
   273→  } catch {
   274→    return fallback;
   275→  }
   276→}
   277→
   278→/**
   279→ * Processes batch Promise.allSettled results with standard error handling.
   280→ *
   281→ * - Throws if every task failed (surfaces the first error).
   282→ * - Logs individual failures when some succeed.
   283→ * - Returns the fulfilled TaskCreationResult values.
   284→ *
   285→ * @param results - The settled promise array from Promise.allSettled
   286→ * @param context - Label used in error/log messages (e.g. "BatchImageGeneration")
   287→ */
   288→export function processBatchResults(
   289→  results: PromiseSettledResult<TaskCreationResult>[],
   290→  context: string,
   291→): TaskCreationResult[] {
   292→  const successful = results.filter(r => r.status === 'fulfilled').length;
   293→  const failed = results.filter(r => r.status === 'rejected').length;
   294→
   295→  if (successful === 0) {
   296→    const firstError = results.find(r => r.status === 'rejected') as PromiseRejectedResult;
   297→    throw new Error(`All batch tasks failed: ${firstError.reason}`);
   298→  }
   299→
   300→  if (failed > 0) {
   301→    results.forEach((result, index) => {
   302→      if (result.status === 'rejected') {
   303→        handleError(result.reason, { context: `${context}:task${index + 1}`, showToast: false });
   304→      }
   305→    });
   306→  }
   307→
   308→  return results
   309→    .filter((r): r is PromiseFulfilledResult<TaskCreationResult> => r.status === 'fulfilled')
   310→    .map(r => r.value);
   311→}
   312→
```

```
1→-- Create task_types table with run_type support
     2→-- This replaces task_cost_configs with enhanced metadata including run_type filtering
     3→
     4→-- =============================================================================
     5→-- 1. Create task_types table
     6→-- =============================================================================
     7→
     8→CREATE TABLE task_types (
     9→  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    10→  name text NOT NULL UNIQUE,                    -- e.g., 'single_image', 'travel_orchestrator'
    11→  run_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'gpu',         -- 'gpu' | 'api' 
    12→  category text NOT NULL,                       -- 'generation', 'processing', 'orchestration', 'utility'
    13→  display_name text NOT NULL,
    14→  description text,
    15→  base_cost_per_second decimal(10,6) NOT NULL,  -- Base cost per second in decimal cents
    16→  cost_factors jsonb DEFAULT '{}',              -- Flexible cost factors configuration
    17→  is_active boolean DEFAULT true,
    18→  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    19→  updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now() NOT NULL
    20→);
    21→
    22→-- Create indexes for performance
    23→CREATE INDEX idx_task_types_name ON task_types(name);
    24→CREATE INDEX idx_task_types_run_type ON task_types(run_type);
    25→CREATE INDEX idx_task_types_category ON task_types(category);
    26→CREATE INDEX idx_task_types_active ON task_types(is_active);
    27→
    28→-- Add constraint for run_type values
    29→ALTER TABLE task_types ADD CONSTRAINT check_run_type CHECK (run_type IN ('gpu', 'api'));
    30→
    31→-- =============================================================================
    32→-- 2. Migrate data from task_cost_configs (all as 'gpu' type)
    33→-- =============================================================================
    34→
    35→INSERT INTO task_types (name, run_type, category, display_name, description, base_cost_per_second, cost_factors, is_active) 
    36→SELECT 
    37→  tcc.task_type as name,
    38→  'gpu' as run_type,                           -- All existing tasks default to GPU
    39→  tcc.category,
    40→  tcc.display_name,
    41→  CASE 
    42→    WHEN tcc.task_type = 'single_image' THEN 'Generate individual images using AI models'
    43→    WHEN tcc.task_type = 'travel_stitch' THEN 'Stitch individual video segments into final output'
    44→    WHEN tcc.task_type = 'travel_orchestrator' THEN 'Coordinate complex multi-step travel generation workflows'
    45→    WHEN tcc.task_type = 'image_upscale' THEN 'Increase image resolution using AI upscaling'
    46→    WHEN tcc.task_type = 'image_edit' THEN 'Edit and modify existing images using AI'
    47→    WHEN tcc.task_type = 'lora_training' THEN 'Train custom LoRA models for personalized generation'
    48→    WHEN tcc.task_type = 'travel_segment' THEN 'Generate individual video segments for travel sequences'
    49→    WHEN tcc.task_type = 'edit_travel_kontext' THEN 'Edit travel sequences using Kontext model'
    50→    WHEN tcc.task_type = 'edit_travel_flux' THEN 'Edit travel sequences using Flux model'
    51→    ELSE 'AI processing task'
    52→  END as description,
    53→  tcc.base_cost_per_second,
    54→  tcc.cost_factors,
    55→  tcc.is_active
    56→FROM task_cost_configs tcc
    57→WHERE tcc.is_active = true;
    58→
    59→-- =============================================================================
    60→-- 3. Add helper function to get task run_type with fallback
    61→-- =============================================================================
    62→
    63→CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_task_run_type(p_task_type text)
    64→RETURNS text
    65→LANGUAGE plpgsql
    66→SECURITY DEFINER
    67→AS $$
    68→DECLARE
    69→  v_run_type text;
    70→BEGIN
    71→  -- Look up run_type for the task_type
    72→  SELECT run_type INTO v_run_type
    73→  FROM task_types 
    74→  WHERE name = p_task_type AND is_active = true;
    75→  
    76→  -- If not found, default to 'gpu'
    77→  IF v_run_type IS NULL THEN
    78→    v_run_type := 'gpu';
    79→  END IF;
    80→  
    81→  RETURN v_run_type;
    82→END;
    83→$$;
    84→
    85→-- =============================================================================
    86→-- 4. Add comments
    87→-- =============================================================================
    88→
    89→COMMENT ON TABLE task_types IS 'Registry of all task types with their execution environment (gpu/api) and metadata';
    90→COMMENT ON COLUMN task_types.name IS 'Unique task type identifier (matches tasks.task_type)';
    91→COMMENT ON COLUMN task_types.run_type IS 'Execution environment: gpu (local/cloud GPU) or api (external API calls)';
    92→COMMENT ON COLUMN task_types.category IS 'Task category for organization and UI display';
    93→COMMENT ON FUNCTION get_task_run_type IS 'Helper function to get run_type for a task with gpu fallback';
    94→
```

```
   102→  handleRemoveLora: (id: string) => void;
   103→  handleLoraStrengthChange: (id: string, strength: number) => void;

   106→/** Full context value */
   107→interface ImageGenerationFormContextValue {
   108→  // UI state from reducer
   109→  uiState: ImageGenerationFormUIState;
   110→  uiActions: FormUIActions;
   111→
   112→  // Core state
   113→  core: FormCoreState;
   114→
   115→  // Prompt state and handlers

   118→

   121→  referenceHandlers: FormReferenceHandlers;
   122→
   123→  // LORA state and handlers

   125→  loraHandlers: FormLoraHandlers;
   126→}
   127→
   128→// ============================================================================
   129→// Context
   130→// ============================================================================
   131→
   132→const ImageGenerationFormContext = createContext<ImageGenerationFormContextValue | null>(null);
   133→
   134→// ============================================================================
   135→// Hook
   136→// ============================================================================
   137→
   138→function useImageGenerationFormContext(): ImageGenerationFormContextValue {
   139→  const context = useContext(ImageGenerationFormContext);
   140→  if (!context) {
   141→    throw new Error(
   142→      'useImageGenerationFormContext must be used within ImageGenerationFormProvider'
   143→    );
   144→  }
   145→  return context;
   146→}
   147→
   148→// Convenience hooks for specific domains
   149→export function useFormUIContext() {
   150→  const { uiState, uiActions } = useImageGenerationFormContext();
   151→  return { uiState, uiActions };
   152→}
   153→
   154→export function useFormCoreContext() {
   155→  const { core } = useImageGenerationFormContext();
   156→  return core;
   157→}
   158→
   159→export function useFormPromptsContext() {
   160→  const { prompts, promptHandlers } = useImageGenerationFormContext();
   161→  return { ...prompts, ...promptHandlers };
   162→}
   163→
   164→export function useFormReferencesContext() {
   165→  const { references, referenceHandlers } = useImageGenerationFormContext();
   166→  return { ...references, ...referenceHandlers };
   167→}
   168→
   169→export function useFormLorasContext() {
   170→  const { loras, loraHandlers } = useImageGenerationFormContext();
   171→  return { ...loras, ...loraHandlers };
   172→}
   173→
   174→// ============================================================================
   175→// Provider
   176→// ============================================================================
   177→
   178→interface ImageGenerationFormProviderProps {
   179→  value: ImageGenerationFormContextValue;
   180→  children: React.ReactNode;
   181→}
   182→
   183→export function ImageGenerationFormProvider({
   184→  value,
   185→  children,
   186→}: ImageGenerationFormProviderProps) {
   187→  return (
   188→    <ImageGenerationFormContext.Provider value={value}>
   189→      {children}
   190→    </ImageGenerationFormContext.Provider>
   191→  );
   192→}
   193→
   194→// ============================================================================
   195→// Context Value Builder Hook
   196→// ============================================================================
   197→
   198→interface UseContextValueProps {
   199→  uiState: ImageGenerationFormUIState;
   200→  uiActions: FormUIActions;
   201→  core: FormCoreState;
   202→  prompts: FormPromptState;
   203→  promptHandlers: FormPromptHandlers;
   204→  references: FormReferenceState;
   205→  referenceHandlers: FormReferenceHandlers;
   206→  loras: FormLoraState;
   207→  loraHandlers: FormLoraHandlers;
   208→}
   209→
   210→/**
   211→ * Builds memoized context value from component state.
   212→ * Call this in the main component and pass to ImageGenerationFormProvider.
   213→ */
   214→export function useContextValue(props: UseContextValueProps): ImageGenerationFormContextValue {
   215→  const {
   216→    uiState,
   217→    uiActions,
   218→    core,
   219→    prompts,
   220→    promptHandlers,
   221→    references,
   222→    referenceHandlers,
   223→    loras,
   224→    loraHandlers,
   225→  } = props;
   226→
   227→  return useMemo<ImageGenerationFormContextValue>(() => ({
   228→    uiState,
   229→    uiActions,
   230→    core,
   231→    prompts,
   232→    promptHandlers,
   233→    references,

   242→    promptHandlers,
   243→    references,
   244→    referenceHandlers,
   245→    loras,
   246→    loraHandlers,
   247→  ]);
   248→}
```
