     3→
     4→type AuthCallback = (event: string, session: Session | null) => void;
     5→
     6→export class AuthStateManager {
     7→  private listeners: Array<{id: string, callback: AuthCallback}> = [];
     8→  private isInitialized = false;
     9→  private __LAST_AUTH_HEAL_AT__ = 0;
    10→
    11→  constructor(private supabase: SupabaseClient) {}
    12→
    13→  subscribe(id: string, callback: AuthCallback) {
    14→    this.listeners.push({ id, callback });
    15→    return () => {
    16→      this.listeners = this.listeners.filter(listener => listener.id !== id);
    17→    };
    18→  }
    19→
    20→  private notifyListeners(event: string, session: Session | null) {
    21→    this.listeners.forEach(({ callback }) => {
    22→      try {
    23→        callback(event, session);
    24→      } catch (error) {
    25→        handleError(error, { context: 'AuthStateManager', showToast: false });
    26→      }
    27→    });
    28→  }
    29→
    30→  private handleCoreAuth(event: string, session: Session | null) {
    31→    try {
    32→      this.supabase?.realtime?.setAuth?.(session?.access_token ?? null);
    33→      
    34→      if (event === 'SIGNED_IN' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    35→        setTimeout(async () => {
    36→          try {
    37→            const now = Date.now();
    38→            if (now - this.__LAST_AUTH_HEAL_AT__ > 5000) {
    39→              this.__LAST_AUTH_HEAL_AT__ = now;
    40→              
    41→              // Use ReconnectScheduler instead of direct event dispatch
    42→              try {
    43→                const module = await import('@/integrations/supabase/reconnect/ReconnectScheduler');
    44→                const { getReconnectScheduler } = module;
    45→                const scheduler = getReconnectScheduler();
    46→                scheduler.requestReconnect({
    47→                  source: 'AuthManager',
    48→                  reason: `SIGNED_IN event (${event})`,
    49→                  priority: 'high'
    50→                });
    51→              } catch (importError) {
    52→                handleError(importError, { context: 'AuthStateManager', showToast: false });
    53→              }
    54→            }
    55→          } catch (healError) {
    56→            handleError(healError, { context: 'AuthStateManager', showToast: false });
    57→          }
    58→        }, 1000);
    59→      }
    60→    } catch (setAuthError) {
    61→      handleError(setAuthError, { context: 'AuthStateManager', showToast: false });
    62→    }
    63→  }

- Verify the extracted logic matches the original in each function

   509→    if (isServiceRole) {
   510→      // Service role: can update any task
   511→      updateResult = await supabaseAdmin
   512→        .from("tasks")
   513→        .update(updatePayload)
   514→        .eq("id", task_id)
   515→        .select()
   516→        .single();
   517→
   518→    } else {
   519→      // User token: can only update tasks in their projects
   520→      const { data: userProjects } = await supabaseAdmin
   521→        .from("projects")
   522→        .select("id")
   523→        .eq("user_id", callerId);
   524→
   525→      if (!userProjects || userProjects.length === 0) {
   526→        logger.error("User has no projects", { user_id: callerId ?? undefined });
   527→        await logger.flush();
   528→        return new Response("User has no projects", { status: 403 });
   529→      }
   530→
   531→      const projectIds = userProjects.map((p: any) => p.id);
   532→      
   533→      updateResult = await supabaseAdmin
   534→        .from("tasks")
   535→        .update(updatePayload)
   536→        .eq("id", task_id)
   537→        .in("project_id", projectIds)
   538→        .select()
   539→        .single();
   540→    }

   542→    if (updateResult.error) {
   543→      if (updateResult.error.code === "PGRST116") {
   544→        logger.warn("Task not found or not accessible", { task_id });
   545→        await logger.flush();
   546→        return new Response("Task not found or not accessible", { status: 404 });
   547→      }
   548→      logger.error("Database update error", { 
   549→        task_id,
   550→        error: updateResult.error.message,
   551→        code: updateResult.error.code
   552→      });
   553→      await logger.flush();
   554→      return new Response(`Database error: ${updateResult.error.message}`, { status: 500 });
   555→    }
   556→
   557→    if (!updateResult.data) {
   558→      logger.warn("Task not found or not accessible (no data)", { task_id });
   559→      await logger.flush();
   560→      return new Response("Task not found or not accessible", { status: 404 });
   561→    }

   564→      task_id, 
   565→      old_status: currentTask?.status,
   566→      new_status: status 
   567→    });
   568→
   569→    // Handle cascading failures/cancellations for orchestrated tasks
   570→    if (status === "Failed" || status === "Cancelled") {
   571→      await handleCascadingTaskFailure(supabaseAdmin, logger, task_id, status, updateResult.data);
   572→      
   573→      // Bill for completed work when orchestrator is cancelled
   574→      if (status === "Cancelled") {
   575→        await handleOrchestratorCancellationBilling(
   576→          supabaseAdmin, 
   577→          supabaseUrl, 
   578→          serviceKey, 
   579→          logger, 
   580→          task_id, 
   581→          updateResult.data
   582→        );
   583→      }
   584→    }
   585→    
   586→    await logger.flush();
   587→    return new Response(JSON.stringify({
   588→      success: true,
   589→      task_id: task_id,
   590→      status: status,
   591→      message: `Task status updated to '${status}'`
   592→    }), {
   593→      status: 200,
   594→      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }
   595→    });
   596→
   597→  } catch (error: any) {
   598→    logger.critical("Unexpected error", { task_id, error: error?.message });
   599→    await logger.flush();
   600→    return new Response(`Internal server error: ${error?.message}`, { status: 500 });
   601→  }
   602→});

   334→      output_location: publicUrl,
   335→      has_thumbnail: !!thumbnailUrl
   336→    });
   337→    await logger.flush();

   339→    return new Response(JSON.stringify(responseData), {
   340→      status: 200,
   341→      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }
   342→    });
   343→
   344→  } catch (error: any) {
   345→    logger.critical("Unexpected error", { 
   346→      task_id: taskIdString, 
   347→      error: error?.message,
   348→      stack: error?.stack?.substring(0, 500)
   349→    });
   350→    console.error("[COMPLETE-TASK] Edge function error:", error);
   351→    await logger.flush();
   352→    return new Response(`Internal error: ${error?.message}`, { status: 500 });
   353→  }
   354→}

   357→if ((import.meta as any).main) {
   358→  serve((req) => completeTaskHandler(req));
   359→}

1→/**
     2→ * Billing utilities for complete_task
     3→ * Handles cost calculation triggers
     4→ */
     5→
     6→import { extractOrchestratorTaskId } from './params.ts';
     7→
     8→/**
     9→ * Trigger cost calculation for a task
    10→ * 
    11→ * @param supabaseUrl - The Supabase project URL
    12→ * @param serviceKey - The service role key for authentication
    13→ * @param taskId - The task ID to calculate cost for
    14→ * @param logTag - Optional log tag prefix (default: 'CostCalc')
    15→ */
    16→export async function triggerCostCalculation(
    17→  supabaseUrl: string,
    18→  serviceKey: string,
    19→  taskId: string,
    20→  logTag: string = 'CostCalc'
    21→): Promise<void> {
    22→  try {
    23→    console.log(`[${logTag}] Triggering cost calculation for ${taskId}...`);
    24→    const costResp = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/functions/v1/calculate-task-cost`, {
    25→      method: "POST",
    26→      headers: {
    27→        "Authorization": `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
    28→        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    29→      },
    30→      body: JSON.stringify({ task_id: taskId })
    31→    });
    32→
    33→    if (costResp.ok) {
    34→      const costData = await costResp.json();
    35→      if (costData && typeof costData.cost === 'number') {
    36→        console.log(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation successful: $${costData.cost.toFixed(3)}`);
    37→      }
    38→    } else {
    39→      const errTxt = await costResp.text();
    40→      console.error(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation failed: ${errTxt}`);
    41→    }
    42→  } catch (costErr) {
    43→    console.error(`[${logTag}] Error triggering cost calculation:`, costErr);
    44→  }
    45→}
    46→
    47→/**
    48→ * Trigger cost calculation for a task, but skip if it's a sub-task
    49→ * (Sub-tasks have their costs rolled up into the orchestrator)
    50→ * 
    51→ * @param supabase - Supabase client for fetching task params
    52→ * @param supabaseUrl - The Supabase project URL
    53→ * @param serviceKey - The service role key for authentication
    54→ * @param taskId - The task ID to calculate cost for
    55→ */
    56→export async function triggerCostCalculationIfNotSubTask(
    57→  supabase: any,
    58→  supabaseUrl: string,
    59→  serviceKey: string,
    60→  taskId: string
    61→): Promise<void> {
    62→  try {
    63→    const { data: taskForCostCheck } = await supabase
    64→      .from("tasks")
    65→      .select("params")
    66→      .eq("id", taskId)
    67→      .single();
    68→
    69→    const subTaskOrchestratorRef = extractOrchestratorTaskId(taskForCostCheck?.params, 'CostCalc');
    70→    if (subTaskOrchestratorRef) {
    71→      console.log(`[COMPLETE-TASK] Task ${taskId} is a sub-task, skipping cost calculation`);
    72→      return;
    73→    }
    74→
    75→    await triggerCostCalculation(supabaseUrl, serviceKey, taskId, 'COMPLETE-TASK');
    76→  } catch (costErr) {
    77→    console.error("[COMPLETE-TASK] Error triggering cost calculation:", costErr);
    78→  }
    79→}
    80→
    81→
    82→
    83→

   218→    case 'jpg':

   221→    case 'gif':

   231→    default:

   233→  }

   270→  // Add thumbnail_url to params if available
   271→  if (thumbnailUrl) {

   275→  return generationParams;

1→/**
     2→ * Orchestrator completion logic for complete_task
     3→ * Handles checking if all child segments are complete and marking orchestrator done
     4→ */
     5→
     6→import { extractOrchestratorTaskId, extractOrchestratorRunId } from './params.ts';
     7→import { triggerCostCalculation } from './billing.ts';
     8→import { TASK_TYPES, SEGMENT_TYPE_CONFIG } from './constants.ts';
     9→import type { TaskContext } from './index.ts';
    10→
    11→/** Minimal shape for segment tasks returned from DB queries */
    12→interface SegmentTask {
    13→  id: string;
    14→  status: string;
    15→  generation_started_at: string | null;
    16→}
    17→
    18→/** Minimal shape for the orchestrator task fetched from DB */
    19→interface OrchestratorTask {
    20→  id: string;
    21→  status: string;
    22→  params: Record<string, any>;
    23→}
    24→
    25→/**
    26→ * Check if all sibling segments are complete and mark orchestrator done if so
    27→ */
    28→export async function checkOrchestratorCompletion(
    29→  supabase: any,
    30→  taskIdString: string,
    31→  completedTask: TaskContext,
    32→  publicUrl: string,
    33→  supabaseUrl: string,
    34→  serviceKey: string
    35→): Promise<void> {
    36→  const taskType = completedTask.task_type;
    37→  const config = taskType ? SEGMENT_TYPE_CONFIG[taskType] : null;
    38→
    39→  if (!config) {
    40→    return; // Not a segment task
    41→  }
    42→
    43→  const orchestratorTaskId = extractOrchestratorTaskId(completedTask.params, 'OrchestratorComplete');
    44→  const orchestratorRunId = extractOrchestratorRunId(completedTask.params, 'OrchestratorComplete');
    45→
    46→  if (!orchestratorTaskId) {
    47→    return;
    48→  }
    49→
    50→  console.log(`[OrchestratorComplete] ${taskType} ${taskIdString} completed. Checking siblings for orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId}`);
    51→
    52→  // FETCH: orchestrator task + sibling segments in parallel
    53→  const segmentTypeToQuery = config.isFinalStep
    54→    ? (config.billingSegmentType || config.segmentType)
    55→    : config.segmentType;
    56→
    57→  const orchPromise: Promise<{ data: OrchestratorTask | null; error: any }> =
    58→    supabase.from("tasks").select("id, status, params").eq("id", orchestratorTaskId).single();
    59→
    60→  const [orchResult, allSegments] = await Promise.all([
    61→    orchPromise,
    62→    findSiblingSegments(supabase, segmentTypeToQuery, completedTask.project_id, orchestratorTaskId, orchestratorRunId),
    63→  ]);
    64→
    65→  // VALIDATE: orchestrator exists and isn't already done
    66→  const { data: orchestratorTask, error: orchError } = orchResult;
    67→
    68→  if (orchError) {
    69→    console.error(`[OrchestratorComplete] Error fetching orchestrator task ${orchestratorTaskId}:`, orchError);
    70→    return;
    71→  }
    72→
    73→  if (!orchestratorTask) {
    74→    console.log(`[OrchestratorComplete] Orchestrator task ${orchestratorTaskId} not found`);
    75→    return;
    76→  }
    77→
    78→  if (orchestratorTask.status === 'Complete') {
    79→    console.log(`[OrchestratorComplete] Orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} is already Complete`);
    80→    return;
    81→  }
    82→
    83→  // FINAL STEP: tasks like join_final_stitch complete the orchestrator directly
    84→  if (config.isFinalStep) {
    85→    console.log(`[OrchestratorComplete] ${taskType} is a final step task - marking orchestrator complete directly`);
    86→
    87→    await markOrchestratorComplete(
    88→      supabase,
    89→      orchestratorTaskId,
    90→      allSegments || [],
    91→      publicUrl,
    92→      true,
    93→      supabaseUrl,
    94→      serviceKey
    95→    );
    96→    return;
    97→  }
    98→
    99→  // COUNT: check segment completion status
   100→  let expectedSegmentCount: number | null = null;
   101→
   102→  if (taskType === TASK_TYPES.TRAVEL_SEGMENT) {
   103→    expectedSegmentCount = orchestratorTask.params?.orchestrator_details?.num_new_segments_to_generate ||
   104→      orchestratorTask.params?.num_new_segments_to_generate || null;
   105→  } else if (taskType === TASK_TYPES.JOIN_CLIPS_SEGMENT) {
   106→    const clipList = orchestratorTask.params?.orchestrator_details?.clip_list;
   107→    if (Array.isArray(clipList) && clipList.length > 1) {
   108→      expectedSegmentCount = clipList.length - 1;
   109→    } else {
   110→      expectedSegmentCount = orchestratorTask.params?.orchestrator_details?.num_joins || null;
   111→    }
   112→  }
   113→
   114→  console.log(`[OrchestratorComplete] Orchestrator expects ${expectedSegmentCount ?? 'unknown'} segments`);
   115→
   116→  if (!allSegments || allSegments.length === 0) {
   117→    console.log(`[OrchestratorComplete] No segments found for orchestrator`);
   118→    return;
   119→  }
   120→
   121→  const foundSegments = allSegments.length;
   122→  const completedSegments = allSegments.filter((s) => s.status === 'Complete').length;
   123→  const failedSegments = allSegments.filter((s) => s.status === 'Failed' || s.status === 'Cancelled').length;
   124→  const pendingSegments = foundSegments - completedSegments - failedSegments;
   125→
   126→  console.log(`[OrchestratorComplete] ${taskType} status: ${completedSegments} complete, ${failedSegments} failed, ${pendingSegments} pending`);
   127→
   128→  if (expectedSegmentCount !== null && foundSegments !== expectedSegmentCount) {
   129→    console.log(`[OrchestratorComplete] Warning: Found ${foundSegments} segments but expected ${expectedSegmentCount}`);
   130→    return;
   131→  }
   132→
   133→  if (pendingSegments > 0) {
   134→    console.log(`[OrchestratorComplete] Still waiting for ${pendingSegments} segments to complete`);
   135→    return;
   136→  }
   137→
   138→  if (failedSegments > 0) {
   139→    await markOrchestratorFailed(supabase, orchestratorTaskId, failedSegments, foundSegments);
   140→    return;
   141→  }
   142→
   143→  // WAIT: check if a final step task (like join_final_stitch) is still pending
   144→  if (config.waitForFinalStepType) {
   145→    const finalStitchStatus = await checkFinalStitchStatus(
   146→      supabase,
   147→      config.waitForFinalStepType,
   148→      completedTask.project_id,
   149→      orchestratorTaskId,
   150→    );
   151→
   152→    if (finalStitchStatus === 'pending') {
   153→      console.log(`[OrchestratorComplete] Waiting for ${config.waitForFinalStepType} to complete`);
   154→      return;
   155→    }
   156→
   157→    if (finalStitchStatus === 'failed') {
   158→      console.log(`[OrchestratorComplete] Final stitch failed - marking orchestrator as Failed`);
   159→      await markOrchestratorFailed(supabase, orchestratorTaskId, 1, 1);
   160→      return;
   161→    }
   162→
   163→    if (finalStitchStatus === 'complete') {
   164→      console.log(`[OrchestratorComplete] Final stitch is complete - will mark orchestrator complete`);
   165→    }
   166→  }
   167→
   168→  // COMPLETE: all segments done, no pending final step
   169→  await markOrchestratorComplete(
   170→    supabase,
   171→    orchestratorTaskId,
   172→    allSegments,
   173→    publicUrl,
   174→    false,
   175→    supabaseUrl,
   176→    serviceKey
   177→  );
   178→}
   179→
   180→/**
   181→ * Find sibling segment tasks using run_id (preferred) or orchestrator_task_id (fallback)
   182→ */
   183→async function findSiblingSegments(
   184→  supabase: any,
   185→  segmentType: string,
   186→  projectId: string,
   187→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   188→  orchestratorRunId: string | null
   189→): Promise<SegmentTask[] | null> {
   190→  let allSegments: SegmentTask[] | null = null;
   191→  let segmentsError: any = null;
   192→
   193→  if (orchestratorRunId) {
   194→    console.log(`[OrchestratorComplete] Querying ${segmentType} by run_id: ${orchestratorRunId}`);
   195→
   196→    const runIdResult = await supabase
   197→      .from("tasks")
   198→      .select("id, status, generation_started_at")
   199→      .eq("task_type", segmentType)
   200→      .eq("project_id", projectId)
   201→      .or(`params->>orchestrator_run_id.eq.${orchestratorRunId},params->>run_id.eq.${orchestratorRunId},params->orchestrator_details->>run_id.eq.${orchestratorRunId}`);
   202→
   203→    allSegments = runIdResult.data;
   204→    segmentsError = runIdResult.error;
   205→
   206→    if (allSegments && allSegments.length > 0) {
   207→      console.log(`[OrchestratorComplete] Found ${allSegments.length} segments via run_id query`);
   208→      return allSegments;
   209→    }
   210→  }
   211→

   229→
   230→  if (segmentsError) {

   238→/**
   239→ * Check the status of the final stitch task for this orchestrator
   240→ */
   241→async function checkFinalStitchStatus(
   242→  supabase: any,
   243→  finalStepType: string,
   244→  projectId: string,
   245→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   246→): Promise<'not_found' | 'pending' | 'complete' | 'failed'> {
   247→  console.log(`[OrchestratorComplete] Checking status of ${finalStepType} tasks for orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId}`);
   248→
   249→  const { data: finalStepTasks, error } = await supabase
   250→    .from("tasks")
   251→    .select("id, status")
   252→    .eq("task_type", finalStepType)
   253→    .eq("project_id", projectId)
   254→    .or(`params->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId},params->>orchestrator_task_id_ref.eq.${orchestratorTaskId},params->orchestrator_details->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`);
   255→
   256→  if (error) {
   257→    console.error(`[OrchestratorComplete] Error checking final stitch status:`, error);
   258→    return 'not_found';
   259→  }
   260→
   261→  if (!finalStepTasks || finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
   262→    console.log(`[OrchestratorComplete] No ${finalStepType} tasks found - task not yet created`);
   263→    return 'not_found';
   264→  }
   265→
   266→  const task = finalStepTasks[0];
   267→  console.log(`[OrchestratorComplete] Found ${finalStepType} task ${task.id} with status: ${task.status}`);
   268→
   269→  if (task.status === 'Complete') {
   270→    return 'complete';
   271→  } else if (task.status === 'Failed' || task.status === 'Cancelled') {
   272→    return 'failed';
   273→  } else {
   274→    return 'pending';
   275→  }
   276→}
   277→
   278→/**
   279→ * Mark orchestrator as Failed
   280→ */
   281→async function markOrchestratorFailed(
   282→  supabase: any,
   283→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   284→  failedSegments: number,
   285→  totalSegments: number
   286→): Promise<void> {
   287→  console.log(`[OrchestratorComplete] Marking orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Failed (${failedSegments}/${totalSegments} failed)`);
   288→
   289→  const { error: updateOrchError } = await supabase
   290→    .from("tasks")
   291→    .update({
   292→      status: "Failed",
   293→      error_message: `${failedSegments} of ${totalSegments} segments failed`,
   294→      generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()
   295→    })
   296→    .eq("id", orchestratorTaskId)
   297→    .in("status", ["Queued", "In Progress"]);
   298→
   299→  if (updateOrchError) {
   300→    console.error(`[OrchestratorComplete] Failed to mark orchestrator as Failed:`, updateOrchError);
   301→  } else {
   302→    console.log(`[OrchestratorComplete] Marked orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Failed`);
   303→  }
   304→}
   305→
   306→/**
   307→ * Mark orchestrator as Complete and trigger billing
   308→ */
   309→async function markOrchestratorComplete(
   310→  supabase: any,
   311→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   312→  allSegments: SegmentTask[],
   313→  publicUrl: string,
   314→  isFinalStep: boolean,
   315→  supabaseUrl: string,
   316→  serviceKey: string
   317→): Promise<void> {
   318→  console.log(`[OrchestratorComplete] Marking orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Complete`);
   319→
   320→  // Find earliest sub-task start time for billing
   321→  let earliestStartTime: string | null = null;
   322→  for (const segment of allSegments) {
   323→    if (segment.generation_started_at) {
   324→      if (!earliestStartTime || segment.generation_started_at < earliestStartTime) {
   325→        earliestStartTime = segment.generation_started_at;
   326→      }
   327→    }
   328→  }
   329→
   330→  const updateData: Record<string, any> = {
   331→    status: "Complete",
   332→    generation_started_at: earliestStartTime || new Date().toISOString(),
   333→    generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()
   334→  };
   335→
   336→  // Only set output_location for final step tasks (e.g. join_final_stitch)
   337→  // where publicUrl is the actual stitched output. For segment completions,
   338→  // publicUrl is an arbitrary segment URL that shouldn't be the orchestrator's output.
   339→  if (isFinalStep) {
   340→    updateData.output_location = publicUrl;
   341→  }
   342→
   343→  const { error: updateOrchError } = await supabase
   344→    .from("tasks")
   345→    .update(updateData)
   346→    .eq("id", orchestratorTaskId)
   347→    .in("status", ["Queued", "In Progress"]);
   348→
   349→  if (updateOrchError) {
   350→    console.error(`[OrchestratorComplete] Failed to mark orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Complete:`, updateOrchError);
   351→    return;
   352→  }
   353→
   354→  console.log(`[OrchestratorComplete] Successfully marked orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Complete`);
   355→
   356→  await triggerCostCalculation(supabaseUrl, serviceKey, orchestratorTaskId, 'OrchestratorComplete');
   357→}

    30→// Special cost calculation for video_enhance task
    31→// Combines FILM (time-based) and FlashVSR (megapixel-based) pricing
    32→function calculateVideoEnhanceCost(taskParams: any): { cost: number; breakdown: any } {
    33→  let totalCost = 0;
    34→  const breakdown: any = {};
    35→
    36→  // Get result data from task params (worker should populate this)
    37→  const result = taskParams?.result || taskParams;
    38→
    39→  // FILM interpolation cost: $0.0013 per compute second
    40→  if (result?.interpolation_compute_seconds && result.interpolation_compute_seconds > 0) {
    41→    const filmCost = VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FILM_COST_PER_SECOND * result.interpolation_compute_seconds;
    42→    totalCost += filmCost;
    43→    breakdown.interpolation = {
    44→      compute_seconds: result.interpolation_compute_seconds,
    45→      cost_per_second: VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FILM_COST_PER_SECOND,
    46→      cost: Math.round(filmCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
    47→    };
    48→  }
    49→
    50→  // FlashVSR upscale cost: $0.0005 per megapixel
    51→  if (result?.output_width && result?.output_height && result?.output_frames) {
    52→    const megapixels = (result.output_width * result.output_height * result.output_frames) / 1_000_000;
    53→    const upscaleCost = VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL * megapixels;
    54→    totalCost += upscaleCost;
    55→    breakdown.upscale = {
    56→      output_width: result.output_width,
    57→      output_height: result.output_height,
    58→      output_frames: result.output_frames,
    59→      megapixels: Math.round(megapixels * 100) / 100,
    60→      cost_per_megapixel: VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL,
    61→      cost: Math.round(upscaleCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
    62→    };
    63→  }

    71→// Calculate cost based on billing type and task configuration
    72→function calculateTaskCost(

    77→  durationSeconds: number,
    78→  costFactors: any,

    88→    totalCost = unitCost || 0;

    91→  }
    92→
    93→  // Apply cost factors regardless of billing type

    95→    if (costFactors.resolution && taskParams.resolution) {
    96→      const resolutionMultiplier = costFactors.resolution[taskParams.resolution] || 1;
    97→      totalCost *= resolutionMultiplier;
    98→    }
    99→    if (costFactors.frameCount && taskParams.frame_count) {
   100→      if (billingType === 'per_unit') {

   384→        billing_type: taskType.billing_type,
   385→        base_cost_per_second: taskType.base_cost_per_second,
   386→        unit_cost: taskType.unit_cost,

   389→      });
   390→      await logger.flush();
   391→      return jsonResponse({ error: 'Invalid cost calculation' }, 500);
   392→    }
   393→
   394→    // Ensure user exists before inserting credit ledger entry
   395→    const { data: user, error: userError } = await supabaseAdmin
   396→      .from('users')

   401→    if (userError || !user) {

   406→      await logger.flush();
   407→      return jsonResponse({ error: 'User not found for credit calculation' }, 400);
   408→    }
   409→
   410→    // Insert cost into credit ledger
   411→    const { error: ledgerError } = await supabaseAdmin.from('credits_ledger').insert({
   412→      user_id: (task as any).projects.user_id,

   427→        ...(costBreakdown ? { cost_breakdown: costBreakdown } : {})
   428→      }
   429→    });
   430→
   431→    if (ledgerError) {
   432→      logger.error("Failed to insert into credit ledger", { 
   433→        error: ledgerError.message,
   434→        user_id: (task as any).projects.user_id,
   435→        cost
   436→      });
   437→      await logger.flush();
   438→      return jsonResponse({ error: `Failed to record cost in ledger: ${ledgerError.message}` }, 500);
   439→    }
   440→
   441→    logger.info("Cost calculated and recorded", {
   442→      cost,
   443→      billing_type: taskType.billing_type,
   444→      duration_seconds: durationSeconds,
   445→      user_id: (task as any).projects.user_id,
   446→      ...(costBreakdown ? { breakdown: costBreakdown } : {})
   447→    });
   448→    await logger.flush();
   449→
   450→    return jsonResponse({
   451→      success: true,
   452→      cost: cost,
   453→      billing_type: taskType.billing_type,
   454→      duration_seconds: durationSeconds,
   455→      base_cost_per_second: taskType.base_cost_per_second,

   458→      task_type: task.task_type,

   460→      // Include breakdown for compound pricing (e.g., video_enhance)
   461→      ...(costBreakdown ? { cost_breakdown: costBreakdown } : {})
   462→    });
   463→
   464→  } catch (error: any) {
   465→    logger.critical("Unexpected error", { error: error?.message, stack: error?.stack?.substring(0, 500) });
   466→    await logger.flush();
   467→    return jsonResponse({ error: error?.message || 'Unknown error occurred' }, 500);
   468→  }
   469→});

    57→function secondsToTimeString(seconds: number): string {

    44→

    46→  let body: any;

    48→    body = await req.json();
    49→  } catch {

    51→  }
    52→  
    53→  const { sessionId, userId } = body;
    54→
    55→  if (!sessionId || !userId) {
    56→    return jsonResponse({ error: "sessionId and userId are required" }, 400);
    57→  }
    58→
    59→  // ─── 2. Verify service role authentication ──────────────────────
    60→  const authHeader = req.headers.get("Authorization");
    61→  const serviceRoleKey = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY");
    62→  
    63→  if (!authHeader?.startsWith("Bearer ") || authHeader.slice(7) !== serviceRoleKey) {
    64→    return jsonResponse({ error: "Unauthorized - service role required" }, 401);
    65→  }
    66→
    67→  const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL");
    68→  if (!supabaseUrl || !serviceRoleKey) {
    69→    console.error("Missing required environment variables");
    70→    return jsonResponse({ error: "Server configuration error" }, 500);
    71→  }
    72→
    73→  // ─── 3. Create Supabase admin client ────────────────────────────
    74→  const supabaseAdmin = createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceRoleKey, {

    76→      autoRefreshToken: false,
    77→      persistSession: false
    78→    }
    79→  });
    80→
    81→  try {

    83→    const stripeSecretKey = Deno.env.get("STRIPE_SECRET_KEY");
    84→    if (!stripeSecretKey) {
    85→      console.error("STRIPE_SECRET_KEY not set in environment");
    86→      return jsonResponse({ error: "Stripe not configured" }, 500);
    87→    }
    88→
    89→    const stripe = new Stripe(stripeSecretKey, {
    90→      apiVersion: "2024-06-20",
    91→    });
    92→
    93→    // ─── 5. Retrieve checkout session and payment intent ────────────

    95→      expand: ['payment_intent', 'setup_intent']

    97→
    98→    if (!session.payment_intent) {
    99→      return jsonResponse({ error: "No payment intent found in session" }, 400);
   100→    }
   101→
   102→    // Get the payment intent with payment method details

   114→    }

   122→      })
   123→      .eq('id', userId);
   124→
   125→    if (updateError) {

   127→      return jsonResponse({ error: 'Failed to save payment method' }, 500);

   135→      paymentMethodType: paymentIntent.payment_method.type,
   136→    });

   138→    return jsonResponse({

   142→      paymentMethodType: paymentIntent.payment_method.type,

   113→    await logger.flush();

   127→      if (!ownershipResult.success) {

   131→          error: ownershipResult.error
   132→        });
   133→        await logger.flush();
   134→        return new Response(ownershipResult.error || "Forbidden", {

   136→        });
   137→      }

   139→      logger.info("Shot ownership verified", { shot_id, userId: callerId });

   141→
   142→    logger.info("Processing shot", {
   143→      shot_id,
   144→      enhancedPromptsCount: enhanced_prompts.length,
   145→    });

   147→    // Get all shot_generations for this shot, filtering for images with timeline_frame
   148→    const { data: shotGenerations, error: sgError } = await supabaseAdmin
   149→      .from("shot_generations")
   150→      .select(`
   151→        id,
   152→        generation_id,
   153→        timeline_frame,
   154→        metadata,
   155→        generation:generations!shot_generations_generation_id_generations_id_fk(

   157→          type,
   158→          location
   159→        )
   160→      `)
   161→      .eq("shot_id", shot_id)
   162→      .not("timeline_frame", "is", null)
   163→      // Deterministic ordering: Timeline sorts by timeline_frame; add a stable tie-breaker.
   164→      .order("timeline_frame", { ascending: true })
   165→      .order("id", { ascending: true });
   166→
   167→    if (sgError) {
   168→      logger.error("Error fetching shot_generations", { 
   169→        shot_id, 
   170→        error: sgError.message 
   171→      });
   172→      await logger.flush();
   173→      return new Response(`Database error: ${sgError.message}`, { status: 500 });

   175→
   176→    if (!shotGenerations || shotGenerations.length === 0) {
   177→      logger.warn("No shot_generations found for shot", { shot_id });
   178→      await logger.flush();
   179→      return new Response(JSON.stringify({
   180→        success: true,
   181→        message: "No positioned images found for this shot",
   182→        updated_count: 0,
   183→      }), {
   184→        status: 200,
   185→        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }
   186→      });
   187→    }
   188→
   189→    // Filter to only include positioned images (not videos, not unpositioned)
   190→    // Must match Timeline.tsx filtering logic exactly:
   191→    // - Exclude videos by type and extension (.mp4, .webm, .mov)
   192→    // - Exclude unpositioned items (timeline_frame < 0, e.g. -1 sentinel)
   193→    const VIDEO_EXTENSIONS = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mov'];
   194→    const hasVideoExtension = (url: string | null | undefined): boolean => {
   195→      if (!url) return false;
   196→      const lower = url.toLowerCase();
   197→      return VIDEO_EXTENSIONS.some(ext => lower.endsWith(ext));
   198→    };
   199→    
   200→    const imageGenerations = shotGenerations.filter(sg => {
   201→      const gen = sg.generation as any;
   202→      // Exclude videos
   203→      const isVideo = gen?.type === 'video' || 
   204→                     gen?.type === 'video_travel_output' ||
   205→                     hasVideoExtension(gen?.location);
   206→      if (isVideo) return false;
   207→      
   208→      // Exclude unpositioned items (timeline_frame < 0, e.g. -1 sentinel)
   209→      // Note: NULL already excluded by query, but check for safety
   210→      if (sg.timeline_frame == null || sg.timeline_frame < 0) return false;
   211→      
   212→      return true;
   213→    });
   214→
   215→    logger.info("Found shot_generations", {
   216→      shot_id,
   217→      totalCount: shotGenerations.length,
   218→      imageCount: imageGenerations.length,

   220→      firstFewFrames: imageGenerations.slice(0, 3).map(sg => sg.timeline_frame),
   221→    });
   222→
   223→    // Verify enhanced_prompts count matches expected (N-1 for N images, since prompts describe transitions)
   224→    const expectedPromptCount = Math.max(0, imageGenerations.length - 1);
   225→    if (enhanced_prompts.length !== expectedPromptCount) {
   226→      logger.warn("Enhanced prompts count differs from expected", {
   227→        shot_id,
   228→        imageCount: imageGenerations.length,
   229→        expectedPromptCount,
   230→        actualPromptCount: enhanced_prompts.length,
   231→        note: 'Enhanced prompts describe transitions between images (N-1 prompts for N images)'
   232→      });
   233→    }
   234→
   235→    if (imageGenerations.length === 0) {
   236→      logger.info("No image generations found for shot", { shot_id });
   237→      await logger.flush();
   238→      return new Response(JSON.stringify({
   239→        success: true,
   240→        message: "No image generations found for this shot",
   241→        updated_count: 0,
   242→      }), {
   243→        status: 200,
   244→        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }
   245→      });
   246→    }
   247→
   248→    // Update each shot_generation's metadata with the corresponding enhanced_prompt
   249→    // Image at index i gets enhanced_prompts[i] (describes transition FROM this image TO the next)
   250→    const updatePromises = imageGenerations.map(async (sg, index) => {
   251→      // Get existing metadata or create new object
   252→      const existingMetadata = sg.metadata || {};
   253→      
   254→      // Check if we have an enhanced_prompt for this index
   255→      const enhancedPrompt = index < enhanced_prompts.length ? enhanced_prompts[index] : undefined;
   256→      
   257→      // Skip if enhanced_prompt is empty/falsy (expected for last image)
   258→      if (!enhancedPrompt) {
   259→        logger.debug("Skipping shot_generation (no prompt for this index)", {
   260→          shot_id,
   261→          shotGenerationId: sg.id.substring(0, 8),
   262→          index,
   263→          timeline_frame: sg.timeline_frame,
   264→          reason: index >= enhanced_prompts.length ? 'last_image_no_transition' : 'empty_prompt'
   265→        });
   266→        return { id: sg.id, success: true, skipped: true };
   267→      }
   268→
   269→      // Build updated metadata with enhanced_prompt
   270→      const updatedMetadata = {
   271→        ...existingMetadata,
   272→        enhanced_prompt: enhancedPrompt,
   273→      };
   274→
   275→      logger.debug("Updating shot_generation with enhanced_prompt", {
   276→        shot_id,
   277→        shotGenerationId: sg.id.substring(0, 8),
   278→        index,
   279→        timeline_frame: sg.timeline_frame,
   280→        promptPreview: enhancedPrompt.substring(0, 80) + (enhancedPrompt.length > 80 ? '...' : ''),
   281→      });
   282→
   283→      // Update the shot_generation
   284→      const { error: updateError } = await supabaseAdmin
   285→        .from("shot_generations")
   286→        .update({ metadata: updatedMetadata })
   287→        .eq("id", sg.id);
   288→
   289→      if (updateError) {
   290→        logger.error("Error updating shot_generation", {
   291→          shot_id,
   292→          shotGenerationId: sg.id.substring(0, 8),
   293→          error: updateError.message
   294→        });
   295→        return { id: sg.id, success: false, error: updateError.message };
   296→      }
   297→
   298→      return { id: sg.id, success: true };
   299→    });
   300→
   301→    const results = await Promise.all(updatePromises);
   302→    const successCount = results.filter(r => r.success).length;
   303→    const failedCount = results.filter(r => !r.success).length;
   304→    const skippedCount = results.filter(r => (r as any).skipped).length;
   305→
   306→    logger.info("Update complete", {

   308→      total: results.length,
   309→      success: successCount,
   310→      failed: failedCount,
   311→      skipped: skippedCount,
   312→    });
   313→
   314→    await logger.flush();
   315→    
   316→    return new Response(JSON.stringify({
   317→      success: true,

   320→      skipped_count: skippedCount,
   321→      failed_count: failedCount,
   322→      shot_id: shot_id,
   323→    }), {
   324→      status: 200,
   325→      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }
   326→    });
   327→
   328→  } catch (error: any) {
   329→    logger.critical("Unexpected error", {

   332→    });
   333→    await logger.flush();
   334→    return new Response(`Internal server error: ${error?.message || 'Unknown error'}`, { status: 500 });
   335→  }
   336→});

  "file_path": "/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/supabase/functions/_shared/billing.ts",
  "content": "/**\n * Shared billing utilities for edge functions\n *\n * Centralizes:\n *  - Orchestrator/sub-task detection (extractOrchestratorRef, isSubTask)\n *  - Sub-task query filter for Supabase `.or()` calls\n *  - Cost calculation HTTP trigger\n *\n * Consumers: calculate-task-cost, update-task-status, complete_task\n */\n\n// ===== Constants =====\n\n/** UUID v4 regex — used to distinguish real orchestrator FK refs from human-readable IDs */\nexport const UUID_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;\n\n// ===== Orchestrator reference extraction =====\n\n/**\n * Extract orchestrator_task_id from task params.\n *\n * Sub-tasks can store the orchestrator reference in multiple param paths\n * depending on the task type and how they were created:\n *  - params.orchestrator_task_id_ref          (travel_segment)\n *  - params.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id  (join_clips_segment)\n *  - params.originalParams.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id (legacy)\n *  - params.orchestrator_task_id              (some legacy tasks)\n *\n * Returns the raw string value (may not be a valid UUID) or null.\n */\nexport function extractOrchestratorRef(params: any): string | null {\n  if (!params || typeof params !== 'object') return null;\n\n  return (\n    params.orchestrator_task_id_ref ||\n    params.orchestrator_details?.orchestrator_task_id ||\n    params.originalParams?.orchestrator_details?.orchestrator_task_id ||\n    params.orchestrator_task_id ||\n    null\n  );\n}\n\n/**\n * Determine whether a task is a sub-task of an orchestrator.\n *\n * A task is a sub-task when:\n *  1. Its params contain an orchestrator reference (via any of the known paths)\n *  2. That reference is a valid UUID (not a human-readable orchestrator ID)\n *  3. The reference is NOT the task's own ID (orchestrators store their own ID\n *     in params.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id for children to copy)\n *\n * @param params  - task.params (object, not stringified)\n * @param taskId  - the task's own ID, to guard against self-references\n * @returns The orchestrator task ID if this is a sub-task, or null otherwise\n */\nexport function getSubTaskOrchestratorId(params: any, taskId: string): string | null {\n  const ref = extractOrchestratorRef(params);\n  if (!ref) return null;\n  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(ref)) return null;\n  if (ref === taskId) return null;\n  return ref;\n}\n\n// ===== Sub-task query filter =====\n\n/**\n * Build a Supabase PostgREST `.or()` filter string that finds all tasks\n * whose params reference the given orchestrator task ID.\n *\n * Covers all four param paths where a sub-task may store the reference.\n *\n * Usage:\n *   supabase.from('tasks').select('...').or(buildSubTaskFilter(orchestratorId))\n */\nexport function buildSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId: string): string {\n  return [\n    `params->>orchestrator_task_id_ref.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,\n    `params->orchestrator_details->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,\n    `params->originalParams->orchestrator_details->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,\n    `params->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,\n  ].join(',');\n}\n\n// ===== Cost calculation trigger =====\n\n/**\n * Trigger the calculate-task-cost edge function for a given task.\n *\n * This is a fire-and-forget HTTP call (errors are logged, not thrown).\n *\n * @param supabaseUrl - The Supabase project URL\n * @param serviceKey  - The service role key for authentication\n * @param taskId      - The task ID to calculate cost for\n * @param logTag      - Optional log tag prefix (default: 'CostCalc')\n */\nexport async function triggerCostCalculation(\n  supabaseUrl: string,\n  serviceKey: string,\n  taskId: string,\n  logTag: string = 'CostCalc'\n): Promise<void> {\n  try {\n    console.log(`[${logTag}] Triggering cost calculation for ${taskId}...`);\n    const costResp = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/functions/v1/calculate-task-cost`, {\n      method: \"POST\",\n      headers: {\n        \"Authorization\": `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,\n        \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\"\n      },\n      body: JSON.stringify({ task_id: taskId })\n    });\n\n    if (costResp.ok) {\n      const costData = await costResp.json();\n      if (costData.skipped) {\n        console.log(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation skipped: ${costData.reason}`);\n      } else if (typeof costData.cost === 'number') {\n        console.log(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation successful: $${costData.cost.toFixed(3)}`);\n      }\n    } else {\n      const errTxt = await costResp.text();\n      console.error(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation failed: ${errTxt}`);\n    }\n  } catch (costErr) {\n    console.error(`[${logTag}] Error triggering cost calculation:`, costErr);\n  }\n}\n"
}

    92→        userSettingsRef.current = merged;

    94→      });
    95→    } catch (error) {
    96→      handleError(error, { context: 'UserSettingsContext', showToast: false });

    98→  }, [userId]);
    99→
   100→  // Fetch settings when user changes
   101→  useEffect(() => {

   107→      setIsLoadingSettings(false);
   108→    }
   109→  }, [userId, fetchUserSettings]);

   112→  const handleSettingsTimeout = useCallback(() => {
   113→    setIsLoadingSettings(false);
   114→    setUserSettings({});
   115→    userSettingsRef.current = {};

   121→    mobileTimeoutMs: 10000,

   123→    enabled: !!userId,
   124→  });
   125→
   126→  const contextValue = useMemo(
   127→    () => ({
   128→      userSettings,
   129→      isLoadingSettings,
   130→      fetchUserSettings,
   131→      updateUserSettings,
   132→    }),
   133→    [userSettings, isLoadingSettings, fetchUserSettings, updateUserSettings]
   134→  );
   135→
   136→  return (
   137→    <UserSettingsContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
   138→      {children}
   139→    </UserSettingsContext.Provider>
   140→  );
   141→};

   143→/**
   144→ * Hook to access user settings (server-persisted, cross-device).

   147→ *
   148→ * @returns { userSettings, isLoadingSettings, fetchUserSettings, updateUserSettings }
   149→ */
   150→export const useUserSettings = () => {
   151→  const context = useContext(UserSettingsContext);
   152→  if (context === undefined) {
   153→    const errorMessage = 'useUserSettings must be used within a UserSettingsProvider. ' +
   154→      'Make sure the component is rendered inside the UserSettingsProvider tree.';
   155→    console.error('[UserSettingsContext]', errorMessage, {
   156→      stack: new Error().stack,
   157→    });
   158→    throw new Error(errorMessage);
   159→  }

1→import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
     2→import { isMobileUA } from '@/shared/hooks/use-mobile';
     3→
     4→interface UseMobileTimeoutFallbackOptions {
     5→  /** Whether the operation is currently in a loading state */
     6→  isLoading: boolean;
     7→  /** Called when the timeout fires while still loading (e.g. retry fetch, set defaults) */
     8→  onTimeout: () => void;
     9→  /** Timeout duration on mobile devices (default: 15000ms) */
    10→  mobileTimeoutMs?: number;
    11→  /** Timeout duration on desktop (default: 10000ms) */
    12→  desktopTimeoutMs?: number;
    13→  /** Whether the fallback is enabled (default: true) */
    14→  enabled?: boolean;
    15→}
    16→
    17→/**
    18→ * Shared mobile stall recovery hook.
    19→ *
    20→ * When `isLoading` becomes true, starts a timer (longer on mobile).
    21→ * If loading hasn't finished by the time the timer fires, calls `onTimeout`.
    22→ * Timer is cleared when loading finishes or the component unmounts.
    23→ *
    24→ * Replaces inline [MobileStallFix] patterns in ProjectContext and UserSettingsContext.
    25→ */
    26→export function useMobileTimeoutFallback({
    27→  isLoading,
    28→  onTimeout,
    29→  mobileTimeoutMs = 15000,
    30→  desktopTimeoutMs = 10000,
    31→  enabled = true,
    32→}: UseMobileTimeoutFallbackOptions): void {
    33→  const onTimeoutRef = useRef(onTimeout);
    34→  onTimeoutRef.current = onTimeout;
    35→
    36→  useEffect(() => {
    37→    if (!enabled || !isLoading) return;
    38→
    39→    const isMobile = isMobileUA();
    40→    const timeoutMs = isMobile ? mobileTimeoutMs : desktopTimeoutMs;
    41→
    42→    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
    43→      onTimeoutRef.current();
    44→    }, timeoutMs);
    45→
    46→    return () => {
    47→      clearTimeout(timer);
    48→    };
    49→  }, [isLoading, enabled, mobileTimeoutMs, desktopTimeoutMs]);
    50→}
    51→

## Summary

### New file created

**`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/hooks/useMobileTimeoutFallback.ts`** -- A shared hook that encapsulates the mobile stall recovery pattern. It:
- Watches an `isLoading` boolean; when it becomes `true`, starts a timer
- Uses `isMobileUA()` from `use-mobile.tsx` (instead of inline UA regex) to determine timeout duration
- Calls `onTimeout` if loading hasn't finished when the timer fires
- Automatically cleans up the timer when loading finishes or the component unmounts
- Accepts `enabled`, `mobileTimeoutMs`, and `desktopTimeoutMs` options for flexibility

### Refactored files

**`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/contexts/ProjectContext.tsx`**:
- Removed `isMobileRef` (inline `navigator.userAgent` regex)
- Removed `projectsTimeoutRef` and its cleanup useEffect
- Removed inline timeout setup from the project-fetching useEffect (lines ~515-550)
- Removed timeout clearing from `fetchProjects`'s `finally` block
- Added `useMobileTimeoutFallback({ isLoading: isLoadingProjects, onTimeout: fetchProjects, mobileTimeoutMs: 15000, desktopTimeoutMs: 10000, enabled: !!userId })`
- Removed `isLoadingProjects` from the fetch useEffect's dependency array (no longer needed since the hook handles it separately)

**`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/contexts/UserSettingsContext.tsx`**:
- Removed `isMobileRef` (inline `navigator.userAgent` regex)
- Removed `settingsTimeoutRef` and its cleanup useEffect
- Removed inline timeout setup from inside `fetchUserSettings` callback
- Removed timeout clearing from the `finally` block
- Removed `settingsTimeoutRef` cleanup from the user-change useEffect
- Added `handleSettingsTimeout` callback (sets empty defaults on stall)
- Added `useMobileTimeoutFallback({ isLoading: isLoadingSettings, onTimeout: handleSettingsTimeout, mobileTimeoutMs: 10000, desktopTimeoutMs: 5000, enabled: !!userId })`

### AuthContext -- intentionally unchanged

**`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/contexts/AuthContext.tsx`**: The `[AuthDebounce]` pattern is a 150ms debounce on Supabase auth state change events. It does not involve:
- Mobile UA detection
- Loading timeouts / stall recovery
- Any `navigator.userAgent` access

It is a fundamentally different pattern (event debouncing vs loading timeout fallback) and does not benefit from this shared hook. No changes were made.

### Verification
- `npx tsc --noEmit` passes with no errors
- No remaining inline `navigator.userAgent` checks in any of the three context files
- No dangling references to removed refs (`isMobileRef`, `projectsTimeoutRef`, `settingsTimeoutRef`)

    13→ * Trigger cost calculation for a task, but skip if it's a sub-task
    14→ * (Sub-tasks have their costs rolled up into the orchestrator)
    15→ *
    16→ * @param supabase - Supabase client for fetching task params
    17→ * @param supabaseUrl - The Supabase project URL
    18→ * @param serviceKey - The service role key for authentication
    19→ * @param taskId - The task ID to calculate cost for
    20→ */
    21→export async function triggerCostCalculationIfNotSubTask(
    22→  supabase: any,
    23→  supabaseUrl: string,
    24→  serviceKey: string,
    25→  taskId: string
    26→): Promise<void> {
    27→  try {
    28→    const { data: taskForCostCheck } = await supabase
    29→      .from("tasks")
    30→      .select("params")
    31→      .eq("id", taskId)
    32→      .single();
    33→
    34→    const subTaskOrchestratorRef = getSubTaskOrchestratorId(taskForCostCheck?.params, taskId);
    35→    if (subTaskOrchestratorRef) {
    36→      console.log(`[COMPLETE-TASK] Task ${taskId} is a sub-task, skipping cost calculation`);
    37→      return;
    38→    }
    39→
    40→    await triggerCostCalculation(supabaseUrl, serviceKey, taskId, 'COMPLETE-TASK');
    41→  } catch (costErr) {
    42→    console.error("[COMPLETE-TASK] Error triggering cost calculation:", costErr);
    43→  }
    44→}

1→/**
     2→ * Shared billing utilities for edge functions
     3→ *
     4→ * Centralizes:
     5→ *  - Orchestrator/sub-task detection (extractOrchestratorRef, isSubTask)
     6→ *  - Sub-task query filter for Supabase `.or()` calls
     7→ *  - Cost calculation HTTP trigger
     8→ *
     9→ * Consumers: calculate-task-cost, update-task-status, complete_task
    10→ */
    11→
    12→// ===== Constants =====
    13→
    14→/** UUID v4 regex — used to distinguish real orchestrator FK refs from human-readable IDs */
    15→export const UUID_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
    16→
    17→// ===== Orchestrator reference extraction =====
    18→
    19→/**
    20→ * Extract orchestrator_task_id from task params.
    21→ *
    22→ * Sub-tasks can store the orchestrator reference in multiple param paths
    23→ * depending on the task type and how they were created:
    24→ *  - params.orchestrator_task_id_ref          (travel_segment)
    25→ *  - params.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id  (join_clips_segment)
    26→ *  - params.originalParams.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id (legacy)
    27→ *  - params.orchestrator_task_id              (some legacy tasks)
    28→ *
    29→ * Returns the raw string value (may not be a valid UUID) or null.
    30→ */
    31→export function extractOrchestratorRef(params: any): string | null {
    32→  if (!params || typeof params !== 'object') return null;
    33→
    34→  return (
    35→    params.orchestrator_task_id_ref ||
    36→    params.orchestrator_details?.orchestrator_task_id ||
    37→    params.originalParams?.orchestrator_details?.orchestrator_task_id ||
    38→    params.orchestrator_task_id ||
    39→    null
    40→  );
    41→}
    42→
    43→/**
    44→ * Determine whether a task is a sub-task of an orchestrator.
    45→ *
    46→ * A task is a sub-task when:
    47→ *  1. Its params contain an orchestrator reference (via any of the known paths)
    48→ *  2. That reference is a valid UUID (not a human-readable orchestrator ID)
    49→ *  3. The reference is NOT the task's own ID (orchestrators store their own ID
    50→ *     in params.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id for children to copy)
    51→ *
    52→ * @param params  - task.params (object, not stringified)
    53→ * @param taskId  - the task's own ID, to guard against self-references
    54→ * @returns The orchestrator task ID if this is a sub-task, or null otherwise
    55→ */
    56→export function getSubTaskOrchestratorId(params: any, taskId: string): string | null {
    57→  const ref = extractOrchestratorRef(params);
    58→  if (!ref) return null;
    59→  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(ref)) return null;
    60→  if (ref === taskId) return null;
    61→  return ref;
    62→}
    63→
    64→// ===== Sub-task query filter =====
    65→
    66→/**
    67→ * Build a Supabase PostgREST `.or()` filter string that finds all tasks
    68→ * whose params reference the given orchestrator task ID.
    69→ *
    70→ * Covers all four param paths where a sub-task may store the reference.
    71→ *
    72→ * Usage:
    73→ *   supabase.from('tasks').select('...').or(buildSubTaskFilter(orchestratorId))
    74→ */
    75→export function buildSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId: string): string {
    76→  return [
    77→    `params->>orchestrator_task_id_ref.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
    78→    `params->orchestrator_details->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
    79→    `params->originalParams->orchestrator_details->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
    80→    `params->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
    81→  ].join(',');
    82→}
    83→
    84→// ===== Cost calculation trigger =====
    85→
    86→/**
    87→ * Trigger the calculate-task-cost edge function for a given task.
    88→ *
    89→ * This is a fire-and-forget HTTP call (errors are logged, not thrown).
    90→ *
    91→ * @param supabaseUrl - The Supabase project URL
    92→ * @param serviceKey  - The service role key for authentication
    93→ * @param taskId      - The task ID to calculate cost for
    94→ * @param logTag      - Optional log tag prefix (default: 'CostCalc')
    95→ */
    96→export async function triggerCostCalculation(
    97→  supabaseUrl: string,
    98→  serviceKey: string,
    99→  taskId: string,
   100→  logTag: string = 'CostCalc'
   101→): Promise<void> {
   102→  try {
   103→    console.log(`[${logTag}] Triggering cost calculation for ${taskId}...`);
   104→    const costResp = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/functions/v1/calculate-task-cost`, {
   105→      method: "POST",
   106→      headers: {
   107→        "Authorization": `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
   108→        "Content-Type": "application/json"
   109→      },
   110→      body: JSON.stringify({ task_id: taskId })
   111→    });
   112→
   113→    if (costResp.ok) {
   114→      const costData = await costResp.json();
   115→      if (costData.skipped) {
   116→        console.log(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation skipped: ${costData.reason}`);
   117→      } else if (typeof costData.cost === 'number') {
   118→        console.log(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation successful: $${costData.cost.toFixed(3)}`);
   119→      }
   120→    } else {
   121→      const errTxt = await costResp.text();
   122→      console.error(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation failed: ${errTxt}`);
   123→    }
   124→  } catch (costErr) {
   125→    console.error(`[${logTag}] Error triggering cost calculation:`, costErr);
   126→  }
   127→}
   128→

    23→// Pricing constants for video_enhance task (fal.ai rates)
    24→const VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING = {
    25→  // FILM (interpolation): $0.0013 per compute second
    26→  FILM_COST_PER_SECOND: 0.0013,
    27→  // FlashVSR (upscale): $0.0005 per megapixel (width × height × frames / 1,000,000)
    28→  FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL: 0.0005,
    29→};
    30→
    31→// Special cost calculation for video_enhance task
    32→// Combines FILM (time-based) and FlashVSR (megapixel-based) pricing
    33→function calculateVideoEnhanceCost(taskParams: any): { cost: number; breakdown: any } {
    34→  let totalCost = 0;
    35→  const breakdown: any = {};
    36→
    37→  // Get result data from task params (worker should populate this)
    38→  const result = taskParams?.result || taskParams;
    39→
    40→  // FILM interpolation cost: $0.0013 per compute second
    41→  if (result?.interpolation_compute_seconds && result.interpolation_compute_seconds > 0) {
    42→    const filmCost = VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FILM_COST_PER_SECOND * result.interpolation_compute_seconds;
    43→    totalCost += filmCost;
    44→    breakdown.interpolation = {
    45→      compute_seconds: result.interpolation_compute_seconds,
    46→      cost_per_second: VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FILM_COST_PER_SECOND,
    47→      cost: Math.round(filmCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
    48→    };
    49→  }
    50→
    51→  // FlashVSR upscale cost: $0.0005 per megapixel
    52→  if (result?.output_width && result?.output_height && result?.output_frames) {
    53→    const megapixels = (result.output_width * result.output_height * result.output_frames) / 1_000_000;
    54→    const upscaleCost = VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL * megapixels;
    55→    totalCost += upscaleCost;
    56→    breakdown.upscale = {
    57→      output_width: result.output_width,
    58→      output_height: result.output_height,
    59→      output_frames: result.output_frames,
    60→      megapixels: Math.round(megapixels * 100) / 100,
    61→      cost_per_megapixel: VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL,
    62→      cost: Math.round(upscaleCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
    63→    };
    64→  }
    65→
    66→  return {
    67→    cost: Math.round(totalCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
    68→    breakdown,
    69→  };
    70→}

    72→// Calculate cost based on billing type and task configuration
    73→function calculateTaskCost(
    74→  taskType: string,
    75→  billingType: string,
    76→  baseCostPerSecond: number,
    77→  unitCost: number,
    78→  durationSeconds: number,
    79→  costFactors: any,

    81→): { cost: number; breakdown?: any } {
    82→  // Special case: video_enhance has compound pricing (FILM + FlashVSR)
    83→  if (taskType === 'video_enhance') {
    84→    return calculateVideoEnhanceCost(taskParams);
    85→  }
    86→
    87→  let totalCost;
    88→  if (billingType === 'per_unit') {
    89→    totalCost = unitCost || 0;
    90→  } else {
    91→    totalCost = baseCostPerSecond * durationSeconds;
    92→  }
    93→
    94→  // Apply cost factors regardless of billing type
    95→  if (costFactors) {
    96→    if (costFactors.resolution && taskParams.resolution) {
    97→      const resolutionMultiplier = costFactors.resolution[taskParams.resolution] || 1;
    98→      totalCost *= resolutionMultiplier;
    99→    }
   100→    if (costFactors.frameCount && taskParams.frame_count) {
   101→      if (billingType === 'per_unit') {
   102→        totalCost += costFactors.frameCount * taskParams.frame_count;
   103→      } else {
   104→        totalCost += costFactors.frameCount * taskParams.frame_count * durationSeconds;
   105→      }
   106→    }
   107→    if (costFactors.modelType && taskParams.model_type) {
   108→      const modelMultiplier = costFactors.modelType[taskParams.model_type] || 1;
   109→      totalCost *= modelMultiplier;
   110→    }
   111→  }
   112→
   113→  return { cost: Math.round(totalCost * 1000) / 1000 };
   114→}

   249→      
   250→      const { error } = await supabaseAdmin
   251→        .from("tasks")
   252→        .update(updatePayload)
   253→        .eq("id", task.id);
   254→      
   255→      if (error) {
   256→        logger.error("Failed to cascade to task", { 
   257→          cascaded_task_id: task.id, 
   258→          error: error.message 
   259→        });
   260→      }
   261→      
   262→      return { taskId: task.id, error };
   263→    });
   264→    
   265→    const results = await Promise.all(updatePromises);
   266→    const failedUpdates = results.filter(r => r.error);
   267→    
   268→    if (failedUpdates.length > 0) {
   269→      logger.warn("Some cascade updates failed", { 
   270→        failed_count: failedUpdates.length,
   271→        total_count: tasksToUpdate.length
   272→      });
   273→    } else {
   274→      logger.info("Cascade complete", { 
   275→        cascaded_count: tasksToUpdate.length,
   276→        status: failureStatus
   277→      });
   278→    }
   279→    
   280→  } catch (error: any) {
   281→    logger.error("Unexpected error in cascade handler", { error: error?.message });
   282→  }
   283→}
   284→
   285→serve(async (req) => {
   286→  const serviceKey = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY");
   287→  const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL");
   288→
   289→  if (!serviceKey || !supabaseUrl) {
   290→    console.error("[UPDATE-TASK-STATUS] Missing required environment variables");
   291→    return new Response("Server configuration error", { status: 500 });
   292→  }
   293→
   294→  // Create admin client for database operations
   295→  const supabaseAdmin = createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey);
   296→
   297→  // Create logger (task_id will be set after parsing body)
   298→  const logger = new SystemLogger(supabaseAdmin, 'update-task-status');
   299→
   300→  // Only accept POST requests
   301→  if (req.method !== "POST") {
   302→    logger.warn("Method not allowed", { method: req.method });
   303→    await logger.flush();
   304→    return new Response("Method not allowed", { status: 405 });
   305→  }
   306→
   307→  // Parse request body
   308→  let requestBody: any = {};
   309→  try {
   310→    const bodyText = await req.text();
   311→    if (bodyText) {
   312→      requestBody = JSON.parse(bodyText);
   313→    }
   314→  } catch (e) {
   315→    logger.error("Invalid JSON body");
   316→    await logger.flush();
   317→    return new Response("Invalid JSON body", { status: 400 });
   318→  }
   319→
   320→  // Validate required fields
   321→  const { 
   322→    task_id, 
   323→    status, 
   324→    output_location,
   325→    // Support for task retry/requeue
   326→    attempts,
   327→    error_details,
   328→    clear_worker 
   329→  } = requestBody;
   330→
   331→  // Set task_id for all subsequent logs
   332→  if (task_id) {
   333→    logger.setDefaultTaskId(task_id);
   334→  }
   335→
   336→  if (!task_id || !status) {
   337→    logger.error("Missing required fields", { has_task_id: !!task_id, has_status: !!status });
   338→    await logger.flush();
   339→    return new Response("Missing required fields: task_id and status", { status: 400 });
   340→  }
   341→
   342→  // Validate status values
   343→  const validStatuses = ["Queued", "In Progress", "Complete", "Failed", "Cancelled"];
   344→  if (!validStatuses.includes(status)) {
   345→    logger.error("Invalid status value", { status, valid_statuses: validStatuses });
   346→    await logger.flush();
   347→    return new Response(`Invalid status. Must be one of: ${validStatuses.join(", ")}`, { status: 400 });
   348→  }
   349→
   350→  logger.info("Processing status update", { task_id, status });
   351→
   352→  // Authenticate using shared auth module
   353→  const auth = await authenticateRequest(req, supabaseAdmin, "[UPDATE-TASK-STATUS]");
   354→
   355→  if (!auth.success) {
   356→    logger.error("Authentication failed", { error: auth.error });
   357→    await logger.flush();
   358→    return new Response(auth.error || "Authentication failed", { status: auth.statusCode || 403 });
   359→  }
   360→
   361→  const isServiceRole = auth.isServiceRole;
   362→  const callerId = auth.userId;
   363→
   364→  try {
   365→    // Fetch current task status to validate transition
   366→    const { data: currentTask, error: currentTaskError } = await supabaseAdmin
   367→      .from("tasks")
   368→      .select("status")
   369→      .eq("id", task_id)
   370→      .single();
   371→
   372→    if (currentTaskError) {
   373→      logger.error("Error checking current task status", { error: currentTaskError.message });
   374→      await logger.flush();
   375→      return new Response(`Failed to check current task status: ${currentTaskError.message}`, { status: 500 });
   376→    }
   377→
   378→    // --- Status transition validation ---
   379→    // Valid transitions:
   380→    //   Queued      → In Progress, Failed, Cancelled
   381→    //   In Progress → Complete, Failed, Cancelled, Queued (requeue via clear_worker)
   382→    //   Complete    → (terminal — no transitions allowed)
   383→    //   Failed      → (terminal — retries create NEW tasks)
   384→    //   Cancelled   → (terminal — no transitions allowed)
   385→    const validTransitions: Record<string, string[]> = {
   386→      "Queued":      ["In Progress", "Failed", "Cancelled"],
   387→      "In Progress": ["Complete", "Failed", "Cancelled", "Queued"],
   388→      "Complete":    [],
   389→      "Failed":      [],
   390→      "Cancelled":   [],
   391→    };
   392→
   393→    const currentStatus = currentTask?.status as string;
   394→    const allowedNextStatuses = validTransitions[currentStatus];
   395→
   396→    if (allowedNextStatuses && !allowedNextStatuses.includes(status)) {
   397→      logger.warn("Invalid status transition", {
   398→        task_id,
   399→        current_status: currentStatus,
   400→        requested_status: status,
   401→        allowed_transitions: allowedNextStatuses
   402→      });
   403→      await logger.flush();
   404→      return new Response(JSON.stringify({
   405→        success: false,
   406→        task_id: task_id,
   407→        current_status: currentStatus,
   408→        requested_status: status,
   409→        allowed_transitions: allowedNextStatuses,
   410→        message: `Invalid status transition: ${currentStatus} → ${status}`
   411→      }), {
   412→        status: 409,
   413→        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }
   414→      });
   415→    }
   416→
   417→    // Build update payload
   418→    const updatePayload: any = {
   419→      status: status,
   420→      updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
   421→    };
   422→
   423→    if (status === "In Progress") {
   424→      updatePayload.generation_started_at = new Date().toISOString();
   425→    }
   426→
   427→    // Reset generation_started_at when explicitly requested (after model loading)
   428→    // This allows billing to start from when actual work begins, not when task was claimed
   429→    if (requestBody.reset_generation_started_at === true) {
   430→      updatePayload.generation_started_at = new Date().toISOString();
   431→    }
   432→    
   433→    if (status === "Complete") {
   434→      updatePayload.generation_processed_at = new Date().toISOString();
   435→    }
   436→
   437→    // Handle output_location for Failed/Complete statuses
   438→    if (output_location !== undefined) {
   439→      updatePayload.output_location = output_location;
   440→    }
   441→
   442→    // Handle retry-related fields
   443→    if (attempts !== undefined) {
   444→      updatePayload.attempts = attempts;
   445→    }
   446→
   447→    if (error_details !== undefined) {
   448→      updatePayload.error_message = error_details;
   449→    }
   450→
   451→    // When requeuing, clear worker assignment
   452→    if (clear_worker === true) {
   453→      updatePayload.worker_id = null;
   454→      updatePayload.generation_started_at = null;
   455→    }
   456→
   457→    let updateResult;
   458→
   459→    if (isServiceRole) {
   460→      // Service role: can update any task
   461→      updateResult = await supabaseAdmin
   462→        .from("tasks")
   463→        .update(updatePayload)
   464→        .eq("id", task_id)
   465→        .select()
   466→        .single();
   467→
   468→    } else {
   469→      // User token: can only update tasks in their projects
   470→      const { data: userProjects } = await supabaseAdmin
   471→        .from("projects")
   472→        .select("id")
   473→        .eq("user_id", callerId);
   474→
   475→      if (!userProjects || userProjects.length === 0) {
   476→        logger.error("User has no projects", { user_id: callerId ?? undefined });
   477→        await logger.flush();
   478→        return new Response("User has no projects", { status: 403 });
   479→      }
   480→
   481→      const projectIds = userProjects.map((p: any) => p.id);
   482→      
   483→      updateResult = await supabaseAdmin
   484→        .from("tasks")
   485→        .update(updatePayload)
   486→        .eq("id", task_id)
   487→        .in("project_id", projectIds)
   488→        .select()
   489→        .single();
   490→    }
   491→
   492→    if (updateResult.error) {
   493→      if (updateResult.error.code === "PGRST116") {
   494→        logger.warn("Task not found or not accessible", { task_id });
   495→        await logger.flush();
   496→        return new Response("Task not found or not accessible", { status: 404 });
   497→      }
   498→      logger.error("Database update error", { 
   499→        task_id,
   500→        error: updateResult.error.message,
   501→        code: updateResult.error.code
   502→      });
   503→      await logger.flush();
   504→      return new Response(`Database error: ${updateResult.error.message}`, { status: 500 });
   505→    }
   506→
   507→    if (!updateResult.data) {
   508→      logger.warn("Task not found or not accessible (no data)", { task_id });
   509→      await logger.flush();
   510→      return new Response("Task not found or not accessible", { status: 404 });
   511→    }
   512→
   513→    logger.info("Task status updated successfully", { 
   514→      task_id, 
   515→      old_status: currentTask?.status,
   516→      new_status: status 
   517→    });
   518→
   519→    // Handle cascading failures/cancellations for orchestrated tasks
   520→    if (status === "Failed" || status === "Cancelled") {
   521→      await handleCascadingTaskFailure(supabaseAdmin, logger, task_id, status, updateResult.data);
   522→      
   523→      // Bill for completed work when orchestrator is cancelled
   524→      if (status === "Cancelled") {
   525→        await handleOrchestratorCancellationBilling(
   526→          supabaseAdmin, 
   527→          supabaseUrl, 
   528→          serviceKey, 
   529→          logger, 
   530→          task_id, 
   531→          updateResult.data
   532→        );
   533→      }
   534→    }
   535→    
   536→    await logger.flush();
   537→    return new Response(JSON.stringify({
   538→      success: true,
   539→      task_id: task_id,
   540→      status: status,
   541→      message: `Task status updated to '${status}'`
   542→    }), {
   543→      status: 200,
   544→      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }
   545→    });
   546→
   547→  } catch (error: any) {
   548→    logger.critical("Unexpected error", { task_id, error: error?.message });
   549→    await logger.flush();
   550→    return new Response(`Internal server error: ${error?.message}`, { status: 500 });
   551→  }
   552→});

Now I also notice that `complete_task/billing.ts` imports `getSubTaskOrchestratorId` but the old code used `extractOrchestratorTaskId` which does NOT do UUID validation or self-reference checks. Let me verify this is a behavioral change and whether it's correct.

Looking at the old `triggerCostCalculationIfNotSubTask`:
```typescript
const subTaskOrchestratorRef = extractOrchestratorTaskId(taskForCostCheck?.params, 'CostCalc');
if (subTaskOrchestratorRef) {
  // skip
}
```

The old `extractOrchestratorTaskId` returns any raw string found in the params. It does NOT validate UUID or check self-reference. So if a task had a non-UUID orchestrator reference (like a human-readable ID), the old code would skip billing for it (treating it as a sub-task). With the new `getSubTaskOrchestratorId`, it would NOT skip billing because the UUID check would fail.

However, looking at `calculate-task-cost/index.ts`, the original code there DID validate UUID and check self-reference. The `calculate-task-cost` function is the one that actually does the billing, and `complete_task` merely triggers it. So even if `complete_task` incorrectly skips calling `calculate-task-cost`, the cost would still never be calculated because `calculate-task-cost` would do the same sub-task check.

But actually, the correct behavior is: `complete_task`'s `triggerCostCalculationIfNotSubTask` should have the same logic as `calculate-task-cost`'s sub-task check. Using `getSubTaskOrchestratorId` (which validates UUID + self-reference) is more correct than the old raw extraction. It avoids a wasteful HTTP call to `calculate-task-cost` that would just skip anyway, and it also avoids incorrectly skipping the cost trigger for orchestrator tasks that have human-readable IDs in their own params.

This is actually a minor correctness improvement (not a behavior change in practice, since `calculate-task-cost` would do the right thing anyway). Good.

    26→  if (req.method !== 'POST') {
    27→    return jsonResponse({ error: 'Method not allowed' }, 405);

    29→

    31→    // Create Supabase client with service role for admin operations
    32→    const supabaseAdmin = createClient(
    33→      Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL') ?? '',
    34→      Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY') ?? '',
    35→      {
    36→        auth: {
    37→          autoRefreshToken: false,
    38→          persistSession: false
    39→        }
    40→      }
    41→    );
    42→
    43→    const auth = await authenticateRequest(req, supabaseAdmin, "[REVOKE-PAT]", { allowJwtUserAuth: true });
    44→    if (!auth.success || !auth.userId) {
    45→      return jsonResponse({ error: auth.error || 'Authentication failed' }, auth.statusCode || 401);
    46→    }
    47→
    48→    // Get request body
    49→    const { tokenId } = await req.json();
    50→
    51→    if (!tokenId) {
    52→      return jsonResponse({ error: 'tokenId is required' }, 400);
    53→    }
    54→
    55→    // Delete the token (RLS will ensure user can only delete their own)
    56→    const { error: deleteError } = await supabaseAdmin
    57→      .from('user_api_tokens')
    58→      .delete()
    59→      .eq('id', tokenId)
    60→      .eq('user_id', auth.userId); // Extra safety check
    61→
    62→    if (deleteError) {
    63→      console.error('Error deleting token:', deleteError);
    64→      return jsonResponse({ error: 'Failed to revoke token' }, 500);
    65→    }
    66→
    67→    return jsonResponse({ success: true });
    68→  } catch (error: unknown) {
    69→    console.error('Error in revoke-pat function:', error);
    70→    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error';
    71→    return jsonResponse({ error: message }, 500);
    72→  }
    73→});

}
