    45→      pollIntervalRef.current = null;
    46→    }
    47→  }, []);
    48→
    49→  // Main state machine effect — runs once on mount (sessionId is from URL, stable)
    50→  useEffect(() => {
    51→    if (!sessionId) return;
    52→
    53→    setSessionDetails({
    54→      sessionId,
    55→      amount: searchParams.get('amount') || undefined,
    56→    });
    57→
    58→    // Transition: loading → polling
    59→    setState('polling');
    60→
    61→    // Start credit polling immediately
    62→    refreshCredits();
    63→    pollIntervalRef.current = setInterval(refreshCredits, POLL_INTERVAL_MS);
    64→
    65→    // After minimum display time, transition polling → verified
    66→    const displayTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    67→      setState((prev) => (prev === 'polling' ? 'verified' : prev));
    68→    }, MIN_LOADING_DISPLAY_MS);
    69→
    70→    // Hard timeout: stop polling after 30s, force timed_out if still polling
    71→    const maxTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    72→      stopPolling();
    73→      setState((prev) => (prev === 'polling' ? 'timed_out' : prev));
    74→    }, MAX_POLL_DURATION_MS);
    75→
    76→    return () => {
    77→      clearTimeout(displayTimer);
    78→      clearTimeout(maxTimer);
    79→      stopPolling();
    80→    };
    81→  }, [sessionId, searchParams, refreshCredits, stopPolling]);
    82→
    83→  // Stop polling once verified (no need to keep going after success is shown)
    84→  // This is separate so it reacts to state changes without re-running the main effect
    85→  useEffect(() => {
    86→    if (state === 'verified' || state === 'timed_out') {
    87→      stopPolling();
    88→    }
    89→  }, [state, stopPolling]);
    90→
    91→  const handleContinue = () => {
    92→    navigate('/tools');
    93→  };
    94→
    95→  const handleViewTransactions = () => {
    96→    navigate('/tools', { state: { openSettings: true, creditsTab: 'history' } });

    98→
    99→  // No session ID — show error state
   100→  if (!sessionId) {
   101→    return (
   102→      <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-gradient-to-br from-wes-cream via-white to-wes-mint/10">

1→/**
     2→ * Shared billing utilities for edge functions
     3→ *
     4→ * Centralizes:
     5→ *  - Orchestrator/sub-task detection (extractOrchestratorRef, isSubTask)
     6→ *  - Sub-task query filter for Supabase `.or()` calls
     7→ *  - Cost calculation HTTP trigger
     8→ *
     9→ * Consumers: calculate-task-cost, update-task-status, complete_task
    10→ */
    11→
    12→// ===== Constants =====
    13→
    14→/** UUID v4 regex — used to distinguish real orchestrator FK refs from human-readable IDs */
    15→export const UUID_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
    16→
    17→// ===== Orchestrator reference extraction =====
    18→
    19→/**
    20→ * Extract orchestrator_task_id from task params.
    21→ *
    22→ * Sub-tasks can store the orchestrator reference in multiple param paths
    23→ * depending on the task type and how they were created:
    24→ *  - params.orchestrator_task_id_ref          (travel_segment)
    25→ *  - params.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id  (join_clips_segment)
    26→ *  - params.originalParams.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id (legacy)
    27→ *  - params.orchestrator_task_id              (some legacy tasks)
    28→ *
    29→ * Returns the raw string value (may not be a valid UUID) or null.
    30→ */
    31→export function extractOrchestratorRef(params: any): string | null {
    32→  if (!params || typeof params !== 'object') return null;
    33→
    34→  return (
    35→    params.orchestrator_task_id_ref ||
    36→    params.orchestrator_details?.orchestrator_task_id ||
    37→    params.originalParams?.orchestrator_details?.orchestrator_task_id ||
    38→    params.orchestrator_task_id ||
    39→    null
    40→  );
    41→}
    42→
    43→/**
    44→ * Determine whether a task is a sub-task of an orchestrator.
    45→ *
    46→ * A task is a sub-task when:
    47→ *  1. Its params contain an orchestrator reference (via any of the known paths)
    48→ *  2. That reference is a valid UUID (not a human-readable orchestrator ID)
    49→ *  3. The reference is NOT the task's own ID (orchestrators store their own ID
    50→ *     in params.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id for children to copy)
    51→ *
    52→ * @param params  - task.params (object, not stringified)
    53→ * @param taskId  - the task's own ID, to guard against self-references
    54→ * @returns The orchestrator task ID if this is a sub-task, or null otherwise
    55→ */
    56→export function getSubTaskOrchestratorId(params: any, taskId: string): string | null {
    57→  const ref = extractOrchestratorRef(params);
    58→  if (!ref) return null;
    59→  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(ref)) return null;
    60→  if (ref === taskId) return null;
    61→  return ref;
    62→}
    63→
    64→// ===== Sub-task query filter =====
    65→
    66→/**
    67→ * Build a Supabase PostgREST `.or()` filter string that finds all tasks
    68→ * whose params reference the given orchestrator task ID.
    69→ *
    70→ * Covers all four param paths where a sub-task may store the reference.
    71→ *
    72→ * Usage:
    73→ *   supabase.from('tasks').select('...').or(buildSubTaskFilter(orchestratorId))
    74→ */
    75→export function buildSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId: string): string {
    76→  return [
    77→    `params->>orchestrator_task_id_ref.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
    78→    `params->orchestrator_details->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
    79→    `params->originalParams->orchestrator_details->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
    80→    `params->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
    81→  ].join(',');
    82→}
    83→
    84→// ===== Cost calculation trigger =====
    85→
    86→/**
    87→ * Trigger the calculate-task-cost edge function for a given task.
    88→ *
    89→ * This is a fire-and-forget HTTP call (errors are logged, not thrown).
    90→ *
    91→ * @param supabaseUrl - The Supabase project URL
    92→ * @param serviceKey  - The service role key for authentication
    93→ * @param taskId      - The task ID to calculate cost for
    94→ * @param logTag      - Optional log tag prefix (default: 'CostCalc')
    95→ */
    96→export async function triggerCostCalculation(
    97→  supabaseUrl: string,
    98→  serviceKey: string,
    99→  taskId: string,
   100→  logTag: string = 'CostCalc'
   101→): Promise<void> {
   102→  try {
   103→    console.log(`[${logTag}] Triggering cost calculation for ${taskId}...`);
   104→    const costResp = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/functions/v1/calculate-task-cost`, {
   105→      method: "POST",
   106→      headers: {
   107→        "Authorization": `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
   108→        "Content-Type": "application/json"
   109→      },
   110→      body: JSON.stringify({ task_id: taskId })
   111→    });
   112→
   113→    if (costResp.ok) {
   114→      const costData = await costResp.json();
   115→      if (costData.skipped) {
   116→        console.log(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation skipped: ${costData.reason}`);
   117→      } else if (typeof costData.cost === 'number') {
   118→        console.log(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation successful: $${costData.cost.toFixed(3)}`);
   119→      }
   120→    } else {
   121→      const errTxt = await costResp.text();
   122→      console.error(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation failed: ${errTxt}`);
   123→    }
   124→  } catch (costErr) {
   125→    console.error(`[${logTag}] Error triggering cost calculation:`, costErr);
   126→  }
   127→}
   128→

     4→/**
     5→ * AuthGate prevents data-dependent providers from rendering before the
     6→ * initial auth check completes. This is NOT an auth wall -- once the
     7→ * auth state is known (logged in OR logged out), children render normally.
     8→ */
     9→export const AuthGate = ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => {
    10→  const { isLoading } = useAuth();
    11→
    12→  if (isLoading) return null;
    13→
    14→  return <>{children}</>;

     8→
     9→// Type for updating projects (re-exported for consumers that may need it)
    10→interface ProjectUpdate {

    13→}
    14→
    15→interface ProjectContextType {
    16→  projects: Project[];
    17→  selectedProjectId: string | null;
    18→  setSelectedProjectId: (projectId: string | null) => void;
    19→  isLoadingProjects: boolean;
    20→  fetchProjects: () => Promise<void>;
    21→  addNewProject: (projectData: { name: string; aspectRatio: string }) => Promise<Project | null>;
    22→  isCreatingProject: boolean;
    23→  updateProject: (projectId: string, updates: ProjectUpdate) => Promise<boolean>;
    24→  isUpdatingProject: boolean;
    25→  deleteProject: (projectId: string) => Promise<boolean>;
    26→  isDeletingProject: boolean;
    27→  /** Current authenticated user ID, null if not logged in */
    28→  userId: string | null;
    29→}
    30→
    31→const ProjectContext = createContext<ProjectContextType | undefined>(undefined);
    32→
    33→export const ProjectProvider = ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => {
    34→  const { userId } = useAuth();
    35→  const { userSettings: userPreferences, isLoadingSettings: isLoadingPreferences, updateUserSettings } = useUserSettings();
    36→
    37→  // ── Selection: owns selectedProjectId, localStorage persistence, cross-device sync ──
    38→  const selection = useProjectSelection({

    40→    userPreferences,
    41→    isLoadingPreferences,
    42→    updateUserSettings,

    45→  // ── CRUD: owns projects list, loading flags, fetch/create/update/delete ──
    46→  const crud = useProjectCRUD({
    47→    selectedProjectId: selection.selectedProjectId,
    48→    onProjectsLoaded: selection.handleProjectsLoaded,
    49→    onProjectCreated: selection.handleProjectCreated,
    50→    onProjectDeleted: selection.handleProjectDeleted,
    51→    updateUserSettings,
    52→  });
    53→
    54→  // ── Side effects: fetch trigger, cross-device sync, prefetch, mobile fallback ──
    55→  useProjectDefaults({
    56→    userId: userId ?? null,
    57→    selectedProjectId: selection.selectedProjectId,
    58→    isLoadingProjects: crud.isLoadingProjects,
    59→    isLoadingPreferences,
    60→    projects: crud.projects,

    69→        selectedProjectId: selection.selectedProjectId,

    72→    }
    73→  }, [selection.selectedProjectId, crud.projects]);
    74→
    75→  // ── Build context value ──
    76→  const contextValue = useMemo(

    78→      projects: crud.projects || [],
    79→      selectedProjectId: selection.selectedProjectId,
    80→      setSelectedProjectId: selection.setSelectedProjectId,
    81→      isLoadingProjects: crud.isLoadingProjects,
    82→      fetchProjects: crud.fetchProjects,
    83→      addNewProject: crud.addNewProject,
    84→      isCreatingProject: crud.isCreatingProject,
    85→      updateProject: crud.updateProject,
    86→      isUpdatingProject: crud.isUpdatingProject,
    87→      deleteProject: crud.deleteProject,
    88→      isDeletingProject: crud.isDeletingProject,
    89→      userId: userId ?? null,
    90→    }),
    91→    [
    92→      crud.projects,
    93→      selection.selectedProjectId,
    94→      selection.setSelectedProjectId,
    95→      crud.isLoadingProjects,
    96→      crud.fetchProjects,
    97→      crud.addNewProject,
    98→      crud.isCreatingProject,
    99→      crud.updateProject,
   100→      crud.isUpdatingProject,
   101→      crud.deleteProject,
   102→      crud.isDeletingProject,
   103→      userId,
   104→    ]
   105→  );
   106→
   107→  return (
   108→    <ProjectContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
   109→      {children}
   110→    </ProjectContext.Provider>
   111→  );
   112→};
   113→
   114→export const useProject = () => {

   123→    });

1→import * as React from "react"
     2→
     3→const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 768
     4→const TABLET_BREAKPOINT = 1024 // iPads and similar tablets
     5→
     6→// --- Pure compute helpers (no hooks, safe for non-React contexts) ---
     7→
     8→const hasCoarsePointer = (): boolean => {
     9→  try {
    10→    return !!(window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches);
    11→  } catch {
    12→    return false;
    13→  }
    14→};
    15→
    16→// Detect if device is a tablet (iPad-like) specifically
    17→// This allows tablets to have different behavior than phones (e.g., pane locking)
    18→const computeIsTablet = (): boolean => {
    19→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
    20→
    21→  const width = window.innerWidth;
    22→
    23→  // Tablet: wider than phone but not desktop-sized, with touch capability
    24→  const isTabletSize = width >= MOBILE_BREAKPOINT && width < TABLET_BREAKPOINT;
    25→  const isLargeTabletSize = width >= TABLET_BREAKPOINT && width < 1200;
    26→
    27→  // iPadOS 13+ detection (reports as Mac with touch)
    28→  const maxTouchPoints = navigator.maxTouchPoints || 0;
    29→  const isIpadOsLike = navigator.platform === 'MacIntel' && maxTouchPoints > 1;
    30→
    31→  // Generic tablet UA hints
    32→  const ua = navigator.userAgent || '';
    33→  const tabletUA = /iPad|Tablet|Android(?!.*Mobile)|Silk|Kindle|PlayBook/i.test(ua);
    34→
    35→  // Tablet if: iPad-like OR (tablet size + touch capability)
    36→  return Boolean(isIpadOsLike || tabletUA || ((isTabletSize || isLargeTabletSize) && hasCoarsePointer()));
    37→};
    38→
    39→const computeIsMobile = (): boolean => {
    40→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false; // SSR / safety fallback
    41→
    42→  const widthMobile = window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT;
    43→
    44→  // iPadOS 13+ may report as Mac with touch; detect via maxTouchPoints
    45→  const maxTouchPoints = navigator.maxTouchPoints || 0;
    46→  const isIpadOsLike = navigator.platform === 'MacIntel' && maxTouchPoints > 1;
    47→
    48→  // Generic tablet UA hints (best-effort, not relied upon exclusively)
    49→  const ua = navigator.userAgent || '';
    50→  const tabletUA = /iPad|Tablet|Android(?!.*Mobile)|Silk|Kindle|PlayBook/i.test(ua);
    51→
    52→  return Boolean(widthMobile || hasCoarsePointer() || isIpadOsLike || tabletUA);
    53→};
    54→
    55→const computeIsTouchDevice = (): boolean => {
    56→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
    57→  try {
    58→    const ua = navigator.userAgent || '';
    59→    const tabletUA = /iPad|Tablet|Android(?!.*Mobile)|Silk|Kindle|PlayBook/i.test(ua);
    60→    const maxTouchPoints = navigator.maxTouchPoints || 0;
    61→    const isIpadOsLike = navigator.platform === 'MacIntel' && maxTouchPoints > 1;
    62→    return Boolean(hasCoarsePointer() || tabletUA || isIpadOsLike || maxTouchPoints > 0);
    63→  } catch {
    64→    return false;
    65→  }
    66→};
    67→
    68→const computeOrientation = (): 'portrait' | 'landscape' => {
    69→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 'portrait';
    70→  try {
    71→    return window.matchMedia('(orientation: portrait)').matches ? 'portrait' : 'landscape';
    72→  } catch {
    73→    return 'portrait';
    74→  }
    75→};
    76→
    77→const computeIsPortraitMode = (): boolean => {
    78→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
    79→  return window.innerHeight > window.innerWidth;
    80→};
    81→
    82→// --- Non-hook utility ---
    83→
    84→/**
    85→ * Non-hook UA check for contexts that need mobile detection during init
    86→ * (before React hooks are available, e.g. in context default values).
    87→ * Prefer the hooks below for component code.
    88→ */
    89→export function isMobileUA(): boolean {
    90→  if (typeof navigator === 'undefined') return false;
    91→  return /iPhone|iPad|iPod|Android/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
    92→}
    93→
    94→// --- Individual hooks (existing API, preserved for backward compat) ---
    95→
    96→export function useIsMobile() {
    97→  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = React.useState<boolean>(() => computeIsMobile());
    98→
    99→  React.useEffect(() => {
   100→    const mqWidth = window.matchMedia(`(max-width: ${MOBILE_BREAKPOINT - 1}px)`)
   101→    const mqPointer = window.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)')
   102→
   103→    const onChange = () => setIsMobile(computeIsMobile())
   104→
   105→    // Listen to width and pointer changes; also handle window resize as a fallback
   106→    mqWidth.addEventListener("change", onChange)
   107→    mqPointer.addEventListener("change", onChange)
   108→    window.addEventListener('resize', onChange)
   109→
   110→    return () => {
   111→      mqWidth.removeEventListener("change", onChange)
   112→      mqPointer.removeEventListener("change", onChange)
   113→      window.removeEventListener('resize', onChange)
   114→    }
   115→  }, [])
   116→
   117→  return isMobile
   118→}
   119→
   120→// Hook to detect tablet specifically (iPad-like devices)
   121→// Tablets can lock one pane at a time, unlike phones
   122→export function useIsTablet() {
   123→  const [isTablet, setIsTablet] = React.useState<boolean>(() => computeIsTablet());
   124→
   125→  React.useEffect(() => {
   126→    const onChange = () => setIsTablet(computeIsTablet());
   127→
   128→    window.addEventListener('resize', onChange);
   129→
   130→    return () => {
   131→      window.removeEventListener('resize', onChange);
   132→    };
   133→  }, []);
   134→
   135→  return isTablet;
   136→}
   137→
   138→/** Phone only (isMobile && !isTablet) — hides advanced UI that tablets can show */
   139→export function useIsPhone() {
   140→  const isMobile = useIsMobile();
   141→  const isTablet = useIsTablet();
   142→  return isMobile && !isTablet;
   143→}
   144→
   145→/** Touch-capable device (phones, tablets, touch laptops) */
   146→export function useIsTouchDevice() {
   147→  const [isTouchDevice, setIsTouchDevice] = React.useState<boolean>(() => computeIsTouchDevice());
   148→
   149→  React.useEffect(() => {
   150→    const onChange = () => setIsTouchDevice(computeIsTouchDevice());
   151→
   152→    window.addEventListener('resize', onChange);
   153→
   154→    return () => {
   155→      window.removeEventListener('resize', onChange);
   156→    };
   157→  }, []);
   158→
   159→  return isTouchDevice;
   160→}
   161→
   162→// --- Composite hook (replaces useDeviceDetection) ---
   163→
   164→export interface DeviceInfo {
   165→  /** Tablet device (iPad-like) */
   166→  isTablet: boolean;
   167→  /** Phone only (isMobile && !isTablet) */
   168→  isPhone: boolean;
   169→  /** Width >= 768px */
   170→  isTabletOrLarger: boolean;
   171→  /** Any touch-capable device */
   172→  isTouchDevice: boolean;
   173→  /** Media-query based orientation */
   174→  orientation: 'portrait' | 'landscape';
   175→  /** height > width (simpler, more reliable) */
   176→  isPortraitMode: boolean;
   177→  /** Responsive column count for mobile grids */
   178→  mobileColumns: 2 | 3 | 4 | 6;
   179→}
   180→
   181→/**
   182→ * Comprehensive device info hook. Returns all device detection state
   183→ * in a single object. Prefer individual hooks (useIsMobile, useIsTablet, etc.)
   184→ * when you only need one or two values.
   185→ */
   186→export function useDeviceInfo(): DeviceInfo {
   187→  const isMobile = useIsMobile();
   188→  const isTablet = useIsTablet();
   189→
   190→  const [isTabletOrLarger, setIsTabletOrLarger] = React.useState<boolean>(() => {
   191→    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
   192→    return window.innerWidth >= MOBILE_BREAKPOINT;
   193→  });
   194→
   195→  const [orientation, setOrientation] = React.useState<'portrait' | 'landscape'>(() => computeOrientation());
   196→  const [isPortraitMode, setIsPortraitMode] = React.useState<boolean>(() => computeIsPortraitMode());
   197→
   198→  const isTouchDevice = React.useMemo(() => {
   199→    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return !!isMobile;
   200→    return computeIsTouchDevice();
   201→  }, [isMobile]);
   202→
   203→  React.useEffect(() => {
   204→    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
   205→
   206→    const mq = window.matchMedia('(orientation: portrait)');
   207→    const handleOrientation = () => setOrientation(mq.matches ? 'portrait' : 'landscape');
   208→
   209→    const handleResize = () => {
   210→      setIsTabletOrLarger(window.innerWidth >= MOBILE_BREAKPOINT);
   211→      setIsPortraitMode(window.innerHeight > window.innerWidth);
   212→    };
   213→
   214→    try {
   215→      mq.addEventListener('change', handleOrientation);
   216→    } catch {
   217→      /* no-op */
   218→    }
   219→    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
   220→
   221→    return () => {
   222→      try {
   223→        mq.removeEventListener('change', handleOrientation);
   224→      } catch {
   225→        /* no-op */
   226→      }
   227→      window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
   228→    };
   229→  }, []);
   230→
   231→  const isPhone = isMobile && !isTablet;
   232→
   233→  const mobileColumns = React.useMemo(() => {
   234→    if (!isMobile) return 6 as 6;
   235→    if (isTablet) return (orientation === 'portrait' ? 3 : 4) as 3 | 4;
   236→    return 2 as 2;
   237→  }, [isMobile, isTablet, orientation]);
   238→
   239→  return {
   240→    isTablet,
   241→    isPhone,
   242→    isTabletOrLarger,
   243→    isTouchDevice,
   244→    orientation,
   245→    isPortraitMode,
   246→    mobileColumns,
   247→  };
   248→}
   249→

    15→/**
    16→ * Manages which project is selected, including:
    17→ * - Fast resume from localStorage
    18→ * - Cross-device sync from server preferences
    19→ * - Persistence to both localStorage and server
    20→ */
    21→export function useProjectSelection({
    22→  userId,
    23→  userPreferences,
    24→  isLoadingPreferences,
    25→  updateUserSettings,
    26→}: UseProjectSelectionOptions) {
    27→  // CROSS-DEVICE SYNC: Track if we had a localStorage value at startup
    28→  const hadLocalStorageValueRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
    29→  const hasAppliedServerPreferencesRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
    30→
    31→  // FAST RESUME: Try to restore selectedProjectId from localStorage immediately
    32→  const [selectedProjectId, setSelectedProjectIdState] = useState<string | null>(() => {
    33→    try {
    34→      const stored = localStorage.getItem('lastSelectedProjectId');
    35→      if (stored) {
    36→        hadLocalStorageValueRef.current = true;
    37→        return stored;
    38→      } else {
    39→        hadLocalStorageValueRef.current = false;
    40→      }
    41→    } catch (e) {
    42→      console.error('[ProjectContext:FastResume] localStorage access failed:', e);
    43→      hadLocalStorageValueRef.current = false;
    44→    }
    45→    return null;
    46→  });
    47→
    48→  // Keep a ref for synchronous access to latest preferences
    49→  const userPreferencesRef = useRef(userPreferences);
    50→  useEffect(() => {
    51→    userPreferencesRef.current = userPreferences;
    52→  }, [userPreferences]);
    53→
    54→  // CROSS-DEVICE SYNC: Reset sync flag when user logs out
    55→  useEffect(() => {
    56→    if (!userId) {
    57→      hasAppliedServerPreferencesRef.current = false;
    58→    }
    59→  }, [userId]);
    60→
    61→  // CROSS-DEVICE SYNC: When preferences load on a new device (no localStorage),
    62→  // update the selected project to match the server's lastOpenedProjectId
    63→  const applyCrossDeviceSync = useCallback((projects: Project[]) => {
    64→    if (hadLocalStorageValueRef.current) return;
    65→    if (hasAppliedServerPreferencesRef.current) return;
    66→    if (isLoadingPreferences || !userPreferences) return;
    67→    if (!projects.length) return;
    68→
    69→    const serverLastOpenedId = userPreferences.lastOpenedProjectId;
    70→
    71→    if (serverLastOpenedId && serverLastOpenedId !== selectedProjectId) {
    72→      const projectExists = projects.some(p => p.id === serverLastOpenedId);
    73→      if (projectExists) {
    74→        setSelectedProjectIdState(serverLastOpenedId);
    75→        try {
    76→          localStorage.setItem('lastSelectedProjectId', serverLastOpenedId);
    77→        } catch (e) {
    78→          handleError(e, { context: 'ProjectContext.crossDeviceSync', showToast: false });
    79→        }
    80→      }
    81→    }
    82→
    83→    hasAppliedServerPreferencesRef.current = true;
    84→  }, [isLoadingPreferences, userPreferences, selectedProjectId]);
    85→
    86→  const handleSetSelectedProjectId = useCallback((projectId: string | null) => {
    87→    preloadingService.onProjectChange(projectId);
    88→
    89→    setSelectedProjectIdState(projectId);
    90→
    91→    if (projectId) {
    92→      try {
    93→        localStorage.setItem('lastSelectedProjectId', projectId);
    94→      } catch (e) {
    95→        handleError(e, { context: 'ProjectContext.fastResume', showToast: false });
    96→      }
    97→      updateUserSettings('user', { lastOpenedProjectId: projectId });
    98→    } else {
    99→      try {
   100→        localStorage.removeItem('lastSelectedProjectId');
   101→      } catch (e) {
   102→        handleError(e, { context: 'ProjectContext.fastResume', showToast: false });
   103→      }
   104→      updateUserSettings('user', { lastOpenedProjectId: undefined });
   105→    }
   106→  }, [updateUserSettings]);
   107→
   108→  /** Called when projects are loaded — decides which project to select. */
   109→  const handleProjectsLoaded = useCallback((projects: Project[], isNewDefault: boolean) => {
   110→    if (isNewDefault) {
   111→      // Brand new default project: select it directly
   112→      handleSetSelectedProjectId(projects[0].id);
   113→    } else {
   114→      const lastOpenedProjectId = userPreferencesRef.current?.lastOpenedProjectId;
   115→      const projectIdToSelect = determineProjectIdToSelect(projects, selectedProjectId, lastOpenedProjectId);
   116→
   117→      if (projectIdToSelect !== selectedProjectId) {
   118→        handleSetSelectedProjectId(projectIdToSelect);
   119→      }
   120→    }
   121→  }, [selectedProjectId, handleSetSelectedProjectId]);
   122→
   123→  /** Called after a new project is created. */
   124→  const handleProjectCreated = useCallback((project: Project) => {
   125→    handleSetSelectedProjectId(project.id);
   126→  }, [handleSetSelectedProjectId]);
   127→
   128→  /** Called after a project is deleted — selects the next project. */
   129→  const handleProjectDeleted = useCallback((remainingProjects: Project[]) => {
   130→    const nextProjectId = determineProjectIdToSelect(remainingProjects, null, null);
   131→    setSelectedProjectIdState(nextProjectId);

   133→    if (nextProjectId) {

   135→    } else {
   136→      updateUserSettings('user', { lastOpenedProjectId: undefined });
   137→    }
   138→  }, [updateUserSettings]);
   139→
   140→  return {
   141→    selectedProjectId,
   142→    setSelectedProjectId: handleSetSelectedProjectId,
   143→    applyCrossDeviceSync,
   144→    handleProjectsLoaded,
   145→    handleProjectCreated,
   146→    handleProjectDeleted,
   147→    userPreferencesRef,
   148→  };
   149→}

    99→      handleError(userError, { context: 'ProjectContext.createUser', showToast: false });
   100→    }
   101→  }
   102→};
   103→
   104→export const determineProjectIdToSelect = (
   105→  projects: Project[],
   106→  preferredId: string | null | undefined,
   107→  lastOpenedId: string | null | undefined
   108→): string | null => {
   109→  if (!projects.length) return null;
   110→
   111→  const projectIds = new Set(projects.map(p => p.id));
   112→
   113→  if (preferredId && projectIds.has(preferredId)) {
   114→    return preferredId;
   115→  }
   116→  if (lastOpenedId && projectIds.has(lastOpenedId)) {
   117→    return lastOpenedId;
   118→  }
   119→  return projects[0].id;
   120→};
   121→
   122→interface UseProjectCRUDOptions {
   123→  selectedProjectId: string | null;
   124→  onProjectsLoaded: (projects: Project[], isNewDefault: boolean) => void;
   125→  onProjectCreated: (project: Project) => void;
   126→  onProjectDeleted: (remainingProjects: Project[]) => void;
   127→  updateUserSettings: (scope: 'user', patch: Partial<UserPreferences>) => Promise<void>;
   128→}
   129→
   130→/**
   131→ * Manages project CRUD operations: fetch, create, update, delete.
   132→ * Owns the `projects` list state and all loading flags.
   133→ */
   134→export function useProjectCRUD({
   135→  selectedProjectId,
   136→  onProjectsLoaded,
   137→  onProjectCreated,
   138→  onProjectDeleted,
   139→  updateUserSettings,
   140→}: UseProjectCRUDOptions) {
   141→  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<Project[]>([]);
   142→  const [isLoadingProjects, setIsLoadingProjects] = useState(true);
   143→  const [isCreatingProject, setIsCreatingProject] = useState(false);
   144→  const [isUpdatingProject, setIsUpdatingProject] = useState(false);
   145→  const [isDeletingProject, setIsDeletingProject] = useState(false);
   146→
   147→  const fetchProjects = useCallback(async () => {
   148→    try {
   149→      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
   150→      if (!user) throw new Error('Not authenticated');
   151→
   152→      await ensureUserRecord(user.id);
   153→
   154→      const { data: projectsData, error } = await supabase
   155→        .from('projects')
   156→        .select('*')
   157→        .eq('user_id', user.id)
   158→        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
   159→
   160→      if (error) throw error;
   161→
   162→      if (!projectsData || projectsData.length === 0) {
   163→        const { data: newProject, error: createError } = await supabase
   164→          .from('projects')
   165→          .insert({
   166→            name: 'Sample Project',
   167→            user_id: user.id,
   168→            aspect_ratio: '16:9',
   169→          })
   170→          .select()
   171→          .single();
   172→
   173→        if (createError) throw createError;
   174→
   175→        await createDefaultShot(newProject.id, undefined, true);
   176→
   177→        const mappedProject = mapDbProjectToProject(newProject);
   178→        setProjects([mappedProject]);
   179→        onProjectsLoaded([mappedProject], true);
   180→      } else {
   181→        const mappedProjects = projectsData.map(mapDbProjectToProject);
   182→        setProjects(mappedProjects);
   183→        onProjectsLoaded(mappedProjects, false);
   184→      }
   185→    } catch (error: unknown) {
   186→      handleError(error, { context: 'ProjectContext', toastTitle: 'Failed to load projects' });
   187→      setProjects([]);
   188→    } finally {
   189→      setIsLoadingProjects(false);
   190→    }
   191→  }, [onProjectsLoaded]);
   192→
   193→  const addNewProject = useCallback(async (projectData: { name: string; aspectRatio: string }) => {
   194→    if (!projectData.name.trim()) {
   195→      toast.error("Project name cannot be empty.");
   196→      return null;
   197→    }
   198→    if (!projectData.aspectRatio) {
   199→      toast.error("Aspect ratio cannot be empty.");
   200→      return null;
   201→    }
   202→    setIsCreatingProject(true);
   203→    try {
   204→      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
   205→      if (!user) throw new Error('Not authenticated');
   206→
   207→      await ensureUserRecord(user.id);
   208→
   209→      const settingsToInherit = selectedProjectId
   210→        ? await fetchInheritableProjectSettings(selectedProjectId)
   211→        : {};
   212→
   213→      const { data: newProject, error } = await supabase
   214→        .from('projects')
   215→        .insert({
   216→          name: projectData.name,
   217→          user_id: user.id,
   218→          aspect_ratio: projectData.aspectRatio,
   219→          settings: settingsToInherit,
   220→        })
   221→        .select()
   222→        .single();
   223→
   224→      if (error) throw error;
   225→
   226→      const shotSettingsToInherit = selectedProjectId
   227→        ? await buildShotSettingsForNewProject(selectedProjectId, settingsToInherit)
   228→        : {};
   229→
   230→      await createDefaultShot(newProject.id, shotSettingsToInherit);
   231→
   232→      const mappedProject = mapDbProjectToProject(newProject);
   233→      setProjects(prevProjects => sortProjectsByCreatedAt([...prevProjects, mappedProject]));
   234→      onProjectCreated(mappedProject);
   235→
   236→      updateUserSettings('user', { lastOpenedProjectId: mappedProject.id });
   237→
   238→      return mappedProject;
   239→    } catch (err: unknown) {
   240→      handleError(err, { context: 'ProjectContext', toastTitle: 'Failed to create project' });
   241→      return null;
   242→    } finally {
   243→      setIsCreatingProject(false);
   244→    }
   245→  }, [selectedProjectId, onProjectCreated, updateUserSettings]);
   246→
   247→  const updateProject = useCallback(async (projectId: string, updates: ProjectUpdate): Promise<boolean> => {
   248→    if (!updates.name?.trim() && !updates.aspectRatio) {
   249→      toast.error("No changes to save.");
   250→      return false;
   251→    }
   252→    setIsUpdatingProject(true);
   253→    try {
   254→      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
   255→      if (!user) throw new Error('Not authenticated');
   256→
   257→      const dbUpdates: Record<string, string | undefined> = {};
   258→      if (updates.name !== undefined) dbUpdates.name = updates.name;
   259→      if (updates.aspectRatio !== undefined) dbUpdates.aspect_ratio = updates.aspectRatio;
   260→
   261→      const { data: updatedProject, error } = await supabase
   262→        .from('projects')
   263→        .update(dbUpdates)
   264→        .eq('id', projectId)
   265→        .eq('user_id', user.id)
   266→        .select()
   267→        .single();
   268→
   269→      if (error) throw error;
   270→
   271→      const mappedProject = mapDbProjectToProject(updatedProject);
   272→
   273→      setProjects(prevProjects =>
   274→        sortProjectsByCreatedAt(
   275→          prevProjects.map(p => p.id === projectId ? mappedProject : p)
   276→        )
   277→      );
   278→      return true;
   279→    } catch (err: unknown) {
   280→      handleError(err, { context: 'ProjectContext', toastTitle: 'Failed to update project' });
   281→      return false;
   282→    } finally {
   283→      setIsUpdatingProject(false);
   284→    }
   285→  }, []);
   286→
   287→  const deleteProject = useCallback(async (projectId: string): Promise<boolean> => {
   288→    setIsDeletingProject(true);
   289→    try {
   290→      const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
   291→      if (!session) throw new Error('Not authenticated');
   292→
   293→      const { data, error } = await supabase.functions.invoke('delete-project', {
   294→        body: { projectId },
   295→      });
   296→
   297→      if (error) throw error;
   298→      if (data?.error) throw new Error(data.error);
   299→
   300→      setProjects(prevProjects => {
   301→        const updated = prevProjects.filter(p => p.id !== projectId);
   302→        onProjectDeleted(updated);
   303→        return updated;
   304→      });
   305→
   306→      return true;
   307→    } catch (err: unknown) {
   308→      handleError(err, { context: 'ProjectContext', toastTitle: 'Failed to delete project' });
   309→      return false;
   310→    } finally {
   311→      setIsDeletingProject(false);
   312→    }
   313→  }, [onProjectDeleted]);
   314→
   315→  return {
   316→    projects,
   317→    isLoadingProjects,
   318→    fetchProjects,
   319→    addNewProject,
   320→    isCreatingProject,
   321→    updateProject,
   322→    isUpdatingProject,
   323→    deleteProject,
   324→    isDeletingProject,
   325→  };
   326→}
   327→

1→import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
     2→import { usePrefetchToolSettings } from '@/shared/hooks/usePrefetchToolSettings';
     3→import { useMobileTimeoutFallback } from '@/shared/hooks/useMobileTimeoutFallback';
     4→import { Project } from '@/types/project';
     5→
     6→interface UseProjectDefaultsOptions {
     7→  userId: string | null;
     8→  selectedProjectId: string | null;
     9→  isLoadingProjects: boolean;
    10→  isLoadingPreferences: boolean;
    11→  projects: Project[];
    12→  fetchProjects: () => Promise<void>;
    13→  applyCrossDeviceSync: (projects: Project[]) => void;
    14→}
    15→
    16→/**
    17→ * Orchestrates project-related side effects:
    18→ * - Triggers fetchProjects when userId is available
    19→ * - Cross-device sync when preferences + projects are both loaded
    20→ * - Prefetches tool settings for the selected project
    21→ * - Mobile timeout fallback for stalled fetches
    22→ */
    23→export function useProjectDefaults({
    24→  userId,
    25→  selectedProjectId,
    26→  isLoadingProjects,
    27→  isLoadingPreferences,
    28→  projects,
    29→  fetchProjects,
    30→  applyCrossDeviceSync,
    31→}: UseProjectDefaultsOptions) {
    32→  // [PROFILING] Track fetch invocations to detect triple-fetch issue
    33→  const fetchInvocationCountRef = useRef(0);
    34→  const lastFetchReasonRef = useRef<string>('');
    35→
    36→  // Prefetch all tool settings for the currently selected project
    37→  usePrefetchToolSettings(selectedProjectId);
    38→
    39→  // Trigger initial project fetch when userId becomes available
    40→  useEffect(() => {
    41→    if (userId) {
    42→      fetchInvocationCountRef.current += 1;
    43→      const reason = `userId=${!!userId}, isLoadingPreferences=${isLoadingPreferences}`;
    44→      lastFetchReasonRef.current = reason;
    45→
    46→      fetchProjects();
    47→    }
    48→  }, [userId, isLoadingPreferences, fetchProjects]);
    49→
    50→  // Cross-device sync: apply server preferences once projects + prefs are loaded
    51→  useEffect(() => {
    52→    if (projects.length > 0) {
    53→      applyCrossDeviceSync(projects);
    54→    }
    55→  }, [projects, applyCrossDeviceSync]);
    56→
    57→  // [MobileStallFix] Fallback recovery: retry fetch if projects loading stalls
    58→  useMobileTimeoutFallback({
    59→    isLoading: isLoadingProjects,
    60→    onTimeout: fetchProjects,
    61→    mobileTimeoutMs: 15000,
    62→    desktopTimeoutMs: 10000,
    63→    enabled: !!userId,
    64→  });
    65→}
    66→

     7→import {
     8→  getSubTaskOrchestratorId,

    11→
    12→// Re-export triggerCostCalculation so existing imports from orchestrator.ts continue to work

    14→
    15→/**
    16→ * Trigger cost calculation for a task, but skip if it's a sub-task
    17→ * (Sub-tasks have their costs rolled up into the orchestrator)
    18→ *
    19→ * @param supabase - Supabase client for fetching task params
    20→ * @param supabaseUrl - The Supabase project URL
    21→ * @param serviceKey - The service role key for authentication
    22→ * @param taskId - The task ID to calculate cost for
    23→ */
    24→export async function triggerCostCalculationIfNotSubTask(
    25→  supabase: any,
    26→  supabaseUrl: string,
    27→  serviceKey: string,
    28→  taskId: string
    29→): Promise<void> {
    30→  try {
    31→    const { data: taskForCostCheck } = await supabase
    32→      .from("tasks")
    33→      .select("params")
    34→      .eq("id", taskId)
    35→      .single();
    36→
    37→    const subTaskOrchestratorRef = getSubTaskOrchestratorId(taskForCostCheck?.params, taskId);
    38→    if (subTaskOrchestratorRef) {
    39→      console.log(`[COMPLETE-TASK] Task ${taskId} is a sub-task, skipping cost calculation`);
    40→      return;
    41→    }
    42→
    43→    await triggerCostCalculation(supabaseUrl, serviceKey, taskId, 'COMPLETE-TASK');
    44→  } catch (costErr) {
    45→    console.error("[COMPLETE-TASK] Error triggering cost calculation:", costErr);
    46→  }
    47→}

   140→/**
   141→ * Handles cascading task failures/cancellations for orchestrated tasks.
   142→ * When a task fails or is cancelled, this function:
   143→ * 1. Finds the orchestrator task (if the failed task references one)
   144→ * 2. Finds all sibling tasks that reference the same orchestrator
   145→ * 3. Marks them all as Failed/Cancelled appropriately

   147→async function handleCascadingTaskFailure(
   148→  supabaseAdmin: any,
   149→  logger: SystemLogger,
   150→  failedTaskId: string,
   151→  failureStatus: string,
   152→  failedTaskData: any
   153→) {

   158→    });

   176→        isOrchestratorTask = true;
   177→        logger.debug("Task is the orchestrator itself", { task_id: failedTaskId });
   178→      }
   179→    }
   180→    
   181→    if (!orchestratorTaskId) {
   182→      logger.debug("No orchestrator reference found, skipping cascade", { task_id: failedTaskId });
   183→      return;
   184→    }
   185→    
   186→    logger.info("Found orchestrator task", { 
   187→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   188→      is_orchestrator_task: isOrchestratorTask
   189→    });
   190→    
   191→    // Find all tasks that reference this orchestrator (including the orchestrator itself)
   192→    // Must check all paths where orchestrator reference might be stored
   193→    let query;
   194→

   196→      // If the failed task IS the orchestrator, find all children that reference it
   197→      query = supabaseAdmin
   198→        .from("tasks")
   199→        .select("id, task_type, status, params")
   200→        .or(buildSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId))
   201→        .neq("id", failedTaskId)
   202→        .neq("status", "Failed")
   203→        .neq("status", "Cancelled")
   204→        .neq("status", "Complete");
   205→    } else {
   206→      // If a child task failed, find orchestrator + all siblings
   207→      query = supabaseAdmin
   208→        .from("tasks")
   209→        .select("id, task_type, status, params")
   210→        .or(`id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId},${buildSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId)}`)
   211→        .neq("status", "Failed")
   212→        .neq("status", "Cancelled")
   213→        .neq("status", "Complete");
   214→    }
   215→    
   216→    const { data: relatedTasks, error: fetchError } = await query;
   217→    
   218→    if (fetchError) {
   219→      logger.error("Error fetching related tasks for cascade", { error: fetchError.message });
   220→      return;
   221→    }
   222→    
   223→    if (!relatedTasks || relatedTasks.length === 0) {
   224→      logger.debug("No related tasks found for cascade");
   225→      return;
   226→    }
   227→    
   228→    // Update all related tasks to Failed/Cancelled
   229→    const tasksToUpdate = relatedTasks.filter((task: any) => task.id !== failedTaskId);

   232→      logger.debug("No additional tasks to cascade to after filtering");
   233→      return;
   234→    }
   235→

   261→      return { taskId: task.id, error };

   270→        total_count: tasksToUpdate.length

   284→serve(async (req) => {

   335→  if (!task_id || !status) {

   337→    await logger.flush();
   338→    return new Response("Missing required fields: task_id and status", { status: 400 });
   339→  }
   340→
   341→  // Validate status values
   342→  const validStatuses = ["Queued", "In Progress", "Complete", "Failed", "Cancelled"];
   343→  if (!validStatuses.includes(status)) {

   347→  }

   349→  logger.info("Processing status update", { task_id, status });

   351→  // Authenticate using shared auth module

   359→

   373→      await logger.flush();

   377→    // --- Status transition validation ---
   378→    // Valid transitions:
   379→    //   Queued      → In Progress, Failed, Cancelled

   467→    } else {

   482→      updateResult = await supabaseAdmin

   485→        .eq("id", task_id)

   487→        .select()
   488→        .single();

   491→    if (updateResult.error) {

   494→        await logger.flush();
   495→        return new Response("Task not found or not accessible", { status: 404 });

   497→      logger.error("Database update error", { 
   498→        task_id,
   499→        error: updateResult.error.message,
   500→        code: updateResult.error.code
   501→      });
   502→      await logger.flush();
   503→      return new Response(`Database error: ${updateResult.error.message}`, { status: 500 });
   504→    }
   505→
   506→    if (!updateResult.data) {
   507→      logger.warn("Task not found or not accessible (no data)", { task_id });
   508→      await logger.flush();
   509→      return new Response("Task not found or not accessible", { status: 404 });

   511→
   512→    logger.info("Task status updated successfully", {

   514→      old_status: currentTask?.status,
   515→      new_status: status 
   516→    });
   517→
   518→    // Handle cascading failures/cancellations for orchestrated tasks
   519→    if (status === "Failed" || status === "Cancelled") {

   521→      
   522→      // Bill for completed work when orchestrator is cancelled
   523→      if (status === "Cancelled") {
   524→        await handleOrchestratorCancellationBilling(
   525→          supabaseAdmin, 
   526→          supabaseUrl, 
   527→          serviceKey, 
   528→          logger, 
   529→          task_id, 
   530→          updateResult.data
   531→        );
   532→      }
   533→    }
   534→    
   535→    await logger.flush();

   537→      success: true,
   538→      task_id: task_id,
   539→      status: status,
   540→      message: `Task status updated to '${status}'`
   541→    }), {
   542→      status: 200,

   544→    });
   545→

1→/**
     2→ * Shared billing utilities for edge functions
     3→ *
     4→ * Centralizes:
     5→ *  - Orchestrator/sub-task detection (extractOrchestratorRef, isSubTask)
     6→ *  - Sub-task query filter for Supabase `.or()` calls
     7→ *  - Cost calculation HTTP trigger
     8→ *
     9→ * Consumers: calculate-task-cost, update-task-status, complete_task
    10→ */
    11→
    12→// ===== Constants =====
    13→
    14→/** UUID v4 regex — used to distinguish real orchestrator FK refs from human-readable IDs */
    15→export const UUID_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
    16→
    17→// ===== Orchestrator reference extraction =====
    18→
    19→/**
    20→ * Extract orchestrator_task_id from task params.
    21→ *
    22→ * Sub-tasks can store the orchestrator reference in multiple param paths
    23→ * depending on the task type and how they were created:
    24→ *  - params.orchestrator_task_id_ref          (travel_segment)
    25→ *  - params.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id  (join_clips_segment)
    26→ *  - params.originalParams.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id (legacy)
    27→ *  - params.orchestrator_task_id              (some legacy tasks)
    28→ *
    29→ * Returns the raw string value (may not be a valid UUID) or null.
    30→ */
    31→export function extractOrchestratorRef(params: any): string | null {
    32→  if (!params || typeof params !== 'object') return null;
    33→
    34→  return (
    35→    params.orchestrator_task_id_ref ||
    36→    params.orchestrator_details?.orchestrator_task_id ||
    37→    params.originalParams?.orchestrator_details?.orchestrator_task_id ||
    38→    params.orchestrator_task_id ||
    39→    null
    40→  );
    41→}
    42→
    43→/**
    44→ * Determine whether a task is a sub-task of an orchestrator.
    45→ *
    46→ * A task is a sub-task when:
    47→ *  1. Its params contain an orchestrator reference (via any of the known paths)
    48→ *  2. That reference is a valid UUID (not a human-readable orchestrator ID)
    49→ *  3. The reference is NOT the task's own ID (orchestrators store their own ID
    50→ *     in params.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id for children to copy)
    51→ *
    52→ * @param params  - task.params (object, not stringified)
    53→ * @param taskId  - the task's own ID, to guard against self-references
    54→ * @returns The orchestrator task ID if this is a sub-task, or null otherwise
    55→ */
    56→export function getSubTaskOrchestratorId(params: any, taskId: string): string | null {
    57→  const ref = extractOrchestratorRef(params);
    58→  if (!ref) return null;
    59→  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(ref)) return null;
    60→  if (ref === taskId) return null;
    61→  return ref;
    62→}
    63→
    64→// ===== Sub-task query filter =====
    65→
    66→/**
    67→ * Build a Supabase PostgREST `.or()` filter string that finds all tasks
    68→ * whose params reference the given orchestrator task ID.
    69→ *
    70→ * Covers all four param paths where a sub-task may store the reference.
    71→ *
    72→ * Usage:
    73→ *   supabase.from('tasks').select('...').or(buildSubTaskFilter(orchestratorId))
    74→ */
    75→export function buildSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId: string): string {
    76→  return [
    77→    `params->>orchestrator_task_id_ref.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
    78→    `params->orchestrator_details->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
    79→    `params->originalParams->orchestrator_details->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
    80→    `params->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
    81→  ].join(',');
    82→}
    83→
    84→// ===== Cost calculation trigger =====
    85→
    86→/**
    87→ * Trigger the calculate-task-cost edge function for a given task.
    88→ *
    89→ * This is a fire-and-forget HTTP call (errors are logged, not thrown).
    90→ *
    91→ * @param supabaseUrl - The Supabase project URL
    92→ * @param serviceKey  - The service role key for authentication
    93→ * @param taskId      - The task ID to calculate cost for
    94→ * @param logTag      - Optional log tag prefix (default: 'CostCalc')
    95→ */
    96→export async function triggerCostCalculation(
    97→  supabaseUrl: string,
    98→  serviceKey: string,
    99→  taskId: string,
   100→  logTag: string = 'CostCalc'
   101→): Promise<void> {
   102→  try {
   103→    console.log(`[${logTag}] Triggering cost calculation for ${taskId}...`);
   104→    const costResp = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/functions/v1/calculate-task-cost`, {
   105→      method: "POST",
   106→      headers: {
   107→        "Authorization": `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
   108→        "Content-Type": "application/json"
   109→      },
   110→      body: JSON.stringify({ task_id: taskId })
   111→    });
   112→
   113→    if (costResp.ok) {
   114→      const costData = await costResp.json();
   115→      if (costData.skipped) {
   116→        console.log(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation skipped: ${costData.reason}`);
   117→      } else if (typeof costData.cost === 'number') {
   118→        console.log(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation successful: $${costData.cost.toFixed(3)}`);
   119→      }
   120→    } else {
   121→      const errTxt = await costResp.text();
   122→      console.error(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation failed: ${errTxt}`);
   123→    }
   124→  } catch (costErr) {
   125→    console.error(`[${logTag}] Error triggering cost calculation:`, costErr);
   126→  }
   127→}
   128→

1→import { createContext, useContext, ReactNode, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
     2→import { Project } from '@/types/project';
     3→import { useAuth } from './AuthContext';
     4→import { useUserSettings } from './UserSettingsContext';
     5→import { useProjectSelection } from '@/shared/hooks/useProjectSelection';
     6→import { useProjectCRUD } from '@/shared/hooks/useProjectCRUD';
     7→import { useProjectDefaults } from '@/shared/hooks/useProjectDefaults';
     8→
     9→// Type for updating projects (re-exported for consumers that may need it)
    10→interface ProjectUpdate {
    11→  name?: string;
    12→  aspectRatio?: string;
    13→}
    14→
    15→interface ProjectContextType {
    16→  projects: Project[];
    17→  selectedProjectId: string | null;
    18→  setSelectedProjectId: (projectId: string | null) => void;
    19→  isLoadingProjects: boolean;
    20→  fetchProjects: () => Promise<void>;
    21→  addNewProject: (projectData: { name: string; aspectRatio: string }) => Promise<Project | null>;
    22→  isCreatingProject: boolean;
    23→  updateProject: (projectId: string, updates: ProjectUpdate) => Promise<boolean>;
    24→  isUpdatingProject: boolean;
    25→  deleteProject: (projectId: string) => Promise<boolean>;
    26→  isDeletingProject: boolean;
    27→  /** Current authenticated user ID, null if not logged in */
    28→  userId: string | null;
    29→}
    30→
    31→const ProjectContext = createContext<ProjectContextType | undefined>(undefined);
    32→
    33→export const ProjectProvider = ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => {
    34→  const { userId } = useAuth();
    35→  const { userSettings: userPreferences, isLoadingSettings: isLoadingPreferences, updateUserSettings } = useUserSettings();
    36→
    37→  // ── Selection: owns selectedProjectId, localStorage persistence, cross-device sync ──
    38→  const selection = useProjectSelection({
    39→    userId: userId ?? null,
    40→    userPreferences,
    41→    isLoadingPreferences,
    42→    updateUserSettings,
    43→  });
    44→
    45→  // ── CRUD: owns projects list, loading flags, fetch/create/update/delete ──
    46→  const crud = useProjectCRUD({
    47→    selectedProjectId: selection.selectedProjectId,
    48→    onProjectsLoaded: selection.handleProjectsLoaded,
    49→    onProjectCreated: selection.handleProjectCreated,
    50→    onProjectDeleted: selection.handleProjectDeleted,
    51→    updateUserSettings,
    52→  });
    53→
    54→  // ── Side effects: fetch trigger, cross-device sync, prefetch, mobile fallback ──
    55→  useProjectDefaults({
    56→    userId: userId ?? null,
    57→    selectedProjectId: selection.selectedProjectId,
    58→    isLoadingProjects: crud.isLoadingProjects,
    59→    isLoadingPreferences,
    60→    projects: crud.projects,
    61→    fetchProjects: crud.fetchProjects,
    62→    applyCrossDeviceSync: selection.applyCrossDeviceSync,
    63→  });
    64→
    65→  // ── Expose context for debugging (dev only) ──
    66→  useEffect(() => {
    67→    if (import.meta.env.DEV && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    68→      window.__PROJECT_CONTEXT__ = {
    69→        selectedProjectId: selection.selectedProjectId,
    70→        projects: crud.projects,
    71→      };
    72→    }
    73→  }, [selection.selectedProjectId, crud.projects]);
    74→
    75→  // ── Build context value ──
    76→  const contextValue = useMemo(
    77→    (): ProjectContextType => ({
    78→      projects: crud.projects || [],
    79→      selectedProjectId: selection.selectedProjectId,
    80→      setSelectedProjectId: selection.setSelectedProjectId,
    81→      isLoadingProjects: crud.isLoadingProjects,
    82→      fetchProjects: crud.fetchProjects,
    83→      addNewProject: crud.addNewProject,
    84→      isCreatingProject: crud.isCreatingProject,
    85→      updateProject: crud.updateProject,
    86→      isUpdatingProject: crud.isUpdatingProject,
    87→      deleteProject: crud.deleteProject,
    88→      isDeletingProject: crud.isDeletingProject,
    89→      userId: userId ?? null,
    90→    }),
    91→    [
    92→      crud.projects,
    93→      selection.selectedProjectId,
    94→      selection.setSelectedProjectId,
    95→      crud.isLoadingProjects,
    96→      crud.fetchProjects,
    97→      crud.addNewProject,
    98→      crud.isCreatingProject,
    99→      crud.updateProject,
   100→      crud.isUpdatingProject,
   101→      crud.deleteProject,
   102→      crud.isDeletingProject,
   103→      userId,
   104→    ]
   105→  );
   106→
   107→  return (
   108→    <ProjectContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
   109→      {children}
   110→    </ProjectContext.Provider>
   111→  );
   112→};
   113→
   114→export const useProject = () => {
   115→  const context = useContext(ProjectContext);
   116→  if (context === undefined) {
   117→    const errorMessage = 'useProject must be used within a ProjectProvider. ' +
   118→      'Make sure the component is rendered inside the ProjectProvider tree. ' +
   119→      'Check that the component is not being rendered outside of App.tsx or in an error boundary that is outside the provider.';
   120→    console.error('[ProjectContext]', errorMessage, {
   121→      stack: new Error().stack,
   122→      windowLocation: typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.href : 'N/A'
   123→    });
   124→    throw new Error(errorMessage);
   125→  }
   126→  return context;
   127→};
   128→

     6→
     7→// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
     8→declare const Deno: any;
     9→
    10→/**
    11→ * Edge function: claim-next-task
    12→ *
    13→ * OPTIMIZED VERSION - Performance improvements over original:
    14→ * - Single database query instead of N+1 queries
    15→ * - Database-level filtering instead of JavaScript filtering
    16→ * - Atomic operations to prevent race conditions
    17→ * - Dramatically reduced network round trips
    18→ * - Enhanced debugging capabilities
    19→ *
    20→ * Claims the next queued task atomically using optimized PostgreSQL functions.
    21→ * - Service-role key: claims any task across all users (cloud processing)
    22→ * - User token: claims only tasks for that specific user (local processing)
    23→ *
    24→ * NOTE: For task counts and statistics, use the separate task-counts function.
    25→ *
    26→ * POST /functions/v1/claim-next-task
    27→ * Headers: Authorization: Bearer <service-key or PAT>
    28→ * Body: {
    29→ *   worker_id?: string,        // Optional worker ID for service role
    30→ *   run_type?: 'gpu' | 'api',  // Optional: filter tasks by execution environment
    31→ *   same_model_only?: boolean, // Optional: only claim tasks matching worker's current_model
    32→ *   debug?: boolean            // Optional: enable verbose logging/analysis on 204 responses
    33→ * }
    34→ *
    35→ * Returns:
    36→ * - 200 OK with task data if task claimed successfully
    37→ * - 204 No Content if no tasks available
    38→ * - 401 Unauthorized if no valid token
    39→ * - 403 Forbidden if token invalid or user not found
    40→ * - 500 Internal Server Error
    41→ */
    42→serve(async (req) => {
    43→  const serviceKey = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY");
    44→  const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL");
    45→
    46→  if (!serviceKey || !supabaseUrl) {
    47→    console.error("[CLAIM-NEXT-TASK] Missing required environment variables");
    48→    return new Response("Server configuration error", { status: 500 });
    49→  }
    50→
    51→  // Create admin client for database operations
    52→  const supabaseAdmin = createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey);
    53→
    54→  // Create logger
    55→  const logger = new SystemLogger(supabaseAdmin, 'claim-next-task');
    56→
    57→  // Only accept POST requests
    58→  if (req.method !== "POST") {
    59→    logger.warn("Method not allowed", { method: req.method });
    60→    await logger.flush();
    61→    return new Response("Method not allowed", { status: 405 });
    62→  }
    63→
    64→  // Parse request body
    65→  let requestBody: any = {};
    66→  try {
    67→    const bodyText = await req.text();
    68→    if (bodyText) {
    69→      requestBody = JSON.parse(bodyText);
    70→    }
    71→  } catch (e) {
    72→    logger.debug("No valid JSON body provided, using defaults");
    73→  }
    74→
    75→  const workerId = requestBody.worker_id || `edge_${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
    76→  const runType = requestBody.run_type || null; // 'gpu', 'api', or null (no filtering)
    77→  const sameModelOnly = requestBody.same_model_only || false; // Only claim tasks matching worker's current model
    78→  const debug = requestBody.debug === true; // Enable verbose analysis on 204 responses
    79→
    80→  // Authenticate using shared auth module
    81→  const auth = await authenticateRequest(req, supabaseAdmin, "[CLAIM-NEXT-TASK]");
    82→
    83→  if (!auth.success) {
    84→    logger.error("Authentication failed", { error: auth.error });
    85→    await logger.flush();
    86→    return new Response(auth.error || "Authentication failed", { status: auth.statusCode || 403 });
    87→  }
    88→
    89→  const isServiceRole = auth.isServiceRole;
    90→  const callerId = auth.userId;
    91→
    92→  if (isServiceRole) {
    93→    logger.info("Authenticated via service-role key", { worker_id: workerId, run_type: runType });
    94→  } else {
    95→    logger.info("Authenticated via PAT", { user_id: callerId });
    96→  }
    97→
    98→  try {
    99→    if (isServiceRole) {
   100→      // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   101→      // SERVICE ROLE PATH: Use optimized PostgreSQL function
   102→      // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   103→      const pathType = runType === 'api' ? 'API' : 'GPU';
   104→      logger.info(`Claiming task (service-role, ${pathType} path)`, { 
   105→        worker_id: workerId, 
   106→        run_type: runType,
   107→        same_model_only: sameModelOnly
   108→      });
   109→      
   110→      let claimResult, claimError;

   113→          .rpc('claim_next_task_service_role', {
   114→            p_worker_id: workerId,
   115→            p_include_active: false,
   116→            p_run_type: runType,
   117→            p_same_model_only: sameModelOnly
   118→          });
   119→        
   120→        claimResult = rpcResponse.data;
   121→        claimError = rpcResponse.error;
   122→        
   123→      } catch (e: any) {
   124→        logger.error("Exception during RPC call", { error: e?.message });
   125→        throw e;
   126→      }
   127→
   128→      if (claimError) {
   129→        logger.error("Claim RPC error", { 
   130→          error: claimError.message,
   131→          code: claimError.code 
   132→        });
   133→        throw claimError;
   134→      }
   135→
   136→      if (!claimResult || claimResult.length === 0) {
   137→        // Only log and analyze when debug=true to reduce overhead for frequent polling
   138→        if (debug) {
   139→          logger.info("No eligible tasks available", {

   102→        handleError(e, { context: 'ProjectContext.fastResume', showToast: false });
   103→      }
   104→      updateUserSettings('user', { lastOpenedProjectId: undefined });
   105→    }
   106→  }, [updateUserSettings]);
   107→
   108→  /** Called when projects are loaded — decides which project to select. */
   109→  const handleProjectsLoaded = useCallback((projects: Project[], isNewDefault: boolean) => {
   110→    if (isNewDefault) {
   111→      // Brand new default project: select it directly
   112→      handleSetSelectedProjectId(projects[0].id);
   113→    } else {
   114→      const lastOpenedProjectId = userPreferencesRef.current?.lastOpenedProjectId;
   115→      const projectIdToSelect = determineProjectIdToSelect(projects, selectedProjectId, lastOpenedProjectId);
   116→
   117→      if (projectIdToSelect !== selectedProjectId) {
   118→        handleSetSelectedProjectId(projectIdToSelect);
   119→      }
   120→    }
   121→  }, [selectedProjectId, handleSetSelectedProjectId]);
   122→
   123→  /** Called after a new project is created. */
   124→  const handleProjectCreated = useCallback((project: Project) => {
   125→    handleSetSelectedProjectId(project.id);
   126→  }, [handleSetSelectedProjectId]);
   127→
   128→  /** Called after a project is deleted — selects the next project. */
   129→  const handleProjectDeleted = useCallback((remainingProjects: Project[]) => {
   130→    const nextProjectId = determineProjectIdToSelect(remainingProjects, null, null);
   131→    setSelectedProjectIdState(nextProjectId);
   132→
   133→    if (nextProjectId) {
   134→      updateUserSettings('user', { lastOpenedProjectId: nextProjectId });
   135→    } else {
   136→      updateUserSettings('user', { lastOpenedProjectId: undefined });
   137→    }
   138→  }, [updateUserSettings]);
   139→
   140→  return {
   141→    selectedProjectId,
   142→    setSelectedProjectId: handleSetSelectedProjectId,
   143→    applyCrossDeviceSync,
   144→    handleProjectsLoaded,
   145→    handleProjectCreated,
   146→    handleProjectDeleted,
   147→    userPreferencesRef,
   148→  };
   149→}

1→import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
     2→import { usePrefetchToolSettings } from '@/shared/hooks/usePrefetchToolSettings';
     3→import { useMobileTimeoutFallback } from '@/shared/hooks/useMobileTimeoutFallback';
     4→import { Project } from '@/types/project';
     5→
     6→interface UseProjectDefaultsOptions {
     7→  userId: string | null;
     8→  selectedProjectId: string | null;
     9→  isLoadingProjects: boolean;
    10→  isLoadingPreferences: boolean;
    11→  projects: Project[];
    12→  fetchProjects: () => Promise<void>;
    13→  applyCrossDeviceSync: (projects: Project[]) => void;
    14→}
    15→
    16→/**
    17→ * Orchestrates project-related side effects:
    18→ * - Triggers fetchProjects when userId is available
    19→ * - Cross-device sync when preferences + projects are both loaded
    20→ * - Prefetches tool settings for the selected project
    21→ * - Mobile timeout fallback for stalled fetches
    22→ */
    23→export function useProjectDefaults({
    24→  userId,
    25→  selectedProjectId,
    26→  isLoadingProjects,
    27→  isLoadingPreferences,
    28→  projects,
    29→  fetchProjects,
    30→  applyCrossDeviceSync,
    31→}: UseProjectDefaultsOptions) {
    32→  // [PROFILING] Track fetch invocations to detect triple-fetch issue
    33→  const fetchInvocationCountRef = useRef(0);
    34→  const lastFetchReasonRef = useRef<string>('');
    35→
    36→  // Prefetch all tool settings for the currently selected project
    37→  usePrefetchToolSettings(selectedProjectId);
    38→
    39→  // Trigger initial project fetch when userId becomes available
    40→  useEffect(() => {
    41→    if (userId) {
    42→      fetchInvocationCountRef.current += 1;
    43→      const reason = `userId=${!!userId}, isLoadingPreferences=${isLoadingPreferences}`;
    44→      lastFetchReasonRef.current = reason;
    45→
    46→      fetchProjects();
    47→    }
    48→  }, [userId, isLoadingPreferences, fetchProjects]);
    49→
    50→  // Cross-device sync: apply server preferences once projects + prefs are loaded
    51→  useEffect(() => {
    52→    if (projects.length > 0) {
    53→      applyCrossDeviceSync(projects);
    54→    }
    55→  }, [projects, applyCrossDeviceSync]);
    56→
    57→  // [MobileStallFix] Fallback recovery: retry fetch if projects loading stalls
    58→  useMobileTimeoutFallback({
    59→    isLoading: isLoadingProjects,
    60→    onTimeout: fetchProjects,
    61→    mobileTimeoutMs: 15000,
    62→    desktopTimeoutMs: 10000,
    63→    enabled: !!userId,
    64→  });
    65→}
    66→
