   199→  // Ensure itemsPerPage is a multiple of columns to guarantee full rows
   200→  const rawItemsPerPage = itemsPerPage ?? defaultItemsPerPage;
   201→  const actualItemsPerPage = Math.floor(rawItemsPerPage / effectiveColumnsPerRow) * effectiveColumnsPerRow || effectiveColumnsPerRow;
   202→
   203→  // Memoize simplified shot options to prevent re-computation on every render
   204→  const simplifiedShotOptions = React.useMemo(() =>
   205→    [...allShots]
   206→      .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.created_at || 0).getTime() - new Date(a.created_at || 0).getTime())
   207→      .map(s => ({
   208→        id: s.id,
   209→        name: s.name,
   210→        settings: s.settings,
   211→        created_at: s.created_at
   212→      })),
   213→    [allShots]
   214→  );
   215→
   216→  // Memoize grid column classes to prevent unnecessary recalculations
   217→  const gridColumnClasses = React.useMemo(() => {
   218→    return GRID_COLUMN_CLASSES[effectiveColumnsPerRow as keyof typeof GRID_COLUMN_CLASSES] || aspectRatioLayout.gridColumnClasses;
   219→  }, [effectiveColumnsPerRow, aspectRatioLayout.gridColumnClasses]);
   220→
   221→  // Core state management hook
   222→  const stateHook = useMediaGalleryState({
   223→    images,
   224→    currentShotId,
   225→    lastShotId,
   226→    simplifiedShotOptions,
   227→    isServerPagination: !!(onServerPageChange && serverPage),
   228→    serverPage,
   229→  });
   230→
   231→  // Filters hook
   232→  const filtersHook = useMediaGalleryFilters({
   233→    images,
   234→    optimisticDeletedIds: stateHook.state.optimisticDeletedIds,
   235→    currentToolType,
   236→    initialFilterState,
   237→    onServerPageChange,
   238→    serverPage,
   239→    filters,
   240→    onFiltersChange,
   241→    defaultFilters,
   242→  });
   243→
   244→  // Check if filters are active for empty state
   245→  const hasFilters = filtersHook.filterByToolType || filtersHook.mediaTypeFilter !== 'all' || !!filtersHook.searchTerm.trim() || filtersHook.showStarredOnly || !filtersHook.toolTypeFilterEnabled;
   246→
   247→  // Pagination hook
   248→  const paginationHook = useMediaGalleryPagination({
   249→    filteredImages: filtersHook.filteredImages,
   250→    itemsPerPage: actualItemsPerPage,
   251→    onServerPageChange,
   252→    serverPage,
   253→    offset,
   254→    totalCount,
   255→    enableAdjacentPagePreloading,
   256→    isMobile,
   257→    galleryTopRef: stateHook.galleryTopRef,
   258→  });
   259→
   260→  const withPaginationReset = useCallback(<T,>(fn: () => T): T => {
   261→    const result = fn();
   262→    paginationHook.goToFirstPage();
   263→    if (paginationHook.isServerPagination) {
   264→      paginationHook.setIsGalleryLoading(true);
   265→    }
   266→    return result;
   267→  }, [paginationHook.goToFirstPage, paginationHook.isServerPagination, paginationHook.setIsGalleryLoading]);
   268→
   269→  // Handle page bounds exceeded (e.g., deleted all items on last page)
   270→  const handlePageBoundsExceeded = useCallback((newLastPage: number) => {
   271→    if (onServerPageChange) {
   272→      onServerPageChange(newLastPage);
   273→    }
   274→  }, [onServerPageChange]);
   275→
   276→  // Actions hook
   277→  const actionsHook = useMediaGalleryActions({
   278→    onDelete,
   279→    onApplySettings,
   280→    onAddToLastShot,
   281→    onAddToLastShotWithoutPosition,
   282→    onToggleStar,
   283→    activeLightboxMedia: stateHook.state.activeLightboxMedia,
   284→    setActiveLightboxMedia: stateHook.setActiveLightboxMedia,
   285→    setAutoEnterEditMode: stateHook.setAutoEnterEditMode,
   286→    markOptimisticDeleted: stateHook.markOptimisticDeleted,
   287→    markOptimisticDeletedWithBackfill: stateHook.markOptimisticDeletedWithBackfill,
   288→    removeOptimisticDeleted: stateHook.removeOptimisticDeleted,
   289→    setDownloadingImageId: stateHook.setDownloadingImageId,
   290→    setShowTickForImageId: stateHook.setShowTickForImageId,
   291→    setShowTickForSecondaryImageId: stateHook.setShowTickForSecondaryImageId,
   292→    mainTickTimeoutRef: stateHook.mainTickTimeoutRef,
   293→    secondaryTickTimeoutRef: stateHook.secondaryTickTimeoutRef,
   294→    onBackfillRequest,
   295→    serverPage,
   296→    itemsPerPage: actualItemsPerPage,
   297→    isServerPagination: paginationHook.isServerPagination,
   298→    setIsBackfillLoading: stateHook.setIsBackfillLoading,
   299→    filteredImages: filtersHook.filteredImages,
   300→    setIsDownloadingStarred: stateHook.setIsDownloadingStarred,
   301→    setSelectedShotIdLocal: stateHook.setSelectedShotIdLocal,
   302→    // New props for robust backfill
   303→    totalCount,
   304→    offset,
   305→    optimisticDeletedCount: stateHook.state.optimisticDeletedIds.size,
   306→    onPageBoundsExceeded: handlePageBoundsExceeded,
   307→  });
   308→
   309→  // Mobile interactions hook
   310→  const mobileHook = useMobileInteractions({
   311→    isMobile,
   312→    mobileActiveImageId: stateHook.state.mobileActiveImageId,
   313→    setMobileActiveImageId: stateHook.setMobileActiveImageId,
   314→    mobilePopoverOpenImageId: stateHook.state.mobilePopoverOpenImageId,
   315→    setMobilePopoverOpenImageId: stateHook.setMobilePopoverOpenImageId,
   316→    lastTouchTimeRef: stateHook.lastTouchTimeRef,
   317→    lastTappedImageIdRef: stateHook.lastTappedImageIdRef,
   318→    doubleTapTimeoutRef: stateHook.doubleTapTimeoutRef,
   319→    onOpenLightbox: actionsHook.handleOpenLightbox,
   320→  });
   321→
   322→  // Task details functionality using shared hook
   323→  // IMPORTANT: Use generation_id (actual generations.id) when available, falling back to id
   324→  // For ShotImageManager images, id is shot_generations.id but generation_id is the actual generation ID
   325→  const lightboxImageId = stateHook.state.activeLightboxMedia?.generation_id
   326→    || stateHook.state.activeLightboxMedia?.id
   327→    || null;
   328→  const {
   329→    taskDetailsData,
   330→    taskMapping: lightboxTaskMapping,
   331→    task,
   332→    taskError,
   333→  } = useTaskDetails({
   334→    generationId: lightboxImageId,
   335→    onApplySettingsFromTask: onApplySettings,
   336→    onClose: actionsHook.handleCloseLightbox,
   337→  });
   338→  const inputImages = taskDetailsData?.inputImages || [];
   339→
   340→  // Background thumbnail generation for videos without thumbnails
   341→  useBackgroundThumbnailGenerator({
   342→    videos: paginationHook.paginatedImages || [],
   343→    projectId: selectedProjectId,
   344→    enabled: !!selectedProjectId && (paginationHook.paginatedImages?.length || 0) > 0,
   345→  });
   346→
   347→  // Lazy-load variant badge data (derivedCount, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCount)
   348→  // This allows images to display immediately while badge data loads in background
   349→  const paginatedGenerationIds = useMemo(() =>
   350→    (paginationHook.paginatedImages || []).map(img =>
   351→      getGenerationId(img)
   352→    ).filter(Boolean),
   353→    [paginationHook.paginatedImages]
   354→  );
   355→  const { getBadgeData, isLoading: isBadgeDataLoading } = useVariantBadges(paginatedGenerationIds);
   356→
   357→  // Merge badge data with paginated images (only when badge data is loaded)
   358→  const paginatedImagesWithBadges = useMemo(() => {
   359→    if (!paginationHook.paginatedImages) return [];
   360→    return paginationHook.paginatedImages.map(img => {
   361→      // Don't merge badge data while loading - prevents showing "0" badges
   362→      // Strip out any existing derivedCount to prevent flash of "0"
   363→      if (isBadgeDataLoading) {
   364→        const { derivedCount, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCount, ...imgWithoutBadges } = img;
   365→        return imgWithoutBadges;
   366→      }
   367→      const generationId = getGenerationId(img);
   368→      const badgeData = getBadgeData(generationId);
   369→      return {
   370→        ...img,
   371→        derivedCount: badgeData.derivedCount,
   372→        hasUnviewedVariants: badgeData.hasUnviewedVariants,
   373→        unviewedVariantCount: badgeData.unviewedVariantCount,
   374→      };
   375→    });
   376→  }, [paginationHook.paginatedImages, getBadgeData, isBadgeDataLoading]);
   377→
   378→  // Calculate effective page for progressive loading
   379→  const effectivePage = paginationHook.isServerPagination
   380→    ? Math.max(0, (serverPage ?? 1) - 1)
   381→    : paginationHook.page;
   382→
   383→  // Memoized navigation handler to prevent re-creation
   384→  const handleNavigateToShot = useCallback((shot: Shot) => {
   385→    
   386→    try {
   387→      navigateToShot(shot);
   388→      
   389→      // Now we close the lightbox from the component that owns its state
   390→      actionsHook.handleCloseLightbox();
   391→    } catch (error) {
   392→      handleError(error, { context: 'MediaGallery', showToast: false });
   393→    }
   394→  }, [navigateToShot, actionsHook.handleCloseLightbox]);
   395→
   396→  // Memoized visit shot handler
   397→  const handleVisitShotFromNotifier = useCallback((shotId: string) => {
   398→    
   399→    // Find the shot object from the shot ID
   400→    const shot = simplifiedShotOptions.find(s => s.id === shotId);
   401→    if (!shot) {
   402→      console.error('[VisitShotDebug] ERROR: Shot not found for ID:', shotId);
   403→      return;
   404→    }
   405→    
   406→    // Convert the simplified shot to a full Shot object
   407→    const fullShot = allShots.find(s => s.id === shotId);
   408→    if (!fullShot) {
   409→      console.error('[VisitShotDebug] ERROR: Full shot not found for ID:', shotId);
   410→      return;
   411→    }
   412→    
   413→    try {
   414→      navigateToShot(fullShot);
   415→    } catch (error) {
   416→      handleError(error, { context: 'MediaGallery', showToast: false });
   417→    }
   418→  }, [simplifiedShotOptions, allShots, navigateToShot]);
   419→
   420→  // Lightbox navigation (next/previous/go-to-index with cross-page support)
   421→  const {
   422→    handleNextImage,
   423→    handlePreviousImage,
   424→    handleSetActiveLightboxIndex,
   425→    pendingTargetSetTimeRef,
   426→  } = useLightboxNavigation({
   427→    activeLightboxMedia: stateHook.state.activeLightboxMedia,
   428→    filteredImages: filtersHook.filteredImages,
   429→    isServerPagination: paginationHook.isServerPagination,
   430→    serverPage,
   431→    totalPages: paginationHook.totalPages,
   432→    onServerPageChange,
   433→    handleOpenLightbox: actionsHook.handleOpenLightbox,
   434→    setPendingLightboxTarget: stateHook.setPendingLightboxTarget,
   435→  });
   436→
   437→  // Track filteredImages changes for debugging cross-page navigation
   438→  const prevFilteredImagesRef = useRef<string>('');
   439→
   440→  // Handle opening lightbox after page navigation
   441→  useEffect(() => {
   442→    const currentSignature = `${filtersHook.filteredImages.length}-${filtersHook.filteredImages[0]?.id?.substring(0,8) ?? 'none'}-${filtersHook.filteredImages[filtersHook.filteredImages.length-1]?.id?.substring(0,8) ?? 'none'}`;
   443→
   444→    prevFilteredImagesRef.current = currentSignature;
   445→
   446→    if (stateHook.state.pendingLightboxTarget && filtersHook.filteredImages.length > 0) {
   447→      const targetIndex = stateHook.state.pendingLightboxTarget === 'first' ? 0 : filtersHook.filteredImages.length - 1;
   448→      const targetImage = filtersHook.filteredImages[targetIndex];
   449→
   450→      if (targetImage) {
   451→        actionsHook.handleOpenLightbox(targetImage);
   452→        stateHook.setPendingLightboxTarget(null);
   453→        pendingTargetSetTimeRef.current = null;
   454→      }
   455→    } else if (stateHook.state.pendingLightboxTarget && filtersHook.filteredImages.length === 0) {
   456→    }
   457→  }, [filtersHook.filteredImages, stateHook.state.pendingLightboxTarget, actionsHook.handleOpenLightbox, stateHook.setPendingLightboxTarget, serverPage]);
   458→
   459→  // Listen for custom event to select a shot for adding images (from VideoShotDisplay)
   460→  useEffect(() => {
   461→    const handleSelectShotForAddition = (event: CustomEvent<{ shotId: string; shotName: string }>) => {
   462→      const { shotId } = event.detail;
   463→      // Use handleShotChange to update both selectedShotIdLocal AND lastAffectedShotId
   464→      // This ensures handleAddToShot will use the correct target shot
   465→      actionsHook.handleShotChange(shotId);
   466→    };
   467→
   468→    window.addEventListener('selectShotForAddition', handleSelectShotForAddition as EventListener);
   469→    return () => window.removeEventListener('selectShotForAddition', handleSelectShotForAddition as EventListener);
   470→  }, [actionsHook.handleShotChange]);
   471→
   472→  // Wrapper functions to adapt 3-parameter onAddToLastShot to 4-parameter signature expected by MediaGalleryLightbox
   473→  // The lightbox passes (targetShotId, generationId, imageUrl, thumbUrl) but parent provides (generationId, imageUrl, thumbUrl)
   474→  // We ignore targetShotId because the parent's handler uses lastAffectedShotId (updated via onShotChange)
   475→  const adaptedOnAddToShot = useMemo(() => {
   476→    if (!onAddToLastShot) return undefined;
   477→    return async (_targetShotId: string, generationId: string, imageUrl?: string, thumbUrl?: string): Promise<boolean> => {
   478→      return onAddToLastShot(generationId, imageUrl, thumbUrl);
   479→    };
   480→  }, [onAddToLastShot]);
   481→
   482→  const adaptedOnAddToShotWithoutPosition = useMemo(() => {
   483→    if (!onAddToLastShotWithoutPosition) return undefined;
   484→    return async (_targetShotId: string, generationId: string, imageUrl?: string, thumbUrl?: string): Promise<boolean> => {
   485→      return onAddToLastShotWithoutPosition(generationId, imageUrl, thumbUrl);
   486→    };
   487→  }, [onAddToLastShotWithoutPosition]);

   489→  // Additional action handlers

   496→  const handleShowAllShots = useCallback(() => {

   500→  // Task details handlers
   501→  const handleShowTaskDetails = useCallback(() => {

   513→    }

   515→
   516→  return (
   517→    <TooltipProvider>

   523→          isMobile && !hidePagination ? 'pb-16' : (reducedSpacing ? 'pb-0' : ((!hidePagination && !hideBottomPagination) ? 'pb-[62px]' : 'pb-0')),
   524→          className
   525→        )}
   526→      >
   527→        {/* Header section with pagination and filters */}
   528→        <div ref={stateHook.galleryTopRef}>
   529→          <MediaGalleryHeader
   530→            // Pagination props
   531→            totalPages={paginationHook.totalPages}
   532→            page={paginationHook.page}
   533→            isServerPagination={paginationHook.isServerPagination}
   534→            serverPage={serverPage}
   535→            rangeStart={paginationHook.rangeStart}
   536→            rangeEnd={paginationHook.rangeEnd}
   537→            totalFilteredItems={paginationHook.totalFilteredItems}
   538→            loadingButton={paginationHook.loadingButton}
   539→            whiteText={whiteText}
   540→            reducedSpacing={reducedSpacing}
   541→            hidePagination={hidePagination}
   542→            onPageChange={paginationHook.handlePageChange}
   543→            isPhoneOnly={isPhoneOnly}
   544→
   545→            // Filter props
   546→            hideTopFilters={hideTopFilters}

   549→            onStarredFilterChange={(val) => withPaginationReset(() => filtersHook.setShowStarredOnly(Boolean(val)))}

   551→            // Shot filter props

   558→
   559→            // Search props

   570→            onMediaTypeFilterChange={(value) => withPaginationReset(() => filtersHook.setMediaTypeFilter(value))}

    17→ *   }}
    18→ * />
    19→ * ```

## Decomposition Summary

### Original state
- `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/SegmentSettingsForm/SegmentSettingsForm.tsx` -- **1044 lines**, single monolithic component with ~47 props

### New structure after decomposition

**Parent component (orchestrator):**
- `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/SegmentSettingsForm/SegmentSettingsForm.tsx` -- **376 lines** (down from 1044)
  - Owns top-level UI state (submit success, saving defaults, drag state)
  - Renders header, image previews with frames slider, submit button, and restore/save defaults buttons
  - Delegates to `PromptSection` and `AdvancedSettingsSection`

**Extracted sub-components:**

1. `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/SegmentSettingsForm/components/PromptSection.tsx` -- **116 lines**
   - Prompt textarea with enhanced/default badges and field controls
   - Enhance prompt toggle and make-primary variant switch

2. `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/SegmentSettingsForm/components/AdvancedSettingsSection.tsx` -- **396 lines**
   - The collapsible "Advanced Settings" panel
   - Before/after prompt text fields, negative prompt
   - Motion controls (MotionPresetSelector + LoRA management)
   - Delegates structure video rendering to `StructureVideoSection`
   - LoRA selector modal
   - Owns its own `showAdvanced`, `isLoraModalOpen`, and `savingField` state
   - Owns its own LoRA and motion handlers (these were previously inline in the parent)

3. `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/SegmentSettingsForm/components/StructureVideoSection.tsx` -- **429 lines**
   - Loading skeleton when uploading
   - "Add structure video" UI (upload/browse) when none exists
   - Video preview with remove/replace overlay when one exists
   - Treatment selector (Fit to Range / 1:1 Mapping)
   - Strength and end-percent sliders with default controls
   - DatasetBrowser modal for browsing videos

### What was preserved
- **No behavior changes** -- all form logic, callbacks, and rendering remain identical
- **No export changes** -- consumers still import `SegmentSettingsForm` from the same path via the barrel `index.tsx`
- **No files outside the directory were touched**
- **Props at 1 level of drilling** -- no new contexts were created

### Key design decisions
- `AdvancedSettingsSection` owns its own `savingField` state and LoRA/motion handlers. These were tightly coupled to the advanced settings UI and do not need to be shared with the parent.
- `handleSaveFieldAsDefault` exists in both the parent (for prompt defaults) and `AdvancedSettingsSection` (for advanced field defaults). Each wraps the same `onSaveFieldAsDefault` prop but manages its own local saving-indicator state independently, which is correct -- a save in one section should not show a spinner in the other.
- Drag-and-drop state (`isDraggingVideo`) remains in the parent and is passed down, because the drag handlers manipulate parent-level state.
- `videoUpload` hook remains in the parent and is passed to both `AdvancedSettingsSection` and through to `StructureVideoSection`, since upload state needs to be shared across the form boundary.

`npx tsc --noEmit` passes with zero errors.

> AGENT

The `useMemo` depends on `configOverrides` which is the reference from props. When callers pass a literal `config={{ ... }}` object, it will create a new reference each render. But this is the same as the previous behavior where each boolean prop was destructured directly. The memoization means the spread only happens when `configOverrides` changes, which is fine.

However, there's a subtle issue: callers that pass inline config objects like `config={{ showShare: false }}` will recreate the object on every render. This was the same behavior as before (each boolean prop was separately evaluated on each render), so no regression. And the `useMemo` is cheap enough that this doesn't matter.

Here is a summary of the decomposition.

## What was done

The monolithic `ImageEditContext` (319 lines, 70+ fields in a single React Context) was decomposed into three sub-contexts grouped by concern, with a backward-compatible composed provider.

### New files created

1. **`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/contexts/ImageEditCanvasContext.tsx`** (~185 lines)
   - Contains: edit mode, brush tool, annotation tool, canvas interaction, reposition, display refs, panel position
   - Hook: `useImageEditCanvasSafe()`
   - Consumers: LightboxLayout, FloatingToolControls, MediaDisplayWithCanvas, InfoPanel

2. **`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/contexts/ImageEditFormContext.tsx`** (~105 lines)
   - Contains: prompts, strengths, LoRA, model selection, advanced settings, numGenerations, createAsGeneration
   - Hook: `useImageEditFormSafe()`
   - Consumer: EditModePanel only

3. **`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/contexts/ImageEditStatusContext.tsx`** (~80 lines)
   - Contains: generation loading/success flags (10 booleans)
   - Hook: `useImageEditStatusSafe()`
   - Consumer: EditModePanel only

### Modified files

4. **`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/contexts/ImageEditContext.tsx`** (319 -> 233 lines)
   - Rewritten as a composed provider that splits a single `ImageEditState` value into three sub-context slices via `useMemo`
   - `ImageEditState` type is now `ImageEditCanvasState & ImageEditFormState & ImageEditStatusState`
   - `ImageEditProvider` nests all three sub-providers
   - `useImageEditSafe()` still works (merges all three sub-contexts) but is marked as the backward-compatible option
   - All sub-context types and hooks are re-exported for discoverability

5. **`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/components/FloatingToolControls.tsx`**
   - Changed from `useImageEditSafe()` to `useImageEditCanvasSafe()` (only needs canvas state)

6. **`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/components/MediaDisplayWithCanvas.tsx`**
   - Changed from `useImageEditSafe()` to `useImageEditCanvasSafe()` (only needs canvas state)

7. **`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/components/layouts/LightboxLayout.tsx`**
   - Changed from `useImageEditSafe()` to `useImageEditCanvasSafe()` (only needs canvas state)

8. **`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/components/InfoPanel.tsx`**
   - Changed from `useImageEditSafe()` to `useImageEditCanvasSafe()` (only needs 3 mode fields)

9. **`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/components/EditModePanel.tsx`**
   - Changed from single `useImageEditSafe()` to three specific hooks: `useImageEditCanvasSafe()`, `useImageEditFormSafe()`, `useImageEditStatusSafe()`
   - Props-first override pattern (`imageEditState ?? context`) preserved for InlineEditView compatibility

### Re-render reduction

The key performance win: **canvas/overlay components (LightboxLayout, FloatingToolControls, MediaDisplayWithCanvas) no longer re-render when form fields change** (user typing prompts, adjusting strength sliders, toggling LoRA, etc.), and vice versa. The `ImageEditProvider` splits the incoming value into three `useMemo`-guarded slices, so only the relevant sub-context value changes when its fields change.

### Why 3 contexts, not 4

The original plan suggested 4 contexts (EditMode, BrushTool, CanvasInteraction, EditForm). After analyzing all consumers, I found that mode/brush/annotation/canvas/reposition fields are consumed together by LightboxLayout, FloatingToolControls, and MediaDisplayWithCanvas. Splitting these into separate contexts would not reduce re-renders because every canvas-related component needs fields from all of them. The natural boundary is **canvas vs. form vs. status** -- form and status are only consumed by EditModePanel, while canvas is consumed by all the overlay/layout components.

## Summary

### Problem
`MediaGallery` had 49 top-level props in its `MediaGalleryProps` interface, of which 17 were boolean configuration flags controlling visibility, layout modes, and section hiding.

### Solution
Created a `GalleryConfig` interface grouping all 17 boolean flags into a single `config?: Partial<GalleryConfig>` prop. Callers now pass a config object instead of 17 individual boolean props.

### Files Modified

**1. `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/MediaGallery/types.ts`**
- Added `GalleryConfig` interface with 17 boolean fields organized into three groups:
  - **Visibility flags:** `showDelete`, `showDownload`, `showShare`, `showEdit`, `showStar`, `showAddToShot`
  - **UI mode flags:** `enableSingleClick`, `videosAsThumbnails`, `whiteText`, `reducedSpacing`, `showShotFilter`, `showSearch`
  - **Hide flags:** `hidePagination`, `hideTopFilters`, `hideMediaTypeFilter`, `hideBottomPagination`, `hideShotNotifier`
- Added `DEFAULT_GALLERY_CONFIG` constant with all default values matching previous defaults
- Replaced 17 individual boolean props in `MediaGalleryProps` with `config?: Partial<GalleryConfig>`

**2. `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/MediaGallery/index.tsx`**
- Added imports for `GalleryConfig` and `DEFAULT_GALLERY_CONFIG`
- Added re-exports for external consumers
- Changed props destructuring to extract `config: configOverrides` instead of 17 individual booleans
- Added `useMemo` to merge `configOverrides` with `DEFAULT_GALLERY_CONFIG`
- Destructured the merged config into local variables for downstream usage (no changes to child component prop passing)

**3-9. Eight caller files updated** (all pass `config={{ ... }}` instead of individual boolean props):

   227→ */
   228→export function useImageEditSafe(): ImageEditState {
   229→  const canvas = useImageEditCanvasSafe();
   230→  const form = useImageEditFormSafe();
   231→  const status = useImageEditStatusSafe();
   232→  return { ...canvas, ...form, ...status };
   233→}

1→import * as React from "react"
     2→
     3→const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 768
     4→const TABLET_BREAKPOINT = 1024 // iPads and similar tablets
     5→
     6→// --- Pure compute helpers (no hooks, safe for non-React contexts) ---
     7→
     8→const hasCoarsePointer = (): boolean => {
     9→  try {
    10→    return !!(window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches);
    11→  } catch {
    12→    return false;
    13→  }
    14→};
    15→
    16→// Detect if device is a tablet (iPad-like) specifically
    17→// This allows tablets to have different behavior than phones (e.g., pane locking)
    18→const computeIsTablet = (): boolean => {
    19→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
    20→
    21→  const width = window.innerWidth;
    22→
    23→  // Tablet: wider than phone but not desktop-sized, with touch capability
    24→  const isTabletSize = width >= MOBILE_BREAKPOINT && width < TABLET_BREAKPOINT;
    25→  const isLargeTabletSize = width >= TABLET_BREAKPOINT && width < 1200;
    26→
    27→  // iPadOS 13+ detection (reports as Mac with touch)
    28→  const maxTouchPoints = navigator.maxTouchPoints || 0;
    29→  const isIpadOsLike = navigator.platform === 'MacIntel' && maxTouchPoints > 1;
    30→
    31→  // Generic tablet UA hints
    32→  const ua = navigator.userAgent || '';
    33→  const tabletUA = /iPad|Tablet|Android(?!.*Mobile)|Silk|Kindle|PlayBook/i.test(ua);
    34→
    35→  // Tablet if: iPad-like OR (tablet size + touch capability)
    36→  return Boolean(isIpadOsLike || tabletUA || ((isTabletSize || isLargeTabletSize) && hasCoarsePointer()));
    37→};
    38→
    39→const computeIsMobile = (): boolean => {
    40→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false; // SSR / safety fallback
    41→
    42→  const widthMobile = window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT;
    43→
    44→  // iPadOS 13+ may report as Mac with touch; detect via maxTouchPoints
    45→  const maxTouchPoints = navigator.maxTouchPoints || 0;
    46→  const isIpadOsLike = navigator.platform === 'MacIntel' && maxTouchPoints > 1;
    47→
    48→  // Generic tablet UA hints (best-effort, not relied upon exclusively)
    49→  const ua = navigator.userAgent || '';
    50→  const tabletUA = /iPad|Tablet|Android(?!.*Mobile)|Silk|Kindle|PlayBook/i.test(ua);
    51→
    52→  return Boolean(widthMobile || hasCoarsePointer() || isIpadOsLike || tabletUA);
    53→};
    54→
    55→const computeIsTouchDevice = (): boolean => {
    56→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
    57→  try {
    58→    const ua = navigator.userAgent || '';
    59→    const tabletUA = /iPad|Tablet|Android(?!.*Mobile)|Silk|Kindle|PlayBook/i.test(ua);
    60→    const maxTouchPoints = navigator.maxTouchPoints || 0;
    61→    const isIpadOsLike = navigator.platform === 'MacIntel' && maxTouchPoints > 1;
    62→    return Boolean(hasCoarsePointer() || tabletUA || isIpadOsLike || maxTouchPoints > 0);
    63→  } catch {
    64→    return false;
    65→  }
    66→};
    67→
    68→const computeOrientation = (): 'portrait' | 'landscape' => {
    69→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 'portrait';
    70→  try {
    71→    return window.matchMedia('(orientation: portrait)').matches ? 'portrait' : 'landscape';
    72→  } catch {
    73→    return 'portrait';
    74→  }
    75→};
    76→
    77→const computeIsPortraitMode = (): boolean => {
    78→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
    79→  return window.innerHeight > window.innerWidth;
    80→};
    81→
    82→// --- Non-hook utility ---
    83→
    84→/**
    85→ * Non-hook UA check for contexts that need mobile detection during init
    86→ * (before React hooks are available, e.g. in context default values).
    87→ * Prefer the hooks below for component code.
    88→ */
    89→export function isMobileUA(): boolean {
    90→  if (typeof navigator === 'undefined') return false;
    91→  return /iPhone|iPad|iPod|Android/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
    92→}
    93→
    94→// --- Individual hooks (existing API, preserved for backward compat) ---
    95→
    96→export function useIsMobile() {
    97→  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = React.useState<boolean>(() => computeIsMobile());
    98→
    99→  React.useEffect(() => {
   100→    const mqWidth = window.matchMedia(`(max-width: ${MOBILE_BREAKPOINT - 1}px)`)
   101→    const mqPointer = window.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)')
   102→
   103→    const onChange = () => setIsMobile(computeIsMobile())
   104→
   105→    // Listen to width and pointer changes; also handle window resize as a fallback
   106→    mqWidth.addEventListener("change", onChange)
   107→    mqPointer.addEventListener("change", onChange)
   108→    window.addEventListener('resize', onChange)
   109→
   110→    return () => {
   111→      mqWidth.removeEventListener("change", onChange)
   112→      mqPointer.removeEventListener("change", onChange)
   113→      window.removeEventListener('resize', onChange)
   114→    }
   115→  }, [])
   116→
   117→  return isMobile
   118→}
   119→
   120→// Hook to detect tablet specifically (iPad-like devices)
   121→// Tablets can lock one pane at a time, unlike phones
   122→export function useIsTablet() {
   123→  const [isTablet, setIsTablet] = React.useState<boolean>(() => computeIsTablet());
   124→
   125→  React.useEffect(() => {
   126→    const onChange = () => setIsTablet(computeIsTablet());
   127→
   128→    window.addEventListener('resize', onChange);
   129→
   130→    return () => {
   131→      window.removeEventListener('resize', onChange);
   132→    };
   133→  }, []);
   134→
   135→  return isTablet;
   136→}
   137→
   138→/** Phone only (isMobile && !isTablet) — hides advanced UI that tablets can show */
   139→export function useIsPhone() {
   140→  const isMobile = useIsMobile();
   141→  const isTablet = useIsTablet();
   142→  return isMobile && !isTablet;
   143→}
   144→
   145→/** Touch-capable device (phones, tablets, touch laptops) */
   146→export function useIsTouchDevice() {
   147→  const [isTouchDevice, setIsTouchDevice] = React.useState<boolean>(() => computeIsTouchDevice());
   148→
   149→  React.useEffect(() => {
   150→    const onChange = () => setIsTouchDevice(computeIsTouchDevice());
   151→
   152→    window.addEventListener('resize', onChange);
   153→
   154→    return () => {
   155→      window.removeEventListener('resize', onChange);
   156→    };
   157→  }, []);
   158→
   159→  return isTouchDevice;
   160→}
   161→
   162→// --- Composite hook ---
   163→
   164→export interface DeviceInfo {
   165→  /** Tablet device (iPad-like) */
   166→  isTablet: boolean;
   167→  /** Phone only (isMobile && !isTablet) */
   168→  isPhone: boolean;
   169→  /** Width >= 768px */
   170→  isTabletOrLarger: boolean;
   171→  /** Any touch-capable device */
   172→  isTouchDevice: boolean;
   173→  /** Media-query based orientation */
   174→  orientation: 'portrait' | 'landscape';
   175→  /** height > width (simpler, more reliable) */
   176→  isPortraitMode: boolean;
   177→  /** Responsive column count for mobile grids */
   178→  mobileColumns: 2 | 3 | 4 | 6;
   179→}
   180→
   181→/**
   182→ * Comprehensive device info hook. Returns all device detection state
   183→ * in a single object. Prefer individual hooks (useIsMobile, useIsTablet, etc.)
   184→ * when you only need one or two values.
   185→ */
   186→export function useDeviceInfo(): DeviceInfo {
   187→  const isMobile = useIsMobile();
   188→  const isTablet = useIsTablet();
   189→
   190→  const [isTabletOrLarger, setIsTabletOrLarger] = React.useState<boolean>(() => {
   191→    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
   192→    return window.innerWidth >= MOBILE_BREAKPOINT;
   193→  });
   194→
   195→  const [orientation, setOrientation] = React.useState<'portrait' | 'landscape'>(() => computeOrientation());
   196→  const [isPortraitMode, setIsPortraitMode] = React.useState<boolean>(() => computeIsPortraitMode());
   197→
   198→  const isTouchDevice = React.useMemo(() => {

   201→  }, [isMobile]);
   202→
   203→  React.useEffect(() => {
   204→    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
   205→
   206→    const mq = window.matchMedia('(orientation: portrait)');
   207→    const handleOrientation = () => setOrientation(mq.matches ? 'portrait' : 'landscape');
   208→
   209→    const handleResize = () => {

     9→// Type for updating projects (re-exported for consumers that may need it)
    10→interface ProjectUpdate {
    11→  name?: string;

    13→}
    14→
    15→interface ProjectContextType {

    17→  selectedProjectId: string | null;

    19→  isLoadingProjects: boolean;
    20→  fetchProjects: () => Promise<void>;

    24→  isUpdatingProject: boolean;

    29→}
    30→
    31→const ProjectContext = createContext<ProjectContextType | undefined>(undefined);

    33→export const ProjectProvider = ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => {
    34→  const { userId } = useAuth();
    35→  const { userSettings: userPreferences, isLoadingSettings: isLoadingPreferences, updateUserSettings } = useUserSettings();
    36→
    37→  // ── Selection: owns selectedProjectId, localStorage persistence, cross-device sync ──
    38→  const selection = useProjectSelection({
    39→    userId: userId ?? null,
    40→    userPreferences,
    41→    isLoadingPreferences,
    42→    updateUserSettings,
    43→  });
    44→
    45→  // ── CRUD: owns projects list, loading flags, fetch/create/update/delete ──
    46→  const crud = useProjectCRUD({
    47→    selectedProjectId: selection.selectedProjectId,
    48→    onProjectsLoaded: selection.handleProjectsLoaded,
    49→    onProjectCreated: selection.handleProjectCreated,
    50→    onProjectDeleted: selection.handleProjectDeleted,
    51→    updateUserSettings,
    52→  });
    53→
    54→  // ── Side effects: fetch trigger, cross-device sync, prefetch, mobile fallback ──
    55→  useProjectDefaults({
    56→    userId: userId ?? null,
    57→    selectedProjectId: selection.selectedProjectId,
    58→    isLoadingProjects: crud.isLoadingProjects,
    59→    isLoadingPreferences,
    60→    projects: crud.projects,
    61→    fetchProjects: crud.fetchProjects,
    62→    applyCrossDeviceSync: selection.applyCrossDeviceSync,
    63→  });

    68→  useEffect(() => {

    71→        selectedProjectId: selection.selectedProjectId,
    72→        projects: crud.projects,

    74→    }
    75→  }, [selection.selectedProjectId, crud.projects]);
    76→
    77→  // ── Build context value ──
    78→  const contextValue = useMemo(
    79→    (): ProjectContextType => ({
    80→      projects: crud.projects || [],
    81→      selectedProjectId: selection.selectedProjectId,
    82→      setSelectedProjectId: selection.setSelectedProjectId,
    83→      isLoadingProjects: crud.isLoadingProjects,
    84→      fetchProjects: crud.fetchProjects,
    85→      addNewProject: crud.addNewProject,
    86→      isCreatingProject: crud.isCreatingProject,
    87→      updateProject: crud.updateProject,
    88→      isUpdatingProject: crud.isUpdatingProject,
    89→      deleteProject: crud.deleteProject,
    90→      isDeletingProject: crud.isDeletingProject,
    91→      userId: userId ?? null,
    92→    }),
    93→    [
    94→      crud.projects,
    95→      selection.selectedProjectId,
    96→      selection.setSelectedProjectId,
    97→      crud.isLoadingProjects,
    98→      crud.fetchProjects,
    99→      crud.addNewProject,
   100→      crud.isCreatingProject,
   101→      crud.updateProject,
   102→      crud.isUpdatingProject,
   103→      crud.deleteProject,
   104→      crud.isDeletingProject,
   105→      userId,
   106→    ]
   107→  );
   108→
   109→  return (
   110→    <ProjectContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
   111→      {children}
   112→    </ProjectContext.Provider>
   113→  );
   114→};
   115→
   116→export const useProject = () => {

1→/**
     2→ * Shared billing utilities for edge functions
     3→ *
     4→ * Centralizes:
     5→ *  - Orchestrator/sub-task detection (extractOrchestratorRef, isSubTask)
     6→ *  - Sub-task query filter for Supabase `.or()` calls
     7→ *  - Cost calculation HTTP trigger
     8→ *
     9→ * Consumers: calculate-task-cost, update-task-status, complete_task
    10→ */
    11→
    12→// ===== Constants =====
    13→
    14→/** UUID v4 regex — used to distinguish real orchestrator FK refs from human-readable IDs */
    15→export const UUID_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
    16→
    17→// ===== Orchestrator reference extraction =====
    18→
    19→/**
    20→ * Extract orchestrator_task_id from task params.
    21→ *
    22→ * Sub-tasks can store the orchestrator reference in multiple param paths
    23→ * depending on the task type and how they were created:
    24→ *  - params.orchestrator_task_id_ref          (travel_segment)
    25→ *  - params.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id  (join_clips_segment)
    26→ *  - params.originalParams.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id (legacy)
    27→ *  - params.orchestrator_task_id              (some legacy tasks)
    28→ *
    29→ * Returns the raw string value (may not be a valid UUID) or null.
    30→ */
    31→export function extractOrchestratorRef(params: any): string | null {
    32→  if (!params || typeof params !== 'object') return null;
    33→
    34→  return (
    35→    params.orchestrator_task_id_ref ||
    36→    params.orchestrator_details?.orchestrator_task_id ||
    37→    params.originalParams?.orchestrator_details?.orchestrator_task_id ||
    38→    params.orchestrator_task_id ||
    39→    null
    40→  );
    41→}
    42→
    43→/**
    44→ * Determine whether a task is a sub-task of an orchestrator.
    45→ *
    46→ * A task is a sub-task when:
    47→ *  1. Its params contain an orchestrator reference (via any of the known paths)
    48→ *  2. That reference is a valid UUID (not a human-readable orchestrator ID)
    49→ *  3. The reference is NOT the task's own ID (orchestrators store their own ID
    50→ *     in params.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id for children to copy)
    51→ *
    52→ * @param params  - task.params (object, not stringified)
    53→ * @param taskId  - the task's own ID, to guard against self-references
    54→ * @returns The orchestrator task ID if this is a sub-task, or null otherwise
    55→ */
    56→export function getSubTaskOrchestratorId(params: any, taskId: string): string | null {
    57→  const ref = extractOrchestratorRef(params);
    58→  if (!ref) return null;
    59→  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(ref)) return null;
    60→  if (ref === taskId) return null;
    61→  return ref;
    62→}
    63→
    64→// ===== Sub-task query filter =====
    65→
    66→/**
    67→ * Build a Supabase PostgREST `.or()` filter string that finds all tasks
    68→ * whose params reference the given orchestrator task ID.
    69→ *
    70→ * Covers all four param paths where a sub-task may store the reference.
    71→ *
    72→ * Usage:
    73→ *   supabase.from('tasks').select('...').or(buildSubTaskFilter(orchestratorId))
    74→ */
    75→export function buildSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId: string): string {
    76→  return [
    77→    `params->>orchestrator_task_id_ref.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
    78→    `params->orchestrator_details->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
    79→    `params->originalParams->orchestrator_details->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
    80→    `params->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
    81→  ].join(',');
    82→}
    83→
    84→// ===== Cost calculation trigger =====
    85→
    86→/**
    87→ * Trigger the calculate-task-cost edge function for a given task.
    88→ *
    89→ * This is a fire-and-forget HTTP call (errors are logged, not thrown).
    90→ *
    91→ * @param supabaseUrl - The Supabase project URL
    92→ * @param serviceKey  - The service role key for authentication
    93→ * @param taskId      - The task ID to calculate cost for
    94→ * @param logTag      - Optional log tag prefix (default: 'CostCalc')
    95→ */
    96→export async function triggerCostCalculation(
    97→  supabaseUrl: string,
    98→  serviceKey: string,
    99→  taskId: string,
   100→  logTag: string = 'CostCalc'
   101→): Promise<void> {
   102→  try {
   103→    console.log(`[${logTag}] Triggering cost calculation for ${taskId}...`);
   104→    const costResp = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/functions/v1/calculate-task-cost`, {
   105→      method: "POST",
   106→      headers: {
   107→        "Authorization": `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
   108→        "Content-Type": "application/json"
   109→      },
   110→      body: JSON.stringify({ task_id: taskId })
   111→    });
   112→
   113→    if (costResp.ok) {
   114→      const costData = await costResp.json();
   115→      if (costData.skipped) {
   116→        console.log(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation skipped: ${costData.reason}`);
   117→      } else if (typeof costData.cost === 'number') {
   118→        console.log(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation successful: $${costData.cost.toFixed(3)}`);
   119→      }
   120→    } else {
   121→      const errTxt = await costResp.text();
   122→      console.error(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation failed: ${errTxt}`);
   123→    }
   124→  } catch (costErr) {
   125→    console.error(`[${logTag}] Error triggering cost calculation:`, costErr);
   126→  }
   127→}
   128→

     3→import { useIsMobile, useIsTablet } from '@/shared/hooks/use-mobile';
     4→import { PANE_CONFIG } from '@/shared/config/panes';
     5→import { updateToolSettingsSupabase } from '@/shared/hooks/useToolSettings';
     6→import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     7→import { handleError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandler';
     8→
     9→interface PanesContextType {
    10→  isGenerationsPaneLocked: boolean;
    11→  setIsGenerationsPaneLocked: (isLocked: boolean) => void;
    12→  isGenerationsPaneOpen: boolean;
    13→  setIsGenerationsPaneOpen: (isOpen: boolean) => void;
    14→  generationsPaneHeight: number;
    15→  setGenerationsPaneHeight: (height: number) => void;
    16→
    17→  isShotsPaneLocked: boolean;
    18→  setIsShotsPaneLocked: (isLocked: boolean) => void;
    19→  shotsPaneWidth: number;
    20→  setShotsPaneWidth: (width: number) => void;
    21→
    22→  isTasksPaneLocked: boolean;
    23→  setIsTasksPaneLocked: (isLocked: boolean) => void;
    24→  tasksPaneWidth: number;
    25→  setTasksPaneWidth: (width: number) => void;
    26→
    27→  // Active task tracking for highlighting
    28→  activeTaskId: string | null;
    29→  setActiveTaskId: (taskId: string | null) => void;
    30→
    31→  // Programmatic tasks pane control (desktop only)
    32→  isTasksPaneOpen: boolean;
    33→  setIsTasksPaneOpen: (isOpen: boolean) => void;
    34→
    35→  // Reset all pane locks (used by ProductTour)
    36→  resetAllPaneLocks: () => void;
    37→}
    38→
    39→const PanesContext = createContext<PanesContextType | undefined>(undefined);
    40→
    41→export const PanesProvider: React.FC<{ children: ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
    42→  const isMobile = useIsMobile();
    43→  const isTablet = useIsTablet();
    44→  
    45→  // On tablets, allow locking but only one pane at a time
    46→  // On phones (mobile but not tablet), no locking allowed
    47→  const isSmallMobile = isMobile && !isTablet;
    48→  
    49→  // Load pane locks from user settings (desktop and tablet)
    50→  const { value: paneLocks, update: savePaneLocks, isLoading } = useUserUIState('paneLocks', {
    51→    shots: false,
    52→    tasks: false,
    53→    gens: false,
    54→  });
    55→
    56→  // Local state for lock status (source of truth for UI)
    57→  const [locks, setLocks] = useState(paneLocks);
    58→
    59→  // Pane open states (not persisted, runtime only)
    60→  const [isGenerationsPaneOpenState, setIsGenerationsPaneOpenState] = useState(false);
    61→  const [isTasksPaneOpenState, setIsTasksPaneOpenState] = useState(false);
    62→
    63→  // Pane dimensions (not persisted)
    64→  const [generationsPaneHeight, setGenerationsPaneHeightState] = useState<number>(PANE_CONFIG.dimensions.DEFAULT_HEIGHT);
    65→  const [shotsPaneWidth, setShotsPaneWidthState] = useState<number>(PANE_CONFIG.dimensions.DEFAULT_WIDTH);
    66→  const [tasksPaneWidth, setTasksPaneWidthState] = useState<number>(PANE_CONFIG.dimensions.DEFAULT_WIDTH);
    67→  
    68→  // Active task tracking (not persisted)
    69→  const [activeTaskId, setActiveTaskId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    70→
    71→  // Hydrate local state once when settings load (desktop and tablet)
    72→  useEffect(() => {
    73→    if (isSmallMobile) {
    74→      // On small mobile (phones), always start with unlocked state
    75→      setLocks({
    76→        shots: false,
    77→        tasks: false,
    78→        gens: false,
    79→      });
    80→      return;
    81→    }
    82→
    83→    if (!isLoading) {
    84→      // Hydrating pane locks from server (desktop and tablet)
    85→      // On tablets, only keep one lock if multiple are saved
    86→      let newLocks = paneLocks;
    87→      if (isTablet) {
    88→        const activeLocks = Object.entries(paneLocks).filter(([_, locked]) => locked);
    89→        if (activeLocks.length > 1) {
    90→          // Keep only the first locked pane on tablets
    91→          const firstLocked = activeLocks[0][0] as 'shots' | 'tasks' | 'gens';
    92→          newLocks = {
    93→            shots: firstLocked === 'shots',
    94→            tasks: firstLocked === 'tasks',
    95→            gens: firstLocked === 'gens',
    96→          };
    97→        }
    98→      }
    99→      setLocks(newLocks);
   100→
   101→      // IMPORTANT: Sync isTasksPaneOpen with isTasksPaneLocked on hydration
   102→      // This ensures lightboxes (which read isTasksPaneOpen from context) correctly
   103→      // account for a locked pane even after page refresh
   104→      if (newLocks.tasks) {
   105→        setIsTasksPaneOpenState(true);
   106→      }
   107→    }
   108→  }, [isLoading, paneLocks, isSmallMobile, isTablet]);
   109→
   110→
   111→  // Factory for pane lock setters — each pane follows the same logic:
   112→  // 1. On mobile/tablet + locking: unlock all OTHER panes (exclusive locking)
   113→  // 2. On small phone: skip persistence to DB
   114→  // 3. On desktop: standard toggle
   115→  const createPaneLockSetter = useCallback(
   116→    (lockKey: 'gens' | 'shots' | 'tasks') => (isLocked: boolean) => {
   117→      setLocks(prev => {
   118→        if (prev[lockKey] === isLocked) return prev;
   119→
   120→        // On mobile/tablets, unlock other panes when locking this one (only one pane can be locked at a time)
   121→        const exclusiveLock = (isMobile || isTablet) && isLocked;
   122→        return exclusiveLock
   123→          ? { shots: false, tasks: false, gens: false, [lockKey]: isLocked }
   124→          : { ...prev, [lockKey]: isLocked };
   125→      });
   126→
   127→      // Save to database (desktop and tablet only, not small phones)
   128→      // Kept outside setLocks updater to avoid side effects in state updater functions
   129→      if (!isSmallMobile) {
   130→        const exclusiveLock = (isMobile || isTablet) && isLocked;
   131→        savePaneLocks(exclusiveLock
   132→          ? { shots: false, tasks: false, gens: false, [lockKey]: isLocked }
   133→          : { [lockKey]: isLocked });
   134→      }
   135→
   136→      // IMPORTANT: Sync isTasksPaneOpen with isTasksPaneLocked
   137→      // This ensures lightboxes correctly account for locked pane state
   138→      if (lockKey === 'tasks' && isLocked) {
   139→        setIsTasksPaneOpenState(true);
   140→      }
   141→    },
   142→    [savePaneLocks, isSmallMobile, isMobile, isTablet]
   143→  );
   144→
   145→  const setIsGenerationsPaneLocked = useMemo(() => createPaneLockSetter('gens'), [createPaneLockSetter]);
   146→  const setIsShotsPaneLocked = useMemo(() => createPaneLockSetter('shots'), [createPaneLockSetter]);
   147→  const setIsTasksPaneLocked = useMemo(() => createPaneLockSetter('tasks'), [createPaneLockSetter]);
   148→
   149→  // Open state setters
   150→  const setIsGenerationsPaneOpen = useCallback((isOpen: boolean) => {
   151→    setIsGenerationsPaneOpenState(isOpen);
   152→  }, []);
   153→  
   154→  const setIsTasksPaneOpen = useCallback((isOpen: boolean) => {
   155→    // Works on desktop and tablets - only small phones use hover/tap behavior exclusively
   156→    if (!isSmallMobile) {
   157→      setIsTasksPaneOpenState(isOpen);
   158→    }
   159→  }, [isSmallMobile]);
   160→
   161→  // Reset all pane locks immediately (used by ProductTour)
   162→  // This updates local state, useUserUIState value, and database without debounce
   163→  const resetAllPaneLocks = useCallback(async () => {
   164→    const unlockedState = { shots: false, tasks: false, gens: false };
   165→
   166→    // Update local locks state immediately
   167→    setLocks(unlockedState);
   168→
   169→    // Update the useUserUIState local value (prevents sync effect from restoring old value)
   170→    savePaneLocks(unlockedState);
   171→
   172→    // Also save to database immediately (no debounce) for reliability
   173→    try {
   174→      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
   175→      if (user) {
   176→        await updateToolSettingsSupabase({
   177→          scope: 'user',
   178→          id: user.id,
   179→          toolId: 'ui',
   180→          patch: { paneLocks: unlockedState },
   181→        }, undefined, 'immediate');
   182→      }
   183→    } catch (error) {
   184→      handleError(error, { context: 'PanesContext', showToast: false });
   185→    }
   186→  }, [savePaneLocks]);
   187→
   188→  // Dimension setters
   189→  const setGenerationsPaneHeight = useCallback((height: number) => {
   190→    setGenerationsPaneHeightState(height);
   191→  }, []);
   192→
   193→  const setShotsPaneWidth = useCallback((width: number) => {
   194→    setShotsPaneWidthState(width);
   195→  }, []);
   196→
   197→  const setTasksPaneWidth = useCallback((width: number) => {
   198→    setTasksPaneWidthState(width);
   199→  }, []);
   200→
   201→  const value = useMemo(
   202→    () => ({
   203→      // Return actual lock state for all device types (mobile locking is now supported)
   204→      isGenerationsPaneLocked: locks.gens,
   205→      setIsGenerationsPaneLocked,
   206→      isGenerationsPaneOpen: isGenerationsPaneOpenState,
   207→      setIsGenerationsPaneOpen,
   208→      generationsPaneHeight,
   209→      setGenerationsPaneHeight,
   210→      isShotsPaneLocked: locks.shots,
   211→      setIsShotsPaneLocked,
   212→      shotsPaneWidth,
   213→      setShotsPaneWidth,
   214→      isTasksPaneLocked: locks.tasks,
   215→      setIsTasksPaneLocked,
   216→      tasksPaneWidth,
   217→      setTasksPaneWidth,
   218→      activeTaskId,
   219→      setActiveTaskId,
   220→      isTasksPaneOpen: isTasksPaneOpenState,
   221→      setIsTasksPaneOpen,
   222→      resetAllPaneLocks,
   223→    }),
   224→    [
   225→      locks.gens,
   226→      locks.shots,
   227→      locks.tasks,
   228→      setIsGenerationsPaneLocked,
   229→      setIsShotsPaneLocked,
   230→      setIsTasksPaneLocked,
   231→      isGenerationsPaneOpenState,
   232→      setIsGenerationsPaneOpen,
   233→      generationsPaneHeight,
   234→      setGenerationsPaneHeight,
   235→      shotsPaneWidth,
   236→      setShotsPaneWidth,
   237→      tasksPaneWidth,
   238→      setTasksPaneWidth,
   239→      activeTaskId,
   240→      setActiveTaskId,
   241→      isTasksPaneOpenState,
   242→      setIsTasksPaneOpen,
   243→      resetAllPaneLocks,
   244→    ]
   245→  );
   246→
   247→  return (
   248→    <PanesContext.Provider value={value}>
   249→      {children}
   250→    </PanesContext.Provider>
   251→  );
   252→};
   253→
   254→export const usePanes = () => {
   255→  const context = useContext(PanesContext);
   256→  if (context === undefined) {
   257→    throw new Error('usePanes must be used within a PanesProvider');
   258→  }
   259→  return context;
   260→};

   276→        )
   277→      );
   278→      return true;
   279→    } catch (err: unknown) {
   280→      handleError(err, { context: 'ProjectContext', toastTitle: 'Failed to update project' });
   281→      return false;
   282→    } finally {
   283→      setIsUpdatingProject(false);
   284→    }
   285→  }, []);
   286→
   287→  const deleteProject = useCallback(async (projectId: string): Promise<boolean> => {
   288→    setIsDeletingProject(true);
   289→    try {
   290→      const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
   291→      if (!session) throw new Error('Not authenticated');
   292→
   293→      const { data, error } = await supabase.functions.invoke('delete-project', {
   294→        body: { projectId },
   295→      });
   296→
   297→      if (error) throw error;
   298→      if (data?.error) throw new Error(data.error);
   299→
   300→      setProjects(prevProjects => {
   301→        const updated = prevProjects.filter(p => p.id !== projectId);
   302→        onProjectDeleted(updated);
   303→        return updated;
   304→      });
   305→
   306→      return true;
   307→    } catch (err: unknown) {
   308→      handleError(err, { context: 'ProjectContext', toastTitle: 'Failed to delete project' });
   309→      return false;
   310→    } finally {
   311→      setIsDeletingProject(false);
   312→    }
   313→  }, [onProjectDeleted]);
   314→
   315→  return {
   316→    projects,
   317→    isLoadingProjects,
   318→    fetchProjects,
   319→    addNewProject,
   320→    isCreatingProject,
   321→    updateProject,
   322→    isUpdatingProject,
   323→    deleteProject,
   324→    isDeletingProject,
   325→  };

1→import { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
     2→import { Project } from '@/types/project';
     3→import { handleError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandler';
     4→import { preloadingService } from '@/shared/lib/preloading';
     5→import { UserPreferences } from '@/shared/settings/userPreferences';
     6→import { determineProjectIdToSelect } from './useProjectCRUD';
     7→
     8→interface UseProjectSelectionOptions {
     9→  userId: string | null;
    10→  userPreferences: UserPreferences | undefined;
    11→  isLoadingPreferences: boolean;
    12→  updateUserSettings: (scope: 'user', patch: Partial<UserPreferences>) => Promise<void>;
    13→}
    14→
    15→/**
    16→ * Manages which project is selected, including:
    17→ * - Fast resume from localStorage
    18→ * - Cross-device sync from server preferences
    19→ * - Persistence to both localStorage and server
    20→ */
    21→export function useProjectSelection({
    22→  userId,
    23→  userPreferences,
    24→  isLoadingPreferences,
    25→  updateUserSettings,
    26→}: UseProjectSelectionOptions) {
    27→  // CROSS-DEVICE SYNC: Track if we had a localStorage value at startup
    28→  const hadLocalStorageValueRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
    29→  const hasAppliedServerPreferencesRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
    30→
    31→  // FAST RESUME: Try to restore selectedProjectId from localStorage immediately
    32→  const [selectedProjectId, setSelectedProjectIdState] = useState<string | null>(() => {
    33→    try {
    34→      const stored = localStorage.getItem('lastSelectedProjectId');
    35→      if (stored) {
    36→        hadLocalStorageValueRef.current = true;
    37→        return stored;
    38→      } else {
    39→        hadLocalStorageValueRef.current = false;
    40→      }
    41→    } catch (e) {
    42→      console.error('[ProjectContext:FastResume] localStorage access failed:', e);
    43→      hadLocalStorageValueRef.current = false;
    44→    }
    45→    return null;
    46→  });
    47→
    48→  // Keep a ref for synchronous access to latest preferences
    49→  const userPreferencesRef = useRef(userPreferences);
    50→  useEffect(() => {
    51→    userPreferencesRef.current = userPreferences;
    52→  }, [userPreferences]);
    53→
    54→  // CROSS-DEVICE SYNC: Reset sync flag when user logs out
    55→  useEffect(() => {
    56→    if (!userId) {
    57→      hasAppliedServerPreferencesRef.current = false;
    58→    }
    59→  }, [userId]);
    60→
    61→  // CROSS-DEVICE SYNC: When preferences load on a new device (no localStorage),
    62→  // update the selected project to match the server's lastOpenedProjectId
    63→  const applyCrossDeviceSync = useCallback((projects: Project[]) => {
    64→    if (hadLocalStorageValueRef.current) return;
    65→    if (hasAppliedServerPreferencesRef.current) return;
    66→    if (isLoadingPreferences || !userPreferences) return;
    67→    if (!projects.length) return;
    68→
    69→    const serverLastOpenedId = userPreferences.lastOpenedProjectId;
    70→
    71→    if (serverLastOpenedId && serverLastOpenedId !== selectedProjectId) {
    72→      const projectExists = projects.some(p => p.id === serverLastOpenedId);
    73→      if (projectExists) {
    74→        setSelectedProjectIdState(serverLastOpenedId);
    75→        try {
    76→          localStorage.setItem('lastSelectedProjectId', serverLastOpenedId);
    77→        } catch (e) {
    78→          handleError(e, { context: 'ProjectContext.crossDeviceSync', showToast: false });
    79→        }
    80→      }
    81→    }
    82→
    83→    hasAppliedServerPreferencesRef.current = true;
    84→  }, [isLoadingPreferences, userPreferences, selectedProjectId]);
    85→
    86→  const handleSetSelectedProjectId = useCallback((projectId: string | null) => {
    87→    preloadingService.onProjectChange(projectId);
    88→
    89→    setSelectedProjectIdState(projectId);
    90→
    91→    if (projectId) {
    92→      try {
    93→        localStorage.setItem('lastSelectedProjectId', projectId);
    94→      } catch (e) {
    95→        handleError(e, { context: 'ProjectContext.fastResume', showToast: false });
    96→      }
    97→      updateUserSettings('user', { lastOpenedProjectId: projectId });
    98→    } else {
    99→      try {
   100→        localStorage.removeItem('lastSelectedProjectId');
   101→      } catch (e) {
   102→        handleError(e, { context: 'ProjectContext.fastResume', showToast: false });
   103→      }
   104→      updateUserSettings('user', { lastOpenedProjectId: undefined });
   105→    }
   106→  }, [updateUserSettings]);
   107→
   108→  /** Called when projects are loaded — decides which project to select. */
   109→  const handleProjectsLoaded = useCallback((projects: Project[], isNewDefault: boolean) => {
   110→    if (isNewDefault) {
   111→      // Brand new default project: select it directly
   112→      handleSetSelectedProjectId(projects[0].id);
   113→    } else {
   114→      const lastOpenedProjectId = userPreferencesRef.current?.lastOpenedProjectId;
   115→      const projectIdToSelect = determineProjectIdToSelect(projects, selectedProjectId, lastOpenedProjectId);
   116→
   117→      if (projectIdToSelect !== selectedProjectId) {
   118→        handleSetSelectedProjectId(projectIdToSelect);
   119→      }
   120→    }
   121→  }, [selectedProjectId, handleSetSelectedProjectId]);
   122→
   123→  /** Called after a new project is created. */
   124→  const handleProjectCreated = useCallback((project: Project) => {
   125→    handleSetSelectedProjectId(project.id);
   126→  }, [handleSetSelectedProjectId]);
   127→
   128→  /** Called after a project is deleted — selects the next project. */
   129→  const handleProjectDeleted = useCallback((remainingProjects: Project[]) => {
   130→    const nextProjectId = determineProjectIdToSelect(remainingProjects, null, null);
   131→    setSelectedProjectIdState(nextProjectId);
   132→
   133→    if (nextProjectId) {
   134→      updateUserSettings('user', { lastOpenedProjectId: nextProjectId });
   135→    } else {
   136→      updateUserSettings('user', { lastOpenedProjectId: undefined });
   137→    }
   138→  }, [updateUserSettings]);
   139→
   140→  return {
   141→    selectedProjectId,
   142→    setSelectedProjectId: handleSetSelectedProjectId,
   143→    applyCrossDeviceSync,
   144→    handleProjectsLoaded,
   145→    handleProjectCreated,
   146→    handleProjectDeleted,
   147→    userPreferencesRef,
   148→  };
   149→}
   150→

1→import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
     2→import { usePrefetchToolSettings } from '@/shared/hooks/usePrefetchToolSettings';
     3→import { useMobileTimeoutFallback } from '@/shared/hooks/useMobileTimeoutFallback';
     4→import { Project } from '@/types/project';
     5→
     6→interface UseProjectDefaultsOptions {
     7→  userId: string | null;
     8→  selectedProjectId: string | null;
     9→  isLoadingProjects: boolean;
    10→  isLoadingPreferences: boolean;
    11→  projects: Project[];
    12→  fetchProjects: () => Promise<void>;
    13→  applyCrossDeviceSync: (projects: Project[]) => void;
    14→}
    15→
    16→/**
    17→ * Orchestrates project-related side effects:
    18→ * - Triggers fetchProjects when userId is available
    19→ * - Cross-device sync when preferences + projects are both loaded
    20→ * - Prefetches tool settings for the selected project
    21→ * - Mobile timeout fallback for stalled fetches
    22→ */
    23→export function useProjectDefaults({
    24→  userId,
    25→  selectedProjectId,
    26→  isLoadingProjects,
    27→  isLoadingPreferences,
    28→  projects,
    29→  fetchProjects,
    30→  applyCrossDeviceSync,
    31→}: UseProjectDefaultsOptions) {
    32→  // [PROFILING] Track fetch invocations to detect triple-fetch issue
    33→  const fetchInvocationCountRef = useRef(0);
    34→  const lastFetchReasonRef = useRef<string>('');
    35→
    36→  // Prefetch all tool settings for the currently selected project
    37→  usePrefetchToolSettings(selectedProjectId);
    38→
    39→  // Trigger initial project fetch when userId becomes available
    40→  useEffect(() => {
    41→    if (userId) {
    42→      fetchInvocationCountRef.current += 1;
    43→      const reason = `userId=${!!userId}, isLoadingPreferences=${isLoadingPreferences}`;
    44→      lastFetchReasonRef.current = reason;
    45→
    46→      fetchProjects();
    47→    }
    48→  }, [userId, isLoadingPreferences, fetchProjects]);
    49→
    50→  // Cross-device sync: apply server preferences once projects + prefs are loaded
    51→  useEffect(() => {
    52→    if (projects.length > 0) {
    53→      applyCrossDeviceSync(projects);
    54→    }
    55→  }, [projects, applyCrossDeviceSync]);
    56→
    57→  // [MobileStallFix] Fallback recovery: retry fetch if projects loading stalls
    58→  useMobileTimeoutFallback({
    59→    isLoading: isLoadingProjects,
    60→    onTimeout: fetchProjects,
    61→    mobileTimeoutMs: 15000,
    62→    desktopTimeoutMs: 10000,
    63→    enabled: !!userId,
    64→  });
    65→}
