    42→import { downloadMedia } from '@/shared/components/MediaLightbox/utils';
    43→import { useVariants } from '@/shared/hooks/useVariants';
    44→
    45→// ============================================================================
    46→// Types
    47→// ============================================================================
    48→
    49→interface InlineEditViewProps {
    50→  media: GenerationRow;
    51→  onClose: () => void;
    52→  onNavigateToGeneration?: (generationId: string) => Promise<void>;
    53→}
    54→
    55→// ============================================================================
    56→// useInlineEditState — all hook orchestration + persistence sync + memo
    57→// ============================================================================
    58→
    59→function useInlineEditState(
    60→  media: GenerationRow,
    61→  _onClose: () => void,
    62→  onNavigateToGeneration?: (generationId: string) => Promise<void>,
    63→) {
    64→  const displayCanvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
    65→  const maskCanvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
    66→  const imageContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    67→
    68→  const isMobile = useIsMobile();
    69→  const { selectedProjectId } = useProject();
    70→  const { value: generationMethods } = useUserUIState('generationMethods', { onComputer: true, inCloud: true });
    71→  const isCloudMode = generationMethods.inCloud;
    72→
    73→  // Uses canonical isVideoAny from typeGuards
    74→  const isVideo = isVideoAny(media);
    75→
    76→  const upscaleHook = useUpscale({ media, selectedProjectId, isVideo });
    77→  const {
    78→    effectiveImageUrl,
    79→    isUpscaling,
    80→    handleUpscale,
    81→  } = upscaleHook;
    82→
    83→  // Image dimensions state (needed by inpainting hook)
    84→  const [imageDimensions, setImageDimensions] = useState<{ width: number; height: number } | null>(null);
    85→  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
    86→
    87→  // Create as variant toggle - when true, creates variant; when false, creates new generation
    88→  // Default to false (createAsGeneration=false means variant mode is ON)
    89→  const [createAsGeneration, setCreateAsGeneration] = useState(false);
    90→
    91→  // Flip functionality removed - use reposition mode instead
    92→  const isFlippedHorizontally = false;
    93→  const isSaving = false;
    94→
    95→  const { isInSceneBoostEnabled, setIsInSceneBoostEnabled, loraMode, setLoraMode, customLoraUrl, setCustomLoraUrl, editModeLoRAs } = useEditModeLoRAs();
    96→
    97→  // Variants hook - moved early so activeVariantId is available for other hooks
    98→  // Detect if this is a shot_generation record (has shotImageEntryId or shot_generation_id matching media.id)
    99→  const isShotGenerationRecord = media.shotImageEntryId === media.id ||
   100→                                  media.shot_generation_id === media.id;
   101→  const actualGenerationId = media.generation_id ||
   102→                              (!isShotGenerationRecord ? media.id : null);
   103→
   104→  // Edit settings persistence - for img2img strength, enablePromptExpansion, and editMode
   105→  const editSettingsPersistence = useEditSettingsPersistence({
   106→    generationId: actualGenerationId,
   107→    projectId: selectedProjectId,
   108→  });
   109→  const {
   110→    editMode: persistedEditMode,
   111→    setEditMode: setPersistedEditMode,
   112→    img2imgStrength: persistedImg2imgStrength,
   113→    img2imgEnablePromptExpansion: persistedImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion,
   114→    img2imgPrompt: persistedImg2imgPrompt,
   115→    img2imgPromptHasBeenSet: persistedImg2imgPromptHasBeenSet,
   116→    setImg2imgStrength: setPersistedImg2imgStrength,
   117→    setImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion: setPersistedImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion,
   118→    setImg2imgPrompt: setPersistedImg2imgPrompt,
   119→    prompt: persistedPrompt,
   120→    setPrompt: setPersistedPrompt,
   121→    numGenerations,
   122→    setNumGenerations,
   123→    isReady: isEditSettingsReady,
   124→    hasPersistedSettings,
   125→  } = editSettingsPersistence;
   126→  const {
   127→    activeVariant,
   128→    setActiveVariantId,
   129→    refetch: refetchVariants,
   130→  } = useVariants({
   131→    generationId: actualGenerationId,
   132→    enabled: true,
   133→  });
   134→
   135→  const inpaintingHook = useInpainting({
   136→    media,
   137→    selectedProjectId,
   138→    isVideo,
   139→    displayCanvasRef,
   140→    maskCanvasRef,
   141→    imageContainerRef,
   142→    imageDimensions,
   143→    handleExitInpaintMode: () => {},
   144→    loras: editModeLoRAs,
   145→    toolTypeOverride: TOOL_IDS.EDIT_IMAGES,
   146→    activeVariantId: activeVariant?.id, // Store strokes per-variant, not per-generation
   147→    createAsGeneration, // If true, create a new generation instead of a variant
   148→  });
   149→  const {
   150→    isInpaintMode,
   151→    brushStrokes,
   152→    isEraseMode,
   153→    inpaintPrompt,
   154→    inpaintNumGenerations,
   155→    brushSize,
   156→    isGeneratingInpaint,
   157→    inpaintGenerateSuccess,
   158→    isAnnotateMode,
   159→    editMode,
   160→    annotationMode,
   161→    selectedShapeId,
   162→    isDrawing,
   163→    currentStroke,
   164→    setIsInpaintMode,
   165→    setIsEraseMode,
   166→    setInpaintPrompt,
   167→    setInpaintNumGenerations,
   168→    setBrushSize,
   169→    setIsAnnotateMode,
   170→    setEditMode,
   171→    setAnnotationMode,
   172→    handleKonvaPointerDown,
   173→    handleKonvaPointerMove,
   174→    handleKonvaPointerUp,
   175→    handleShapeClick,
   176→    handleUndo,
   177→    handleClearMask,
   178→    handleEnterInpaintMode,
   179→    handleGenerateInpaint,
   180→    handleGenerateAnnotatedEdit,
   181→    handleDeleteSelected,
   182→    handleToggleFreeForm,
   183→    getDeleteButtonPosition,
   184→    strokeOverlayRef,
   185→  } = inpaintingHook;
   186→
   187→  const magicEditHook = useMagicEditMode({
   188→    media,
   189→    selectedProjectId,
   190→    isVideo,
   191→    isInpaintMode,
   192→    setIsInpaintMode,
   193→    handleEnterInpaintMode,
   194→    handleGenerateInpaint,
   195→    brushStrokes,
   196→    inpaintPrompt,
   197→    setInpaintPrompt,
   198→    inpaintNumGenerations,
   199→    setInpaintNumGenerations,
   200→    editModeLoRAs,
   201→    sourceUrlForTasks: effectiveImageUrl,
   202→    imageDimensions,
   203→    isInSceneBoostEnabled,
   204→    setIsInSceneBoostEnabled,
   205→    toolTypeOverride: TOOL_IDS.EDIT_IMAGES,
   206→    createAsGeneration, // If true, create a new generation instead of a variant
   207→    // qwenEditModel not passed - uses default 'qwen-edit'
   208→  });
   209→  const {
   210→    isCreatingMagicEditTasks,
   211→    magicEditTasksCreated,
   212→    inpaintPanelPosition,
   213→    setInpaintPanelPosition,
   214→    handleEnterMagicEditMode,
   215→    handleExitMagicEditMode,
   216→    handleUnifiedGenerate,
   217→    isSpecialEditMode
   218→  } = magicEditHook;
   219→
   220→  const repositionHook = useRepositionMode({
   221→    media,
   222→    selectedProjectId,
   223→    imageDimensions,
   224→    imageContainerRef,
   225→    loras: editModeLoRAs,
   226→    inpaintPrompt,
   227→    inpaintNumGenerations,
   228→    handleExitInpaintMode: handleExitMagicEditMode,
   229→    toolTypeOverride: TOOL_IDS.EDIT_IMAGES,
   230→    onVariantCreated: setActiveVariantId,
   231→    refetchVariants,
   232→    createAsGeneration, // If true, create a new generation instead of a variant
   233→  });
   234→  const {
   235→    transform: repositionTransform,
   236→    hasTransformChanges,
   237→    isGeneratingReposition,
   238→    repositionGenerateSuccess,
   239→    isSavingAsVariant,
   240→    saveAsVariantSuccess,
   241→    setScale,
   242→    setRotation,
   243→    toggleFlipH,
   244→    toggleFlipV,
   245→    resetTransform,
   246→    handleGenerateReposition,
   247→    handleSaveAsVariant,
   248→    getTransformStyle,
   249→  } = repositionHook;
   250→
   251→  // Fetch available LoRAs for img2img mode
   252→  const { data: availableLoras } = usePublicLoras();
   253→
   254→  // Img2Img mode hook - uses persisted settings
   255→
   256→  const img2imgHook = useImg2ImgMode({
   257→    media,
   258→    selectedProjectId,
   259→    isVideo,
   260→    sourceUrlForTasks: effectiveImageUrl,
   261→    toolTypeOverride: TOOL_IDS.EDIT_IMAGES,
   262→    createAsGeneration,
   263→    availableLoras,
   264→    // Pass persisted values
   265→    img2imgStrength: persistedImg2imgStrength,
   266→    setImg2imgStrength: setPersistedImg2imgStrength,
   267→    enablePromptExpansion: persistedImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion,
   268→    setEnablePromptExpansion: setPersistedImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion,
   269→    // Img2Img prompt is persisted separately to avoid cross-mode races
   270→    img2imgPrompt: persistedImg2imgPrompt,
   271→    setImg2imgPrompt: setPersistedImg2imgPrompt,
   272→    img2imgPromptHasBeenSet: persistedImg2imgPromptHasBeenSet,
   273→    // Number of generations (shared with other edit modes)
   274→    numGenerations,
   275→  });
   276→  const {
   277→    img2imgPrompt,
   278→    img2imgStrength,
   279→    enablePromptExpansion,
   280→    isGeneratingImg2Img,
   281→    img2imgGenerateSuccess,
   282→    setImg2imgPrompt,
   283→    setImg2imgStrength,
   284→    setEnablePromptExpansion,
   285→    handleGenerateImg2Img,
   286→    loraManager: img2imgLoraManager,
   287→  } = img2imgHook;
   288→
   289→  // ========================================
   290→  // Persistence sync effects
   291→  // ========================================
   292→
   293→  // Track if we've synced from persistence
   294→  const hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef = useRef(false);
   295→  // Track the last known good prompt to prevent race conditions
   296→  const lastUserPromptRef = useRef<string>('');
   297→  // Debounce timer for prompt sync
   298→  const promptSyncTimerRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
   299→
   300→  // Sync persistence -> useInpainting (on initial load)
   301→  useEffect(() => {
   302→    if (!isEditSettingsReady || hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef.current) return;
   303→
   304→    // Sync editMode
   305→    if (persistedEditMode && persistedEditMode !== editMode) {
   306→      setEditMode(persistedEditMode);
   307→    }
   308→
   309→    // Sync numGenerations
   310→    if (numGenerations !== inpaintNumGenerations) {
   311→      setInpaintNumGenerations(numGenerations);
   312→    }
   313→
   314→    // Sync prompt (only if has persisted settings - otherwise leave empty to avoid resetting user input)
   315→    if (hasPersistedSettings && persistedPrompt && persistedPrompt !== inpaintPrompt) {
   316→      setInpaintPrompt(persistedPrompt);
   317→      lastUserPromptRef.current = persistedPrompt;
   318→    }
   319→
   320→    hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef.current = true;
   321→  }, [isEditSettingsReady, hasPersistedSettings, persistedEditMode, editMode, setEditMode, numGenerations, inpaintNumGenerations, setInpaintNumGenerations, persistedPrompt, inpaintPrompt, setInpaintPrompt]);
   322→
   323→  // Sync editMode: useInpainting -> persistence (on change)
   324→  useEffect(() => {
   325→    if (!hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef.current || !isEditSettingsReady) return;
   326→
   327→    if (editMode !== persistedEditMode) {
   328→      setPersistedEditMode(editMode);
   329→    }
   330→  }, [editMode, persistedEditMode, setPersistedEditMode, isEditSettingsReady]);
   331→
   332→  // Sync numGenerations: useInpainting -> persistence (on change)
   333→  useEffect(() => {
   334→    if (!hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef.current || !isEditSettingsReady) return;
   335→
   336→    if (inpaintNumGenerations !== numGenerations) {
   337→      setNumGenerations(inpaintNumGenerations);
   338→    }
   339→  }, [inpaintNumGenerations, numGenerations, setNumGenerations, isEditSettingsReady]);
   340→
   341→  // Sync prompt: useInpainting -> persistence (on change, with debounce to prevent race conditions)
   342→  useEffect(() => {
   343→    if (!hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef.current || !isEditSettingsReady) return;
   344→
   345→    // If inpaintPrompt is reset to empty but we had a user prompt, it's likely a race condition - ignore
   346→    if (inpaintPrompt === '' && lastUserPromptRef.current !== '' && persistedPrompt !== '') {
   347→      // Restore the prompt from persistence after a short delay
   348→      if (promptSyncTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(promptSyncTimerRef.current);
   349→      promptSyncTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
   350→        if (persistedPrompt) {
   351→          setInpaintPrompt(persistedPrompt);
   352→        }
   353→      }, 100);
   354→      return;
   355→    }
   356→
   357→    if (inpaintPrompt !== persistedPrompt) {
   358→      setPersistedPrompt(inpaintPrompt);
   359→      lastUserPromptRef.current = inpaintPrompt;
   360→    }
   361→  }, [inpaintPrompt, persistedPrompt, setPersistedPrompt, setInpaintPrompt, isEditSettingsReady]);
   362→
   363→  // Cleanup timer on unmount
   364→  useEffect(() => {
   365→    return () => {
   366→      if (promptSyncTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(promptSyncTimerRef.current);
   367→    };
   368→  }, []);
   369→
   370→  const { sourceGenerationData } = useSourceGeneration({
   371→    media,
   372→    onOpenExternalGeneration: onNavigateToGeneration ?
   373→      async (id) => onNavigateToGeneration(id) : undefined
   374→  });
   375→
   376→  const lineageHook = useGenerationLineage({ media });
   377→  const {
   378→    derivedGenerations,
   379→    derivedPage,
   380→    derivedTotalPages,
   381→    paginatedDerived,
   382→    setDerivedPage,
   383→  } = lineageHook;
   384→
   385→  const starToggleHook = useStarToggle({ media });
   386→  const { localStarred, toggleStarMutation, handleToggleStar } = starToggleHook;
   387→
   388→  const handleDownload = async () => {
   389→    await downloadMedia(effectiveImageUrl, media.id, isVideo, media.contentType);
   390→  };
   391→
   392→  useEffect(() => {
   393→    if (!isSpecialEditMode) {
   394→       handleEnterMagicEditMode();
   395→    }
   396→  }, [isSpecialEditMode, handleEnterMagicEditMode]);
   397→
   398→  // ========================================
   399→  // STATE VALUES FOR EDIT MODE PANEL
   400→  // These are passed as props to EditModePanel (props-first pattern)
   401→  // ========================================
   402→
   403→  // Build unified ImageEditState value (mode + form + generation status)
   404→  const imageEditValue = useMemo<ImageEditState>(() => ({
   405→    // Mode state
   406→    isInpaintMode,
   407→    isMagicEditMode: isSpecialEditMode,
   408→    isSpecialEditMode,
   409→    editMode: editMode as ImageEditState['editMode'],
   410→
   411→    // Mode setters
   412→    setIsInpaintMode,
   413→    setIsMagicEditMode: () => {},
   414→    setEditMode: setEditMode as ImageEditState['setEditMode'],
   415→
   416→    // Mode entry/exit handlers
   417→    handleEnterInpaintMode,
   418→    handleExitInpaintMode: handleExitMagicEditMode,
   419→    handleEnterMagicEditMode,
   420→    handleExitMagicEditMode,
   421→
   422→    // Brush/Inpaint state
   423→    brushSize,
   424→    setBrushSize,
   425→    isEraseMode,
   426→    setIsEraseMode,
   427→    brushStrokes,
   428→
   429→    // Annotation state
   430→    isAnnotateMode,
   431→    setIsAnnotateMode,
   432→    annotationMode,
   433→    setAnnotationMode,
   434→    selectedShapeId,
   435→
   436→    // Undo/Clear
   437→    handleUndo,
   438→    handleClearMask,
   439→
   440→    // Reposition state
   441→    repositionTransform: repositionHook.transform,
   442→    hasTransformChanges,
   443→
   444→    // Panel UI state
   445→    inpaintPanelPosition,
   446→    setInpaintPanelPosition,
   447→
   448→    // Inpaint form
   449→    inpaintPrompt,
   450→    setInpaintPrompt,
   451→    inpaintNumGenerations,
   452→    setInpaintNumGenerations,
   453→
   454→    // Img2Img form
   455→    img2imgPrompt,
   456→    setImg2imgPrompt,
   457→    img2imgStrength,
   458→    setImg2imgStrength,
   459→    enablePromptExpansion,
   460→    setEnablePromptExpansion,
   461→
   462→    // LoRA mode
   463→    loraMode,
   464→    setLoraMode,
   465→    customLoraUrl,
   466→    setCustomLoraUrl,
   467→
   468→    // Generation options
   469→    createAsGeneration,
   470→    setCreateAsGeneration,
   471→
   472→    // Model selection
   473→    qwenEditModel: 'qwen-edit-2511',
   474→    setQwenEditModel: () => {},
   475→
   476→    // Advanced settings (not used in InlineEditView)
   477→    advancedSettings: DEFAULT_ADVANCED_SETTINGS,
   478→    setAdvancedSettings: () => {},
   479→
   480→    // Generation status
   481→    isGeneratingInpaint,
   482→    inpaintGenerateSuccess,
   483→    isGeneratingImg2Img,
   484→    img2imgGenerateSuccess,
   485→    isGeneratingReposition,
   486→    repositionGenerateSuccess,
   487→    isSavingAsVariant,
   488→    saveAsVariantSuccess,
   489→    isCreatingMagicEditTasks,
   490→    magicEditTasksCreated,
   491→  }), [
   492→    isInpaintMode,
   493→    isSpecialEditMode,
   494→    editMode,
   495→    setIsInpaintMode,
   496→    setEditMode,
   497→    handleEnterInpaintMode,
   498→    handleExitMagicEditMode,
   499→    handleEnterMagicEditMode,
   500→    brushSize,
   501→    setBrushSize,
   502→    isEraseMode,
   503→    setIsEraseMode,
   504→    brushStrokes,
   505→    isAnnotateMode,
   506→    setIsAnnotateMode,
   507→    annotationMode,
   508→    setAnnotationMode,
   509→    selectedShapeId,
   510→    handleUndo,
   511→    handleClearMask,
   512→    repositionHook.transform,
   513→    hasTransformChanges,
   514→    inpaintPanelPosition,
   515→    setInpaintPanelPosition,
   516→    inpaintPrompt,
   517→    setInpaintPrompt,
   518→    inpaintNumGenerations,
   519→    setInpaintNumGenerations,
   520→    img2imgPrompt,
   521→    setImg2imgPrompt,
   522→    img2imgStrength,
   523→    setImg2imgStrength,
   524→    enablePromptExpansion,
   525→    setEnablePromptExpansion,
   526→    loraMode,
   527→    setLoraMode,
   528→    customLoraUrl,
   529→    setCustomLoraUrl,
   530→    createAsGeneration,
   531→    setCreateAsGeneration,
   532→    isGeneratingInpaint,
   533→    inpaintGenerateSuccess,
   534→    isGeneratingImg2Img,
   535→    img2imgGenerateSuccess,
   536→    isGeneratingReposition,
   537→    repositionGenerateSuccess,
   538→    isSavingAsVariant,
   539→    saveAsVariantSuccess,
   540→    isCreatingMagicEditTasks,
   541→    magicEditTasksCreated,
   542→  ]);
   543→
   544→  return {
   545→    // Layout / env
   546→    isMobile,
   547→    selectedProjectId,
   548→    isCloudMode,
   549→    isVideo,
   550→
   551→    // Refs
   552→    imageContainerRef,
   553→    canvasRef,
   554→    maskCanvasRef,
   555→
   556→    // Display state
   557→    effectiveImageUrl,
   558→    isFlippedHorizontally,
   559→    isSaving,
   560→    imageDimensions,
   561→    setImageDimensions,
   562→
   563→    // Upscale
   564→    isUpscaling,
   565→    handleUpscale,
   566→
   567→    // Inpainting canvas state
   568→    isInpaintMode,
   569→    editMode,
   570→    brushStrokes,
   571→    currentStroke,
   572→    isDrawing,
   573→    isEraseMode,
   574→    brushSize,
   575→    annotationMode,
   576→    selectedShapeId,
   577→    isAnnotateMode,
   578→    handleKonvaPointerDown,
   579→    handleKonvaPointerMove,
   580→    handleKonvaPointerUp,
   581→    handleShapeClick,
   582→    strokeOverlayRef,
   583→
   584→    // Annotation actions
   585→    getDeleteButtonPosition,
   586→    handleToggleFreeForm,
   587→    handleDeleteSelected,
   588→
   589→    // Mode controls
   590→    setIsInpaintMode,
   591→    setEditMode,
   592→    setBrushSize,
   593→    setIsEraseMode,
   594→    setAnnotationMode,
   595→    isSpecialEditMode,
   596→    handleEnterMagicEditMode,
   597→
   598→    // Floating tool controls
   599→    repositionTransform,
   600→    setScale,
   601→    setRotation,
   602→    toggleFlipH,
   603→    toggleFlipV,
   604→    resetTransform,
   605→    handleUndo,
   606→    handleClearMask,
   607→    inpaintPanelPosition,
   608→    setInpaintPanelPosition,
   609→
   610→    // Reposition transform style
   611→    getTransformStyle,
   612→
   613→    // Star toggle
   614→    localStarred,
   615→    toggleStarMutation,
   616→    handleToggleStar,
   617→
   618→    // Download
   619→    handleDownload,
   620→
   621→    // EditModePanel props
   622→    sourceGenerationData,
   623→    handleUnifiedGenerate,
   624→    handleGenerateAnnotatedEdit,
   625→    handleGenerateReposition,
   626→    handleSaveAsVariant,
   627→    handleGenerateImg2Img,

   631→  };

   633→
   634→// ============================================================================
   635→// AnnotationButtons — desktop-only shape manipulation buttons
   636→// ============================================================================
   637→
   638→interface AnnotationButtonsProps {
   639→  selectedShapeId: string | null;
   640→  isAnnotateMode: boolean;
   641→  brushStrokes: ReturnType<typeof useInlineEditState>['brushStrokes'];
   642→  getDeleteButtonPosition: () => { x: number; y: number } | null;
   643→  handleToggleFreeForm: () => void;
   644→  handleDeleteSelected: () => void;
   645→}
   646→
   647→function AnnotationButtons({
   648→  selectedShapeId,
   649→  isAnnotateMode,
   650→  brushStrokes,
   651→  getDeleteButtonPosition,
   652→  handleToggleFreeForm,
   653→  handleDeleteSelected,
   654→}: AnnotationButtonsProps) {
   655→  if (!selectedShapeId || !isAnnotateMode) return null;
   656→
   657→  const buttonPos = getDeleteButtonPosition();
   658→  if (!buttonPos) return null;
   659→
   660→  const selectedShape = brushStrokes.find(s => s.id === selectedShapeId);
   661→  const isFreeForm = selectedShape?.isFreeForm || false;
   662→
   663→  return (
   664→    <div className="absolute z-[100] flex gap-2" style={{
   665→      left: `${buttonPos.x}px`,
   666→      top: `${buttonPos.y}px`,
   667→      transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)'
   668→    }}>
   669→      <button
   670→        onClick={handleToggleFreeForm}
   671→        className={cn(
   672→          "rounded-full p-2 shadow-lg transition-colors",
   673→          isFreeForm
   674→            ? "bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 text-white"
   675→            : "bg-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-600 text-white"
   676→        )}
   677→        title={isFreeForm
   678→          ? "Switch to rectangle mode (edges move linearly)"
   679→          : "Switch to free-form mode (rhombus/non-orthogonal angles)"}
   680→      >
   681→        {isFreeForm ? <Diamond className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Square className="h-4 w-4" />}
   682→      </button>
   683→
   684→      <button
   685→        onClick={handleDeleteSelected}

   321→        className="w-full gap-2"

   323→      >

   334→        ) : (

   336→        )}
   337→      </Button>
   338→
   339→      {/* Restore Defaults / Save as Defaults Buttons */}
   340→      {(onRestoreDefaults || onSaveAsShotDefaults) && (
   341→        <div className="flex gap-2">
   342→          {onRestoreDefaults && (
   343→            <Button
   344→              size="sm"
   345→              variant="ghost"
   346→              onClick={onRestoreDefaults}
   347→              disabled={isSubmitting || isSavingDefaults}
   348→              className="flex-1 h-7 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground gap-1"
   349→            >
   350→              <RotateCcw className="w-3 h-3" />
   351→              Restore Defaults
   352→            </Button>
   353→          )}
   354→          {onSaveAsShotDefaults && (
   355→            <Button
   356→              size="sm"
   357→              variant="ghost"
   358→              onClick={handleSaveAsShotDefaults}
   359→              disabled={isSubmitting || isSavingDefaults}
   360→              className="flex-1 h-7 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground gap-1"
   361→            >
   362→              {isSavingDefaults ? (
   363→                <Loader2 className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin" />
   364→              ) : saveDefaultsSuccess ? (
   365→                <span className="text-green-600">&#10003;</span>
   366→              ) : (
   367→                <Save className="w-3 h-3" />
   368→              )}
   369→              {saveDefaultsSuccess ? 'Saved!' : 'Set as Shot Defaults'}
   370→            </Button>
   371→          )}
   372→        </div>
   373→      )}
   374→    </div>
   375→  );
   376→};

    37→}
    38→
    39→const PanesContext = createContext<PanesContextType | undefined>(undefined);
    40→
    41→export const PanesProvider: React.FC<{ children: ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
    42→  const isMobile = useIsMobile();
    43→  const isTablet = useIsTablet();
    44→  
    45→  // On tablets, allow locking but only one pane at a time
    46→  // On phones (mobile but not tablet), no locking allowed
    47→  const isSmallMobile = isMobile && !isTablet;
    48→  
    49→  // Load pane locks from user settings (desktop and tablet)
    50→  const { value: paneLocks, update: savePaneLocks, isLoading } = useUserUIState('paneLocks', {
    51→    shots: false,
    52→    tasks: false,
    53→    gens: false,
    54→  });
    55→
    56→  // Local state for lock status (source of truth for UI)
    57→  const [locks, setLocks] = useState(paneLocks);
    58→
    59→  // Pane open states (not persisted, runtime only)
    60→  const [isGenerationsPaneOpenState, setIsGenerationsPaneOpenState] = useState(false);
    61→  const [isTasksPaneOpenState, setIsTasksPaneOpenState] = useState(false);
    62→
    63→  // Pane dimensions (not persisted)
    64→  const [generationsPaneHeight, setGenerationsPaneHeightState] = useState<number>(PANE_CONFIG.dimensions.DEFAULT_HEIGHT);
    65→  const [shotsPaneWidth, setShotsPaneWidthState] = useState<number>(PANE_CONFIG.dimensions.DEFAULT_WIDTH);
    66→  const [tasksPaneWidth, setTasksPaneWidthState] = useState<number>(PANE_CONFIG.dimensions.DEFAULT_WIDTH);
    67→  
    68→  // Active task tracking (not persisted)
    69→  const [activeTaskId, setActiveTaskId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    70→
    71→  // Hydrate local state once when settings load (desktop and tablet)
    72→  useEffect(() => {
    73→    if (isSmallMobile) {
    74→      // On small mobile (phones), always start with unlocked state
    75→      setLocks({
    76→        shots: false,
    77→        tasks: false,
    78→        gens: false,
    79→      });
    80→      return;
    81→    }
    82→
    83→    if (!isLoading) {
    84→      // Hydrating pane locks from server (desktop and tablet)
    85→      // On tablets, only keep one lock if multiple are saved
    86→      let newLocks = paneLocks;
    87→      if (isTablet) {
    88→        const activeLocks = Object.entries(paneLocks).filter(([_, locked]) => locked);
    89→        if (activeLocks.length > 1) {
    90→          // Keep only the first locked pane on tablets
    91→          const firstLocked = activeLocks[0][0] as 'shots' | 'tasks' | 'gens';
    92→          newLocks = {
    93→            shots: firstLocked === 'shots',
    94→            tasks: firstLocked === 'tasks',
    95→            gens: firstLocked === 'gens',
    96→          };
    97→        }
    98→      }
    99→      setLocks(newLocks);
   100→
   101→      // IMPORTANT: Sync isTasksPaneOpen with isTasksPaneLocked on hydration
   102→      // This ensures lightboxes (which read isTasksPaneOpen from context) correctly
   103→      // account for a locked pane even after page refresh
   104→      if (newLocks.tasks) {
   105→        setIsTasksPaneOpenState(true);
   106→      }
   107→    }
   108→  }, [isLoading, paneLocks, isSmallMobile, isTablet]);
   109→
   110→
   111→  // Factory for pane lock setters — each pane follows the same logic:
   112→  // 1. On mobile/tablet + locking: unlock all OTHER panes (exclusive locking)
   113→  // 2. On small phone: skip persistence to DB
   114→  // 3. On desktop: standard toggle
   115→  const createPaneLockSetter = useCallback(
   116→    (lockKey: 'gens' | 'shots' | 'tasks') => (isLocked: boolean) => {
   117→      setLocks(prev => {
   118→        if (prev[lockKey] === isLocked) return prev;
   119→
   120→        // On mobile/tablets, unlock other panes when locking this one (only one pane can be locked at a time)
   121→        const exclusiveLock = (isMobile || isTablet) && isLocked;
   122→        return exclusiveLock
   123→          ? { shots: false, tasks: false, gens: false, [lockKey]: isLocked }
   124→          : { ...prev, [lockKey]: isLocked };
   125→      });
   126→
   127→      // Save to database (desktop and tablet only, not small phones)
   128→      // Kept outside setLocks updater to avoid side effects in state updater functions
   129→      if (!isSmallMobile) {
   130→        const exclusiveLock = (isMobile || isTablet) && isLocked;
   131→        savePaneLocks(exclusiveLock
   132→          ? { shots: false, tasks: false, gens: false, [lockKey]: isLocked }
   133→          : { [lockKey]: isLocked });
   134→      }
   135→
   136→      // IMPORTANT: Sync isTasksPaneOpen with isTasksPaneLocked
   137→      // This ensures lightboxes correctly account for locked pane state
   138→      if (lockKey === 'tasks' && isLocked) {
   139→        setIsTasksPaneOpenState(true);
   140→      }
   141→    },
   142→    [savePaneLocks, isSmallMobile, isMobile, isTablet]
   143→  );
   144→
   145→  const setIsGenerationsPaneLocked = useMemo(() => createPaneLockSetter('gens'), [createPaneLockSetter]);
   146→  const setIsShotsPaneLocked = useMemo(() => createPaneLockSetter('shots'), [createPaneLockSetter]);
   147→  const setIsTasksPaneLocked = useMemo(() => createPaneLockSetter('tasks'), [createPaneLockSetter]);
   148→
   149→  // Open state setters
   150→  const setIsGenerationsPaneOpen = useCallback((isOpen: boolean) => {
   151→    setIsGenerationsPaneOpenState(isOpen);
   152→  }, []);
   153→  
   154→  const setIsTasksPaneOpen = useCallback((isOpen: boolean) => {
   155→    // Works on desktop and tablets - only small phones use hover/tap behavior exclusively
   156→    if (!isSmallMobile) {
   157→      setIsTasksPaneOpenState(isOpen);
   158→    }
   159→  }, [isSmallMobile]);
   160→
   161→  // Reset all pane locks immediately (used by ProductTour)
   162→  // This updates local state, useUserUIState value, and database without debounce
   163→  const resetAllPaneLocks = useCallback(async () => {
   164→    const unlockedState = { shots: false, tasks: false, gens: false };
   165→

   168→

   171→

   173→    try {

   182→      }
   183→    } catch (error) {

   185→    }
   186→  }, [savePaneLocks]);
   187→
   188→  // Dimension setters
   189→  const setGenerationsPaneHeight = useCallback((height: number) => {

   191→  }, []);
   192→
   193→  const setShotsPaneWidth = useCallback((width: number) => {

   196→
   197→  const setTasksPaneWidth = useCallback((width: number) => {

   199→  }, []);
   200→
   201→  const value = useMemo(

   207→      setIsGenerationsPaneOpen,

     3→import { toast } from '@/shared/components/ui/toast';

     5→import { UserPreferences } from '@/shared/settings/userPreferences';
     6→import { handleError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandler';
     7→import { fetchInheritableProjectSettings, buildShotSettingsForNewProject } from '@/shared/lib/projectSettingsInheritance';
     8→
     9→// Type for updating projects
    10→interface ProjectUpdate {
    11→  name?: string;
    12→  aspectRatio?: string;
    13→}
    14→
    15→// Helper to convert DB row (snake_case) to our Project interface (camelCase)
    16→const mapDbProjectToProject = (row: Record<string, unknown>): Project => ({
    17→  id: row.id as string,
    18→  name: row.name as string,
    19→  user_id: row.user_id as string,
    20→  aspectRatio: (row.aspect_ratio as string) ?? undefined,
    21→  createdAt: (row.created_at as string) ?? undefined,
    22→});
    23→
    24→// Helper to sort projects by creation date (newest first)
    25→const sortProjectsByCreatedAt = (projects: Project[]): Project[] => {
    26→  return [...projects].sort((a, b) => {
    27→    if (!a.createdAt) return 1;
    28→    if (!b.createdAt) return -1;
    29→    return new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime();
    30→  });
    31→};
    32→
    33→/**
    34→ * Copy template content to a new user's Getting Started shot.
    35→ * Calls a SECURITY DEFINER database function that copies starred images,
    36→ * timeline content, and featured video from the template project.
    37→ */
    38→const copyTemplateToNewUser = async (newProjectId: string, newShotId: string): Promise<void> => {
    39→  try {
    40→    const { error } = await supabase.rpc('copy_onboarding_template', {
    41→      target_project_id: newProjectId,
    42→      target_shot_id: newShotId,
    43→    });
    44→
    45→    if (error) {
    46→      return;
    47→    }
    48→  } catch (err) {
    49→    handleError(err, { context: 'ProjectContext', showToast: false });
    50→  }
    51→};
    52→
    53→// Helper function to create a default shot for a new project
    54→const createDefaultShot = async (
    55→  projectId: string,
    56→  initialSettings?: Record<string, unknown>,
    57→  isFirstProject: boolean = false
    58→): Promise<string | null> => {
    59→  try {
    60→    const shotName = isFirstProject ? 'Getting Started' : 'Default Shot';
    61→
    62→    const { data: shot, error } = await supabase
    63→      .from('shots')
    64→      .insert({
    65→        name: shotName,
    66→        project_id: projectId,
    67→        settings: initialSettings || {},
    68→      })
    69→      .select('id')
    70→      .single();
    71→
    72→    if (error) {
    73→      handleError(error, { context: 'ProjectContext', showToast: false });
    74→      return null;
    75→    }
    76→
    77→    if (isFirstProject && shot) {
    78→      await copyTemplateToNewUser(projectId, shot.id);
    79→    }
    80→
    81→    return shot?.id || null;
    82→  } catch (err) {
    83→    handleError(err, { context: 'ProjectContext', showToast: false });
    84→    return null;
    85→  }
    86→};
    87→
    88→/** Ensure the user record exists in the users table. */
    89→const ensureUserRecord = async (userId: string): Promise<void> => {
    90→  const { data: existingUser } = await supabase
    91→    .from('users')
    92→    .select('id')
    93→    .eq('id', userId)
    94→    .single();
    95→
    96→  if (!existingUser) {
    97→    const { error: userError } = await supabase.rpc('create_user_record_if_not_exists');
    98→    if (userError) {
    99→      handleError(userError, { context: 'ProjectContext.createUser', showToast: false });
   100→    }
   101→  }
   102→};
   103→
   104→export const determineProjectIdToSelect = (
   105→  projects: Project[],
   106→  preferredId: string | null | undefined,
   107→  lastOpenedId: string | null | undefined
   108→): string | null => {
   109→  if (!projects.length) return null;
   110→
   111→  const projectIds = new Set(projects.map(p => p.id));
   112→
   113→  if (preferredId && projectIds.has(preferredId)) {
   114→    return preferredId;
   115→  }
   116→  if (lastOpenedId && projectIds.has(lastOpenedId)) {
   117→    return lastOpenedId;
   118→  }
   119→  return projects[0].id;
   120→};
   121→
   122→interface UseProjectCRUDOptions {
   123→  selectedProjectId: string | null;
   124→  onProjectsLoaded: (projects: Project[], isNewDefault: boolean) => void;
   125→  onProjectCreated: (project: Project) => void;
   126→  onProjectDeleted: (remainingProjects: Project[]) => void;
   127→  updateUserSettings: (scope: 'user', patch: Partial<UserPreferences>) => Promise<void>;
   128→}
   129→
   130→/**
   131→ * Manages project CRUD operations: fetch, create, update, delete.
   132→ * Owns the `projects` list state and all loading flags.
   133→ */
   134→export function useProjectCRUD({
   135→  selectedProjectId,
   136→  onProjectsLoaded,
   137→  onProjectCreated,
   138→  onProjectDeleted,
   139→  updateUserSettings,
   140→}: UseProjectCRUDOptions) {
   141→  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<Project[]>([]);
   142→  const [isLoadingProjects, setIsLoadingProjects] = useState(true);
   143→  const [isCreatingProject, setIsCreatingProject] = useState(false);
   144→  const [isUpdatingProject, setIsUpdatingProject] = useState(false);
   145→  const [isDeletingProject, setIsDeletingProject] = useState(false);
   146→
   147→  const fetchProjects = useCallback(async () => {
   148→    try {
   149→      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
   150→      if (!user) throw new Error('Not authenticated');
   151→
   152→      await ensureUserRecord(user.id);
   153→
   154→      const { data: projectsData, error } = await supabase
   155→        .from('projects')
   156→        .select('*')
   157→        .eq('user_id', user.id)
   158→        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
   159→
   160→      if (error) throw error;
   161→
   162→      if (!projectsData || projectsData.length === 0) {
   163→        const { data: newProject, error: createError } = await supabase
   164→          .from('projects')
   165→          .insert({
   166→            name: 'Sample Project',
   167→            user_id: user.id,
   168→            aspect_ratio: '16:9',
   169→          })
   170→          .select()
   171→          .single();
   172→
   173→        if (createError) throw createError;
   174→
   175→        await createDefaultShot(newProject.id, undefined, true);
   176→
   177→        const mappedProject = mapDbProjectToProject(newProject);
   178→        setProjects([mappedProject]);
   179→        onProjectsLoaded([mappedProject], true);
   180→      } else {
   181→        const mappedProjects = projectsData.map(mapDbProjectToProject);
   182→        setProjects(mappedProjects);
   183→        onProjectsLoaded(mappedProjects, false);
   184→      }
   185→    } catch (error: unknown) {
   186→      handleError(error, { context: 'ProjectContext', toastTitle: 'Failed to load projects' });
   187→      setProjects([]);
   188→    } finally {
   189→      setIsLoadingProjects(false);
   190→    }
   191→  }, [onProjectsLoaded]);
   192→
   193→  const addNewProject = useCallback(async (projectData: { name: string; aspectRatio: string }) => {
   194→    if (!projectData.name.trim()) {
   195→      toast.error("Project name cannot be empty.");
   196→      return null;
   197→    }
   198→    if (!projectData.aspectRatio) {
   199→      toast.error("Aspect ratio cannot be empty.");
   200→      return null;
   201→    }
   202→    setIsCreatingProject(true);
   203→    try {
   204→      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
   205→      if (!user) throw new Error('Not authenticated');
   206→
   207→      await ensureUserRecord(user.id);
   208→
   209→      const settingsToInherit = selectedProjectId
   210→        ? await fetchInheritableProjectSettings(selectedProjectId)
   211→        : {};
   212→
   213→      const { data: newProject, error } = await supabase
   214→        .from('projects')
   215→        .insert({
   216→          name: projectData.name,
   217→          user_id: user.id,
   218→          aspect_ratio: projectData.aspectRatio,
   219→          settings: settingsToInherit,
   220→        })
   221→        .select()
   222→        .single();
   223→
   224→      if (error) throw error;
   225→
   226→      const shotSettingsToInherit = selectedProjectId
   227→        ? await buildShotSettingsForNewProject(selectedProjectId, settingsToInherit)
   228→        : {};
   229→
   230→      await createDefaultShot(newProject.id, shotSettingsToInherit);
   231→
   232→      const mappedProject = mapDbProjectToProject(newProject);
   233→      setProjects(prevProjects => sortProjectsByCreatedAt([...prevProjects, mappedProject]));
   234→      onProjectCreated(mappedProject);
   235→
   236→      updateUserSettings('user', { lastOpenedProjectId: mappedProject.id });
   237→
   238→      return mappedProject;
   239→    } catch (err: unknown) {
   240→      handleError(err, { context: 'ProjectContext', toastTitle: 'Failed to create project' });
   241→      return null;
   242→    } finally {
   243→      setIsCreatingProject(false);
   244→    }
   245→  }, [selectedProjectId, onProjectCreated, updateUserSettings]);
   246→
   247→  const updateProject = useCallback(async (projectId: string, updates: ProjectUpdate): Promise<boolean> => {
   248→    if (!updates.name?.trim() && !updates.aspectRatio) {
   249→      toast.error("No changes to save.");
   250→      return false;
   251→    }
   252→    setIsUpdatingProject(true);
   253→    try {
   254→      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
   255→      if (!user) throw new Error('Not authenticated');
   256→
   257→      const dbUpdates: Record<string, string | undefined> = {};
   258→      if (updates.name !== undefined) dbUpdates.name = updates.name;
   259→      if (updates.aspectRatio !== undefined) dbUpdates.aspect_ratio = updates.aspectRatio;
   260→
   261→      const { data: updatedProject, error } = await supabase
   262→        .from('projects')
   263→        .update(dbUpdates)
   264→        .eq('id', projectId)
   265→        .eq('user_id', user.id)
   266→        .select()
   267→        .single();
   268→
   269→      if (error) throw error;
   270→
   271→      const mappedProject = mapDbProjectToProject(updatedProject);
   272→
   273→      setProjects(prevProjects =>
   274→        sortProjectsByCreatedAt(
   275→          prevProjects.map(p => p.id === projectId ? mappedProject : p)
   276→        )
   277→      );
   278→      return true;
   279→    } catch (err: unknown) {
   280→      handleError(err, { context: 'ProjectContext', toastTitle: 'Failed to update project' });
   281→      return false;
   282→    } finally {
   283→      setIsUpdatingProject(false);
   284→    }
   285→  }, []);
   286→
   287→  const deleteProject = useCallback(async (projectId: string): Promise<boolean> => {
   288→    setIsDeletingProject(true);
   289→    try {
   290→      const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
   291→      if (!session) throw new Error('Not authenticated');
   292→
   293→      const { data, error } = await supabase.functions.invoke('delete-project', {
   294→        body: { projectId },
   295→      });
   296→
   297→      if (error) throw error;
   298→      if (data?.error) throw new Error(data.error);
   299→
   300→      setProjects(prevProjects => {
   301→        const updated = prevProjects.filter(p => p.id !== projectId);
   302→        onProjectDeleted(updated);
   303→        return updated;
   304→      });
   305→
   306→      return true;
   307→    } catch (err: unknown) {
   308→      handleError(err, { context: 'ProjectContext', toastTitle: 'Failed to delete project' });
   309→      return false;
   310→    } finally {
   311→      setIsDeletingProject(false);
   312→    }
   313→  }, [onProjectDeleted]);
   314→
   315→  return {
   316→    projects,
   317→    isLoadingProjects,
   318→    fetchProjects,
   319→    addNewProject,
   320→    isCreatingProject,
   321→    updateProject,
   322→    isUpdatingProject,
   323→    deleteProject,
   324→    isDeletingProject,
   325→  };
   326→}
   327→

1→import { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
     2→import { Project } from '@/types/project';
     3→import { handleError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandler';
     4→import { preloadingService } from '@/shared/lib/preloading';
     5→import { UserPreferences } from '@/shared/settings/userPreferences';
     6→import { determineProjectIdToSelect } from './useProjectCRUD';
     7→
     8→interface UseProjectSelectionOptions {
     9→  userId: string | null;
    10→  userPreferences: UserPreferences | undefined;
    11→  isLoadingPreferences: boolean;
    12→  updateUserSettings: (scope: 'user', patch: Partial<UserPreferences>) => Promise<void>;
    13→}
    14→
    15→/**
    16→ * Manages which project is selected, including:
    17→ * - Fast resume from localStorage
    18→ * - Cross-device sync from server preferences
    19→ * - Persistence to both localStorage and server
    20→ */
    21→export function useProjectSelection({
    22→  userId,
    23→  userPreferences,
    24→  isLoadingPreferences,
    25→  updateUserSettings,
    26→}: UseProjectSelectionOptions) {
    27→  // CROSS-DEVICE SYNC: Track if we had a localStorage value at startup
    28→  const hadLocalStorageValueRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
    29→  const hasAppliedServerPreferencesRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
    30→
    31→  // FAST RESUME: Try to restore selectedProjectId from localStorage immediately
    32→  const [selectedProjectId, setSelectedProjectIdState] = useState<string | null>(() => {
    33→    try {
    34→      const stored = localStorage.getItem('lastSelectedProjectId');
    35→      if (stored) {
    36→        hadLocalStorageValueRef.current = true;
    37→        return stored;
    38→      } else {
    39→        hadLocalStorageValueRef.current = false;
    40→      }
    41→    } catch (e) {
    42→      console.error('[ProjectContext:FastResume] localStorage access failed:', e);
    43→      hadLocalStorageValueRef.current = false;
    44→    }
    45→    return null;
    46→  });
    47→
    48→  // Keep a ref for synchronous access to latest preferences
    49→  const userPreferencesRef = useRef(userPreferences);
    50→  useEffect(() => {
    51→    userPreferencesRef.current = userPreferences;
    52→  }, [userPreferences]);
    53→
    54→  // CROSS-DEVICE SYNC: Reset sync flag when user logs out
    55→  useEffect(() => {
    56→    if (!userId) {
    57→      hasAppliedServerPreferencesRef.current = false;
    58→    }
    59→  }, [userId]);
    60→
    61→  // CROSS-DEVICE SYNC: When preferences load on a new device (no localStorage),
    62→  // update the selected project to match the server's lastOpenedProjectId
    63→  const applyCrossDeviceSync = useCallback((projects: Project[]) => {
    64→    if (hadLocalStorageValueRef.current) return;
    65→    if (hasAppliedServerPreferencesRef.current) return;
    66→    if (isLoadingPreferences || !userPreferences) return;
    67→    if (!projects.length) return;
    68→
    69→    const serverLastOpenedId = userPreferences.lastOpenedProjectId;
    70→
    71→    if (serverLastOpenedId && serverLastOpenedId !== selectedProjectId) {
    72→      const projectExists = projects.some(p => p.id === serverLastOpenedId);
    73→      if (projectExists) {
    74→        setSelectedProjectIdState(serverLastOpenedId);
    75→        try {
    76→          localStorage.setItem('lastSelectedProjectId', serverLastOpenedId);
    77→        } catch (e) {
    78→          handleError(e, { context: 'ProjectContext.crossDeviceSync', showToast: false });
    79→        }
    80→      }
    81→    }
    82→
    83→    hasAppliedServerPreferencesRef.current = true;
    84→  }, [isLoadingPreferences, userPreferences, selectedProjectId]);
    85→
    86→  const handleSetSelectedProjectId = useCallback((projectId: string | null) => {
    87→    preloadingService.onProjectChange(projectId);
    88→
    89→    setSelectedProjectIdState(projectId);
    90→
    91→    if (projectId) {
    92→      try {
    93→        localStorage.setItem('lastSelectedProjectId', projectId);
    94→      } catch (e) {
    95→        handleError(e, { context: 'ProjectContext.fastResume', showToast: false });
    96→      }
    97→      updateUserSettings('user', { lastOpenedProjectId: projectId });
    98→    } else {
    99→      try {
   100→        localStorage.removeItem('lastSelectedProjectId');
   101→      } catch (e) {
   102→        handleError(e, { context: 'ProjectContext.fastResume', showToast: false });
   103→      }
   104→      updateUserSettings('user', { lastOpenedProjectId: undefined });
   105→    }
   106→  }, [updateUserSettings]);
   107→
   108→  /** Called when projects are loaded — decides which project to select. */
   109→  const handleProjectsLoaded = useCallback((projects: Project[], isNewDefault: boolean) => {
   110→    if (isNewDefault) {
   111→      // Brand new default project: select it directly
   112→      handleSetSelectedProjectId(projects[0].id);
   113→    } else {
   114→      const lastOpenedProjectId = userPreferencesRef.current?.lastOpenedProjectId;
   115→      const projectIdToSelect = determineProjectIdToSelect(projects, selectedProjectId, lastOpenedProjectId);
   116→
   117→      if (projectIdToSelect !== selectedProjectId) {
   118→        handleSetSelectedProjectId(projectIdToSelect);
   119→      }
   120→    }
   121→  }, [selectedProjectId, handleSetSelectedProjectId]);
   122→
   123→  /** Called after a new project is created. */
   124→  const handleProjectCreated = useCallback((project: Project) => {
   125→    handleSetSelectedProjectId(project.id);
   126→  }, [handleSetSelectedProjectId]);
   127→
   128→  /** Called after a project is deleted — selects the next project. */
   129→  const handleProjectDeleted = useCallback((remainingProjects: Project[]) => {
   130→    const nextProjectId = determineProjectIdToSelect(remainingProjects, null, null);
   131→    setSelectedProjectIdState(nextProjectId);
   132→
   133→    if (nextProjectId) {
   134→      updateUserSettings('user', { lastOpenedProjectId: nextProjectId });
   135→    } else {
   136→      updateUserSettings('user', { lastOpenedProjectId: undefined });
   137→    }
   138→  }, [updateUserSettings]);
   139→
   140→  return {
   141→    selectedProjectId,
   142→    setSelectedProjectId: handleSetSelectedProjectId,
   143→    applyCrossDeviceSync,
   144→    handleProjectsLoaded,
   145→    handleProjectCreated,
   146→    handleProjectDeleted,
   147→    userPreferencesRef,
   148→  };
   149→}
   150→

    99→  onOpenExternalGeneration?: (generationId: string, derivedContext?: string[]) => Promise<void>;

   102→  tasksPaneWidth?: number;
   103→  initialVariantId?: string;
   104→  adjacentSegments?: AdjacentSegmentsData;

   106→
   107→// ============================================================================

   110→
   111→export const ImageLightbox: React.FC<ImageLightboxProps> = (props) => {

   178→

   195→  // ========================================

   202→
   203→  React.useLayoutEffect(() => {

   208→  // ========================================

   259→
   260→  // ========================================

   893→          handleGenerateReposition={handleGenerateReposition}
   894→          handleSaveAsVariant={handleSaveAsVariant}
   895→          handleGenerateImg2Img={handleGenerateImg2Img}
   896→          isCloudMode={isCloudMode}
   897→          handleUpscale={handleUpscale}
   898→          isUpscaling={isUpscaling}
   899→          upscaleSuccess={upscaleSuccess}

   901→          editLoraManager={editLoraManager}
   902→          availableLoras={availableLoras}
   903→          advancedSettings={advancedSettings}

   906→        />

   924→        replaceImages={replaceImages}
   925→        onReplaceImagesChange={setReplaceImages}
   926→        onSwitchToPrimary={variants.primaryVariant ? () => variants.setActiveVariantId(variants.primaryVariant.id) : undefined}

1→import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
     2→import { usePrefetchToolSettings } from '@/shared/hooks/usePrefetchToolSettings';
     3→import { useMobileTimeoutFallback } from '@/shared/hooks/useMobileTimeoutFallback';
     4→import { Project } from '@/types/project';
     5→
     6→interface UseProjectDefaultsOptions {
     7→  userId: string | null;
     8→  selectedProjectId: string | null;
     9→  isLoadingProjects: boolean;
    10→  isLoadingPreferences: boolean;
    11→  projects: Project[];
    12→  fetchProjects: () => Promise<void>;
    13→  applyCrossDeviceSync: (projects: Project[]) => void;
    14→}
    15→
    16→/**
    17→ * Orchestrates project-related side effects:
    18→ * - Triggers fetchProjects when userId is available
    19→ * - Cross-device sync when preferences + projects are both loaded
    20→ * - Prefetches tool settings for the selected project
    21→ * - Mobile timeout fallback for stalled fetches
    22→ */
    23→export function useProjectDefaults({
    24→  userId,
    25→  selectedProjectId,
    26→  isLoadingProjects,
    27→  isLoadingPreferences,
    28→  projects,
    29→  fetchProjects,
    30→  applyCrossDeviceSync,
    31→}: UseProjectDefaultsOptions) {
    32→  // [PROFILING] Track fetch invocations to detect triple-fetch issue
    33→  const fetchInvocationCountRef = useRef(0);
    34→  const lastFetchReasonRef = useRef<string>('');
    35→
    36→  // Prefetch all tool settings for the currently selected project
    37→  usePrefetchToolSettings(selectedProjectId);
    38→
    39→  // Trigger initial project fetch when userId becomes available
    40→  useEffect(() => {
    41→    if (userId) {
    42→      fetchInvocationCountRef.current += 1;
    43→      const reason = `userId=${!!userId}, isLoadingPreferences=${isLoadingPreferences}`;
    44→      lastFetchReasonRef.current = reason;
    45→
    46→      fetchProjects();
    47→    }
    48→  }, [userId, isLoadingPreferences, fetchProjects]);
    49→
    50→  // Cross-device sync: apply server preferences once projects + prefs are loaded
    51→  useEffect(() => {
    52→    if (projects.length > 0) {
    53→      applyCrossDeviceSync(projects);
    54→    }
    55→  }, [projects, applyCrossDeviceSync]);
    56→
    57→  // [MobileStallFix] Fallback recovery: retry fetch if projects loading stalls
    58→  useMobileTimeoutFallback({
    59→    isLoading: isLoadingProjects,
    60→    onTimeout: fetchProjects,
    61→    mobileTimeoutMs: 15000,
    62→    desktopTimeoutMs: 10000,
    63→    enabled: !!userId,
    64→  });
    65→}
    66→

    61→export const AdvancedSettingsSection: React.FC<AdvancedSettingsSectionProps> = ({

    97→  const builtinPreset = useMemo(() => {
    98→    return generationMode === 'vace' ? BUILTIN_VACE_PRESET : BUILTIN_I2V_PRESET;
    99→  }, [generationMode]);
   100→
   101→  const featuredPresetIds = useMemo(() => {
   102→    return generationMode === 'vace' ? SEGMENT_VACE_FEATURED_PRESET_IDS : SEGMENT_I2V_FEATURED_PRESET_IDS;
   103→  }, [generationMode]);
   104→
   105→  // Compute effective loras
   106→  const effectiveLoras = useMemo(() => {
   107→    if (settings.loras !== undefined) {
   108→      return settings.loras;
   109→    }
   110→    return shotDefaults?.loras ?? [];
   111→  }, [settings.loras, shotDefaults?.loras]);
   112→
   113→  // Handlers
   114→  const handleMotionModeChange = useCallback((mode: 'basic' | 'advanced') => {
   115→    onChange({
   116→      motionMode: mode,
   117→      phaseConfig: mode === 'basic' && !settings.selectedPhasePresetId
   118→        ? undefined
   119→        : (settings.phaseConfig ?? shotDefaults?.phaseConfig),
   120→    });
   121→  }, [onChange, settings.phaseConfig, settings.selectedPhasePresetId, shotDefaults?.phaseConfig]);
   122→
   123→  const handlePhaseConfigChange = useCallback((config: PhaseConfig) => {
   124→    onChange({
   125→      phaseConfig: stripModeFromPhaseConfig(config),
   126→    });

   128→
   129→  const handlePhasePresetSelect = useCallback((presetId: string, config: PhaseConfig) => {

   132→      phaseConfig: stripModeFromPhaseConfig(config),
   133→    });
   134→  }, [onChange]);
   135→
   136→  const handlePhasePresetRemove = useCallback(() => {
   137→    onChange({
   138→      selectedPhasePresetId: null,

   140→    });
   141→  }, [onChange, settings.motionMode]);
   142→
   143→  const handleRandomSeedChange = useCallback((value: boolean) => {

   146→
   147→  const handleAddLoraClick = useCallback(() => {

   151→  const handleLoraSelect = useCallback((lora: LoraModel) => {
   152→    const loraId = lora['Model ID'] || (lora.id as string);

   154→    const loraName = lora.Name || (lora.name as string | undefined);
   155→
   156→    if (!loraPath) return;
   157→    const currentLoras = effectiveLoras;

   159→
   160→    onChange({

   236→                isSavingDefault={savingField === 'textBeforePrompts'}
   237→                className="min-h-0 h-8 text-xs resize-none py-1.5 overflow-hidden"
   238→                placeholder="Text to prepend..."
   239→                voiceInput

   241→                onVoiceResult={(result) => {

1→/**
     2→ * Billing utilities for complete_task
     3→ *
     4→ * Re-exports shared billing logic and adds complete_task-specific helpers.
     5→ */
     6→
     7→import {
     8→  getSubTaskOrchestratorId,
     9→  triggerCostCalculation,
    10→} from '../_shared/billing.ts';
    11→
    12→// Re-export triggerCostCalculation so existing imports from orchestrator.ts continue to work
    13→export { triggerCostCalculation };
    14→
    15→/**
    16→ * Trigger cost calculation for a task, but skip if it's a sub-task
    17→ * (Sub-tasks have their costs rolled up into the orchestrator)
    18→ *
    19→ * @param supabase - Supabase client for fetching task params
    20→ * @param supabaseUrl - The Supabase project URL
    21→ * @param serviceKey - The service role key for authentication
    22→ * @param taskId - The task ID to calculate cost for
    23→ */
    24→export async function triggerCostCalculationIfNotSubTask(
    25→  supabase: any,
    26→  supabaseUrl: string,
    27→  serviceKey: string,
    28→  taskId: string
    29→): Promise<void> {
    30→  try {
    31→    const { data: taskForCostCheck } = await supabase
    32→      .from("tasks")
    33→      .select("params")
    34→      .eq("id", taskId)
    35→      .single();
    36→
    37→    const subTaskOrchestratorRef = getSubTaskOrchestratorId(taskForCostCheck?.params, taskId);
    38→    if (subTaskOrchestratorRef) {
    39→      console.log(`[COMPLETE-TASK] Task ${taskId} is a sub-task, skipping cost calculation`);
    40→      return;
    41→    }
    42→
    43→    await triggerCostCalculation(supabaseUrl, serviceKey, taskId, 'COMPLETE-TASK');
    44→  } catch (costErr) {
    45→    console.error("[COMPLETE-TASK] Error triggering cost calculation:", costErr);
    46→  }
    47→}
    48→

   102→  const handleTrailingEndFrameChange = React.useCallback((endFrame: number | undefined) => {
   103→    const next = new Map(framePositions);
   104→    if (endFrame === undefined) {
   105→      next.delete(TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY);
   106→    } else {
   107→      next.set(TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY, endFrame);
   108→    }
   109→    setFramePositions(next);
   110→  }, [framePositions, setFramePositions]);
   111→
   112→  // Register trailing end frame updater with parent (for useFrameCountUpdater to use).
   113→  // Uses useLayoutEffect to ensure the ref is set before any user interactions fire.
   114→  useLayoutEffect(() => {
   115→    onRegisterTrailingUpdater?.(handleTrailingEndFrameChange);
   116→  }, [onRegisterTrailingUpdater, handleTrailingEndFrameChange]);
   117→
   118→  // Compute trailing video info from videoOutputs SYNCHRONOUSLY to avoid layout shift
   119→  // This replaces the async callback approach that caused fullMax to expand after render
   120→  const { hasTrailing: hasExistingTrailingVideo, videoUrl: computedTrailingVideoUrl } = React.useMemo(() => {
   121→    if (!videoOutputs || videoOutputs.length === 0 || images.length === 0) {
   122→      return { hasTrailing: false, videoUrl: null };
   123→    }
   124→
   125→    // Find the last image's shot_generation_id from framePositions (exclude trailing key)
   126→    const sortedEntries = [...framePositions.entries()]
   127→      .filter(([id]) => id !== TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY)
   128→      .sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]);
   129→    const lastImageShotGenId = sortedEntries[sortedEntries.length - 1]?.[0] || null;
   130→
   131→    return findTrailingVideoInfo(videoOutputs, lastImageShotGenId);
   132→  }, [videoOutputs, framePositions, images.length]);
   133→
   134→  // Use computed URL, with callback as fallback for edge cases
   135→  const [callbackTrailingVideoUrl, setTrailingVideoUrl] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
   136→  const trailingVideoUrl = computedTrailingVideoUrl || callbackTrailingVideoUrl;
   137→
   138→  // Use orchestrator hook for all state, effects, and handlers
   139→  const {
   140→    timelineRef,
   141→    containerRef,
   142→    fullMin,
   143→    fullMax,
   144→    fullRange,
   145→    containerWidth,
   146→    dragState,
   147→    dragOffset,
   148→    currentDragFrame,
   149→    swapTargetId,
   150→    pushMode,
   151→    handleMouseDown,
   152→    zoomLevel,
   153→    handleZoomInToCenter,
   154→    handleZoomOutFromCenter,
   155→    handleZoomReset,
   156→    handleZoomToStart,
   157→    handleTimelineDoubleClick,
   158→    selectedIds,
   159→    showSelectionBar,
   160→    isSelected,
   161→    toggleSelection,
   162→    clearSelection,
   163→    pendingDropFrame,
   164→    pendingDuplicateFrame,
   165→    pendingExternalAddFrame,
   166→    activePendingFrame,
   167→    isInternalDropProcessing,

   169→    dropTargetFrame,

   172→    handleDragOver,
   173→    handleDragLeave,
   174→    handleDrop,
   175→    currentPositions,
   176→    pairInfo,
   177→    pairDataByIndex,
   178→    localShotGenPositions,
   179→    showPairLabels,
   180→    handleDuplicateInterceptor,
   181→    handleTimelineTapToMove,
   182→    handleVideoBrowserSelect,
   183→    handleEndpointMouseDown,
   184→    endpointDragFrame,
   185→    isEndpointDragging: isEndpointDraggingState,
   186→    resetGap,

   190→    setShowVideoBrowser,
   191→    isUploadingStructureVideo,
   192→    setIsUploadingStructureVideo,
   193→    isMobile,
   194→    isTablet,
   195→    enableTapToMove,
   196→    prefetchTaskData,
   197→  } = useTimelineOrchestrator({
   198→    shotId,
   199→    projectId,

   202→    setFramePositions,

   204→    onFileDrop,

   220→
   221→  // Image-only positions (excluding trailing endpoint) for sorts that need the "last image"
   222→  const imagePositions = React.useMemo(() => {
   223→    const filtered = new Map(currentPositions);
   224→    filtered.delete(TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY);
   225→    return filtered;
   226→  }, [currentPositions]);
   227→
   228→  // When any pending item exists (duplicate, drop, external add), compute augmented
   229→  // pairInfo + positions so pair regions and segment strip update immediately
   230→  const imagePositionsWithPending = React.useMemo(() => {
   231→    if (activePendingFrame === null) return imagePositions;
   232→    // Skip phantom if a real item already exists at this frame (optimistic update
   233→    // arrived before pending state cleared — prevents a brief extra pair/segment)
   234→    const realItemAtFrame = [...imagePositions.values()].some(pos => pos === activePendingFrame);
   235→    if (realItemAtFrame) return imagePositions;
   236→    const augmented = new Map(imagePositions);
   237→    augmented.set(PENDING_POSITION_KEY, activePendingFrame);
   238→    return augmented;
   239→  }, [imagePositions, activePendingFrame]);
   240→
   241→  const pairInfoWithPending = React.useMemo(() => {
   242→    if (activePendingFrame === null) return pairInfo;
   243→    return getPairInfo(imagePositionsWithPending);
   244→  }, [pairInfo, activePendingFrame, imagePositionsWithPending]);
   245→
   246→  const numPairs = Math.max(0, images.length - 1);
   247→  const maxAllowedGap = 81;
   248→
   249→  // Track the last image ID to detect when it changes (new image added at end)
   250→  // When the last image changes, clear trailingVideoUrl to prevent showing stale video
   251→  // Note: trailingEndFrame is handled by derivedEndFrame validation (end_frame > lastImageFrame)
   252→  const lastImageIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
   253→  useEffect(() => {
   254→    if (imagePositions.size === 0) return;
   255→
   256→    // Find the current last image (highest frame position)
   257→    const sortedEntries = [...imagePositions.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]);
   258→    const currentLastImageId = sortedEntries[sortedEntries.length - 1]?.[0] || null;
   259→
   260→    // If the last image changed, clear trailing video URL
   261→    if (lastImageIdRef.current !== null &&
   262→        currentLastImageId !== lastImageIdRef.current) {
   263→      if (trailingVideoUrl) {
   264→        setTrailingVideoUrl(null);
   265→      }
   266→    }
   267→
   268→    lastImageIdRef.current = currentLastImageId;
   269→  }, [imagePositions, trailingVideoUrl]);
   270→
   271→  // Handler to extract final frame from trailing video and add as next image
   272→  const handleExtractFinalFrame = useCallback(async () => {
   273→    if (!trailingVideoUrl || !onFileDrop) return;
   274→
   275→    try {
   276→      // Create video element to extract frame
   277→      const video = document.createElement('video');
   278→      video.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
   279→      video.muted = true;
   280→      video.playsInline = true;
   281→      video.preload = 'auto';
   282→      video.src = trailingVideoUrl;
   283→
   284→      await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
   285→        video.onloadedmetadata = () => resolve();
   286→        video.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to load video'));
   287→        setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Video load timeout')), 10000);
   288→      });
   289→
   290→      // Seek to the last frame (duration - small epsilon)
   291→      video.currentTime = Math.max(0, video.duration - 0.01);
   292→
   293→      await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
   294→        video.onseeked = () => resolve();
   295→        setTimeout(resolve, 2000);
   296→      });
   297→
   298→      // Extract frame to canvas
   299→      const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
   300→      canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
   301→      canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
   302→      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
   303→      if (!ctx) throw new Error('Failed to get canvas context');
   304→
   305→      ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0);
   306→
   307→      // Convert to blob
   308→      const blob = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
   309→        canvas.toBlob(
   310→          (b) => (b ? resolve(b) : reject(new Error('Failed to create blob'))),
   311→          'image/png',
   312→          1.0
   313→        );
   314→      });
   315→
   316→      // Create File object
   317→      const file = new File([blob], `extracted-frame-${Date.now()}.png`, { type: 'image/png' });
   318→
   319→      // Calculate target frame (after the trailing endpoint)
   320→      const sortedPositions = [...currentPositions.values()].sort((a, b) => a - b);
   321→      const lastImageFrame = sortedPositions[sortedPositions.length - 1] ?? 0;
   322→      const effectiveEndFrame = trailingEndFrame ?? (lastImageFrame + 17);
   323→      const targetFrame = effectiveEndFrame + 5; // Add small gap after endpoint
   324→
   325→      // Drop the file at the target position
   326→      await onFileDrop([file], targetFrame);
   327→
   328→      // Note: The trailing segment state will be automatically cleared by the useEffect
   329→      // that watches for last image changes
   330→
   331→      // Clean up
   332→      video.src = '';
   333→    } catch (error) {
   334→      handleError(error, { context: 'extractAndDropFinalFrame' });
   335→      toast.error('Failed to extract frame from video');
   336→    }
   337→  }, [trailingVideoUrl, onFileDrop, currentPositions, trailingEndFrame]);
   338→
   339→  const handleReset = useCallback(() => {
   340→    if (images.length === 1) {
   341→      // Single-image: combine image reset + trailing in one position update.
   342→      // Calling onResetFrames then handleTrailingEndFrameChange would trigger two
   343→      // parallel setFramePositions calls that race on metadata.end_frame.
   344→      const newPositions = new Map<string, number>();
   345→      newPositions.set(images[0].id, 0);
   346→      newPositions.set(TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY, resetGap);
   347→      setFramePositions(newPositions);
   348→    } else {
   349→      onResetFrames(resetGap);
   350→    }
   351→  }, [onResetFrames, resetGap, images, setFramePositions]);
   352→
   353→  // Build pair click handler for SegmentOutputStrip
   354→  const handleOpenPairSettings = useCallback((pairIndex: number, passedFrameData?: { frames: number; startFrame: number; endFrame: number }) => {
   355→
   356→    if (!onPairClick) return;
   357→
   358→    // Handle single-image mode (trailing segment is the only segment)
   359→    if (images.length === 1 && trailingEndFrame !== undefined) {
   360→      const entry = [...imagePositions.entries()][0];
   361→      if (entry) {
   362→        const [imageId, imageFrame] = entry;
   363→        const image = images[0];
   364→        const frames = passedFrameData?.frames ?? (trailingEndFrame - imageFrame);
   365→        const startFrame = passedFrameData?.startFrame ?? imageFrame;
   366→        const endFrame = passedFrameData?.endFrame ?? trailingEndFrame;
   367→        onPairClick(pairIndex, {
   368→          index: 0,
   369→          frames,
   370→          startFrame,
   371→          endFrame,
   372→          startImage: {
   373→            id: imageId,
   374→            generationId: image.generation_id,
   375→            url: image.imageUrl || image.thumbUrl,
   376→            thumbUrl: image.thumbUrl,
   377→            position: 1,
   378→          },
   379→          endImage: null,
   380→        });
   381→      }
   382→      return;
   383→    }
   384→
   385→    // Handle multi-image trailing segment (pairIndex is after all regular pairs)
   386→    if (pairIndex === pairInfo.length && trailingEndFrame !== undefined && imagePositions.size > 0) {
   387→      const sortedEntries = [...imagePositions.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]);
   388→      const lastEntry = sortedEntries[sortedEntries.length - 1];
   389→      if (lastEntry) {
   390→        const [imageId, imageFrame] = lastEntry;
   391→        const lastImage = images.find(img => {
   392→          const imgId = img.shot_generation_id || img.id;
   393→          return imgId === imageId;
   394→        }) || images[images.length - 1];
   395→
   396→        const defaultOffset = 9; // Same as multi-image default
   397→        const effectiveEndFrame = trailingEndFrame ?? (imageFrame + defaultOffset);
   398→        const frames = passedFrameData?.frames ?? (effectiveEndFrame - imageFrame);
   399→        const startFrame = passedFrameData?.startFrame ?? imageFrame;
   400→        const endFrame = passedFrameData?.endFrame ?? effectiveEndFrame;
   401→
   402→        const pairData = {
   403→          index: pairIndex,
   404→          frames,
   405→          startFrame,
   406→          endFrame,
   407→          startImage: lastImage ? {
   408→            id: imageId,
   409→            generationId: lastImage.generation_id,
   410→            url: lastImage.imageUrl || lastImage.thumbUrl,
   411→            thumbUrl: lastImage.thumbUrl,
   412→            position: sortedEntries.length,
   413→          } : null,
   414→          endImage: null,
   415→        };
   416→        onPairClick(pairIndex, pairData);
   417→      }
   418→      return;
   419→    }
   420→
   421→    const pairData = pairDataByIndex.get(pairIndex);
   422→    const frameData = passedFrameData ?? pairInfo[pairIndex];
   423→    if (frameData) {
   424→      const mergedPairData = {
   425→        index: pairIndex,
   426→        frames: frameData.frames,
   427→        startFrame: frameData.startFrame,
   428→        endFrame: frameData.endFrame,
   429→        startImage: pairData?.startImage ?? null,
   430→        endImage: pairData?.endImage ?? null,
   431→      };
   432→      onPairClick(pairIndex, mergedPairData);
   433→    } else if (pairData) {
   434→      onPairClick(pairIndex, pairData);
   435→    }
   436→  }, [onPairClick, images, trailingEndFrame, currentPositions, pairDataByIndex, pairInfo]);
   437→
   438→  // Memoized callbacks for SelectionActionBar
   439→  const handleDeleteSelected = useCallback(() => {

   443→
   444→  const handleNewShotFromSelection = useCallback(async () => {

   447→    return newShotId;
   448→  }, [onNewShotFromSelection, selectedIds]);
   449→
   450→  return (
   451→    <div className="w-full overflow-x-hidden relative">

   454→        {shotId && (projectId || readOnly) && onStructureVideoChange && (structureVideoPath || !readOnly) && (

   458→          >

   472→            {(structureVideos ? true : !structureVideoPath) && (

   474→                shotId={shotId}
   475→                projectId={projectId}
   476→                readOnly={readOnly}
   477→                hasNoImages={hasNoImages}

   479→                structureVideoTreatment={structureVideoTreatment}
   480→                structureVideoMotionStrength={structureVideoMotionStrength}
   481→                structureVideos={structureVideos}
   482→                fullMax={fullMax}

   484→                onUpdateStructureVideo={onUpdateStructureVideo}
   485→                onStructureVideoChange={onStructureVideoChange}
   486→                onShowVideoBrowser={() => setShowVideoBrowser(true)}

   488→                setIsUploadingStructureVideo={setIsUploadingStructureVideo}

   493→
   494→        {/* Timeline scrolling container */}

   498→          style={{ minHeight: "240px", paddingTop: "2.5rem", paddingBottom: "7.5rem" }}
   499→          onDragEnter={handleDragEnter}
   500→          onDragOver={(e) => handleDragOver(e, containerRef)}

   503→        >
   504→          {/* Segment output strip */}
   505→          {shotId && (projectId || (readOnly && videoOutputs)) && (() => {
   506→            // Compute trailing segment info for SegmentOutputStrip
   507→            const sortedEntries = imagePositions.size > 0

   509→              : [];
   510→            const lastEntry = sortedEntries[sortedEntries.length - 1];

   514→            // If any pending item is beyond the last real image, trailing starts from it
   515→            const pendingIsLast = activePendingFrame !== null &&
   516→              realLastFrame !== undefined &&
   517→              activePendingFrame > realLastFrame;
   518→            const effectiveLastFrame = pendingIsLast ? activePendingFrame : realLastFrame;
   519→
   520→            return (
   521→              <SegmentOutputStrip
   522→                shotId={shotId}
   523→                projectId={projectId}
   524→                readOnly={readOnly}
   525→                projectAspectRatio={projectAspectRatio}
   526→                pairInfo={pairInfoWithPending}
   527→                fullMin={fullMin}
   528→                fullMax={fullMax}
   529→                fullRange={fullRange}
   530→                containerWidth={containerWidth}
   531→                zoomLevel={zoomLevel}
   532→                segmentSlots={parentSegmentSlots ?? []}
   533→                isLoading={isSegmentsLoading}
   534→                localShotGenPositions={localShotGenPositions}
   535→                hasPendingTask={parentHasPendingTask}
   536→                pairDataByIndex={pairDataByIndex}
   537→                onOpenPairSettings={onPairClick ? handleOpenPairSettings : undefined}
   538→                selectedParentId={selectedOutputId}
   539→                onSegmentFrameCountChange={onSegmentFrameCountChange}
   540→                // SIMPLIFIED: Always pass lastImageId so hook can find existing trailing videos
   541→                lastImageId={lastEntry?.[0]}
   542→                // SIMPLIFIED: Only pass trailingSegmentMode when user has configured trailing
   543→                // (trailingEndFrame is set and valid - validation happens in derivedEndFrame)
   544→                // When pending item is at the end, shift trailing to start from it
   545→                trailingSegmentMode={lastEntry && trailingEndFrame !== undefined ? (() => {

   549→                  const effectiveImageFrame = pendingIsLast ? activePendingFrame! : imageFrame;

   551→                  return { imageId: effectiveImageId, imageFrame: effectiveImageFrame, endFrame: effectiveEndFrame };

   553→                isMultiImage={isMultiImage}
   554→                lastImageFrame={effectiveLastFrame}
   555→                onAddTrailingSegment={realLastFrame !== undefined && lastEntry ? () => {

   563→                onTrailingVideoInfo={setTrailingVideoUrl}
   564→              />
   565→            );
   566→          })()}
   567→
   568→          {/* Structure video strip(s) */}
   569→          {shotId && (projectId || readOnly) && (

   573→                isLoading={isStructureVideoLoading}
   574→                cachedHasStructureVideo={cachedHasStructureVideo}

   577→                onRemoveVideo={onRemoveStructureVideo}
   578→                fullMin={fullMin}
   579→                fullMax={fullMax}
   580→                fullRange={fullRange}
   581→                containerWidth={containerWidth}
   582→                zoomLevel={zoomLevel}
   583→                timelineFrameCount={images.length}
   584→                readOnly={readOnly}
   585→              />
   586→            ) : onStructureVideoChange && (

   588→                <GuidanceVideoStrip

   592→                  onTreatmentChange={(treatment) => onStructureVideoChange(structureVideoPath, structureVideoMetadata, treatment, structureVideoMotionStrength, structureVideoType)}
   593→                  onRemove={() => onStructureVideoChange(null, null, 'adjust', 1.0, 'flow')}
   594→                  onMetadataExtracted={(metadata) => onStructureVideoChange(structureVideoPath, metadata, structureVideoTreatment, structureVideoMotionStrength, structureVideoType)}
   595→                  fullMin={fullMin}
   596→                  fullMax={fullMax}
   597→                  fullRange={fullRange}
   598→                  containerWidth={containerWidth}
   599→                  zoomLevel={zoomLevel}
   600→                  timelineFrameCount={images.length}
   601→                  readOnly={readOnly}
   602→                />
   603→              ) : isUploadingStructureVideo ? (
   604→                <div className="relative h-28 -mt-1 mb-3" style={{ width: zoomLevel > 1 ? `${zoomLevel * 100}%` : '100%', minWidth: '100%' }}>
   605→                  <div className="absolute left-4 right-4 top-6 bottom-2 flex items-center justify-center bg-muted/50 dark:bg-muted-foreground/15 border border-border/30 rounded-sm">
   606→                    <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-medium">Uploading video...</span>
   607→                  </div>
   608→                </div>
   609→              ) : !readOnly ? (

   611→                  shotId={shotId}
   612→                  projectId={projectId}

   615→                  }}
   616→                  currentVideoUrl={structureVideoPath}
   617→                  compact={false}

   619→                  onZoomIn={handleZoomInToCenter}
