   221→    onFileDrop,
   222→  });
   223→
   224→  // --- Derived pair data (augmented with pending items) ---
   225→  const imagePositionsWithPending = useMemo(() => {
   226→    if (activePendingFrame === null) return imagePositions;
   227→    const realItemAtFrame = [...imagePositions.values()].some(pos => pos === activePendingFrame);
   228→    if (realItemAtFrame) return imagePositions;
   229→    const augmented = new Map(imagePositions);
   230→    augmented.set(PENDING_POSITION_KEY, activePendingFrame);
   231→    return augmented;
   232→  }, [imagePositions, activePendingFrame]);
   233→
   234→  const pairInfoWithPending = useMemo(() => {
   235→    if (activePendingFrame === null) return pairInfo;
   236→    return getPairInfo(imagePositionsWithPending);
   237→  }, [pairInfo, activePendingFrame, imagePositionsWithPending]);
   238→
   239→  const numPairs = Math.max(0, images.length - 1);
   240→  const maxAllowedGap = 81;
   241→
   242→  // --- Pair settings handler ---
   243→  const { handleOpenPairSettings } = usePairSettingsHandler({
   244→    images,
   245→    imagePositions,
   246→    trailingEndFrame,
   247→    currentPositions,
   248→    pairInfo,
   249→    pairDataByIndex,
   250→    onPairClick,
   251→  });
   252→
   253→  // --- Simple handlers ---
   254→  const handleReset = useCallback(() => {
   255→    if (images.length === 1) {
   256→      const newPositions = new Map<string, number>();
   257→      newPositions.set(images[0].id, 0);
   258→      newPositions.set(TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY, resetGap);
   259→      setFramePositions(newPositions);
   260→    } else {
   261→      onResetFrames(resetGap);
   262→    }
   263→  }, [onResetFrames, resetGap, images, setFramePositions]);
   264→
   265→  const handleDeleteSelected = useCallback(() => {
   266→    selectedIds.forEach(id => onImageDelete(id));
   267→    clearSelection();
   268→  }, [selectedIds, onImageDelete, clearSelection]);
   269→
   270→  const handleNewShotFromSelection = useCallback(async () => {
   271→    if (!onNewShotFromSelection) return;
   272→    const newShotId = await onNewShotFromSelection(selectedIds);
   273→    return newShotId;
   274→  }, [onNewShotFromSelection, selectedIds]);
   275→
   276→  // --- JSX ---
   277→  return (
   278→    <div className="w-full overflow-x-hidden relative">
   279→      <div className="relative">
   280→        {/* Top controls overlay */}
   281→        {shotId && (projectId || readOnly) && onStructureVideoChange && (structureVideoPath || !readOnly) && (
   282→          <div
   283→            className="absolute left-0 z-30 flex items-end justify-between pointer-events-none px-8"
   284→            style={{ width: "100%", maxWidth: "100vw", top: zoomLevel > 1 ? '0.98875rem' : '1rem' }}
   285→          >
   286→            <ZoomControls
   287→              zoomLevel={zoomLevel}
   288→              onZoomIn={handleZoomInToCenter}
   289→              onZoomOut={handleZoomOutFromCenter}
   290→              onZoomReset={handleZoomReset}
   291→              onZoomToStart={handleZoomToStart}
   292→              hasNoImages={hasNoImages}
   293→            />
   294→
   295→            {!audioUrl && onAudioChange && !readOnly && (
   296→              <AddAudioButton projectId={projectId} shotId={shotId} onAudioChange={onAudioChange} />
   297→            )}
   298→
   299→            {(structureVideos ? true : !structureVideoPath) && (
   300→              <GuidanceVideoControls
   301→                shotId={shotId}
   302→                projectId={projectId}
   303→                readOnly={readOnly}
   304→                hasNoImages={hasNoImages}
   305→                structureVideoType={structureVideoType}
   306→                structureVideoTreatment={structureVideoTreatment}
   307→                structureVideoMotionStrength={structureVideoMotionStrength}
   308→                structureVideos={structureVideos}
   309→                fullMax={fullMax}
   310→                onAddStructureVideo={onAddStructureVideo}
   311→                onUpdateStructureVideo={onUpdateStructureVideo}
   312→                onStructureVideoChange={onStructureVideoChange}
   313→                onShowVideoBrowser={() => setShowVideoBrowser(true)}
   314→                isUploadingStructureVideo={isUploadingStructureVideo}
   315→                setIsUploadingStructureVideo={setIsUploadingStructureVideo}
   316→              />
   317→            )}
   318→          </div>
   319→        )}
   320→
   321→        {/* Timeline scrolling container */}
   322→        <div
   323→          ref={timelineRef}
   324→          className={`timeline-scroll relative bg-muted/20 border rounded-lg px-5 overflow-x-auto ${zoomLevel <= 1 ? 'no-scrollbar' : ''} ${isFileOver ? 'ring-2 ring-primary bg-primary/5' : ''}`}
   325→          style={{ minHeight: "240px", paddingTop: "2.5rem", paddingBottom: "7.5rem" }}
   326→          onDragEnter={handleDragEnter}
   327→          onDragOver={(e) => handleDragOver(e, containerRef)}
   328→          onDragLeave={handleDragLeave}
   329→          onDrop={(e) => handleDrop(e, containerRef)}
   330→        >
   331→          {/* Segment output strip */}
   332→          {shotId && (projectId || (readOnly && videoOutputs)) && (() => {
   333→            const sortedEntries = imagePositions.size > 0
   334→              ? [...imagePositions.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1])
   335→              : [];
   336→            const lastEntry = sortedEntries[sortedEntries.length - 1];
   337→            const isMultiImage = images.length > 1;
   338→            const realLastFrame = lastEntry ? lastEntry[1] : undefined;
   339→            const pendingIsLast = activePendingFrame !== null &&
   340→              realLastFrame !== undefined &&
   341→              activePendingFrame > realLastFrame;
   342→            const effectiveLastFrame = pendingIsLast ? activePendingFrame : realLastFrame;
   343→
   344→            return (
   345→              <SegmentOutputStrip
   346→                shotId={shotId}
   347→                projectId={projectId}
   348→                readOnly={readOnly}
   349→                projectAspectRatio={projectAspectRatio}
   350→                pairInfo={pairInfoWithPending}
   351→                fullMin={fullMin}
   352→                fullMax={fullMax}
   353→                fullRange={fullRange}
   354→                containerWidth={containerWidth}
   355→                zoomLevel={zoomLevel}
   356→                segmentSlots={parentSegmentSlots ?? []}
   357→                isLoading={isSegmentsLoading}
   358→                localShotGenPositions={localShotGenPositions}
   359→                hasPendingTask={parentHasPendingTask}
   360→                pairDataByIndex={pairDataByIndex}
   361→                onOpenPairSettings={onPairClick ? handleOpenPairSettings : undefined}
   362→                selectedParentId={selectedOutputId}
   363→                onSegmentFrameCountChange={onSegmentFrameCountChange}
   364→                lastImageId={lastEntry?.[0]}
   365→                trailingSegmentMode={lastEntry && trailingEndFrame !== undefined ? (() => {
   366→                  const [imageId, imageFrame] = lastEntry;
   367→                  const trailingDuration = trailingEndFrame - imageFrame;
   368→                  const effectiveImageId = pendingIsLast ? PENDING_POSITION_KEY : imageId;
   369→                  const effectiveImageFrame = pendingIsLast ? activePendingFrame! : imageFrame;
   370→                  const effectiveEndFrame = pendingIsLast ? activePendingFrame! + trailingDuration : trailingEndFrame;
   371→                  return { imageId: effectiveImageId, imageFrame: effectiveImageFrame, endFrame: effectiveEndFrame };
   372→                })() : undefined}
   373→                isMultiImage={isMultiImage}
   374→                lastImageFrame={effectiveLastFrame}
   375→                onAddTrailingSegment={realLastFrame !== undefined && lastEntry ? () => {
   376→                  handleTrailingEndFrameChange(realLastFrame + 17);
   377→                } : undefined}
   378→                onRemoveTrailingSegment={isMultiImage && trailingEndFrame !== undefined ? () => {
   379→                  handleTrailingEndFrameChange(undefined);
   380→                } : undefined}
   381→                onTrailingVideoInfo={setTrailingVideoUrl}
   382→              />
   383→            );
   384→          })()}
   385→
   386→          {/* Structure video strip(s) */}
   387→          {shotId && (projectId || readOnly) && (
   388→            structureVideos && onUpdateStructureVideo && onRemoveStructureVideo ? (
   389→              <GuidanceVideosContainer
   390→                structureVideos={structureVideos}
   391→                isLoading={isStructureVideoLoading}
   392→                cachedHasStructureVideo={cachedHasStructureVideo}
   393→                shotId={shotId}
   394→                onUpdateVideo={onUpdateStructureVideo}
   395→                onRemoveVideo={onRemoveStructureVideo}
   396→                fullMin={fullMin}
   397→                fullMax={fullMax}
   398→                fullRange={fullRange}
   399→                containerWidth={containerWidth}
   400→                zoomLevel={zoomLevel}
   401→                timelineFrameCount={images.length}
   402→                readOnly={readOnly}
   403→              />
   404→            ) : onStructureVideoChange && (
   405→              structureVideoPath ? (
   406→                <GuidanceVideoStrip
   407→                  videoUrl={structureVideoPath}
   408→                  videoMetadata={structureVideoMetadata || null}
   409→                  treatment={structureVideoTreatment}
   410→                  onTreatmentChange={(treatment) => onStructureVideoChange(structureVideoPath, structureVideoMetadata, treatment, structureVideoMotionStrength, structureVideoType)}
   411→                  onRemove={() => onStructureVideoChange(null, null, 'adjust', 1.0, 'flow')}
   412→                  onMetadataExtracted={(metadata) => onStructureVideoChange(structureVideoPath, metadata, structureVideoTreatment, structureVideoMotionStrength, structureVideoType)}
   413→                  fullMin={fullMin}
   414→                  fullMax={fullMax}
   415→                  fullRange={fullRange}
   416→                  containerWidth={containerWidth}
   417→                  zoomLevel={zoomLevel}
   418→                  timelineFrameCount={images.length}
   419→                  readOnly={readOnly}
   420→                />
   421→              ) : isUploadingStructureVideo ? (
   422→                <div className="relative h-28 -mt-1 mb-3" style={{ width: zoomLevel > 1 ? `${zoomLevel * 100}%` : '100%', minWidth: '100%' }}>
   423→                  <div className="absolute left-4 right-4 top-6 bottom-2 flex items-center justify-center bg-muted/50 dark:bg-muted-foreground/15 border border-border/30 rounded-sm">
   424→                    <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-medium">Uploading video...</span>
   425→                  </div>
   426→                </div>
   427→              ) : !readOnly ? (
   428→                <GuidanceVideoUploader
   429→                  shotId={shotId}
   430→                  projectId={projectId}
   431→                  onVideoUploaded={(videoUrl, metadata) => {
   432→                    if (videoUrl && metadata) onStructureVideoChange(videoUrl, metadata, structureVideoTreatment, structureVideoMotionStrength, structureVideoType);
   433→                  }}
   434→                  currentVideoUrl={structureVideoPath}
   435→                  compact={false}
   436→                  zoomLevel={zoomLevel}
   437→                  onZoomIn={handleZoomInToCenter}
   438→                  onZoomOut={handleZoomOutFromCenter}
   439→                  onZoomReset={handleZoomReset}
   440→                  onZoomToStart={handleZoomToStart}
   441→                  hasNoImages={hasNoImages}
   442→                />
   443→              ) : null
   444→            )
   445→          )}
   446→
   447→          {/* Audio strip */}
   448→          {onAudioChange && audioUrl && (
   449→            <div className="mt-1 mb-2">
   450→              <AudioStrip
   451→                audioUrl={audioUrl}
   452→                audioMetadata={audioMetadata || null}
   453→                onRemove={() => onAudioChange(null, null)}
   454→                fullMin={fullMin}
   455→                fullMax={fullMax}
   456→                fullRange={fullRange}
   457→                containerWidth={containerWidth}
   458→                zoomLevel={zoomLevel}
   459→                readOnly={readOnly}
   460→                compact={!!structureVideoPath}
   461→              />
   462→            </div>
   463→          )}
   464→
   465→          {/* Timeline container */}
   466→          <div
   467→            ref={containerRef}
   468→            id="timeline-container"
   469→            className="relative h-36 mt-3 mb-2"
   470→            onDoubleClick={(e) => {
   471→              const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
   472→              if (!target.closest('[data-item-id]') && !target.closest('button')) {
   473→                handleTimelineDoubleClick(e, containerRef);
   474→              }
   475→            }}
   476→            onClick={(e) => {
   477→              const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
   478→              if (!target.closest('[data-item-id]') && !target.closest('button')) {
   479→                if (enableTapToMove && selectedIds.length > 0) {
   480→                  e.preventDefault();
   481→                  e.stopPropagation();
   482→                  handleTimelineTapToMove(e.clientX);
   483→                  return;
   484→                }
   485→                if (selectedIds.length > 0) clearSelection();
   486→              }
   487→            }}
   488→            style={{
   489→              width: zoomLevel > 1 ? `${zoomLevel * 100}%` : '100%',
   490→              minWidth: "100%",
   491→              userSelect: 'none',
   492→              paddingLeft: `${TIMELINE_HORIZONTAL_PADDING}px`,
   493→              paddingRight: `${TIMELINE_HORIZONTAL_PADDING + 60}px`,
   494→              cursor: enableTapToMove && selectedIds.length > 0 ? 'crosshair' : 'default',
   495→            }}
   496→          >
   497→            <DropIndicator
   498→              isVisible={isFileOver}
   499→              dropTargetFrame={dropTargetFrame}
   500→              fullMin={fullMin}
   501→              fullRange={fullRange}
   502→              containerWidth={containerWidth}
   503→              dragType={dragType}
   504→            />
   505→
   506→            <TimelineRuler
   507→              fullMin={fullMin}
   508→              fullMax={fullMax}
   509→              fullRange={fullRange}
   510→              zoomLevel={zoomLevel}
   511→              containerWidth={containerWidth}
   512→              hasNoImages={hasNoImages}
   513→            />
   514→
   515→            {/* Pair regions */}
   516→            {(() => {
   517→              const sortedDynamicPositions = [...imagePositionsWithPending.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]);
   518→              return pairInfoWithPending.map((pair, index) => {
   519→              const [startEntry, endEntry] = [sortedDynamicPositions[index], sortedDynamicPositions[index + 1]];
   520→
   521→              const getPixel = (entry: [string, number] | undefined): number => {
   522→                if (!entry) return 0;
   523→                const [, framePos] = entry;
   524→                const effectiveWidth = containerWidth - (TIMELINE_PADDING_OFFSET * 2);
   525→                return TIMELINE_PADDING_OFFSET + ((framePos - fullMin) / fullRange) * effectiveWidth;
   526→              };
   527→
   528→              const startPixel = getPixel(startEntry);
   529→              const endPixel = getPixel(endEntry);
   530→              const actualStartFrame = startEntry?.[1] ?? pair.startFrame;
   531→              const actualEndFrame = endEntry?.[1] ?? pair.endFrame;
   532→              const actualFrames = actualEndFrame - actualStartFrame;
   533→
   534→              const startPercent = (startPixel / containerWidth) * 100;
   535→              const endPercent = (endPixel / containerWidth) * 100;
   536→
   537→              const contextStartFrameUnclipped = actualEndFrame;
   538→              const contextStartFrame = Math.max(0, contextStartFrameUnclipped);
   539→              const visibleContextFrames = Math.max(0, actualEndFrame - contextStartFrame);
   540→
   541→              const effectiveWidth = containerWidth - (TIMELINE_PADDING_OFFSET * 2);
   542→              const contextStartPixel = TIMELINE_PADDING_OFFSET + ((contextStartFrame - fullMin) / fullRange) * effectiveWidth;
   543→              const contextStartPercent = (contextStartPixel / containerWidth) * 100;
   544→
   545→              const generationStartPixel = TIMELINE_PADDING_OFFSET + ((pair.generationStart - fullMin) / fullRange) * effectiveWidth;
   546→              const generationStartPercent = (generationStartPixel / containerWidth) * 100;
   547→
   548→              const startImage = images.find(img => img.id === startEntry?.[0]);
   549→              const endImage = images.find(img => img.id === endEntry?.[0]);
   550→              const pairPromptData = pairPrompts?.[index];
   551→              const pairPromptFromMetadata = pairPromptData?.prompt || '';
   552→              const pairNegativePromptFromMetadata = pairPromptData?.negativePrompt || '';
   553→              const actualEnhancedPrompt = startImage?.metadata?.enhanced_prompt || '';
   554→
   555→              return (
   556→                <PairRegion
   557→                  key={`pair-${index}`}
   558→                  index={index}
   559→                  startPercent={startPercent}
   560→                  endPercent={endPercent}
   561→                  contextStartPercent={contextStartPercent}
   562→                  generationStartPercent={generationStartPercent}
   563→                  actualFrames={actualFrames}
   564→                  visibleContextFrames={visibleContextFrames}
   565→                  isDragging={dragState.isDragging}
   566→                  numPairs={numPairs}
   567→                  startFrame={pair.startFrame}
   568→                  endFrame={pair.endFrame}
   569→                  onPairClick={onPairClick ? (pairIndex, pairData) => {
   570→                    onPairClick(pairIndex, {
   571→                      ...pairData,
   572→                      startImage: startImage ? {
   573→                        id: startImage.id,
   574→                        url: startImage.imageUrl || startImage.thumbUrl,
   575→                        thumbUrl: startImage.thumbUrl,
   576→                        timeline_frame: startImage.timeline_frame ?? 0,
   577→                        position: index + 1
   578→                      } : null,
   579→                      endImage: endImage ? {
   580→                        id: endImage.id,
   581→                        url: endImage.imageUrl || endImage.thumbUrl,
   582→                        thumbUrl: endImage.thumbUrl,
   583→                        timeline_frame: endImage.timeline_frame ?? 0,
   584→                        position: index + 2
   585→                      } : null
   586→                    });
   587→                  } : undefined}
   588→                  pairPrompt={pairPromptFromMetadata}
   589→                  pairNegativePrompt={pairNegativePromptFromMetadata}
   590→                  enhancedPrompt={actualEnhancedPrompt}
   591→                  defaultPrompt={defaultPrompt}
   592→                  defaultNegativePrompt={defaultNegativePrompt}
   593→                  showLabel={showPairLabels}
   594→                  hidePairLabel={
   595→                    (enableTapToMove && selectedIds.length > 0) ||
   596→                    (isFileOver && dropTargetFrame !== null && dropTargetFrame > actualStartFrame && dropTargetFrame < actualEndFrame) ||
   597→                    (dragState.isDragging && currentDragFrame !== null && currentDragFrame > actualStartFrame && currentDragFrame < actualEndFrame)
   598→                  }
   599→                  onClearEnhancedPrompt={onClearEnhancedPrompt}
   600→                  readOnly={readOnly}
   601→                />
   602→              );
   603→            });
   604→            })()}
   605→
   606→            {/* Trailing endpoint - appears after last image */}
   607→            {imagePositions.size > 0 && (() => {
   608→              const sortedEntries = [...imagePositions.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]);
   609→              const lastEntry = sortedEntries[sortedEntries.length - 1];
   610→              if (!lastEntry) return null;
   611→              const [id, imageFrame] = lastEntry;
   612→
   613→              const isMultiImage = images.length > 1;
   614→              const hasTrailingSegment = trailingEndFrame !== undefined;
   615→
   616→              if (isMultiImage && !hasTrailingSegment && !hasExistingTrailingVideo) {
   617→                return null;
   618→              }
   619→
   620→              const defaultEndFrame = imageFrame + (isMultiImage ? 17 : 49);
   621→              const effectiveEndFrame = trailingEndFrame ?? defaultEndFrame;
   622→              const gapToImage = effectiveEndFrame - imageFrame;
   623→              const lastImageIndex = sortedEntries.length - 1;
   624→              const lastImage = images.find(img => {
   625→                const imgId = img.shot_generation_id || img.id;
   626→                return imgId === id;
   627→              }) || images[lastImageIndex];
   628→
   629→              const trailingPairIndex = Math.max(0, sortedEntries.length - 1);
   630→
   631→              return (
   632→                <TrailingEndpoint
   633→                  framePosition={effectiveEndFrame}
   634→                  imageFramePosition={imageFrame}
   635→                  isDragging={isEndpointDraggingState}
   636→                  dragOffset={null}
   637→                  onMouseDown={readOnly ? undefined : (e, endpointId) => handleEndpointMouseDown(e, endpointId)}
   638→                  timelineWidth={containerWidth}
   639→                  fullMinFrames={fullMin}
   640→                  fullRange={fullRange}
   641→                  currentDragFrame={isEndpointDraggingState ? endpointDragFrame : null}
   642→                  gapToImage={gapToImage}
   643→                  maxAllowedGap={maxAllowedGap}
   644→                  readOnly={readOnly}
   645→                  compact={isMultiImage}
   646→                  onDurationClick={onPairClick && lastImage ? () => {
   647→                    onPairClick(trailingPairIndex, {
   648→                      index: trailingPairIndex,
   649→                      frames: effectiveEndFrame - imageFrame,
   650→                      startFrame: imageFrame,
   651→                      endFrame: effectiveEndFrame,
   652→                      startImage: {
   653→                        id,
   654→                        generationId: lastImage.generation_id,
   655→                        url: lastImage.imageUrl || lastImage.thumbUrl,
   656→                        thumbUrl: lastImage.thumbUrl,
   657→                        position: sortedEntries.length,
   658→                      },
   659→                      endImage: null,
   660→                    });
   661→                  } : undefined}
   662→                  hasTrailingVideo={!!trailingVideoUrl}
   663→                  onExtractFinalFrame={trailingVideoUrl && onFileDrop ? handleExtractFinalFrame : undefined}
   664→                />
   665→              );
   666→            })()}
   667→
   668→            {/* Pending frame marker */}
   669→            <PendingFrameMarker
   670→              pendingFrame={activePendingFrame}
   671→              fullMin={fullMin}
   672→              fullRange={fullRange}
   673→              containerWidth={containerWidth}
   674→              imagesLength={images.length}
   675→            />
   676→
   677→            {/* Skeleton for uploading item */}
   678→            {(isUploadingImage || isInternalDropProcessing) && pendingDropFrame !== null && (
   679→              <TimelineSkeletonItem
   680→                framePosition={pendingDropFrame}
   681→                fullMin={fullMin}
   682→                fullRange={fullRange}
   683→                containerWidth={containerWidth}
   684→                projectAspectRatio={projectAspectRatio}
   685→              />
   686→            )}
   687→
   688→            {/* Skeleton for duplicating item */}
   689→            {pendingDuplicateFrame !== null && (
   690→              <TimelineSkeletonItem
   691→                framePosition={pendingDuplicateFrame}
   692→                fullMin={fullMin}
   693→                fullRange={fullRange}
   694→                containerWidth={containerWidth}
   695→                projectAspectRatio={projectAspectRatio}
   696→              />
   697→            )}
   698→
   699→            {/* Skeleton for external add */}
   700→            {pendingExternalAddFrame !== null && (
   701→              <TimelineSkeletonItem
   702→                framePosition={pendingExternalAddFrame}
   703→                fullMin={fullMin}
   704→                fullRange={fullRange}
   705→                containerWidth={containerWidth}
   706→                projectAspectRatio={projectAspectRatio}
   707→              />
   708→            )}
   709→
   710→            {/* Timeline items */}
   711→            {images.map((image, idx) => {
   712→              const imageKey = image.id;
   713→              const positionFromMap = currentPositions.get(imageKey);
   714→              const framePosition = positionFromMap ?? image.timeline_frame;
   715→              if (framePosition === undefined || framePosition === null) return null;
   716→              const isDragging = dragState.isDragging && dragState.activeId === imageKey;
   717→
   718→              return (
   719→                <TimelineItem
   720→                  key={imageKey}
   721→                  image={image}
   722→                  framePosition={framePosition}
   723→                  isDragging={isDragging}
   724→                  isSwapTarget={swapTargetId === imageKey}
   725→                  dragOffset={isDragging ? dragOffset : null}
   726→                  onMouseDown={readOnly ? undefined : (e) => handleMouseDown(e, imageKey, containerRef)}
   727→                  onDoubleClick={isMobile && !isTablet ? undefined : () => handleDesktopDoubleClick(idx)}
   728→                  onMobileTap={isMobile ? () => handleMobileTap(idx) : undefined}
   729→                  zoomLevel={zoomLevel}
   730→                  timelineWidth={containerWidth}
   731→                  fullMinFrames={fullMin}
   732→                  fullRange={fullRange}
   733→                  currentDragFrame={isDragging ? currentDragFrame : null}
   734→                  originalFramePos={framePositions.get(imageKey) ?? 0}
   735→                  onDelete={onImageDelete}
   736→                  onDuplicate={handleDuplicateInterceptor}
   737→                  onInpaintClick={handleInpaintClick ? () => handleInpaintClick(idx) : undefined}
   738→                  duplicatingImageId={duplicatingImageId}
   739→                  duplicateSuccessImageId={duplicateSuccessImageId}
   740→                  projectAspectRatio={projectAspectRatio}
   741→                  readOnly={readOnly}
   742→                  onPrefetch={!isMobile ? () => {
   743→                    const generationId = getGenerationId(image);
   744→                    if (generationId) prefetchTaskData(generationId);
   745→                  } : undefined}
   746→                  isSelected={isSelected(imageKey)}
   747→                  onSelectionClick={readOnly ? undefined : () => toggleSelection(imageKey)}
   748→                  selectedCount={selectedIds.length}
   749→                />
   750→              );
   751→            })}
   752→          </div>
   753→        </div>
   754→
   755→        {/* Bottom controls */}
   756→        <TimelineBottomControls
   757→          resetGap={resetGap}
   758→          setResetGap={setResetGap}
   759→          maxGap={maxGap}
   760→          onReset={handleReset}
   761→          onFileDrop={onFileDrop}
   762→          isUploadingImage={isUploadingImage}
   763→          uploadProgress={uploadProgress}
   764→          readOnly={readOnly}

## Summary

### Problem
`TimelineContainer.tsx` was 988 lines with interaction logic, trailing endpoint management, pair settings routing, and JSX rendering all mixed together.

### Approach
After thorough analysis, I identified that the component's size comes from two sources:
1. **Interaction/state logic** (~260 lines) -- callbacks, effects, derived state
2. **JSX rendering** (~530 lines) -- inherent UI complexity rendering segments, endpoints, strips, controls

Per the task rules, I focused on extracting pure interaction/state logic (not rendering logic). The key constraint was a **data dependency ordering**: the `useTimelineOrchestrator` hook needs `hasExistingTrailingVideo` (derived from `framePositions`), while downstream logic needs `currentPositions` (from the orchestrator). This required splitting trailing endpoint logic into pre-orchestrator and post-orchestrator phases.

### Files Modified/Created

**Modified:**
- `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/tools/travel-between-images/components/Timeline/TimelineContainer/TimelineContainer.tsx` (988 -> 795 lines)

**Created:**
- `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/tools/travel-between-images/components/Timeline/hooks/useTrailingEndpoint.ts` (157 lines) -- Manages trailing video URL state, last-image-change tracking, image-only positions derivation, and video frame extraction
- `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/tools/travel-between-images/components/Timeline/hooks/usePairSettingsHandler.ts` (119 lines) -- Handles the complex 3-case pair click routing logic (single-image, multi-image trailing, regular pairs)

### What Each Hook Contains

**`useTrailingEndpoint`** (157 lines):
- `trailingVideoUrl` state (computed + callback fallback)
- `imagePositions` derived from `currentPositions` (excluding trailing endpoint key)
- Last image ID tracking effect (clears stale trailing video URLs)
- `handleExtractFinalFrame` -- creates a video element, seeks to final frame, captures to canvas, converts to file, and drops at target position

**`usePairSettingsHandler`** (119 lines):
- `handleOpenPairSettings` callback with 3 code paths:
  - Single-image mode (trailing segment is only segment)
  - Multi-image trailing segment (pairIndex after regular pairs)
  - Regular pair segments

### What Stayed in TimelineContainer

- Pre-orchestrator trailing values (29 lines) -- `trailingEndFrame`, `handleTrailingEndFrameChange`, `hasExistingTrailingVideo` computation -- must run before orchestrator due to data dependency
- Orchestrator hook call and destructuring (82 lines)
- Derived pending pair data (14 lines)
- Simple handlers: `handleReset`, `handleDeleteSelected`, `handleNewShotFromSelection` (21 lines)
- JSX rendering (~519 lines) -- inherent to the component's UI complexity

### Verification
`npx tsc --noEmit` passes with zero errors. All external APIs (exports, props, context shapes) remain identical. No files outside `src/tools/travel-between-images/components/Timeline/` were touched.

The issue: FloatingToolControls reads from ImageEdit context (via useImageEditCanvasSafe()) to get its state. When rendered inside InlineEditView, there is NO ImageEditProvider wrapping it, so it gets default/empty values from the safe hook. This means: in InlineEditView, FloatingToolControls silently doesn't work as expected because it reads from context defaults instead of the actual edit state.

   197→**Agent K (PaymentSuccessPage state machine):** Good refactor. 4 competing timeouts → explicit state machine with `PaymentState` type and named constants. Functional state updates prevent race conditions. The state machine is simple and documented with a comment at top of file. Auto-redirect was removed in favor of explicit "Return to Tool" button — this is an improvement (auto-redirect after payment is jarring). No over-engineering.
   198→
   199→**Agent L (@ts-nocheck removal):** Completed 5 of 7 targeted functions (ai-voice-prompt, broadcast-realtime, generate-pat, revoke-pat, tasks-list) before hitting rate limit. Remaining: ai-prompt, stripe-webhook (the two largest/most complex). Changes are minimal — just type annotations and `error: unknown` catches. Deferred items will be addressed in Wave 3 alongside other ai-prompt work.
   200→
   201→**Agent M (Task status transition guards):** Clean. Replaced ad-hoc "don't overwrite Complete" and "don't overwrite Cancelled" guards with a proper `validTransitions` lookup table. Returns 409 Conflict with the allowed transitions in the response. `In Progress → Queued` is allowed (requeue via clear_worker). No new files or abstractions.
   202→
   203→**Sense check:** No over-engineering. All changes are appropriate in scope. `tsc --noEmit` passes clean.
   204→
   205→### Wave 3 — Evaluation
   206→
   207→**Agent N (Mobile timeout extraction):** Clean. Created `useMobileTimeoutFallback.ts` hook. ProjectContext and UserSettingsContext now use the shared hook instead of inline UA sniffing + timeout patterns. Inline `navigator.userAgent` regex replaced with `isMobileUA()` from `use-mobile.tsx`. ~40 lines removed from each context.
   208→
   209→**Agent P (ai-prompt rate limit fix):** Clean. Changed `getClientIp(req)` → `user.id` for rate limiting. Also removed `@ts-nocheck`, added minimal types (`body: Record<string, unknown>` instead of `any`, safe property extraction instead of destructuring). Good two-for-one.
   210→
   211→**Agent R (Window globals cleanup):** Clean. Centralized all `window.__*` type declarations in `browser-extensions.d.ts` with `[structural]` vs `[debug]` category annotations. Removed scattered `declare global` blocks from individual files. Gated debug globals behind `import.meta.env.DEV`. No behavior changes.
   212→
   213→**Agent O (Auth standardization):** Clean. Migrated 7 edge functions from manual JWT extraction to shared `authenticateRequest()`: ai-voice-prompt, generate-pat, revoke-pat, delete-project, huggingface-upload, setup-auto-topup, stripe-checkout. Each function now has ~10 fewer lines. Functions that legitimately need different auth (stripe-webhook) were correctly skipped.
   214→
   215→**Agent Q (Billing consolidation):** Good extraction. Created `_shared/billing.ts` (127 lines) with 4 exports: `extractOrchestratorRef`, `getSubTaskOrchestratorId`, `buildSubTaskFilter`, `triggerCostCalculation`. Updated `calculate-task-cost`, `update-task-status`, and `complete_task/billing.ts` to use shared module. One minor improvement: `complete_task` now uses UUID-validated sub-task detection instead of raw extraction.
   216→
   217→**Sense check:** No over-engineering. The billing extraction is the largest new abstraction but justified — the duplicated sub-task detection logic was error-prone and the shared filter string was 200+ chars repeated 5 times. `tsc --noEmit` passes clean.
   218→
   219→### Wave 4 — Evaluation
   220→
   221→**Agent S (ProjectContext decomposition):** Good decomposition. ProjectContext 653→128 lines (thin provider). Three extracted hooks:
   222→- `useProjectCRUD.ts` (327 lines): project list state, fetch/create/update/delete. `determineProjectIdToSelect` exported as utility.
   223→- `useProjectSelection.ts` (150 lines): selectedProjectId state, localStorage persistence, cross-device sync.
   224→- `useProjectDefaults.ts` (65 lines): side-effect orchestrator — fetch trigger, cross-device sync, prefetch, mobile timeout fallback.
   225→
   226→Context shape is unchanged — all consumers (`useProject()`) get the exact same `ProjectContextType`. The callback pattern (onProjectsLoaded/Created/Deleted) is necessary for CRUD→selection communication. Not circular — `useProjectSelection` provides callbacks, `useProjectCRUD` calls them.
   227→
   228→**Agent T (App.tsx auth gate):** Clean. `AuthGate` is a 6-line component that returns `null` during auth check, preventing data-dependent providers (UserSettings, Project, Realtime, etc.) from rendering before auth state is known. This is NOT an auth wall — unauthenticated users still render normally once auth check completes.
   229→
   230→**Agent U (Edge function logging + CORS):** Mechanical. Added `SystemLogger` (buffered DB logging) to 18 edge functions. Changes are consistent: import → create logger → replace console.log/error → add `await logger.flush()` before error responses. Console output is preserved (SystemLogger writes to both console and DB). Functions that already had SystemLogger were skipped.
   231→
   232→**Post-wave review fixes applied:**
   233→1. **BUG FIX:** `window.__PROJECT_CONTEXT__` was incorrectly DEV-gated on write (by Wave 3 Agent R) but read in production by `useProjectGenerations`, `useTasks`, and `ImageGenerationToolPage`. Removed DEV gate — this is a `[structural]` global, not debug-only.
   234→2. **Anti-pattern fix:** PanesContext `savePaneLocks` moved outside `setLocks` state updater to avoid side effects in updater functions (React StrictMode double-invocation safe).
   235→3. **Stale comments:** Updated 3 references to deleted `useDeviceDetection` → `useDeviceInfo`.

   238→
   239→### Wave 5a — Evaluation
   240→
   241→**Agent V (ImageEditContext → 3 sub-contexts):** Clean decomposition. Original 319-line monolithic context split into:
   242→- `ImageEditCanvasContext.tsx` (182 lines): mode, brush, annotation, canvas, reposition, display refs. Consumers: LightboxLayout, FloatingToolControls, MediaDisplayWithCanvas, InfoPanel.
   243→- `ImageEditFormContext.tsx` (105 lines): prompts, strengths, LoRA, model, advanced settings. Consumer: EditModePanel only.
   244→- `ImageEditStatusContext.tsx` (76 lines): 10 generation loading/success booleans. Consumer: EditModePanel only.
   245→- `ImageEditContext.tsx` (234 lines): composed provider with `useMemo` slices. Backward-compatible `useImageEditSafe()` preserved.
   246→
   247→Split strategy was 3 contexts instead of planned 4 — correct decision since mode/brush/annotation/canvas/reposition are always consumed together by canvas components. The natural boundary is canvas vs. form vs. status. Consumers migrated to specific hooks. `tsc --noEmit` passes clean.

   249→**Pre-existing issue found:** InlineEditView renders FloatingToolControls without wrapping in ImageEditProvider. FloatingToolControls reads from context (gets defaults), and the props InlineEditView passes are silently ignored. This predates our changes — FloatingToolControls was already context-only before Wave 5a.
   250→
   251→**Agent W (SegmentSettingsForm → 3 sub-components):** Good extraction. Original 1044 lines → parent 376 lines + 3 extracted components:
   252→- `AdvancedSettingsSection.tsx` (396 lines): collapsible advanced panel with motion/LoRA/structure video. Owns its own `savingField` state and LoRA handlers.
   253→- `PromptSection.tsx` (116 lines): prompt textarea with enhanced/default badges and field controls.
   254→- `StructureVideoSection.tsx` (429 lines): video upload, preview, treatment selector, strength/percent sliders, DatasetBrowser modal.
   255→
   256→Total is 1334 lines (up from 1044) due to interface definitions and imports — expected overhead of decomposition. Each file has a clear single responsibility. No new contexts or abstractions — pure prop drilling at 1 level.
   257→
   258→**Agent X (MediaGallery GalleryConfig object):** Clean. 17 individual boolean props → single `config?: Partial<GalleryConfig>` prop with `DEFAULT_GALLERY_CONFIG` defaults. Migrated 8 callers across 7 files. Internal components (Grid, Header, Lightbox) still accept individual props — correct since they're internal, and a second level of config-object indirection would add complexity for no benefit. `tsc --noEmit` passes clean. Net prop count: MediaGalleryProps went from ~50 fields to ~35.
   259→
   260→**Sense check:** No over-engineering. All three decompositions are justified — each addressed a genuine monolith (>300 LOC or >40 props). The ImageEditContext split is the most impactful (re-render reduction for canvas components). SegmentSettingsForm extraction makes the code navigable. MediaGallery config object is a standard pattern. `tsc --noEmit` passes clean.

   285→    handleGenerateImg2Img,
   286→    loraManager: img2imgLoraManager,
   287→  } = img2imgHook;
   288→
   289→  // ========================================
   290→  // Persistence sync effects
   291→  // ========================================
   292→
   293→  // Track if we've synced from persistence
   294→  const hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef = useRef(false);
   295→  // Track the last known good prompt to prevent race conditions
   296→  const lastUserPromptRef = useRef<string>('');
   297→  // Debounce timer for prompt sync
   298→  const promptSyncTimerRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
   299→
   300→  // Sync persistence -> useInpainting (on initial load)
   301→  useEffect(() => {
   302→    if (!isEditSettingsReady || hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef.current) return;
   303→
   304→    // Sync editMode
   305→    if (persistedEditMode && persistedEditMode !== editMode) {
   306→      setEditMode(persistedEditMode);
   307→    }
   308→
   309→    // Sync numGenerations
   310→    if (numGenerations !== inpaintNumGenerations) {
   311→      setInpaintNumGenerations(numGenerations);
   312→    }
   313→
   314→    // Sync prompt (only if has persisted settings - otherwise leave empty to avoid resetting user input)
   315→    if (hasPersistedSettings && persistedPrompt && persistedPrompt !== inpaintPrompt) {
   316→      setInpaintPrompt(persistedPrompt);
   317→      lastUserPromptRef.current = persistedPrompt;
   318→    }
   319→
   320→    hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef.current = true;
   321→  }, [isEditSettingsReady, hasPersistedSettings, persistedEditMode, editMode, setEditMode, numGenerations, inpaintNumGenerations, setInpaintNumGenerations, persistedPrompt, inpaintPrompt, setInpaintPrompt]);
   322→
   323→  // Sync editMode: useInpainting -> persistence (on change)
   324→  useEffect(() => {
   325→    if (!hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef.current || !isEditSettingsReady) return;
   326→
   327→    if (editMode !== persistedEditMode) {
   328→      setPersistedEditMode(editMode);
   329→    }
   330→  }, [editMode, persistedEditMode, setPersistedEditMode, isEditSettingsReady]);
   331→
   332→  // Sync numGenerations: useInpainting -> persistence (on change)
   333→  useEffect(() => {
   334→    if (!hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef.current || !isEditSettingsReady) return;
   335→
   336→    if (inpaintNumGenerations !== numGenerations) {
   337→      setNumGenerations(inpaintNumGenerations);
   338→    }
   339→  }, [inpaintNumGenerations, numGenerations, setNumGenerations, isEditSettingsReady]);
   340→
   341→  // Sync prompt: useInpainting -> persistence (on change, with debounce to prevent race conditions)
   342→  useEffect(() => {
   343→    if (!hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef.current || !isEditSettingsReady) return;
   344→
   345→    // If inpaintPrompt is reset to empty but we had a user prompt, it's likely a race condition - ignore
   346→    if (inpaintPrompt === '' && lastUserPromptRef.current !== '' && persistedPrompt !== '') {
   347→      // Restore the prompt from persistence after a short delay
   348→      if (promptSyncTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(promptSyncTimerRef.current);
   349→      promptSyncTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
   350→        if (persistedPrompt) {
   351→          setInpaintPrompt(persistedPrompt);
   352→        }
   353→      }, 100);
   354→      return;
   355→    }
   356→
   357→    if (inpaintPrompt !== persistedPrompt) {
   358→      setPersistedPrompt(inpaintPrompt);
   359→      lastUserPromptRef.current = inpaintPrompt;
   360→    }
   361→  }, [inpaintPrompt, persistedPrompt, setPersistedPrompt, setInpaintPrompt, isEditSettingsReady]);
   362→
   363→  // Cleanup timer on unmount
   364→  useEffect(() => {
   365→    return () => {
   366→      if (promptSyncTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(promptSyncTimerRef.current);
   367→    };
   368→  }, []);
   369→
   370→  const { sourceGenerationData } = useSourceGeneration({
   371→    media,
   372→    onOpenExternalGeneration: onNavigateToGeneration ?
   373→      async (id) => onNavigateToGeneration(id) : undefined
   374→  });
   375→
   376→  const lineageHook = useGenerationLineage({ media });
   377→  const {
   378→    derivedGenerations,
   379→    derivedPage,
   380→    derivedTotalPages,
   381→    paginatedDerived,
   382→    setDerivedPage,
   383→  } = lineageHook;
   384→
   385→  const starToggleHook = useStarToggle({ media });
   386→  const { localStarred, toggleStarMutation, handleToggleStar } = starToggleHook;
   387→
   388→  const handleDownload = async () => {
   389→    await downloadMedia(effectiveImageUrl, media.id, isVideo, media.contentType);
   390→  };
   391→
   392→  useEffect(() => {
   393→    if (!isSpecialEditMode) {
   394→       handleEnterMagicEditMode();
   395→    }
   396→  }, [isSpecialEditMode, handleEnterMagicEditMode]);
   397→
   398→  // ========================================
   399→  // STATE VALUES FOR EDIT MODE PANEL
   400→  // These are passed as props to EditModePanel (props-first pattern)
   401→  // ========================================
   402→

   404→  const imageEditValue = useMemo<ImageEditState>(() => ({

   415→
   416→    // Mode entry/exit handlers

   421→
   422→    // Brush/Inpaint state

   429→    // Annotation state

   436→    // Undo/Clear

   454→    // Img2Img form

   459→    enablePromptExpansion,

   462→    // LoRA mode

   489→    isCreatingMagicEditTasks,
   490→    magicEditTasksCreated,
   491→  }), [

   494→    editMode,
   495→    setIsInpaintMode,
   496→    setEditMode,
   497→    handleEnterInpaintMode,
   498→    handleExitMagicEditMode,
   499→    handleEnterMagicEditMode,
   500→    brushSize,
   501→    setBrushSize,
   502→    isEraseMode,
   503→    setIsEraseMode,
   504→    brushStrokes,
   505→    isAnnotateMode,
   506→    setIsAnnotateMode,
   507→    annotationMode,
   508→    setAnnotationMode,
   509→    selectedShapeId,
   510→    handleUndo,
   511→    handleClearMask,
   512→    repositionHook.transform,
   513→    hasTransformChanges,
   514→    inpaintPanelPosition,
   515→    setInpaintPanelPosition,
   516→    inpaintPrompt,
   517→    setInpaintPrompt,
   518→    inpaintNumGenerations,
   519→    setInpaintNumGenerations,
   520→    img2imgPrompt,
   521→    setImg2imgPrompt,
   522→    img2imgStrength,
   523→    setImg2imgStrength,
   524→    enablePromptExpansion,
   525→    setEnablePromptExpansion,
   526→    loraMode,
   527→    setLoraMode,
   528→    customLoraUrl,
   529→    setCustomLoraUrl,
   530→    createAsGeneration,
   531→    setCreateAsGeneration,
   532→    isGeneratingInpaint,
   533→    inpaintGenerateSuccess,
   534→    isGeneratingImg2Img,
   535→    img2imgGenerateSuccess,
   536→    isGeneratingReposition,
   537→    repositionGenerateSuccess,
   538→    isSavingAsVariant,

   540→    isCreatingMagicEditTasks,
   541→    magicEditTasksCreated,
   542→  ]);
   543→
   544→  return {

   634→// ============================================================================
   635→// AnnotationButtons — desktop-only shape manipulation buttons
   636→// ============================================================================
   637→
   638→interface AnnotationButtonsProps {
   639→  selectedShapeId: string | null;
   640→  isAnnotateMode: boolean;
   641→  brushStrokes: ReturnType<typeof useInlineEditState>['brushStrokes'];
   642→  getDeleteButtonPosition: () => { x: number; y: number } | null;
   643→  handleToggleFreeForm: () => void;
   644→  handleDeleteSelected: () => void;
   645→}
   646→
   647→function AnnotationButtons({
   648→  selectedShapeId,
   649→  isAnnotateMode,
   650→  brushStrokes,
   651→  getDeleteButtonPosition,
   652→  handleToggleFreeForm,
   653→  handleDeleteSelected,
   654→}: AnnotationButtonsProps) {
   655→  if (!selectedShapeId || !isAnnotateMode) return null;
   656→
   657→  const buttonPos = getDeleteButtonPosition();
   658→  if (!buttonPos) return null;
   659→
   660→  const selectedShape = brushStrokes.find(s => s.id === selectedShapeId);
   661→  const isFreeForm = selectedShape?.isFreeForm || false;
   662→
   663→  return (
   664→    <div className="absolute z-[100] flex gap-2" style={{
   665→      left: `${buttonPos.x}px`,
   666→      top: `${buttonPos.y}px`,
   667→      transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)'
   668→    }}>
   669→      <button
   670→        onClick={handleToggleFreeForm}
   671→        className={cn(
   672→          "rounded-full p-2 shadow-lg transition-colors",
   673→          isFreeForm
   674→            ? "bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 text-white"
   675→            : "bg-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-600 text-white"
   676→        )}
   677→        title={isFreeForm
   678→          ? "Switch to rectangle mode (edges move linearly)"
   679→          : "Switch to free-form mode (rhombus/non-orthogonal angles)"}
   680→      >
   681→        {isFreeForm ? <Diamond className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Square className="h-4 w-4" />}
   682→      </button>
   683→
   684→      <button
   685→        onClick={handleDeleteSelected}
   686→        className="bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white rounded-full p-2 shadow-lg transition-colors"
   687→        title="Delete annotation (or press DELETE key)"
   688→      >
   689→        <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
   690→      </button>
   691→    </div>
   692→  );
   693→}

   699→interface InlineEditCanvasProps {

   705→

   710→    <>
   711→      <MediaDisplayWithCanvas

   717→        isInpaintMode={state.isInpaintMode}
   718→        editMode={state.editMode}
   719→        repositionTransformStyle={state.editMode === 'reposition' ? state.getTransformStyle() : undefined}
   720→        imageContainerRef={state.imageContainerRef}
   721→        canvasRef={state.canvasRef}

   727→        // Konva stroke overlay props

   729→        brushStrokes={state.brushStrokes}

   735→        selectedShapeId={state.selectedShapeId}
   736→        onStrokePointerDown={state.handleKonvaPointerDown}
   737→        onStrokePointerMove={state.handleKonvaPointerMove}
   738→        onStrokePointerUp={state.handleKonvaPointerUp}
   739→        onShapeClick={state.handleShapeClick}
   740→        strokeOverlayRef={state.strokeOverlayRef}
   741→      />
   742→
   743→      {!isMobileVariant && (
   744→        <AnnotationButtons
   745→          selectedShapeId={state.selectedShapeId}
   746→          isAnnotateMode={state.isAnnotateMode}
   747→          brushStrokes={state.brushStrokes}
   748→          getDeleteButtonPosition={state.getDeleteButtonPosition}
   749→          handleToggleFreeForm={state.handleToggleFreeForm}

   751→        />
   752→      )}
   753→
   754→      {state.isSpecialEditMode && (
   755→        <FloatingToolControls

   762→          onSetIsEraseMode={state.setIsEraseMode}

   764→          onSetAnnotationMode={state.setAnnotationMode}
   765→          repositionTransform={state.repositionTransform}
   766→          onRepositionScaleChange={state.setScale}
   767→          onRepositionRotationChange={state.setRotation}
   768→          onRepositionFlipH={state.toggleFlipH}
   769→          onRepositionFlipV={state.toggleFlipV}
   770→          onRepositionReset={state.resetTransform}
   771→          brushStrokes={state.brushStrokes}
   772→          onUndo={state.handleUndo}
   773→          onClearMask={state.handleClearMask}
   774→          panelPosition={state.inpaintPanelPosition}
   775→          onSetPanelPosition={state.setInpaintPanelPosition}
   776→        />
   777→      )}
   778→
   779→      <TopRightControls
   780→        isVideo={state.isVideo}
   781→        readOnly={false}
   782→        isSpecialEditMode={state.isSpecialEditMode}
   783→        selectedProjectId={state.selectedProjectId}
   784→        isCloudMode={state.isCloudMode}
   785→        showDownload={true}
   786→        handleDownload={state.handleDownload}
   787→        mediaId={media.id}
   788→        onClose={onClose}
   789→      />
   790→
   791→      <BottomLeftControls
   792→        isVideo={state.isVideo}
   793→        readOnly={false}
   794→        isSpecialEditMode={state.isSpecialEditMode}
   795→        selectedProjectId={state.selectedProjectId}
   796→        isCloudMode={state.isCloudMode}
   797→        handleEnterMagicEditMode={state.handleEnterMagicEditMode}
   798→        isUpscaling={state.isUpscaling}
   799→        handleUpscale={state.handleUpscale}
   800→      />
   801→
   802→      <BottomRightControls
   803→        isVideo={state.isVideo}
   804→        readOnly={false}
   805→        isSpecialEditMode={state.isSpecialEditMode}
   806→        selectedProjectId={state.selectedProjectId}
   807→        isCloudMode={state.isCloudMode}
   808→        localStarred={state.localStarred}
   809→        handleToggleStar={state.handleToggleStar}
   810→        toggleStarPending={state.toggleStarMutation.isPending}
   811→        isAddingToReferences={false}
   812→        addToReferencesSuccess={false}
   813→        handleAddToReferences={() => {}}
   814→      />
   815→    </>
   816→  );
   817→}

   819→// ============================================================================
   820→// InlineEditSidebar — EditModePanel or fallback placeholder
   821→// ============================================================================
   822→
   823→interface InlineEditSidebarProps {
   824→  variant: 'mobile' | 'desktop';
   825→  state: ReturnType<typeof useInlineEditState>;
   826→  media: GenerationRow;
   827→  onClose: () => void;
   828→  onNavigateToGeneration?: (generationId: string) => Promise<void>;

   830→
   831→function InlineEditSidebar({ variant, state, media, onClose, onNavigateToGeneration }: InlineEditSidebarProps) {
   832→  if (state.isSpecialEditMode) {
   833→    return (
   834→      <EditModePanel
   835→        variant={variant === 'mobile' ? 'mobile' : 'desktop'}
   836→        hideInfoEditToggle={true}
   837→        simplifiedHeader={true}
   838→        sourceGenerationData={state.sourceGenerationData}
   839→        onOpenExternalGeneration={onNavigateToGeneration ?
   840→          async (id) => onNavigateToGeneration(id) : undefined
   841→        }
   842→        currentMediaId={media.id}
   843→        handleUnifiedGenerate={state.handleUnifiedGenerate}
   844→        handleGenerateAnnotatedEdit={state.handleGenerateAnnotatedEdit}
   845→        handleGenerateReposition={state.handleGenerateReposition}
   846→        handleSaveAsVariant={state.handleSaveAsVariant}
   847→        handleGenerateImg2Img={state.handleGenerateImg2Img}
   848→        img2imgLoraManager={state.img2imgLoraManager}
   849→        availableLoras={state.availableLoras}
   850→        coreState={{ onClose }}
   851→        imageEditState={state.imageEditValue}
   852→      />
   853→    );
   854→  }
   855→
   856→  return (
   857→    <div className="w-full h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 text-center gap-y-4">
   858→      <h3 className="text-xl font-medium">Image Editor</h3>
   859→      <p className="text-muted-foreground">Select an option to start editing</p>
   860→
   861→      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 w-full max-w-xs">
   862→        <Button onClick={() => {
   863→          state.setIsInpaintMode(true);
   864→          state.setEditMode('inpaint');
   865→        }} className="w-full">
   866→          Inpaint / Erase
   867→        </Button>
   868→
   869→        <Button onClick={state.handleEnterMagicEditMode} variant="secondary" className="w-full">
   870→          Magic Edit
   871→        </Button>
   872→      </div>
   873→    </div>
   874→  );
   875→}

   877→// ============================================================================
   878→// InlineEditView — layout orchestrator (mobile vs desktop)
   879→// ============================================================================
   880→
   881→export function InlineEditView({ media, onClose, onNavigateToGeneration }: InlineEditViewProps) {
   882→  if (!media) return null;
   883→
   884→  const state = useInlineEditState(media, onClose, onNavigateToGeneration);
   885→
   886→  if (state.isMobile) {
   887→    return (
   888→      <TooltipProvider delayDuration={500}>
   889→        <div className="w-full flex flex-col bg-transparent">
   890→          <div
   891→              className="flex items-center justify-center relative bg-black w-full shrink-0 rounded-t-2xl overflow-hidden"
   892→              style={{ height: '45dvh', touchAction: 'pan-y' }}
   893→            >
   894→              <InlineEditCanvas variant="mobile" state={state} media={media} onClose={onClose} />
   895→            </div>
   896→
   897→            <div
   898→              className={cn(
   899→                "bg-background border-t border-border relative z-[60] w-full rounded-b-2xl pb-8"
   900→              )}
   901→              style={{ minHeight: '55dvh' }}
   902→            >
   903→              <InlineEditSidebar
   904→                variant="mobile"
   905→                state={state}
   906→                media={media}
   907→                onClose={onClose}
   908→                onNavigateToGeneration={onNavigateToGeneration}

    18→## Item Details
    19→
    20→### 1. imagesPerPrompt Silent Change
    21→
    22→**Location:** `src/shared/components/ImageGenerationForm/ImageGenerationForm.tsx` lines 70-76
    23→
    24→```tsx
    25→form.setEffectivePromptMode(mode);
    26→if (mode === 'automated') {
    27→  form.setImagesPerPrompt(8);
    28→} else if (mode === 'managed') {
    29→  form.setImagesPerPrompt(1);
    30→}
    31→```
    32→
    33→**Problem:** Switching prompt mode silently resets `imagesPerPrompt` without telling the user. If they had manually set it to 4, switching to managed drops it to 1 with no indication.
    34→
    35→**Fix options:**
    36→- **A (Minimal):** Add a toast or inline note: "Images per prompt set to {n} for {mode} mode"
    37→- **B (Better):** Remember per-mode values — store `automatedImagesPerPrompt` and `managedImagesPerPrompt` separately, restore on switch
    38→- **C (Best):** Don't auto-set at all; just change the default for new sessions
    39→
    40→**Recommendation:** Option B — store separate values per mode.
    41→
    42→### 2. Hardcoded Colors
    43→
    44→**OnboardingModal:** Need to locate and replace hardcoded hex/rgb values with Tailwind theme tokens (`bg-background`, `text-foreground`, `border-border`, etc.)
    45→
    46→**DatasetBrowserModal:** Same treatment.
    47→
    48→**Action:** Search each component for hardcoded color values, replace with semantic tokens from the design system.
    49→
    50→### 3. complete_task Double Query
    51→
    52→**Location:** `supabase/functions/complete_task/index.ts` lines 42-81
    53→
    54→```ts
    55→// Query 1: Fetch task
    56→const { data: task } = await supabase
    57→  .from("tasks")
    58→  .select(`id, task_type, project_id, params`)
    59→  .eq("id", taskId)
    60→  .single();
    61→
    62→// Query 2: Fetch task_types metadata (comment: "no FK relationship exists")
    63→const { data: typeData } = await supabase
    64→  .from("task_types")
    65→  .select("tool_type, category, content_type, variant_type")
    66→  .eq("name", task.task_type)
    67→  .single();
    68→```
    69→
    70→**The comment says "no FK" but you CAN join on string columns.** The `task_type` column holds the task type name, and `task_types.name` is the PK.
    71→
    72→**Fix:** Single query with embedded select:
    73→```ts
    74→const { data: task } = await supabase
    75→  .from("tasks")
    76→  .select(`id, task_type, project_id, params, task_types!tasks_task_type_fkey(tool_type, category, content_type, variant_type)`)
    77→  .eq("id", taskId)
    78→  .single();
    79→```
    80→
    81→**Or** if no FK constraint exists, add one in a migration first (or use `.select()` with a manual join via RPC). Either way, this saves a round-trip on every task completion.
    82→
    83→### 4. ReferenceSectionProps Prop Drilling
    84→
    85→**Problem:** 35 fields drilled through `ReferenceSection` → 5 child components, when `ImageGenerationFormContext` already provides `FormReferenceState`, `FormReferenceHandlers`, `FormLoraState`, and `FormLoraHandlers`.
    86→
    87→**File:** `src/shared/components/ImageGenerationForm/components/reference/types.ts` (lines 61-96)
    88→
    89→**Drilling chain:** `ImageGenerationForm.tsx` → `ReferenceSection` → `ReferenceModeControls` (16 props), `ReferenceGrid` (9 props), `LoraGrid` (4 props), etc.
    90→
    91→**Fix:** Have child components consume `useImageGenerationFormContext()` directly instead of receiving props. The context already contains all the reference/LoRA state and handlers.
    92→
    93→**Approach:**
    94→1. In `ReferenceModeControls`, `ReferenceGrid`, `LoraGrid` — import and use context directly
    95→2. Remove context-sourced props from `ReferenceSectionProps` interface
    96→3. Keep only truly local/override props in the interface
    97→4. `ReferenceSection` itself becomes a thin layout wrapper
    98→
    99→### 5. ImageLightbox State Mirroring
   100→
   101→**Problem:** ImageLightbox creates local state that mirrors hook returns via useEffect sync, causing a one-frame delay.
   102→
   103→**Root cause:** Hook ordering — some state isn't available during the render where it's needed, so it's "pushed" via useEffect into local state.
   104→
   105→**Action for now:** Add a code comment explaining the workaround and what the proper fix would be (likely restructuring the hook dependency chain). Full fix deferred to P6 (ImageLightbox decomposition).
   106→
   107→### 6. useGenerationActions 14 Refs
   108→
   109→**Location:** `src/tools/travel-between-images/components/ShotEditor/hooks/useGenerationActions.ts` (727 lines)
   110→
   111→**Problem:** 14 `useRef` declarations to work around stale closures. The callbacks need stable references but the data they read changes frequently.
   112→
   113→**Root cause:** The component boundary is wrong — too many concerns in one hook, with data flowing through refs instead of through React's render cycle.
   114→
   115→**Action for now:** Document as architectural note for P6. The proper fix is decomposing useGenerationActions into smaller hooks with narrower data dependencies (e.g., separate hooks for add/remove/duplicate/position operations).
   116→

    34→
    35→| Source | Method | Exports |

    37→| `use-mobile.tsx` (86 lines) | Width + pointer + UA | `useIsMobile()`, `useIsTablet()` |

    42→
    43→**Target:** Single `use-mobile.tsx` exporting:
    44→- `useIsMobile()` — boolean (phones + tablets)
    45→- `useIsTablet()` — boolean (tablets only)
    46→- `useIsPhone()` — boolean (phones only, = isMobile && !isTablet)
    47→- `useIsTouchDevice()` — boolean (any touch-capable)
    48→- `useDeviceInfo()` — full object (orientation, mobileColumns, etc.)
    49→- `isMobileUA()` — non-hook utility for contexts that can't use hooks during init
    50→
    51→### B. Extract Timeout Recovery Pattern
    52→
    53→**Current pattern (repeated 3 times):**
    54→```ts
    55→const isMobile = /iPhone|iPad|iPod|Android/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    56→const timeout = isMobile ? 15000 : 10000;
    57→const timer = setTimeout(() => {
    58→  if (isStillLoading) forceRetry();
    59→}, timeout);
    60→```
    61→
    62→**Proposed hook:**
    63→```ts
    64→function useMobileTimeoutFallback({
    65→  isLoading: boolean,
    66→  onTimeout: () => void,
    67→  mobileTimeoutMs?: number,  // default 15000
    68→  desktopTimeoutMs?: number, // default 10000
    69→})
    70→```
    71→
    72→**For AuthContext debounce (different pattern):** Extract a `useDebouncedAuthEvents()` hook that:
    73→- Deduplicates `(event, userId)` tuples
    74→- Uses 150ms debounce window
    75→- Wraps state updates in `startTransition`
    76→
    77→### C. Unify Pane Lock Logic
    78→
    79→**PanesContext has 3 nearly-identical functions** (lines 113-171):
    80→- `setIsGenerationsPaneLocked`
    81→- `setIsShotsPaneLocked`
    82→- `setIsTasksPaneLocked`
    83→
    84→Each does:
    85→1. On mobile/tablet + locking: unlock all OTHER panes (exclusive locking)
    86→2. On small phone: skip persistence to DB
    87→3. On desktop: standard toggle
    88→
    89→**Fix:** Factory function:
    90→```ts
    91→const createPaneLockSetter = (paneName: 'gens' | 'shots' | 'tasks') =>
    92→  (isLocked: boolean) => {
    93→    setPaneLocks(prev => {
    94→      if ((isMobile || isTablet) && isLocked) {
    95→        // Exclusive: unlock others
    96→        return { gens: false, shots: false, tasks: false, [paneName]: true };
    97→      }
    98→      return { ...prev, [paneName]: isLocked };
    99→    });
   100→    if (!isSmallMobile) {
   101→      savePaneLocks(/* ... */);
   102→    }
   103→  };
   104→```
   105→
   106→### D. PaymentSuccessPage Timeout Soup
   107→
   108→**Current:** 4 overlapping timeouts with unclear coordination:
   109→1. 5000ms — force success if verification still loading
   110→2. 2000ms interval — poll credit queries
   111→3. 30000ms — cleanup everything
   112→4. 1500ms — show loading briefly before success
   113→
   114→**Problem:** Timeouts 1 and 4 can fire in either order. Timeout 3 clears timeout 1 but also forces success, creating redundancy.
   115→
   116→**Fix: State machine approach:**
   117→```
   118→loading → polling (2s interval) → verified | timeout(30s) → success → redirect
   119→```
   120→
   121→States: `loading` | `polling` | `verified` | `timed_out` | `redirecting`
   122→
   123→Transitions:
   124→- `loading` → `polling`: on mount, start credit poll
   125→- `polling` → `verified`: when credits reflect payment
   126→- `polling` → `timed_out`: after 30s, assume success anyway
   127→- `verified`/`timed_out` → `redirecting`: after 1.5s display delay
   128→

    56→├── useProjectSelection()     — selectedProjectId, persistence
    57→├── useProjectDefaults()      — default creation, template copying
    58→├── useProjectSettings()      — settings inheritance, aspect ratio
    59→└── useMobileTimeoutFallback() — from P4
    60→```
    61→
    62→Each extracted hook manages its own React Query queries. ProjectContext becomes a provider that composes them.
    63→
    64→### B. Rate Limiting
    65→
    66→**Current state (corrected from original report):**
    67→- `_shared/rateLimit.ts` exists with `checkRateLimit()` function
    68→- `check_rate_limit` RPC **does exist** — migration `20251212001252_add_rate_limiting.sql` creates it with sliding window logic
    69→- Rate limiting is applied in 5 edge functions (generate-pat, stripe-checkout, ai-prompt, create-task, and others)
    70→- **The real bug:** `ai-prompt` rate limits by IP (`getClientIp(req)`) instead of `user.id`, causing cross-user collisions behind shared IPs (offices, schools)
    71→- Several expensive endpoints lack rate limiting entirely: `complete_task`, `calculate-task-cost`, `delete-project`
    72→
    73→**Fix:**
    74→1. Change `ai-prompt` to pass `user.id` instead of `clientIp` (lines 62-69)
    75→2. Add rate limiting to uncovered expensive endpoints
    76→3. Consider whether any other authenticated endpoints wrongly use IP
    77→
    78→### C. Context Nesting in App.tsx
    79→
    80→**Current:** 13 providers nested (not 11 as originally reported):
    81→1. QueryClientProvider → 2. TaskTypeConfigInitializer → 3. AuthProvider → 4. UserSettingsProvider → 5. ProjectProvider → 6. RealtimeProvider → 7. ShotsProvider → 8. GenerationTaskProvider → 9. IncomingTasksProvider → 10. PanesProvider → 11. LastAffectedShotProvider → 12. CurrentShotProvider → 13. ToolPageHeaderProvider
    82→
    83→**Auth is correctly positioned** (3rd) — but heavy providers like ProjectProvider still initialize before auth resolves, causing wasted renders.
    84→
    85→**Fix:**
    86→1. Add `<AuthGate>` component after `AuthProvider` that renders children only when auth is resolved
    87→2. Place data-dependent providers (ProjectProvider, ShotsProvider, etc.) inside the gate
    88→3. Lightweight providers (theme, toast, panes) can stay outside
    89→4. Consider grouping related providers (Shots + CurrentShot + LastAffectedShot → ShotsGroup)
    90→
    91→### D. Window Globals
    92→
    93→**Found:**
    94→- `window.__AUTH_MANAGER__` — structural (used for auth state access outside React)
    95→- `window.__PROJECT_CONTEXT__` — structural (used for project access outside React)
    96→- `window.__REACT_QUERY_CLIENT__` — structural (used for cache access outside React)
    97→- `window.__supabase_client__` — structural (client reference for edge functions)
    98→- `window.__projectDebugLog` — debug only
    99→
   100→**Analysis:** The structural globals exist because some code (service workers, non-React utilities, edge function proxies) needs access to React state. These are legitimate escape hatches but should be:
   101→1. Typed properly (not `any`)
   102→2. Gated behind `import.meta.env.DEV` where possible
   103→3. Documented in one place (a `globals.d.ts` type file)
   104→
   105→### E. Billing Logic
   106→
   107→Three edge functions with duplicated sub-task detection logic. Need to identify which functions and extract a shared billing module.
   108→
   109→**Key concern:** Sub-task detection (orchestrator tasks that spawn child tasks) determines credit charging. If this logic diverges across functions, users could be over/under-charged.
   110→
   111→### F. Task Status Guards
   112→
   113→**Current:** Frontend TasksPane can change task status. No server-side validation prevents invalid transitions (e.g., Completed → Queued).
   114→
   115→**Fix:** Add a DB trigger or RPC that validates transitions:
   116→```
   117→Valid: Queued → In Progress → Completed
   118→Valid: Queued → Cancelled
   119→Valid: In Progress → Failed
   120→Invalid: Completed → anything
   121→Invalid: Failed → anything (except retry → new task)
   122→```
   123→
```

    49→## Decomposition Strategies Per Component
    50→
    51→### 1. SegmentSettingsForm (1,044 lines, 47+ props)
    52→**File:** `src/shared/components/SegmentSettingsForm/SegmentSettingsForm.tsx`
    53→
    54→**Current responsibilities:**
    55→- Prompt field with default handling
    56→- Advanced settings collapsible (motion, LoRA, model options)

    63→SegmentSettingsForm (~400 lines)

    66→│   ├── MotionPresets
    67→│   ├── LoraSelector
    68→│   └── ModelOptions
    69→├── StructureVideoSection (~200 lines)
    70→│   ├── VideoUploader
    71→│   └── VideoPreview
    72→└── SubmitControls (~100 lines)
    73→```
    74→
    75→### 2. ImageLightbox (1,030 lines, 45 props)
    76→**File:** `src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/ImageLightbox.tsx`
    77→
    78→**Current responsibilities:**
    79→- Upscale, inpaint, magic edit, reposition, img2img mode orchestration
    80→- Variant management and navigation
    81→- Star toggle and shot positioning
    82→- Task details display
    83→- Layout decisions
    84→- ImageEditContext provider
    85→
    86→**Extraction plan:**
    87→```
    88→ImageLightbox (~300 lines, display + layout only)
    89→├── ImageEditOrchestrator (new, ~300 lines)
    90→│   ├── Manages edit mode state machine
    91→│   ├── Provides ImageEditContext
    92→│   └── Delegates to mode-specific handlers
    93→├── ImageLightboxHeader (~100 lines)
    94→├── ImageLightboxContent (~150 lines)
    95→└── ImageLightboxFooter (~100 lines)
    96→```
    97→
    98→### 3. MediaGallery (752 lines, 119 props)
    99→**File:** `src/shared/components/MediaGallery/index.tsx`
   100→
   101→**The #1 issue is 119 props.** Many of these are configuration flags (showDelete, showDownload, showShare, etc.) and callbacks.
   102→
   103→**Reduction strategy:**
   104→1. **Config object:** Group boolean flags into `GalleryConfig`:
   105→   ```ts
   106→   interface GalleryConfig {
   107→     showDelete?: boolean;
   108→     showDownload?: boolean;
   109→     showShare?: boolean;
   110→     showEdit?: boolean;
   111→     showStar?: boolean;
   112→     showAddToShot?: boolean;
   113→     // ... etc
   114→   }
   115→   ```
   116→2. **Context for shared state:** Gallery items shouldn't receive 20+ props — they should read from a `MediaGalleryContext`
   117→3. **Extract LightboxCoordinator:** The lightbox management is a separate concern
   118→
   119→### 4. ImageEditContext (319 lines, 70+ fields)
   120→**File:** `src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/contexts/ImageEditContext.tsx`
   121→
   122→**Problem:** Any mutation in any of 70+ fields triggers re-renders in all consumers.
   123→
   124→**Split into:**
   125→```
   126→ImageEditContext (thin, composes sub-contexts)
   127→├── EditModeContext        — 8 fields (current mode, mode switcher)
   128→├── BrushToolContext       — 6 fields (size, opacity, color, tool type)
   129→├── AnnotationToolContext  — 4 fields (annotation mode, shapes)
   130→├── CanvasInteractionContext — 8 fields (zoom, pan, transform)
   131→├── RepositionContext      — 6 fields (transform state)
   132→├── EditFormContext        — 10+ fields (prompt, params, submit)
   133→└── GenerationStatusContext — 8+ fields (loading, progress, results)
   134→```
   135→
   136→Each sub-context only re-renders its consumers when relevant state changes.
   137→
   138→---
   139→
   140→## General Decomposition Rules
   141→
   142→1. **Extract when a section has its own state** — if a group of fields change together but independently of other groups, it's a natural boundary
   143→2. **Props → Context when drilling >2 levels** — but split contexts by concern (don't create another mega-context)
   144→3. **Hooks → smaller hooks when they have >5 useRef** — refs are a code smell for wrong boundaries
   145→4. **Components → smaller components at ~300 LOC** — the sweet spot for readability
   146→5. **Don't share what doesn't need sharing** — if only one consumer uses a field, it doesn't belong in shared context
   147→6. **Config objects for boolean flag groups** — `{ showDelete, showDownload, showShare }` → `GalleryConfig`
   148→
