    56→// useInlineEditState — all hook orchestration + persistence sync + memo
    57→// ============================================================================
    58→
    59→function useInlineEditState(
    60→  media: GenerationRow,
    61→  _onClose: () => void,
    62→  onNavigateToGeneration?: (generationId: string) => Promise<void>,
    63→) {
    64→  const displayCanvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
    65→  const maskCanvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
    66→  const imageContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    67→
    68→  const isMobile = useIsMobile();
    69→  const { selectedProjectId } = useProject();
    70→  const { value: generationMethods } = useUserUIState('generationMethods', { onComputer: true, inCloud: true });
    71→  const isCloudMode = generationMethods.inCloud;
    72→
    73→  // Uses canonical isVideoAny from typeGuards
    74→  const isVideo = isVideoAny(media);
    75→
    76→  const upscaleHook = useUpscale({ media, selectedProjectId, isVideo });
    77→  const {
    78→    effectiveImageUrl,
    79→    isUpscaling,
    80→    handleUpscale,
    81→  } = upscaleHook;
    82→
    83→  // Image dimensions state (needed by inpainting hook)
    84→  const [imageDimensions, setImageDimensions] = useState<{ width: number; height: number } | null>(null);
    85→  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
    86→
    87→  // Create as variant toggle - when true, creates variant; when false, creates new generation
    88→  // Default to false (createAsGeneration=false means variant mode is ON)
    89→  const [createAsGeneration, setCreateAsGeneration] = useState(false);
    90→
    91→  // Flip functionality removed - use reposition mode instead
    92→  const isFlippedHorizontally = false;
    93→  const isSaving = false;
    94→
    95→  const { isInSceneBoostEnabled, setIsInSceneBoostEnabled, loraMode, setLoraMode, customLoraUrl, setCustomLoraUrl, editModeLoRAs } = useEditModeLoRAs();
    96→
    97→  // Variants hook - moved early so activeVariantId is available for other hooks
    98→  // Detect if this is a shot_generation record (has shotImageEntryId or shot_generation_id matching media.id)
    99→  const isShotGenerationRecord = media.shotImageEntryId === media.id ||
   100→                                  media.shot_generation_id === media.id;
   101→  const actualGenerationId = media.generation_id ||
   102→                              (!isShotGenerationRecord ? media.id : null);
   103→
   104→  // Edit settings persistence - for img2img strength, enablePromptExpansion, and editMode
   105→  const editSettingsPersistence = useEditSettingsPersistence({
   106→    generationId: actualGenerationId,
   107→    projectId: selectedProjectId,
   108→  });
   109→  const {
   110→    editMode: persistedEditMode,
   111→    setEditMode: setPersistedEditMode,
   112→    img2imgStrength: persistedImg2imgStrength,
   113→    img2imgEnablePromptExpansion: persistedImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion,
   114→    img2imgPrompt: persistedImg2imgPrompt,
   115→    img2imgPromptHasBeenSet: persistedImg2imgPromptHasBeenSet,
   116→    setImg2imgStrength: setPersistedImg2imgStrength,
   117→    setImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion: setPersistedImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion,
   118→    setImg2imgPrompt: setPersistedImg2imgPrompt,
   119→    prompt: persistedPrompt,
   120→    setPrompt: setPersistedPrompt,
   121→    numGenerations,
   122→    setNumGenerations,
   123→    isReady: isEditSettingsReady,
   124→    hasPersistedSettings,
   125→  } = editSettingsPersistence;
   126→  const {
   127→    activeVariant,
   128→    setActiveVariantId,
   129→    refetch: refetchVariants,
   130→  } = useVariants({
   131→    generationId: actualGenerationId,
   132→    enabled: true,
   133→  });
   134→
   135→  const inpaintingHook = useInpainting({
   136→    media,
   137→    selectedProjectId,
   138→    isVideo,
   139→    displayCanvasRef,
   140→    maskCanvasRef,
   141→    imageContainerRef,
   142→    imageDimensions,
   143→    handleExitInpaintMode: () => {},
   144→    loras: editModeLoRAs,
   145→    toolTypeOverride: TOOL_IDS.EDIT_IMAGES,
   146→    activeVariantId: activeVariant?.id, // Store strokes per-variant, not per-generation
   147→    createAsGeneration, // If true, create a new generation instead of a variant
   148→  });
   149→  const {
   150→    isInpaintMode,
   151→    brushStrokes,
   152→    isEraseMode,
   153→    inpaintPrompt,
   154→    inpaintNumGenerations,
   155→    brushSize,
   156→    isGeneratingInpaint,
   157→    inpaintGenerateSuccess,
   158→    isAnnotateMode,
   159→    editMode,
   160→    annotationMode,
   161→    selectedShapeId,
   162→    isDrawing,
   163→    currentStroke,
   164→    setIsInpaintMode,
   165→    setIsEraseMode,
   166→    setInpaintPrompt,
   167→    setInpaintNumGenerations,
   168→    setBrushSize,
   169→    setIsAnnotateMode,
   170→    setEditMode,
   171→    setAnnotationMode,
   172→    handleKonvaPointerDown,
   173→    handleKonvaPointerMove,
   174→    handleKonvaPointerUp,
   175→    handleShapeClick,
   176→    handleUndo,
   177→    handleClearMask,
   178→    handleEnterInpaintMode,
   179→    handleGenerateInpaint,
   180→    handleGenerateAnnotatedEdit,
   181→    handleDeleteSelected,
   182→    handleToggleFreeForm,
   183→    getDeleteButtonPosition,
   184→    strokeOverlayRef,
   185→    onStrokeComplete,
   186→    onStrokesChange,
   187→    onSelectionChange,
   188→    onTextModeHint,
   189→  } = inpaintingHook;
   190→
   191→  const magicEditHook = useMagicEditMode({
   192→    media,
   193→    selectedProjectId,
   194→    isVideo,
   195→    isInpaintMode,
   196→    setIsInpaintMode,
   197→    handleEnterInpaintMode,
   198→    handleGenerateInpaint,
   199→    brushStrokes,
   200→    inpaintPrompt,
   201→    setInpaintPrompt,
   202→    inpaintNumGenerations,
   203→    setInpaintNumGenerations,
   204→    editModeLoRAs,
   205→    sourceUrlForTasks: effectiveImageUrl,
   206→    imageDimensions,
   207→    isInSceneBoostEnabled,
   208→    setIsInSceneBoostEnabled,
   209→    toolTypeOverride: TOOL_IDS.EDIT_IMAGES,
   210→    createAsGeneration, // If true, create a new generation instead of a variant
   211→    // qwenEditModel not passed - uses default 'qwen-edit'
   212→  });
   213→  const {
   214→    isCreatingMagicEditTasks,
   215→    magicEditTasksCreated,
   216→    inpaintPanelPosition,
   217→    setInpaintPanelPosition,
   218→    handleEnterMagicEditMode,
   219→    handleExitMagicEditMode,
   220→    handleUnifiedGenerate,
   221→    isSpecialEditMode
   222→  } = magicEditHook;
   223→
   224→  const repositionHook = useRepositionMode({
   225→    media,
   226→    selectedProjectId,
   227→    imageDimensions,
   228→    imageContainerRef,
   229→    loras: editModeLoRAs,
   230→    inpaintPrompt,
   231→    inpaintNumGenerations,
   232→    handleExitInpaintMode: handleExitMagicEditMode,
   233→    toolTypeOverride: TOOL_IDS.EDIT_IMAGES,
   234→    onVariantCreated: setActiveVariantId,
   235→    refetchVariants,
   236→    createAsGeneration, // If true, create a new generation instead of a variant
   237→  });
   238→  const {
   239→    transform: repositionTransform,
   240→    hasTransformChanges,
   241→    isGeneratingReposition,
   242→    repositionGenerateSuccess,
   243→    isSavingAsVariant,
   244→    saveAsVariantSuccess,
   245→    setScale,
   246→    setRotation,
   247→    toggleFlipH,
   248→    toggleFlipV,
   249→    resetTransform,
   250→    handleGenerateReposition,
   251→    handleSaveAsVariant,
   252→    getTransformStyle,
   253→    isDragging: isRepositionDragging,
   254→    dragHandlers: repositionDragHandlers,
   255→  } = repositionHook;
   256→
   257→  // Fetch available LoRAs for img2img mode
   258→  const { data: availableLoras } = usePublicLoras();
   259→
   260→  // Img2Img mode hook - uses persisted settings
   261→
   262→  const img2imgHook = useImg2ImgMode({
   263→    media,
   264→    selectedProjectId,
   265→    isVideo,
   266→    sourceUrlForTasks: effectiveImageUrl,
   267→    toolTypeOverride: TOOL_IDS.EDIT_IMAGES,
   268→    createAsGeneration,
   269→    availableLoras,
   270→    // Pass persisted values
   271→    img2imgStrength: persistedImg2imgStrength,
   272→    setImg2imgStrength: setPersistedImg2imgStrength,
   273→    enablePromptExpansion: persistedImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion,
   274→    setEnablePromptExpansion: setPersistedImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion,
   275→    // Img2Img prompt is persisted separately to avoid cross-mode races
   276→    img2imgPrompt: persistedImg2imgPrompt,
   277→    setImg2imgPrompt: setPersistedImg2imgPrompt,
   278→    img2imgPromptHasBeenSet: persistedImg2imgPromptHasBeenSet,
   279→    // Number of generations (shared with other edit modes)
   280→    numGenerations,
   281→  });
   282→  const {
   283→    img2imgPrompt,
   284→    img2imgStrength,
   285→    enablePromptExpansion,
   286→    isGeneratingImg2Img,
   287→    img2imgGenerateSuccess,
   288→    setImg2imgPrompt,
   289→    setImg2imgStrength,
   290→    setEnablePromptExpansion,
   291→    handleGenerateImg2Img,
   292→    loraManager: img2imgLoraManager,
   293→  } = img2imgHook;
   294→
   295→  // ========================================
   296→  // Persistence sync effects
   297→  // ========================================
   298→
   299→  // Track if we've synced from persistence
   300→  const hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef = useRef(false);
   301→  // Track the last known good prompt to prevent race conditions
   302→  const lastUserPromptRef = useRef<string>('');
   303→  // Debounce timer for prompt sync
   304→  const promptSyncTimerRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
   305→
   306→  // Sync persistence -> useInpainting (on initial load)
   307→  useEffect(() => {
   308→    if (!isEditSettingsReady || hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef.current) return;
   309→
   310→    // Sync editMode
   311→    if (persistedEditMode && persistedEditMode !== editMode) {
   312→      setEditMode(persistedEditMode);
   313→    }
   314→
   315→    // Sync numGenerations
   316→    if (numGenerations !== inpaintNumGenerations) {
   317→      setInpaintNumGenerations(numGenerations);
   318→    }
   319→
   320→    // Sync prompt (only if has persisted settings - otherwise leave empty to avoid resetting user input)
   321→    if (hasPersistedSettings && persistedPrompt && persistedPrompt !== inpaintPrompt) {
   322→      setInpaintPrompt(persistedPrompt);
   323→      lastUserPromptRef.current = persistedPrompt;
   324→    }
   325→
   326→    hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef.current = true;
   327→  }, [isEditSettingsReady, hasPersistedSettings, persistedEditMode, editMode, setEditMode, numGenerations, inpaintNumGenerations, setInpaintNumGenerations, persistedPrompt, inpaintPrompt, setInpaintPrompt]);
   328→
   329→  // Sync editMode: useInpainting -> persistence (on change)
   330→  useEffect(() => {
   331→    if (!hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef.current || !isEditSettingsReady) return;
   332→
   333→    if (editMode !== persistedEditMode) {
   334→      setPersistedEditMode(editMode);
   335→    }
   336→  }, [editMode, persistedEditMode, setPersistedEditMode, isEditSettingsReady]);
   337→
   338→  // Sync numGenerations: useInpainting -> persistence (on change)
   339→  useEffect(() => {
   340→    if (!hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef.current || !isEditSettingsReady) return;
   341→
   342→    if (inpaintNumGenerations !== numGenerations) {
   343→      setNumGenerations(inpaintNumGenerations);
   344→    }
   345→  }, [inpaintNumGenerations, numGenerations, setNumGenerations, isEditSettingsReady]);
   346→
   347→  // Sync prompt: useInpainting -> persistence (on change, with debounce to prevent race conditions)
   348→  useEffect(() => {
   349→    if (!hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef.current || !isEditSettingsReady) return;
   350→
   351→    // If inpaintPrompt is reset to empty but we had a user prompt, it's likely a race condition - ignore
   352→    if (inpaintPrompt === '' && lastUserPromptRef.current !== '' && persistedPrompt !== '') {
   353→      // Restore the prompt from persistence after a short delay
   354→      if (promptSyncTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(promptSyncTimerRef.current);
   355→      promptSyncTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
   356→        if (persistedPrompt) {
   357→          setInpaintPrompt(persistedPrompt);
   358→        }
   359→      }, 100);
   360→      return;
   361→    }
   362→
   363→    if (inpaintPrompt !== persistedPrompt) {
   364→      setPersistedPrompt(inpaintPrompt);
   365→      lastUserPromptRef.current = inpaintPrompt;
   366→    }
   367→  }, [inpaintPrompt, persistedPrompt, setPersistedPrompt, setInpaintPrompt, isEditSettingsReady]);
   368→
   369→  // Cleanup timer on unmount
   370→  useEffect(() => {
   371→    return () => {
   372→      if (promptSyncTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(promptSyncTimerRef.current);
   373→    };
   374→  }, []);
   375→
   376→  const { sourceGenerationData } = useSourceGeneration({
   377→    media,
   378→    onOpenExternalGeneration: onNavigateToGeneration ?
   379→      async (id) => onNavigateToGeneration(id) : undefined
   380→  });
   381→
   382→  const lineageHook = useGenerationLineage({ media });
   383→  const {
   384→    derivedGenerations,
   385→    derivedPage,
   386→    derivedTotalPages,
   387→    paginatedDerived,
   388→    setDerivedPage,
   389→  } = lineageHook;
   390→
   391→  const starToggleHook = useStarToggle({ media });
   392→  const { localStarred, toggleStarMutation, handleToggleStar } = starToggleHook;
   393→
   394→  const handleDownload = async () => {
   395→    await downloadMedia(effectiveImageUrl, media.id, isVideo, media.contentType);
   396→  };
   397→
   398→  useEffect(() => {
   399→    if (!isSpecialEditMode) {
   400→       handleEnterMagicEditMode();
   401→    }
   402→  }, [isSpecialEditMode, handleEnterMagicEditMode]);
   403→
   404→  // ========================================
   405→  // STATE VALUES FOR EDIT MODE PANEL
   406→  // These are passed as props to EditModePanel (props-first pattern)
   407→  // ========================================
   408→
   409→  // Build unified ImageEditState value (mode + form + generation status)
   410→  const imageEditValue = useMemo<ImageEditState>(() => ({
   411→    // Mode state
   412→    isInpaintMode,
   413→    isMagicEditMode: isSpecialEditMode,
   414→    isSpecialEditMode,
   415→    editMode: editMode as ImageEditState['editMode'],
   416→
   417→    // Mode setters
   418→    setIsInpaintMode,
   419→    setIsMagicEditMode: () => {},
   420→    setEditMode: setEditMode as ImageEditState['setEditMode'],
   421→
   422→    // Mode entry/exit handlers
   423→    handleEnterInpaintMode,
   424→    handleExitInpaintMode: handleExitMagicEditMode,
   425→    handleEnterMagicEditMode,
   426→    handleExitMagicEditMode,
   427→
   428→    // Brush/Inpaint state
   429→    brushSize,
   430→    setBrushSize,
   431→    isEraseMode,
   432→    setIsEraseMode,
   433→    brushStrokes,
   434→
   435→    // Annotation state
   436→    isAnnotateMode,
   437→    setIsAnnotateMode,
   438→    annotationMode,
   439→    setAnnotationMode,
   440→    selectedShapeId,
   441→
   442→    // Canvas interaction
   443→    onStrokeComplete,
   444→    onStrokesChange,
   445→    onSelectionChange,
   446→    onTextModeHint,
   447→    strokeOverlayRef,
   448→    getDeleteButtonPosition,
   449→    handleToggleFreeForm,
   450→    handleDeleteSelected,
   451→
   452→    // Undo/Clear
   453→    handleUndo,
   454→    handleClearMask,
   455→
   456→    // Reposition state
   457→    repositionTransform: repositionHook.transform,
   458→    hasTransformChanges,
   459→    isRepositionDragging,
   460→    repositionDragHandlers,
   461→    getTransformStyle,
   462→    setScale,
   463→    setRotation,
   464→    toggleFlipH,
   465→    toggleFlipV,
   466→    resetTransform,
   467→
   468→    // Display refs
   469→    imageContainerRef,
   470→    isFlippedHorizontally,
   471→    isSaving,
   472→
   473→    // Panel UI state
   474→    inpaintPanelPosition,
   475→    setInpaintPanelPosition,
   476→
   477→    // Inpaint form
   478→    inpaintPrompt,
   479→    setInpaintPrompt,
   480→    inpaintNumGenerations,
   481→    setInpaintNumGenerations,
   482→
   483→    // Img2Img form
   484→    img2imgPrompt,
   485→    setImg2imgPrompt,
   486→    img2imgStrength,
   487→    setImg2imgStrength,
   488→    enablePromptExpansion,
   489→    setEnablePromptExpansion,
   490→
   491→    // LoRA mode
   492→    loraMode,
   493→    setLoraMode,
   494→    customLoraUrl,
   495→    setCustomLoraUrl,
   496→
   497→    // Generation options
   498→    createAsGeneration,
   499→    setCreateAsGeneration,
   500→
   501→    // Model selection
   502→    qwenEditModel: 'qwen-edit-2511',
   503→    setQwenEditModel: () => {},
   504→
   505→    // Advanced settings (not used in InlineEditView)
   506→    advancedSettings: DEFAULT_ADVANCED_SETTINGS,
   507→    setAdvancedSettings: () => {},
   508→
   509→    // Generation status
   510→    isGeneratingInpaint,
   511→    inpaintGenerateSuccess,
   512→    isGeneratingImg2Img,
   513→    img2imgGenerateSuccess,
   514→    isGeneratingReposition,
   515→    repositionGenerateSuccess,
   516→    isSavingAsVariant,
   517→    saveAsVariantSuccess,
   518→    isCreatingMagicEditTasks,
   519→    magicEditTasksCreated,
   520→  }), [
   521→    isInpaintMode,
   522→    isSpecialEditMode,
   523→    editMode,
   524→    setIsInpaintMode,
   525→    setEditMode,
   526→    handleEnterInpaintMode,
   527→    handleExitMagicEditMode,
   528→    handleEnterMagicEditMode,
   529→    brushSize,
   530→    setBrushSize,
   531→    isEraseMode,
   532→    setIsEraseMode,
   533→    brushStrokes,
   534→    isAnnotateMode,
   535→    setIsAnnotateMode,
   536→    annotationMode,
   537→    setAnnotationMode,
   538→    selectedShapeId,
   539→    onStrokeComplete,
   540→    onStrokesChange,
   541→    onSelectionChange,
   542→    onTextModeHint,
   543→    strokeOverlayRef,
   544→    getDeleteButtonPosition,
   545→    handleToggleFreeForm,
   546→    handleDeleteSelected,
   547→    handleUndo,
   548→    handleClearMask,
   549→    repositionHook.transform,
   550→    hasTransformChanges,
   551→    isRepositionDragging,
   552→    repositionDragHandlers,
   553→    getTransformStyle,
   554→    setScale,
   555→    setRotation,
   556→    toggleFlipH,
   557→    toggleFlipV,
   558→    resetTransform,
   559→    imageContainerRef,
   560→    isFlippedHorizontally,
   561→    isSaving,
   562→    inpaintPanelPosition,
   563→    setInpaintPanelPosition,
   564→    inpaintPrompt,
   565→    setInpaintPrompt,
   566→    inpaintNumGenerations,
   567→    setInpaintNumGenerations,
   568→    img2imgPrompt,
   569→    setImg2imgPrompt,
   570→    img2imgStrength,
   571→    setImg2imgStrength,
   572→    enablePromptExpansion,
   573→    setEnablePromptExpansion,
   574→    loraMode,
   575→    setLoraMode,
   576→    customLoraUrl,
   577→    setCustomLoraUrl,
   578→    createAsGeneration,
   579→    setCreateAsGeneration,
   580→    isGeneratingInpaint,
   581→    inpaintGenerateSuccess,
   582→    isGeneratingImg2Img,
   583→    img2imgGenerateSuccess,
   584→    isGeneratingReposition,
   585→    repositionGenerateSuccess,
   586→    isSavingAsVariant,
   587→    saveAsVariantSuccess,
   588→    isCreatingMagicEditTasks,
   589→    magicEditTasksCreated,
   590→  ]);
   591→
   592→  return {
   593→    // Layout / env
   594→    isMobile,
   595→    selectedProjectId,
   596→    isCloudMode,
   597→    isVideo,
   598→
   599→    // Refs
   600→    imageContainerRef,
   601→    canvasRef,
   602→    maskCanvasRef,
   603→
   604→    // Display state
   605→    effectiveImageUrl,
   606→    isFlippedHorizontally,
   607→    isSaving,
   608→    imageDimensions,
   609→    setImageDimensions,
   610→
   611→    // Upscale
   612→    isUpscaling,
   613→    handleUpscale,
   614→
   615→    // Inpainting canvas state
   616→    isInpaintMode,
   617→    editMode,
   618→    brushStrokes,
   619→    currentStroke,

   621→    isEraseMode,
   622→    brushSize,
   623→    annotationMode,
   624→    selectedShapeId,
   625→    isAnnotateMode,
   626→    handleKonvaPointerDown,
   627→    handleKonvaPointerMove,

   681→
   682→// ============================================================================
   683→// AnnotationButtons — desktop-only shape manipulation buttons
   684→// ============================================================================
   685→
   686→interface AnnotationButtonsProps {
   687→  selectedShapeId: string | null;
   688→  isAnnotateMode: boolean;
   689→  brushStrokes: ReturnType<typeof useInlineEditState>['brushStrokes'];
   690→  getDeleteButtonPosition: () => { x: number; y: number } | null;
   691→  handleToggleFreeForm: () => void;
   692→  handleDeleteSelected: () => void;
   693→}
   694→
   695→function AnnotationButtons({
   696→  selectedShapeId,
   697→  isAnnotateMode,
   698→  brushStrokes,
   699→  getDeleteButtonPosition,
   700→  handleToggleFreeForm,
   701→  handleDeleteSelected,
   702→}: AnnotationButtonsProps) {
   703→  if (!selectedShapeId || !isAnnotateMode) return null;
   704→
   705→  const buttonPos = getDeleteButtonPosition();
   706→  if (!buttonPos) return null;
   707→
   708→  const selectedShape = brushStrokes.find(s => s.id === selectedShapeId);
   709→  const isFreeForm = selectedShape?.isFreeForm || false;
   710→
   711→  return (
   712→    <div className="absolute z-[100] flex gap-2" style={{
   713→      left: `${buttonPos.x}px`,
   714→      top: `${buttonPos.y}px`,
   715→      transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)'
   716→    }}>
   717→      <button
   718→        onClick={handleToggleFreeForm}
   719→        className={cn(
   720→          "rounded-full p-2 shadow-lg transition-colors",
   721→          isFreeForm
   722→            ? "bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 text-white"
   723→            : "bg-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-600 text-white"
   724→        )}
   725→        title={isFreeForm
   726→          ? "Switch to rectangle mode (edges move linearly)"
   727→          : "Switch to free-form mode (rhombus/non-orthogonal angles)"}
   728→      >
   729→        {isFreeForm ? <Diamond className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Square className="h-4 w-4" />}
   730→      </button>
   731→
   732→      <button
   733→        onClick={handleDeleteSelected}
   734→        className="bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white rounded-full p-2 shadow-lg transition-colors"
   735→        title="Delete annotation (or press DELETE key)"
   736→      >
   737→        <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
   738→      </button>
   739→    </div>

   741→}
   742→
   743→// ============================================================================
   744→// InlineEditCanvas — media display with all overlay controls
   745→// ============================================================================
   746→
   747→interface InlineEditCanvasProps {
   748→  variant: 'mobile' | 'desktop';
   749→  state: ReturnType<typeof useInlineEditState>;
   750→  media: GenerationRow;
   751→  onClose: () => void;
   752→}
   753→
   754→function InlineEditCanvas({ variant, state, media, onClose }: InlineEditCanvasProps) {
   755→  const isMobileVariant = variant === 'mobile';
   756→
   757→  return (
   758→    <ImageEditProvider value={state.imageEditValue}>
   759→      <MediaDisplayWithCanvas
   760→        effectiveImageUrl={state.effectiveImageUrl}
   761→        thumbUrl={media.thumbnail_url || media.thumbUrl}
   762→        isVideo={state.isVideo}
   763→        onImageLoad={state.setImageDimensions}
   764→        variant={isMobileVariant ? "mobile-stacked" : "desktop-side-panel"}
   765→        containerClassName={isMobileVariant ? "w-full h-full" : "max-w-full max-h-full"}
   766→        debugContext={isMobileVariant ? "Mobile Inline" : "InlineEdit"}
   767→        imageDimensions={state.imageDimensions}
   768→      />
   769→
   770→      {!isMobileVariant && (
   771→        <AnnotationButtons
   772→          selectedShapeId={state.selectedShapeId}
   773→          isAnnotateMode={state.isAnnotateMode}
   774→          brushStrokes={state.brushStrokes}
   775→          getDeleteButtonPosition={state.getDeleteButtonPosition}
   776→          handleToggleFreeForm={state.handleToggleFreeForm}
   777→          handleDeleteSelected={state.handleDeleteSelected}
   778→        />
   779→      )}
   780→
   781→      {state.isSpecialEditMode && (
   782→        <FloatingToolControls
   783→          variant={isMobileVariant ? "mobile" : "tablet"}
   784→        />
   785→      )}
   786→
   787→      <TopRightControls
   788→        isVideo={state.isVideo}
   789→        readOnly={false}
   790→        isSpecialEditMode={state.isSpecialEditMode}
   791→        selectedProjectId={state.selectedProjectId}
   792→        isCloudMode={state.isCloudMode}
   793→        showDownload={true}
   794→        handleDownload={state.handleDownload}
   795→        mediaId={media.id}
   796→        onClose={onClose}
   797→      />
   798→
   799→      <BottomLeftControls
   800→        isVideo={state.isVideo}
   801→        readOnly={false}
   802→        isSpecialEditMode={state.isSpecialEditMode}
   803→        selectedProjectId={state.selectedProjectId}
   804→        isCloudMode={state.isCloudMode}
   805→        handleEnterMagicEditMode={state.handleEnterMagicEditMode}
   806→        isUpscaling={state.isUpscaling}
   807→        handleUpscale={state.handleUpscale}
   808→      />
   809→
   810→      <BottomRightControls
   811→        isVideo={state.isVideo}
   812→        readOnly={false}
   813→        isSpecialEditMode={state.isSpecialEditMode}
   814→        selectedProjectId={state.selectedProjectId}
   815→        isCloudMode={state.isCloudMode}
   816→        localStarred={state.localStarred}
   817→        handleToggleStar={state.handleToggleStar}
   818→        toggleStarPending={state.toggleStarMutation.isPending}
   819→        isAddingToReferences={false}
   820→        addToReferencesSuccess={false}
   821→        handleAddToReferences={() => {}}
   822→      />
   823→    </ImageEditProvider>
   824→  );
   825→}
   826→
   827→// ============================================================================
   828→// InlineEditSidebar — EditModePanel or fallback placeholder
   829→// ============================================================================
   830→
   831→interface InlineEditSidebarProps {
   832→  variant: 'mobile' | 'desktop';
   833→  state: ReturnType<typeof useInlineEditState>;
   834→  media: GenerationRow;
   835→  onClose: () => void;
   836→  onNavigateToGeneration?: (generationId: string) => Promise<void>;
   837→}
   838→
   839→function InlineEditSidebar({ variant, state, media, onClose, onNavigateToGeneration }: InlineEditSidebarProps) {
   840→  if (state.isSpecialEditMode) {
   841→    return (
   842→      <EditModePanel
   843→        variant={variant === 'mobile' ? 'mobile' : 'desktop'}
   844→        hideInfoEditToggle={true}
   845→        simplifiedHeader={true}
   846→        sourceGenerationData={state.sourceGenerationData}
   847→        onOpenExternalGeneration={onNavigateToGeneration ?
   848→          async (id) => onNavigateToGeneration(id) : undefined
   849→        }
   850→        currentMediaId={media.id}
   851→        handleUnifiedGenerate={state.handleUnifiedGenerate}
   852→        handleGenerateAnnotatedEdit={state.handleGenerateAnnotatedEdit}
   853→        handleGenerateReposition={state.handleGenerateReposition}
   854→        handleSaveAsVariant={state.handleSaveAsVariant}
   855→        handleGenerateImg2Img={state.handleGenerateImg2Img}
   856→        img2imgLoraManager={state.img2imgLoraManager}
   857→        availableLoras={state.availableLoras}
   858→        coreState={{ onClose }}
   859→        imageEditState={state.imageEditValue}
   860→      />
   861→    );
   862→  }
   863→
   864→  return (
   865→    <div className="w-full h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 text-center gap-y-4">
   866→      <h3 className="text-xl font-medium">Image Editor</h3>
   867→      <p className="text-muted-foreground">Select an option to start editing</p>
   868→
   869→      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 w-full max-w-xs">

   872→          state.setEditMode('inpaint');

   875→        </Button>
   876→
   877→        <Button onClick={state.handleEnterMagicEditMode} variant="secondary" className="w-full">
   878→          Magic Edit
   879→        </Button>
   880→      </div>
   881→    </div>
   882→  );
   883→}

   454→@@ -0,0 +1,302 @@
   455→+/**
   456→+ * useEditModePanelState
   457→+ *
   458→+ * Encapsulates the non-JSX logic for EditModePanel:
   459→+ * - Props-first state resolution (props override context when provided)
   460→+ * - Local state: prompt-edited tracking, mode-switch LoRA reset
   461→+ * - Mode selector item configuration
   462→+ * - Responsive style helpers
   463→+ *
   464→+ * Keeps EditModePanel as a pure rendering component.
   465→+ */
   466→+
   467→+import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
   468→+import { Paintbrush, Pencil, Type, Move, Wand2, ArrowUp } from 'lucide-react';
   469→+import React from 'react';
   470→+import type { ImageEditState } from '../contexts/ImageEditContext';
   471→+import type { LightboxCoreState, LightboxVariantState } from '../contexts/LightboxStateContext';
   472→+import { useLightboxCoreSafe, useLightboxVariantsSafe } from '../contexts/LightboxStateContext';
   473→+import { useImageEditCanvasSafe } from '../contexts/ImageEditCanvasContext';
   474→+import { useImageEditFormSafe } from '../contexts/ImageEditFormContext';
   475→+import { useImageEditStatusSafe } from '../contexts/ImageEditStatusContext';
   476→+
   477→+// ============================================================================
   478→+// Types
   479→+// ============================================================================
   480→+
   481→+interface UseEditModePanelStateParams {
   482→+  variant: 'desktop' | 'mobile';
   483→+  currentMediaId: string;
   484→+
   485→+  // Cloud mode controls
   486→+  isCloudMode?: boolean;
   487→+  handleUpscale?: () => Promise<void>;
   488→+
   489→+  // Optional state overrides (props-first pattern)
   490→+  coreState?: Pick<LightboxCoreState, 'onClose'>;
   491→+  imageEditState?: ImageEditState;
   492→+  variantsState?: Pick<LightboxVariantState,
   493→+    | 'variants'
   494→+    | 'activeVariant'
   495→+    | 'handleVariantSelect'
   496→+    | 'handleMakePrimary'
   497→+    | 'isLoadingVariants'
   498→+    | 'handlePromoteToGeneration'
   499→+    | 'isPromoting'
   500→+    | 'handleDeleteVariant'
   501→+    | 'onLoadVariantSettings'
   502→+  >;
   503→+}
   504→+
   505→+export interface ModeSelectorItem {
   506→+  id: string;
   507→+  label: string;
   508→+  icon: ReactNode;
   509→+  onClick: () => void;
   510→+}
   511→+
   512→+// ============================================================================
   513→+// Hook
   514→+// ============================================================================
   515→+
   516→+export function useEditModePanelState({
   517→+  variant,
   518→+  currentMediaId,
   519→+  isCloudMode,
   520→+  handleUpscale,
   521→+  coreState,
   522→+  imageEditState,
   523→+  variantsState,
   524→+}: UseEditModePanelStateParams) {
   525→+  const isMobile = variant === 'mobile';
   526→+
   527→+  // ========================================
   528→+  // STATE: Props-first with context fallback
   529→+  // ========================================
   530→+  const contextCore = useLightboxCoreSafe();
   531→+  const contextCanvas = useImageEditCanvasSafe();
   532→+  const contextForm = useImageEditFormSafe();
   533→+  const contextStatus = useImageEditStatusSafe();
   534→+  const contextVariants = useLightboxVariantsSafe();
   535→+
   536→+  // Core state
   537→+  const { onClose } = coreState ?? contextCore;
   538→+
   539→+  // Canvas state (mode, brush, reposition)
   540→+  const {
   541→+    editMode,
   542→+    setEditMode,
   543→+    setIsInpaintMode,
   544→+    brushStrokes,
   545→+    handleExitMagicEditMode,
   546→+    hasTransformChanges,
   547→+  } = imageEditState ?? contextCanvas;
   548→+
   549→+  // Form state (prompts, LoRA, model, settings)
   550→+  const {
   551→+    inpaintPrompt,
   552→+    setInpaintPrompt,
   553→+    inpaintNumGenerations,
   554→+    setInpaintNumGenerations,
   555→+    loraMode,
   556→+    setLoraMode,
   557→+    customLoraUrl,
   558→+    setCustomLoraUrl,
   559→+    createAsGeneration,
   560→+    setCreateAsGeneration,
   561→+    img2imgPrompt,
   562→+    setImg2imgPrompt,
   563→+    img2imgStrength,
   564→+    setImg2imgStrength,
   565→+    setEnablePromptExpansion,
   566→+    qwenEditModel,
   567→+    setQwenEditModel,
   568→+  } = imageEditState ?? contextForm;
   569→+
   570→+  // Generation status
   571→+  const {
   572→+    isGeneratingReposition,
   573→+    repositionGenerateSuccess,
   574→+    isSavingAsVariant,
   575→+    saveAsVariantSuccess,
   576→+    isGeneratingInpaint,
   577→+    inpaintGenerateSuccess,
   578→+    isCreatingMagicEditTasks,
   579→+    magicEditTasksCreated,
   580→+    isGeneratingImg2Img,
   581→+    img2imgGenerateSuccess,
   582→+  } = imageEditState ?? contextStatus;
   583→+
   584→+  // Variants state
   585→+  const {
   586→+    variants,
   587→+    activeVariant,
   588→+    handleVariantSelect: onVariantSelect,
   589→+    handleMakePrimary: onMakePrimary,
   590→+    isLoadingVariants,
   591→+    handlePromoteToGeneration: onPromoteToGeneration,
   592→+    isPromoting,
   593→+    handleDeleteVariant: onDeleteVariant,
   594→+    onLoadVariantSettings,
   595→+  } = variantsState ?? contextVariants;
   596→+
   597→+  const activeVariantId = activeVariant?.id || null;
   598→+
   599→+  // ========================================
   600→+  // LOCAL STATE & EFFECTS
   601→+  // ========================================
   602→+
   603→+  // Track previous edit mode to detect changes
   604→+  const prevEditModeRef = useRef<'text' | 'inpaint' | 'annotate'>(editMode);
   605→+
   606→+  // Track if user has interacted with the prompt field
   607→+  const [hasUserEditedPrompt, setHasUserEditedPrompt] = useState(false);
   608→+
   609→+  // Reset the flag when media changes
   610→+  const prevMediaIdRef = useRef(currentMediaId);
   611→+  useEffect(() => {
   612→+    if (currentMediaId !== prevMediaIdRef.current) {
   613→+      setHasUserEditedPrompt(false);
   614→+      prevMediaIdRef.current = currentMediaId;
   615→+    }
   616→+  }, [currentMediaId]);
   617→+
   618→+  // Auto-reset LoRA mode to "none" when switching to inpaint or annotate
   619→+  useEffect(() => {
   620→+    const prevMode = prevEditModeRef.current;
   621→+    if (prevMode !== editMode && (editMode === 'inpaint' || editMode === 'annotate')) {
   622→+      setLoraMode('none');
   623→+    }
   624→+    prevEditModeRef.current = editMode;
   625→+  }, [editMode, setLoraMode]);
   626→+
   627→+  // ========================================
   628→+  // HANDLERS
   629→+  // ========================================
   630→+
   631→+  const handleClearLora = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
   632→+    e.stopPropagation();
   633→+    setLoraMode('none');
   634→+  };
   635→+
   636→+  // ========================================
   637→+  // MODE SELECTOR ITEMS
   638→+  // ========================================
   639→+
   640→+  const modeSelectorItems: ModeSelectorItem[] = [
   641→+    {
   642→+      id: 'text',
   643→+      label: 'Text',
   644→+      icon: React.createElement(Type),
   645→+      onClick: () => { setIsInpaintMode(true); setEditMode('text'); },
   646→+    },
   647→+    {
   648→+      id: 'inpaint',
   649→+      label: 'Paint',
   650→+      icon: React.createElement(Paintbrush),
   651→+      onClick: () => { setIsInpaintMode(true); setEditMode('inpaint'); },
   652→+    },
   653→+    {
   654→+      id: 'annotate',
   655→+      label: 'Annotate',
   656→+      icon: React.createElement(Pencil),
   657→+      onClick: () => { setIsInpaintMode(true); setEditMode('annotate'); },
   658→+    },
   659→+    {
   660→+      id: 'reposition',
   661→+      label: 'Move',
   662→+      icon: React.createElement(Move),
   663→+      onClick: () => { setIsInpaintMode(true); setEditMode('reposition'); },
   664→+    },
   665→+    {
   666→+      id: 'img2img',
   667→+      label: 'Img2Img',
   668→+      icon: React.createElement(Wand2),
   669→+      onClick: () => { setIsInpaintMode(true); setEditMode('img2img'); },
   670→+    },
   671→+    // Enhance mode (upscale) - only shown when cloud mode is enabled
   672→+    ...(isCloudMode && handleUpscale ? [{
   673→+      id: 'upscale',
   674→+      label: 'Enhance',
   675→+      icon: React.createElement(ArrowUp),
   676→+      onClick: () => { setIsInpaintMode(false); setEditMode('upscale'); },
   677→+    }] : []),
   678→+  ];
   679→+
   680→+  // ========================================
   681→+  // RESPONSIVE STYLES
   682→+  // ========================================
   683→+
   684→+  const labelSize = isMobile ? 'text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground' : 'text-sm';
   685→+  const textareaMinHeight = isMobile ? 'min-h-[50px]' : 'min-h-[100px]';
   686→+  const textareaRows = isMobile ? 2 : 4;
   687→+  const textareaPadding = isMobile ? 'px-2 py-1.5' : 'px-3 py-2';
   688→+  const textareaTextSize = isMobile ? 'text-base' : 'text-sm'; // 16px on mobile prevents iOS zoom
   689→+  const generationsSpacing = isMobile ? 'space-y-0.5' : 'space-y-2';
   690→+
   691→+  return {
   692→+    isMobile,
   693→+    // Core
   694→+    onClose,
   695→+    // Canvas
   696→+    editMode,
   697→+    setEditMode,
   698→+    setIsInpaintMode,
   699→+    brushStrokes,
   700→+    handleExitMagicEditMode,
   701→+    hasTransformChanges,
   702→+    // Form
   703→+    inpaintPrompt,
   704→+    setInpaintPrompt,
   705→+    inpaintNumGenerations,
   706→+    setInpaintNumGenerations,
   707→+    loraMode,
   708→+    setLoraMode,
   709→+    customLoraUrl,
   710→+    setCustomLoraUrl,
   711→+    createAsGeneration,
   712→+    setCreateAsGeneration,
   713→+    img2imgPrompt,
   714→+    setImg2imgPrompt,
   715→+    img2imgStrength,
   716→+    setImg2imgStrength,
   717→+    setEnablePromptExpansion,
   718→+    qwenEditModel,
   719→+    setQwenEditModel,
   720→+    // Status
   721→+    isGeneratingReposition,
   722→+    repositionGenerateSuccess,
   723→+    isSavingAsVariant,
   724→+    saveAsVariantSuccess,
   725→+    isGeneratingInpaint,
   726→+    inpaintGenerateSuccess,
   727→+    isCreatingMagicEditTasks,
   728→+    magicEditTasksCreated,
   729→+    isGeneratingImg2Img,
   730→+    img2imgGenerateSuccess,
   731→+    // Variants
   732→+    variants,
   733→+    activeVariantId,
   734→+    onVariantSelect,
   735→+    onMakePrimary,
   736→+    isLoadingVariants,
   737→+    onPromoteToGeneration,
   738→+    isPromoting,
   739→+    onDeleteVariant,
   740→+    onLoadVariantSettings,
   741→+    // Local state
   742→+    hasUserEditedPrompt,
   743→+    setHasUserEditedPrompt,
   744→+    // Handlers
   745→+    handleClearLora,
   746→+    // Mode selector
   747→+    modeSelectorItems,
   748→+    // Responsive styles
   749→+    labelSize,
   750→+    textareaMinHeight,
   751→+    textareaRows,
   752→+    textareaPadding,
   753→+    textareaTextSize,
   754→+    generationsSpacing,
   755→+  };
   756→+}
   757→diff --git a/src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/hooks/useVideoEditContextValue.ts b/src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/hooks/useVideoEditContextValue.ts
   758→new file mode 100644
   759→index 00000000..109f9311
   760→--- /dev/null
   761→+++ b/src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/hooks/useVideoEditContextValue.ts
   762→@@ -0,0 +1,225 @@
   763→+/**
   764→+ * useVideoEditContextValue
   765→+ *
   766→+ * Assembles the VideoEditState context value from useLightboxVideoMode output
   767→+ * and video enhance settings. Also handles routing variant params to the
   768→+ * correct video edit mode (enhance vs regenerate).
   769→+ *
   770→+ * Extracted from VideoLightbox to keep the component focused on layout/rendering.
   771→+ */
   772→+
   773→+import { useMemo, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
   774→+import type { VideoEditState } from '../contexts/VideoEditContext';
   775→+import type { VideoEnhanceSettings } from './editSettingsTypes';
   776→+
   777→+// ============================================================================
   778→+// Types
   779→+// ============================================================================
   780→+
   781→+type VideoEditSubMode = 'trim' | 'replace' | 'regenerate' | 'enhance' | null;
   782→+
   783→+interface VideoModeOutput {
   784→+  trimVideoRef: React.RefObject<HTMLVideoElement>;
   785→+  trimState: { startTrim: number; endTrim: number; videoDuration: number };
   786→+  trimCurrentTime: number;
   787→+  setTrimCurrentTime: (time: number) => void;
   788→+  trimmedDuration: number;
   789→+  hasTrimChanges: boolean;
   790→+  setStartTrim: (value: number) => void;
   791→+  setEndTrim: (value: number) => void;
   792→+  resetTrim: () => void;
   793→+  setVideoDuration: (duration: number) => void;
   794→+  videoEditing: {
   795→+    videoRef: React.RefObject<HTMLVideoElement>;
   796→+    selections: Array<{ id: string; start: number; end: number }>;
   797→+    activeSelectionId: string | null;
   798→+    handleUpdateSelection: (id: string, start: number, end: number) => void;
   799→+    setActiveSelectionId: (id: string | null) => void;
   800→+    handleRemoveSelection: (id: string) => void;
   801→+    handleAddSelection: () => void;
   802→+  } | null;
   803→+  videoEnhance: {
   804→+    settings: VideoEnhanceSettings;
   805→+    updateSetting: <K extends keyof VideoEnhanceSettings>(key: K, value: VideoEnhanceSettings[K]) => void;
   806→+  };
   807→+  handleEnterVideoEditMode: () => void;
   808→+  handleExitVideoEditMode: () => void;
   809→+  handleEnterVideoTrimMode: () => void;
   810→+  handleEnterVideoReplaceMode: () => void;
   811→+  handleEnterVideoRegenerateMode: () => void;
   812→+  handleEnterVideoEnhanceMode: () => void;
   813→+  isInVideoEditMode: boolean;
   814→+  isVideoTrimModeActive: boolean;
   815→+  isVideoEditModeActive: boolean;
   816→+}
   817→+
   818→+interface UseVideoEditContextValueProps {
   819→+  /** Current video edit sub-mode */
   820→+  videoEditSubMode: VideoEditSubMode;
   821→+  /** Setter for video edit sub-mode (with persistence) */
   822→+  setVideoEditSubMode: (mode: VideoEditSubMode) => void;
   823→+  /** Output from useLightboxVideoMode */
   824→+  videoMode: VideoModeOutput;
   825→+  /** Whether we're in form-only mode (no media) */
   826→+  isFormOnlyMode: boolean;
   827→+
   828→+  // Variant params routing
   829→+  /** Variant params to load into an edit mode */
   830→+  variantParamsToLoad: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   831→+  /** Clear variant params after loading */
   832→+  setVariantParamsToLoad: (params: Record<string, unknown> | null) => void;
   833→+  /** Setter for enhance settings (from persistence) */
   834→+  setEnhanceSettings: (settings: Partial<VideoEnhanceSettings>) => void;
   835→+}
   836→+
   837→+// ============================================================================
   838→+// Hook
   839→+// ============================================================================
   840→+
   841→+export function useVideoEditContextValue(props: UseVideoEditContextValueProps): VideoEditState {
   842→+  const {
   843→+    videoEditSubMode,
   844→+    setVideoEditSubMode,
   845→+    videoMode,
   846→+    isFormOnlyMode,
   847→+    variantParamsToLoad,
   848→+    setVariantParamsToLoad,
   849→+    setEnhanceSettings,
   850→+  } = props;
   851→+
   852→+  const {
   853→+    trimVideoRef,
   854→+    trimState,
   855→+    trimCurrentTime,
   856→+    setTrimCurrentTime,
   857→+    trimmedDuration,
   858→+    hasTrimChanges,
   859→+    setStartTrim,
   860→+    setEndTrim,
   861→+    resetTrim,
   862→+    setVideoDuration,
   863→+    videoEditing,
   864→+    videoEnhance,
   865→+    handleEnterVideoEditMode,
   866→+    handleExitVideoEditMode,
   867→+    handleEnterVideoTrimMode,
   868→+    handleEnterVideoReplaceMode,
   869→+    handleEnterVideoRegenerateMode,
   870→+    handleEnterVideoEnhanceMode,
   871→+    isInVideoEditMode,
   872→+    isVideoTrimModeActive,
   873→+    isVideoEditModeActive,
   874→+  } = videoMode;
   875→+
   876→+  // ========================================
   877→+  // VARIANT PARAMS → EDIT MODE ROUTING
   878→+  // ========================================
   879→+
   880→+  useEffect(() => {

  1524→+ * pending state tracking, and flush-on-unmount/entity-change/beforeunload.
  1525→+ *
  1526→+ * Extracted from useAutoSaveSettings to eliminate duplication between

  1528→+ *
  1529→+ * @internal Used only by useAutoSaveSettings

  1532→+  options: UseDebouncedSettingsSaveOptions<T>
  1533→+): UseDebouncedSettingsSaveReturn<T> {

  1536→+    debounceMs,
  1537→+    status,
  1538→+    flushConfig,
  1539→+    customSaveRef,

    42→  hasInitializedFromPersistence: boolean;
    43→}
    44→
    45→/**
    46→ * Syncs edit settings bidirectionally between persistence layer and UI state.
    47→ * - On load: applies persisted settings to UI (once per generation)
    48→ * - On change: syncs UI changes back to persistence
    49→ */
    50→export function useEditSettingsSync({
    51→  actualGenerationId,
    52→  isEditSettingsReady,
    53→  hasPersistedSettings,
    54→  persistedEditMode,
    55→  persistedNumGenerations,
    56→  persistedPrompt,
    57→  editMode,
    58→  inpaintNumGenerations,
    59→  inpaintPrompt,
    60→  setEditMode,
    61→  setInpaintNumGenerations,
    62→  setInpaintPrompt,
    63→  setPersistedEditMode,
    64→  setPersistedNumGenerations,
    65→  setPersistedPrompt,
    66→}: UseEditSettingsSyncProps): UseEditSettingsSyncReturn {
    67→  // Track if we've synced initial values from persistence to inpainting
    68→  const hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef = useRef(false);
    69→  const lastSyncedGenerationIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
    70→
    71→  // Reset sync tracking when generation changes
    72→  useEffect(() => {
    73→    if (actualGenerationId !== lastSyncedGenerationIdRef.current) {
    74→      hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef.current = false;
    75→      lastSyncedGenerationIdRef.current = actualGenerationId ?? null;
    76→    }
    77→  }, [actualGenerationId]);
    78→
    79→  // Initialize inpainting state from persisted/lastUsed settings (once per generation)
    80→  // IMPORTANT: Wait for isEditSettingsReady to ensure effective values are computed correctly
    81→  useEffect(() => {
    82→    if (
    83→      isEditSettingsReady &&
    84→      !hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef.current &&
    85→      actualGenerationId
    86→    ) {
    87→      hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef.current = true;
    88→
    89→      // Sync edit mode
    90→      if (persistedEditMode && persistedEditMode !== editMode) {
    91→        setEditMode(persistedEditMode);
    92→      }
    93→
    94→      // Sync numGenerations
    95→      if (persistedNumGenerations && persistedNumGenerations !== inpaintNumGenerations) {
    96→        setInpaintNumGenerations(persistedNumGenerations);
    97→      }
    98→
    99→      // Sync prompt (only if has persisted settings - otherwise leave empty)
   100→      if (hasPersistedSettings && persistedPrompt && persistedPrompt !== inpaintPrompt) {
   101→        setInpaintPrompt(persistedPrompt);
   102→      }
   103→    }
   104→  }, [
   105→    isEditSettingsReady,
   106→    actualGenerationId,
   107→    hasPersistedSettings,
   108→    persistedEditMode,
   109→    persistedNumGenerations,
   110→    persistedPrompt,
   111→    editMode,
   112→    inpaintNumGenerations,
   113→    inpaintPrompt,
   114→    setEditMode,
   115→    setInpaintNumGenerations,
   116→    setInpaintPrompt,
   117→  ]);
   118→
   119→  // Sync changes FROM inpainting TO persistence (debounced via the persistence hook)
   120→  useEffect(() => {
   121→    if (!hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef.current || !isEditSettingsReady) return;
   122→
   123→    // Sync editMode changes
   124→    if (editMode !== persistedEditMode) {
   125→      setPersistedEditMode(editMode);
   126→    }
   127→  }, [editMode, persistedEditMode, setPersistedEditMode, isEditSettingsReady]);
   128→
   129→  useEffect(() => {
   130→    if (!hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef.current || !isEditSettingsReady) return;
   131→
   132→    // Sync numGenerations changes
   133→    if (inpaintNumGenerations !== persistedNumGenerations) {
   134→      setPersistedNumGenerations(inpaintNumGenerations);
   135→    }
   136→  }, [inpaintNumGenerations, persistedNumGenerations, setPersistedNumGenerations, isEditSettingsReady]);

   145→  }, [inpaintPrompt, persistedPrompt, setPersistedPrompt, isEditSettingsReady]);

   149→  };

   104→ * - Non-prompt changes also update "last used"
   105→ */
   106→export function useEditSettingsPersistence({
   107→  generationId,
   108→  projectId,
   109→  enabled = true,
   110→}: UseEditSettingsPersistenceProps): UseEditSettingsPersistenceReturn {
   111→  // Per-generation settings
   112→  const generationSettings = useGenerationEditSettings({
   113→    generationId,
   114→    enabled,
   115→  });
   116→
   117→  // "Last used" settings
   118→  const lastUsedSettings = useLastUsedEditSettings({
   119→    projectId,
   120→    enabled,
   121→  });
   122→
   123→  // Track initialization state
   124→  const hasInitializedRef = useRef(false);
   125→  const lastGenerationIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
   126→  const [isReady, setIsReady] = useState(false);
   127→
   128→  // Reset initialization on generation change
   129→  useEffect(() => {
   130→    if (generationId !== lastGenerationIdRef.current) {
   131→      hasInitializedRef.current = false;
   132→      lastGenerationIdRef.current = generationId;
   133→      setIsReady(false);
   134→    }
   135→  }, [generationId]);
   136→
   137→  // Extract stable references for the initialization effect
   138→  const { isLoading: genIsLoading, hasPersistedSettings, initializeFromLastUsed } = generationSettings;
   139→  const { lastUsed } = lastUsedSettings;
   140→
   141→  // Initialize from "last used" when generation loads without persisted settings
   142→  useEffect(() => {
   143→    if (!genIsLoading && !hasInitializedRef.current && !hasPersistedSettings && generationId) {
   144→      hasInitializedRef.current = true;
   145→      // Apply "last used" settings (without prompt)
   146→      initializeFromLastUsed(lastUsed);
   147→      setIsReady(true);
   148→    } else if (!genIsLoading && !hasInitializedRef.current && hasPersistedSettings) {
   149→      hasInitializedRef.current = true;
   150→      setIsReady(true);
   151→    }
   152→  }, [generationId, genIsLoading, hasPersistedSettings, initializeFromLastUsed, lastUsed]);
   153→
   154→  // Compute effective values
   155→  // editMode is ALWAYS from lastUsed (user-level, not per-generation) so it stays consistent across images/videos
   156→  // Other settings like prompt, loraMode are per-generation
   157→  const effectiveSettings = useMemo(() => {
   158→    if (generationSettings.isLoading) {
   159→      // Still loading, use defaults but editMode from lastUsed
   160→      return {
   161→        ...DEFAULT_EDIT_SETTINGS,
   162→        editMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.editMode,
   163→      };
   164→    }
   165→
   166→    if (generationSettings.hasPersistedSettings) {
   167→      // Has persisted settings, use them BUT override editMode with lastUsed (user-level)
   168→      return {
   169→        ...generationSettings.settings,
   170→        editMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.editMode,
   171→      };
   172→    }
   173→
   174→    // No persisted settings yet.
   175→    // Before the coordinator finishes initialization, we use lastUsed as defaults.
   176→    // After initialization, always prefer the live generationSettings state so controls
   177→    // (like the Img2Img strength slider) never feel "locked" while the debounced save runs.
   178→    if (!isReady) {
   179→      return {
   180→        editMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.editMode,
   181→        loraMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.loraMode,
   182→        customLoraUrl: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.customLoraUrl,
   183→        numGenerations: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.numGenerations,
   184→        prompt: generationSettings.settings.prompt || '',
   185→        img2imgPrompt: generationSettings.settings.img2imgPrompt || '',
   186→        img2imgPromptHasBeenSet: generationSettings.settings.img2imgPromptHasBeenSet || false,
   187→        img2imgStrength: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.img2imgStrength,
   188→        img2imgEnablePromptExpansion: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.img2imgEnablePromptExpansion,
   189→        advancedSettings: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.advancedSettings ?? DEFAULT_ADVANCED_SETTINGS,
   190→        createAsGeneration: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.createAsGeneration,
   191→      };
   192→    }
   193→
   194→    // Initialized: use the live per-generation state BUT override editMode with lastUsed (user-level)
   195→    return {
   196→      ...generationSettings.settings,
   197→      editMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.editMode,
   198→    };
   199→  }, [
   200→    isReady,
   201→    generationSettings.isLoading,
   202→    generationSettings.hasPersistedSettings,
   203→    generationSettings.settings,
   204→    lastUsedSettings.lastUsed,
   205→  ]);
   206→
   207→  // Extract stable function references to avoid recreating callbacks on every render
   208→  // (the parent objects are recreated each render, but these functions are stable)
   209→  const { updateLastUsed } = lastUsedSettings;
   210→  const {
   211→    setLoraMode: genSetLoraMode,
   212→    setCustomLoraUrl: genSetCustomLoraUrl,
   213→    setNumGenerations: genSetNumGenerations,
   214→    setPrompt: genSetPrompt,
   215→    setQwenEditModel: genSetQwenEditModel,
   216→    setImg2imgPrompt: genSetImg2imgPrompt,
   217→    setImg2imgStrength: genSetImg2imgStrength,
   218→    setImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion: genSetImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion,
   219→    setAdvancedSettings: genSetAdvancedSettings,
   220→    setEnhanceSettings: genSetEnhanceSettings,
   221→    setCreateAsGeneration: genSetCreateAsGeneration,
   222→  } = generationSettings;
   223→
   224→  // Wrapper setters that also update "last used" (except prompt)
   225→  // editMode is user-level only (not per-generation) so it stays consistent across images/videos
   226→  const setEditMode = useCallback((mode: EditMode) => {
   227→    updateLastUsed({ editMode: mode });
   228→  }, [updateLastUsed]);
   229→
   230→  const setLoraMode = useCallback((mode: LoraMode) => {
   231→    genSetLoraMode(mode);
   232→    updateLastUsed({ loraMode: mode });
   233→  }, [genSetLoraMode, updateLastUsed]);
   234→
   235→  const setCustomLoraUrl = useCallback((url: string) => {
   236→    genSetCustomLoraUrl(url);
   237→    updateLastUsed({ customLoraUrl: url });
   238→  }, [genSetCustomLoraUrl, updateLastUsed]);
   239→
   240→  const setNumGenerations = useCallback((num: number) => {
   241→    genSetNumGenerations(num);
   242→    updateLastUsed({ numGenerations: num });
   243→  }, [genSetNumGenerations, updateLastUsed]);
   244→
   245→  // Prompt only saves to generation (never to "last used")
   246→  const setPrompt = useCallback((prompt: string) => {
   247→    genSetPrompt(prompt);
   248→  }, [genSetPrompt]);
   249→
   250→  // Model selection (saves to generation, cloud mode only)
   251→  const setQwenEditModel = useCallback((model: QwenEditModel) => {
   252→    genSetQwenEditModel(model);
   253→  }, [genSetQwenEditModel]);
   254→
   255→  // Img2Img prompt only saves to generation (never to "last used")
   256→  const setImg2imgPrompt = useCallback((prompt: string) => {
   257→    genSetImg2imgPrompt(prompt);
   258→  }, [genSetImg2imgPrompt]);
   259→
   260→  // Img2Img setters (save to both generation and "last used")
   261→  const setImg2imgStrength = useCallback((strength: number) => {
   262→    genSetImg2imgStrength(strength);
   263→    updateLastUsed({ img2imgStrength: strength });
   264→  }, [genSetImg2imgStrength, updateLastUsed]);
   265→
   266→  const setImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion = useCallback((enabled: boolean) => {
   267→    genSetImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion(enabled);
   268→    updateLastUsed({ img2imgEnablePromptExpansion: enabled });
   269→  }, [genSetImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion, updateLastUsed]);
   270→
   271→  // Advanced settings setter (merges with existing, saves to both generation and "last used")
   272→  const setAdvancedSettings = useCallback((updates: Partial<EditAdvancedSettings>) => {
   273→    genSetAdvancedSettings(updates);
   274→    // Merge updates with current advancedSettings for lastUsed
   275→    const currentAdvanced = effectiveSettings.advancedSettings ?? DEFAULT_ADVANCED_SETTINGS;
   276→    updateLastUsed({ advancedSettings: { ...currentAdvanced, ...updates } });
   277→  }, [genSetAdvancedSettings, updateLastUsed, effectiveSettings.advancedSettings]);
   278→
   279→  // Video enhance settings setter (per-generation only, not "last used")
   280→  const setEnhanceSettings = useCallback((updates: Partial<VideoEnhanceSettings>) => {
   281→    genSetEnhanceSettings(updates);
   282→  }, [genSetEnhanceSettings]);
   283→
   284→  // Generation options setter (saves to both generation and "last used")
   285→  const setCreateAsGeneration = useCallback((value: boolean) => {
   286→    genSetCreateAsGeneration(value);
   287→    updateLastUsed({ createAsGeneration: value });
   288→  }, [genSetCreateAsGeneration, updateLastUsed]);
   289→
   290→  // Video/Panel mode setters (only save to "last used", not per-generation)
   291→  const setVideoEditSubMode = useCallback((mode: VideoEditSubMode) => {
   292→    updateLastUsed({ videoEditSubMode: mode });
   293→  }, [updateLastUsed]);
   294→
   295→  const setPanelMode = useCallback((mode: PanelMode) => {
   296→    updateLastUsed({ panelMode: mode });
   297→  }, [updateLastUsed]);
   298→
   299→  // Computed LoRAs based on mode (replaces useEditModeLoRAs logic)
   300→  const editModeLoRAs = useMemo(() => {
   301→    const { loraMode, customLoraUrl } = effectiveSettings;
   302→
   303→    switch (loraMode) {
   304→      case 'in-scene':
   305→        return [{ url: LORA_URLS['in-scene'], strength: 1.0 }];
   306→      case 'next-scene':
   307→        return [{ url: LORA_URLS['next-scene'], strength: 1.0 }];
   308→      case 'custom':
   309→        return customLoraUrl.trim()
   310→          ? [{ url: customLoraUrl.trim(), strength: 1.0 }]
   311→          : undefined;
   312→      case 'none':
   313→      default:
   314→        return undefined;
   315→    }
   316→  }, [effectiveSettings.loraMode, effectiveSettings.customLoraUrl]);
   317→
   318→  // Legacy compatibility
   319→  const isInSceneBoostEnabled = effectiveSettings.loraMode !== 'none';
   320→  const setIsInSceneBoostEnabled = (enabled: boolean) => {
   321→    setLoraMode(enabled ? 'in-scene' : 'none');
   322→  };
   323→
   324→  return {
   325→    // Current values (using effective settings to avoid race condition)
   326→    editMode: effectiveSettings.editMode,
   327→    loraMode: effectiveSettings.loraMode,
   328→    customLoraUrl: effectiveSettings.customLoraUrl,
   329→    numGenerations: effectiveSettings.numGenerations,
   330→    prompt: effectiveSettings.prompt,
   331→    // Img2Img values
   332→    img2imgPrompt: effectiveSettings.img2imgPrompt,
   333→    img2imgPromptHasBeenSet: effectiveSettings.img2imgPromptHasBeenSet,
   334→    img2imgStrength: effectiveSettings.img2imgStrength,
   335→    img2imgEnablePromptExpansion: effectiveSettings.img2imgEnablePromptExpansion,
   336→    // Advanced settings (hires fix config)
   337→    advancedSettings: effectiveSettings.advancedSettings ?? DEFAULT_ADVANCED_SETTINGS,
   338→    // Video enhance settings (interpolation/upscaling)
   339→    enhanceSettings: effectiveSettings.enhanceSettings ?? DEFAULT_ENHANCE_SETTINGS,
   340→    // Model selection for cloud mode
   341→    qwenEditModel: effectiveSettings.qwenEditModel ?? 'qwen-edit',
   342→    // Generation options
   343→    createAsGeneration: effectiveSettings.createAsGeneration ?? false,
   344→
   345→    // Setters
   346→    setEditMode,
   347→    setLoraMode,
   348→    setCustomLoraUrl,
   349→    setNumGenerations,
   350→    setPrompt,
   351→    setQwenEditModel,
   352→    // Img2Img setters
   353→    setImg2imgPrompt,
   354→    setImg2imgStrength,
   355→    setImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion,
   356→    // Advanced settings setter
   357→    setAdvancedSettings,
   358→    // Video enhance settings setter
   359→    setEnhanceSettings,
   360→    // Generation options setter
   361→    setCreateAsGeneration,
   362→
   363→    // Video/Panel mode (from "last used")
   364→    videoEditSubMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.videoEditSubMode,
   365→    panelMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.panelMode,
   366→    setVideoEditSubMode,
   367→    setPanelMode,
   368→
   369→    // Computed
   370→    editModeLoRAs,
   371→
   372→    // Legacy
   373→    isInSceneBoostEnabled,
   374→    setIsInSceneBoostEnabled,
   375→
   376→    // State
   377→    isLoading: generationSettings.isLoading,
   378→    isReady,
   379→    hasPersistedSettings: generationSettings.hasPersistedSettings,
   380→  };
   381→}
   382→
   383→// Re-export types for convenience
   384→export type { EditMode, LoraMode, QwenEditModel, EditAdvancedSettings, VideoEnhanceSettings, GenerationEditSettings, LastUsedEditSettings, VideoEditSubMode, PanelMode };
   385→

   152→
   153→// ============================================================================
   154→// Context + Hook
   155→// ============================================================================
   156→
   157→const ImageEditCanvasContext = createContext<ImageEditCanvasState | null>(null);
   158→
   159→interface ImageEditCanvasProviderProps {

   163→

1→/**
     2→ * ImageEditContext — Composed provider for all image edit state.
     3→ *
     4→ * Splits state into three sub-contexts by concern:
     5→ *   - ImageEditCanvasContext: mode, brush, annotation, canvas, reposition, display
     6→ *   - ImageEditFormContext: prompts, strengths, LoRA, model, advanced settings
     7→ *   - ImageEditStatusContext: generation loading/success flags
     8→ *
     9→ * The split reduces re-renders: canvas components don't re-render when the user
    10→ * types in a prompt field, and form components don't re-render on brush strokes.
    11→ *
    12→ * For backward compatibility, ImageEditState and useImageEditSafe() still exist
    13→ * and return the full merged state. Components should migrate to the specific
    14→ * sub-context hooks (useImageEditCanvasSafe, useImageEditFormSafe,
    15→ * useImageEditStatusSafe) for optimal performance.
    16→ */
    17→

    23→  ImageEditCanvasProvider,

    35→  useImageEditStatusSafe,
    36→  type ImageEditStatusState,

    38→
    39→// Re-export sub-context types and hooks for direct consumption

    41→export { useImageEditCanvasSafe, useImageEditFormSafe, useImageEditStatusSafe };

    47→

    53→export type ImageEditState =

    92→    // Brush tool

    83→export function useDebouncedSettingsSave<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
    84→  options: UseDebouncedSettingsSaveOptions<T>
    85→): UseDebouncedSettingsSaveReturn<T> {

    87→    entityId,

Now I see a critical issue. Let me look at the `scheduleSave` inside `updateField`/`updateFields` more carefully. In the old code, the `editVersionAtStart` was captured *before* the setTimeout was created, at the point when `updateField` was called. In the new code:

1. `incrementEditVersion()` is called before `setSettings`
2. `scheduleSave` captures `editVersionRef.current` at the time *it* runs (inside the `setSettings` updater)

But wait - `scheduleSave` reads `editVersionRef.current` synchronously when called. Let me trace through this more carefully.

Old code flow:
1. `editVersionRef.current += 1` -> e.g., becomes 5
2. `const editVersionAtStart = editVersionRef.current` -> captures 5
3. `setSettings(prev => { ... setTimeout(async () => { ... if (editVersionRef.current === editVersionAtStart) ... }, debounceMs) ... })`

New code flow:
1. `debouncedSave.incrementEditVersion()` -> editVersionRef becomes 5, returns 5 (but return value is not captured by caller!)
2. `setSettings(prev => { ... debouncedSave.scheduleSave(entityId) ... })`
3. Inside `scheduleSave`: `const editVersionAtStart = editVersionRef.current` -> captures 5

This is functionally equivalent because `incrementEditVersion` runs synchronously before `scheduleSave`, and both access the same ref. The edit version is 5 at both points. SAFE.

But wait - there's a subtle difference. In the old code, if `status` wasn't 'ready' or 'saving', it would still capture the editVersionAtStart and set up the timeout. The early return just skipped the setTimeout. In the new code, `scheduleSave` returns early if status isn't ready/saving, which means the timeout isn't set. But `trackPendingUpdate` still runs, so the pending state is correctly tracked. This matches the old behavior where `pendingSettingsRef.current = updated` was set regardless of status.

Returns the new video's ID. */\n  const uploadVideoFile = async (file: File, userId: string): Promise<string> => {\n    const duration = await getVideoDuration(file);\n\n    const fileExt = file.name.split('.').pop();\n    const fileName = `${userId}/${Date.now()}.${fileExt}`;\n\n    const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage\n      .from('training-data')\n      .upload(fileName, file);\n\n    if (uploadError) {\n      console.error('[Upload] Storage upload error:', uploadError);\n      throw uploadError;\n    }\n\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n      .from('training_data')\n      .insert({\n        user_id: userId,\n        batch_id: selectedBatchId!,\n        original_filename: file.name,\n        storage_location: fileName,\n        duration: Math.round(duration),\n        metadata: {\n          size: file.size,\n          type: file.type,\n        },\n      })\n      .select()\n      .single();\n\n    if (error) {\n      console.error('[Upload] Database insert error:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    setVideos(prev => [transformVideo(data), ...prev]);\n    return data.id;\n  };\n\n  /** Create a segment for a video, resolving null endTimeMs from the video's duration. */\n  const createSegmentForVideo = async (\n    videoId: string,\n    startTimeMs: number,\n    endTimeMs: number | null,\n    description: string,\n  ) => {\n    if (endTimeMs === null) {\n      const localVideo = videos.find(v => v.id === videoId);\n      if (localVideo?.duration) {\n        endTimeMs = Math.round(localVideo.duration * 1000);\n      } else {\n        const { data, error } = await supabase\n          .from('training_data')\n          .select('duration')\n          .eq('id', videoId)\n          .single();\n\n        if (!error && data?.duration) {\n          endTimeMs = Math.round(data.duration * 1000);\n        } else {\n          endTimeMs = 10000;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    await createSegment(videoId, startTimeMs, endTimeMs, description);\n  };\n\n  /** Upload a single video file. Wraps uploadVideoFile with auth + batch checks. */\n  const uploadVideo = async (file: File): Promise<string> => {\n    setIsUploading(true);\n    try {\n      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n      if (!user) throw new Error('User not authenticated');\n\n      if (!selectedBatchId) {\n        throw new Error('Please select a batch first');\n      }\n\n      return await uploadVideoFile(file, user.id);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[Upload] Error uploading video:', error);\n      throw error;\n    } finally {\n      setIsUploading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  /** Upload multiple videos, optionally creating segments based on each file's split mode. */\n  const uploadVideosWithSplitModes = async (videoFiles: Array<{\n    file: File;\n    splitMode: 'take-all' | 'manual' | 'auto-scene';\n    detectedScenes?: number[];\n  }>): Promise<void> => {\n    setIsUploading(true);\n    try {\n      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n      if (!user) throw new Error('User not authenticated');\n\n      if (!selectedBatchId) {\n        throw new Error('Please select a batch first');\n      }\n\n      for (const videoFile of videoFiles) {\n        const videoId = await uploadVideoFile(videoFile.file, user.id);\n\n        switch (videoFile.splitMode) {\n          case 'take-all':\n            await createSegmentForVideo(videoId, 0, null, 'Full video segment');\n            break;\n\n          case 'auto-scene':\n            if (videoFile.detectedScenes && videoFile.detectedScenes.length > 1) {\n              for (let i = 0; i < videoFile.detectedScenes.length - 1; i++) {\n                const startTime = videoFile.detectedScenes[i];\n                const endTime = videoFile.detectedScenes[i + 1];\n                await createSegmentForVideo(\n                  videoId,\n                  Math.round(startTime * 1000),\n                  Math.round(endTime * 1000),\n                  `Auto-detected scene ${i + 1}`,\n                );\n              }\n            } else {\n              await createSegmentForVideo(videoId, 0, null, 'Auto-scene fallback (full video)');\n            }\n            break;\n\n          case 'manual':\n            // Don't create any segments - user will do it manually\n            break;\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Refresh videos to ensure they're properly loaded\n      await Promise.all([fetchVideos(), fetchSegments()]);\n\n      // Give a small delay to ensure DB has fully processed\n      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500));\n\n      // Refresh one more time to ensure URLs are generated\n      await fetchVideos();\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error uploading videos:', error);\n      throw error;\n    } finally {\n      setIsUploading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return {\n    isUploading,\n    uploadVideo,\n    uploadVideosWithSplitModes,\n  };\n}\n"

   101→      crud.updateProject,
   102→      crud.isUpdatingProject,
   103→      crud.deleteProject,
   104→      crud.isDeletingProject,
   105→      userId,
   106→    ]
   107→  );
   108→
   109→  return (
   110→    <ProjectContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
   111→      {children}
   112→    </ProjectContext.Provider>
   113→  );
   114→};
   115→
   116→export const useProject = () => {
   117→  const context = useContext(ProjectContext);
   118→  if (context === undefined) {
   119→    const errorMessage = 'useProject must be used within a ProjectProvider. ' +
   120→      'Make sure the component is rendered inside the ProjectProvider tree. ' +
   121→      'Check that the component is not being rendered outside of App.tsx or in an error boundary that is outside the provider.';
   122→    console.error('[ProjectContext]', errorMessage, {
   123→      stack: new Error().stack,
   124→      windowLocation: typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.href : 'N/A'
   125→    });
   126→    throw new Error(errorMessage);
   127→  }
   128→  return context;
   129→};

1→import { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
     2→import { Project } from '@/types/project';
     3→import { handleError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandler';
     4→import { preloadingService } from '@/shared/lib/preloading';
     5→import { UserPreferences } from '@/shared/settings/userPreferences';
     6→import { determineProjectIdToSelect } from './useProjectCRUD';
     7→
     8→interface UseProjectSelectionOptions {
     9→  userId: string | null;
    10→  userPreferences: UserPreferences | undefined;
    11→  isLoadingPreferences: boolean;
    12→  updateUserSettings: (scope: 'user', patch: Partial<UserPreferences>) => Promise<void>;
    13→}
    14→
    15→/**
    16→ * Manages which project is selected, including:
    17→ * - Fast resume from localStorage
    18→ * - Cross-device sync from server preferences
    19→ * - Persistence to both localStorage and server
    20→ */
    21→export function useProjectSelection({
    22→  userId,
    23→  userPreferences,
    24→  isLoadingPreferences,
    25→  updateUserSettings,
    26→}: UseProjectSelectionOptions) {
    27→  // CROSS-DEVICE SYNC: Track if we had a localStorage value at startup
    28→  const hadLocalStorageValueRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
    29→  const hasAppliedServerPreferencesRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
    30→
    31→  // FAST RESUME: Try to restore selectedProjectId from localStorage immediately
    32→  const [selectedProjectId, setSelectedProjectIdState] = useState<string | null>(() => {
    33→    try {
    34→      const stored = localStorage.getItem('lastSelectedProjectId');
    35→      if (stored) {
    36→        hadLocalStorageValueRef.current = true;
    37→        return stored;
    38→      } else {
    39→        hadLocalStorageValueRef.current = false;
    40→      }
    41→    } catch (e) {
    42→      console.error('[ProjectContext:FastResume] localStorage access failed:', e);
    43→      hadLocalStorageValueRef.current = false;
    44→    }
    45→    return null;
    46→  });
    47→
    48→  // Keep a ref for synchronous access to latest preferences
    49→  const userPreferencesRef = useRef(userPreferences);
    50→  useEffect(() => {
    51→    userPreferencesRef.current = userPreferences;
    52→  }, [userPreferences]);
    53→
    54→  // CROSS-DEVICE SYNC: Reset sync flag when user logs out
    55→  useEffect(() => {
    56→    if (!userId) {
    57→      hasAppliedServerPreferencesRef.current = false;
    58→    }
    59→  }, [userId]);
    60→
    61→  // CROSS-DEVICE SYNC: When preferences load on a new device (no localStorage),
    62→  // update the selected project to match the server's lastOpenedProjectId
    63→  const applyCrossDeviceSync = useCallback((projects: Project[]) => {
    64→    if (hadLocalStorageValueRef.current) return;
    65→    if (hasAppliedServerPreferencesRef.current) return;
    66→    if (isLoadingPreferences || !userPreferences) return;
    67→    if (!projects.length) return;
    68→
    69→    const serverLastOpenedId = userPreferences.lastOpenedProjectId;
    70→
    71→    if (serverLastOpenedId && serverLastOpenedId !== selectedProjectId) {
    72→      const projectExists = projects.some(p => p.id === serverLastOpenedId);
    73→      if (projectExists) {
    74→        setSelectedProjectIdState(serverLastOpenedId);
    75→        try {
    76→          localStorage.setItem('lastSelectedProjectId', serverLastOpenedId);
    77→        } catch (e) {
    78→          handleError(e, { context: 'ProjectContext.crossDeviceSync', showToast: false });
    79→        }
    80→      }
    81→    }
    82→
    83→    hasAppliedServerPreferencesRef.current = true;
    84→  }, [isLoadingPreferences, userPreferences, selectedProjectId]);
    85→
    86→  const handleSetSelectedProjectId = useCallback((projectId: string | null) => {
    87→    preloadingService.onProjectChange(projectId);
    88→
    89→    setSelectedProjectIdState(projectId);
    90→
    91→    if (projectId) {
    92→      try {
    93→        localStorage.setItem('lastSelectedProjectId', projectId);
    94→      } catch (e) {
    95→        handleError(e, { context: 'ProjectContext.fastResume', showToast: false });
    96→      }
    97→      updateUserSettings('user', { lastOpenedProjectId: projectId });
    98→    } else {
    99→      try {
   100→        localStorage.removeItem('lastSelectedProjectId');
   101→      } catch (e) {
   102→        handleError(e, { context: 'ProjectContext.fastResume', showToast: false });
   103→      }
   104→      updateUserSettings('user', { lastOpenedProjectId: undefined });
   105→    }
   106→  }, [updateUserSettings]);
   107→
   108→  /** Called when projects are loaded — decides which project to select. */
   109→  const handleProjectsLoaded = useCallback((projects: Project[], isNewDefault: boolean) => {
   110→    if (isNewDefault) {
   111→      // Brand new default project: select it directly
   112→      handleSetSelectedProjectId(projects[0].id);
   113→    } else {
   114→      const lastOpenedProjectId = userPreferencesRef.current?.lastOpenedProjectId;
   115→      const projectIdToSelect = determineProjectIdToSelect(projects, selectedProjectId, lastOpenedProjectId);
   116→
   117→      if (projectIdToSelect !== selectedProjectId) {
   118→        handleSetSelectedProjectId(projectIdToSelect);
   119→      }
   120→    }
   121→  }, [selectedProjectId, handleSetSelectedProjectId]);
   122→
   123→  /** Called after a new project is created. */
   124→  const handleProjectCreated = useCallback((project: Project) => {
   125→    handleSetSelectedProjectId(project.id);
   126→  }, [handleSetSelectedProjectId]);
   127→
   128→  /** Called after a project is deleted — selects the next project. */
   129→  const handleProjectDeleted = useCallback((remainingProjects: Project[]) => {
   130→    const nextProjectId = determineProjectIdToSelect(remainingProjects, null, null);
   131→    setSelectedProjectIdState(nextProjectId);
   132→
   133→    if (nextProjectId) {
   134→      updateUserSettings('user', { lastOpenedProjectId: nextProjectId });
   135→    } else {
   136→      updateUserSettings('user', { lastOpenedProjectId: undefined });
   137→    }
   138→  }, [updateUserSettings]);
   139→
   140→  return {
   141→    selectedProjectId,
   142→    setSelectedProjectId: handleSetSelectedProjectId,
   143→    applyCrossDeviceSync,
   144→    handleProjectsLoaded,
   145→    handleProjectCreated,
   146→    handleProjectDeleted,
   147→    userPreferencesRef,
   148→  };
   149→}
   150→

    75→      setLocks({
